Benchmarks/PPL/AtomicActions.v:
(** * All four relational action rules, through generated graph certificates. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition edge := action_relation Acquire tt 0 1.
Definition extended := action_label Empty 0 1.

Definition br_root := Jdg [assertion l0 safe]
  [assertion (Join Empty l0) (Box (act Acquire) (First safe))].
Definition br := requested br_root (AtomicEigen OnRight 0 1) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition br_after := premise_at br 0.
Definition br_head := Rdg br_after.(relations) br_after.(antecedent) [assertion (Join l0 l1) (First safe)].
Definition br_unit := requested br_after (UnitLabels br_head [false] true true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition br_first := requested br_head (Local OnRight 0 "First.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition br_leaf := premise_at br_first 0.
Definition br_ax := generated_axiom br_leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition br_build := Cyclic.run_script br_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 br;Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 br_unit;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 2 br_first;Cyclic.CloseWith 3 br_ax].
Theorem atomic_box_right_valid : Cyclic.Valid br_root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound br_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example br_exact_premise : br_after = Rdg [edge] [assertion l0 safe] [assertion extended (First safe)].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition bl_root := Rdg [edge] [assertion (Join Empty l0) (Box (act Acquire) safe)] [assertion extended safe].
Definition bl := requested bl_root (AtomicUse OnLeft 0 0) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition bl_leaf := premise_at bl 0.
Definition bl_ax := generated_axiom bl_leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition bl_build := Cyclic.run_script bl_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 bl;Cyclic.CloseWith 1 bl_ax].
Theorem atomic_box_left_valid : Cyclic.Valid bl_root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound bl_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example bl_consumes_relation : bl_leaf = Jdg [assertion extended safe] [assertion extended safe]. Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition dr_root := Rdg [edge] [assertion extended safe]
  [assertion (Join Empty l0) (Diamond (act Acquire) safe)].
Definition dr := requested dr_root (AtomicUse OnRight 0 0) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dr_leaf := premise_at dr 0.
Definition dr_ax := generated_axiom dr_leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dr_build := Cyclic.run_script dr_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 dr;Cyclic.CloseWith 1 dr_ax].
Theorem atomic_diamond_right_valid : Cyclic.Valid dr_root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound dr_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example dr_consumes_relation : dr_leaf = Jdg [assertion extended safe] [assertion extended safe]. Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition dl_root := Jdg [assertion (Join Empty l0) (Diamond (act Acquire) safe)] [assertion l0 safe].
Definition dl := requested dl_root (AtomicEigen OnLeft 0 1) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dl_after := premise_at dl 0.
Definition dl_head := Rdg dl_after.(relations) [assertion (Join l0 l1) safe] dl_after.(succedent).
Definition dl_unit := requested dl_after (UnitLabels dl_head [false] true true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dl_at := requested dl_head (Local OnLeft 0 "At.L") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dl_leaf := premise_at dl_at 0.
Definition dl_ax := generated_axiom dl_leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition dl_build := Cyclic.run_script dl_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 dl;Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 dl_unit;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 2 dl_at;Cyclic.CloseWith 3 dl_ax].
Theorem atomic_diamond_left_valid : Cyclic.Valid dl_root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound dl_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.

Example stale_successor_rejected : someb (generate_requested br_root (AtomicEigen OnRight 0 0)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition unrelated_relation_goal := Rdg [CustomRelation SameState [StateLabel 2;StateLabel 2]]
  [assertion l0 safe] [assertion (Join Empty l0) (Box (act Acquire) (First safe))].
Example freshness_scans_relation_arguments : someb (generate_requested unrelated_relation_goal (AtomicEigen OnRight 0 2)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition wrong_action := Rdg [action_relation Stutter tt 0 1] bl_root.(antecedent) bl_root.(succedent).
Example wrong_action_rejected : someb (generate_requested wrong_action (AtomicUse OnLeft 0 0)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition wrong_source := Rdg [action_relation Acquire tt 1 0] bl_root.(antecedent) bl_root.(succedent).
Example wrong_source_rejected : someb (generate_requested wrong_source (AtomicUse OnLeft 0 0)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example missing_relation_rejected : someb (generate_requested (Jdg dr_root.(antecedent) dr_root.(succedent)) (AtomicUse OnRight 0 0)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example finite_scan_includes_action_rule :
  existsb (fun r => String.eqb r.(Cyclic.rule_name) "B.Atomic.R") (generate_rules br_root) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M br_root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition transition_world : world M.
Proof. refine (World M (fun x => if Nat.eqb x 0 then Idle else Held) (fun _ => [Idle]) _); discriminate. Defined.
Example live_transition : relations_hold M transition_world [edge].
Proof. constructor; [apply action_relation_holds; split; auto|constructor]. Qed.
Example live_antecedent : left_holds M transition_world dr_root.(antecedent).
Proof. repeat constructor; discriminate. Qed.
Print Assumptions atomic_box_right_valid.
Print Assumptions atomic_box_left_valid.
Print Assumptions atomic_diamond_right_valid.
Print Assumptions atomic_diamond_left_valid.
Print Assumptions box_atomic_right.

Example br_graph_nodes : List.length br_build.(Cyclic.built_graph).(Cyclic.graph_nodes) = 4.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example br_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags br_build.(Cyclic.built_graph)) = 0.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.

Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.

Example dr_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags dr_build.(Cyclic.built_graph)) = 0.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.

Benchmarks/PPL/Booleans.v:
(** * A first complete generated proof script

    Prove [modal -> modal or not modal] without unfolding the modality.
    Read the successive goal/rule/leaf definitions, then the script: node 0
    uses implication-right, node 1 disjunction-right, and node 2 identity.
    [vm_compute] verifies these fixed choices; it does not search for them. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition modal := Box (Test Truth) Truth.
Definition root := Jdg [] [assertion l0 (Impl modal (Disj modal (Neg modal)))].
Definition impl_rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "Impl.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition disj_goal := premise_at impl_rule 0.
Definition disj_rule := requested disj_goal (Local OnRight 0 "Or.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at disj_rule 0.
Definition ax := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Node indices follow the builder's allocation order. This graph is acyclic,
    so the witness can select no trace tags. [raw_check_sound] still verifies
    both graph consistency and the semantic records stored at its nodes. *)
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 impl_rule;Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 disj_rule;Cyclic.CloseWith 2 ax].
Theorem mixed_boolean_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions mixed_boolean_valid.
Benchmarks/PPL/CheckerNegative.v:
(** * Why building a graph is weaker than certifying it

    All local rule records below have genuine semantic proofs. We deliberately
    arrange malformed or nonprogressing graphs around them to show which
    builder/structural/witness checks reject them. No invalid soundness lemma
    is postulated, and a successful [build_ok] is never used as validity. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition root := Jdg [] [traced l0 (Box (Test Truth) Falsity) 0].
Definition exact := requested root (BacklinkExact root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Identity followed by a backlink makes a closed, structurally correct
    cycle, but provides no strict semantic decrease. Constant potentials
    cannot justify its nonprogressing loop, so the full raw check rejects it. *)
Definition cyclic_build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 0 exact].
Definition cyclic_graph := cyclic_build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun _ => Some 0; Cyclic.witness_potential := fun _ => 0 |}.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_builds : cyclic_build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_is_structural : Cyclic.structural_check cyclic_graph = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check cyclic_graph witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example open_node_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check (Cyclic.start_graph root) witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition dangling : Cyclic.graph := {| Cyclic.graph_root := root;
  Cyclic.graph_nodes := [{| Cyclic.node_judgment := root; Cyclic.node_payload := Cyclic.RuleNode exact [99] |}] |}.
Example dangling_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check dangling witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition bad_edge : Cyclic.edge_info := {| Cyclic.edge_valid := [(99,99)]; Cyclic.edge_progress := [] |}.
(** The absent tag 99 has fallback rank zero on both sides, so this identity
    edge satisfies the purely semantic inequalities. Its endpoint metadata is
    nevertheless syntactically invalid: tag 99 occurs in neither judgment.
    This separates semantic record construction from edge well-formedness,
    which both the generator boundary and full checker must enforce. *)
Definition malformed_tag_rule : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (counter_rule "Negative.absent-tag" root root bad_edge).
  intros w H; exists w; split; [exact H|]. split.
  - intros a b [Heq|Hno]; [inversion Heq; subst; apply Nat.le_refl|contradiction].
  - intros a b Hno; contradiction.
Defined.
Definition malformed_build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 malformed_tag_rule;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 0 exact].
Example malformed_tag_graph_builds : malformed_build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example malformed_tag_edge_rejected :
  Cyclic.raw_check malformed_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) witness = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example generator_boundary_rejects_absent_tags : someb (ensure_rule root (Some malformed_tag_rule)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Builder failures are more immediate: a closing record must have the
    node's exact conclusion, and a backlink must name an eligible earlier
    companion. Logical truth of some other judgment cannot repair a mismatch. *)
Definition true_root := Jdg [] [assertion l0 Truth].
Definition true_axiom := generated_axiom true_root ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Example mismatched_axiom_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.CloseWith 0 true_axiom]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example mismatched_rule_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script true_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example wrong_companion_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 1 exact]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.

Definition relational_root := Rdg [action_relation Acquire tt 0 1] root.(antecedent) root.(succedent).
Definition forget_relation := requested relational_root (WeakenRelation 0) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Example relations_cannot_be_ignored_by_backlinks :
  (Cyclic.run_script relational_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 forget_relation;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 0 exact]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Benchmarks/PPL/Cyclic.v:
(** * An explicit cyclic star certificate

    This example is best read after Booleans.v and AssignmentChange.v. Follow
    the named intermediate goals, then the manual script and witness. Star
    unfolding creates a finite base branch and a recurrent assignment branch;
    substitutions bring that branch back to an earlier exact judgment.
    The source-level proof never invokes a graph or witness search. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

(** A real star cycle: an initial-state observation remains true while an
    arbitrary finite number of atomic steps execute. This is a prefix property;
    the separate counter-loop benchmark checks every visited state. *)
Definition action := act Cycle.
Definition body := First safe.
(** The label already has an initial state, a nonempty trace-variable prefix
    extension, and a final state. The antecedent asserts the observation only
    at that initial state; [First] deliberately preserves that observation
    through every finite number of atomic steps. *)
Definition prefix := Join l0 (TraceLabel 0).
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 safe]
  [traced (Join prefix l1) (Box (Star action) body) 0].
Definition star_rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "B.Star.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition base_goal := premise_at star_rule 0.
Definition step_goal := premise_at star_rule 1.
(** Base branch: zero iterations are a true test, so its label gains a final
    stutter. Two explicit associations expose the original head state; then
    First-right reduces the goal to identity against the antecedent. *)
Definition test_rule := requested base_goal (Local OnRight 0 "B.Test.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition base_end := premise_at test_rule 0.
Definition base_mid := Jdg base_end.(antecedent)
  [assertion (Join (Join l0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) l1) body].
Definition base_head := Jdg base_end.(antecedent)
  [assertion (Join l0 (Join (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1) l1)) body].
Definition rotate_base_inner := requested base_end (RotateLabels base_mid [false] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition rotate_base_outer := requested base_mid (RotateLabels base_head [] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition first_rule := requested base_head (Local OnRight 0 "First.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at first_rule 0.
Definition leaf_axiom := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Recurrent branch: execute one atomic action, regroup labels, then absorb the
    old final state into the trace variable and the new state into world name
    1. These are proved substitution inferences with corresponding world
    changes, not an unchecked syntactic identification of execution histories. *)
Definition assignment_rule := requested step_goal (AtomicEigen OnRight 0 2) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition after_assignment := premise_at assignment_rule 0.
Definition forget_relation := requested after_assignment (WeakenRelation 0) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition after_weakening := premise_at forget_relation 0.
Definition updated := 2.
Definition after_world_sub := map_labels (subst_world_label 1 updated) root.
Definition after_trace_sub := map_labels (subst_trace_label 0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) after_world_sub.
Definition rotate_step := requested after_weakening (RotateLabels after_trace_sub [false] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition trace_sub := requested after_trace_sub (SubstituteTrace after_world_sub 0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition world_sub := requested after_world_sub (SubstituteWorld root 1 updated) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition backlink := requested root (BacklinkExact root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).

(** Star at node 0 allocates base node 1 and step node 2. Finish the base
    subtree first, then the recurrent branch; [AddBacklink 11 0] is the actual
    edge returning to the root. The exact backlink itself is nonprogressing. *)
Definition script := [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 star_rule; Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 test_rule;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 3 rotate_base_inner; Cyclic.ApplyRule 4 rotate_base_outer;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 5 first_rule; Cyclic.CloseWith 6 leaf_axiom;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 2 assignment_rule; Cyclic.ApplyRule 7 forget_relation;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 8 rotate_step; Cyclic.ApplyRule 9 trace_sub; Cyclic.ApplyRule 10 world_sub;
  Cyclic.AddBacklink 11 0 backlink].
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root script.
Definition graph := build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
(** Follow tag 0 through the live recurrent region. Potentials decrease on
    its nonprogressing edges and may reset across assignment's strict rank
    decrease (node 2 to node 7). They are proof-graph bookkeeping, not counter
    values or iteration counts. The finite base subtree needs no selected tag. *)
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun i => match i with 0 | 2 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 | 11 => Some 0 | _ => None end;
     Cyclic.witness_potential := fun i => match i with
       0 => 2 | 2 => 1 | 7 => 7 | 8 => 6 | 9 => 5 | 10 => 4 | 11 => 3 | _ => 0 end |}.
Example script_succeeds : build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example graph_size : List.length graph.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) = 12. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example real_backlink :
  match Cyclic.node_at graph 11 with
  | Some n => match n.(Cyclic.node_payload) with
    | Cyclic.BacklinkNode _ target => Nat.eqb target 0
    | _ => false end
  | None => false end = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example accepted : Cyclic.raw_check graph witness = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** The exported validity uses the accepted whole-graph certificate, not a
    finite unrolling or a separate semantic proof of this prefix property. *)
Theorem star_prefix_invariant : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound graph witness accepted). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions star_prefix_invariant.

(** The action can return to its initial state, so star has arbitrarily long
    finite executions; this is not a program bounded to one atomic step. *)
Example returning_execution : program_holds M (Seq action action) [Idle;Released;Idle].
Proof.
  exists [Idle;Released], [Released;Idle]; split.
  - exists Idle, Released; split; [reflexivity|]. left; split; [reflexivity|right; reflexivity].
  - split.
    + exists Released, Idle; split; [reflexivity|]. right; right; split; reflexivity.
    + exists [Idle], Released, [Idle]; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint returning_trace n := match n with
  | 0 => [Idle;Idle] | S n => Idle :: Released :: returning_trace n end.
Lemma returning_trace_head n : exists tail, returning_trace n = Idle :: tail.
Proof. destruct n; eexists; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma arbitrarily_many_steps n : finite_power M (program_holds M action) (2*n) (returning_trace n).
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; [exists Idle; reflexivity|].
  replace (2*S n) with (S (S (2*n))) by lia.
  change (compose M (program_holds M action)
    (finite_power M (program_holds M action) (S (2*n))) (Idle::Released::returning_trace n)).
  exists [Idle;Released], (Released::returning_trace n); split.
  - exists Idle, Released; split; [reflexivity|]. left; split; [reflexivity|right; reflexivity].
  - split.
    + change (compose M (program_holds M action) (finite_power M (program_holds M action) (2*n)) (Released::returning_trace n)).
      exists [Released;Idle], (returning_trace n); split.
      * exists Released, Idle; split; [reflexivity|]. right; right; split; reflexivity.
      * split; [exact IH|]. destruct (returning_trace_head n) as [tail Htail]; rewrite Htail.
        exists [Released], Idle, tail; auto.
    + exists [Idle], Released, (returning_trace n); auto.
Qed.
Example every_finite_round_is_executable n : program_holds M (Star action) (returning_trace n).
Proof. exists (2*n); apply arbitrarily_many_steps. Qed.
Example unbounded_trace_lengths n : List.length (returning_trace n) = 2*n+2.
Proof. induction n; cbn; lia. Qed.

Example distinct_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags graph) = 1.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Benchmarks/PPL/CyclicTags.v:
(** * A cyclic certificate with explicit occurrence-tag renaming

    Reuse Cyclic.v's proof up to its final backlink, insert a rule changing
    tag 0 to tag 7, then backlink with the explicit inverse mapping. Formulas,
    labels and context order stay exact; the witness must now follow the
    changed occurrence name at node 12. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support Cyclic.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Module PrefixCycle := CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL.Cyclic.
Definition root := PrefixCycle.root.
Definition retagged := rename_tags (rename_lookup [(0,7)]) root.
(** [BacklinkTags] returns a local nonprogressing rule. It can be used by
    [ApplyRule] as an ordinary inference or supplied to [AddBacklink] for a
    graph edge to a companion; the request alone creates no graph cycle. *)
Definition forward := requested root (BacklinkTags [(0,7)] retagged) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition backward := requested retagged (BacklinkTags [(7,0)] root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition script := firstn 11 PrefixCycle.script ++ [Cyclic.ApplyRule 11 forward;Cyclic.AddBacklink 12 0 backward].
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root script.
Definition graph := build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
(** The extra renaming edge needs one more potential level in the recurrent
    branch. Strict progress still comes from the inherited atomic action rule,
    never from changing a tag or closing the backlink. *)
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun i => match i with
       | 0 | 2 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 | 11 => Some 0 | 12 => Some 7 | _ => None end;
     Cyclic.witness_potential := fun i => match i with
       | 0 => 2 | 2 => 1 | 7 => 8 | 8 => 7 | 9 => 6 | 10 => 5 | 11 => 4 | 12 => 3 | _ => 0 end |}.
Example build_succeeds : build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example graph_size : List.length graph.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) = 13. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example checked : Cyclic.raw_check graph witness = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem explicit_tag_renaming_cycle : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound graph witness checked). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. exact PrefixCycle.nonvacuity. Qed.
Print Assumptions explicit_tag_renaming_cycle.

Example distinct_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags graph) = 2.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Benchmarks/PPL/Instances.v:
(** * Independent vocabularies, arbitrary frames, and structured world terms. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.PPL Require Import Instance.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics Progress Rules RuleGeneration.
Import ListNotations.
Module AbstractFrame (V : VOCABULARY) (F : FRAME V).
Module Instance := MakeInstance V F.
Definition M := Instance.Model.interpretation.
Theorem arbitrary_predicate p s tail :
  Instance.Sem.formula_holds M (Instance.Syn.Atom p []) (s::tail) <-> F.proposition_holds p s.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem arbitrary_action a tr : Instance.Sem.program_holds M (Instance.Syn.Atomic a tt) tr <->
  exists s t, tr=[s;t] /\ F.step a s t.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
End AbstractFrame.
Module BooleanVocabulary <: VOCABULARY.
  Definition action := bool.
  Definition proposition := bool.
  Definition relation_symbol := nat.
  Definition action_eq_dec := Bool.bool_dec.
  Definition proposition_eq_dec := Bool.bool_dec.
  Definition relation_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition relation_wfb (_ : nat) n := Nat.eqb n 1.
End BooleanVocabulary.
Module BooleanFrame <: FRAME BooleanVocabulary.
  Definition State := bool.
  Definition inhabitant := false.
  Definition step (a s t : bool) := if a then t=negb s else t=s.
  Definition proposition_holds (p s : bool) := s=p.
  Definition relation_holds (_ : nat) (arguments : list (list bool)) := exists tr, arguments=[tr] /\ tr<>[].
End BooleanFrame.
Module Boolean := MakeInstance BooleanVocabulary BooleanFrame.
Definition BM := Boolean.Model.interpretation.
Example boolean_atomic_run : Boolean.Sem.program_holds BM (Boolean.Syn.Atomic true tt) [false;true].
Proof. exists false, true; split; reflexivity. Qed.
Example boolean_predicate : Boolean.Sem.formula_holds BM (Boolean.Syn.Atom true []) [true;false].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Inductive world_expr := WName (x : nat) | WFlip (body : world_expr).
Fixpoint world_expr_eq_dec (a b : world_expr) : {a=b}+{a<>b}.
Proof. decide equality; apply Nat.eq_dec. Defined.
Fixpoint world_names u := match u with WName x => [x] | WFlip u => world_names u end.
Fixpoint world_substitute x value u := match u with
  | WName y => if Nat.eqb x y then value else u
  | WFlip u => WFlip (world_substitute x value u) end.
Fixpoint world_eval (rho : nat -> bool) u := match u with
  | WName x => rho x | WFlip u => negb (world_eval rho u) end.
Module Base := MakeLanguage BooleanVocabulary.
Module Structured <: LANGUAGE.
  Definition atom_symbol := Base.atom_symbol.
  Definition argument := Base.argument.
  Definition binder := Base.binder.
  Definition action_symbol := Base.action_symbol.
  Definition action_argument := Base.action_argument.
  Definition world_term := world_expr.
  Definition relation_symbol := Base.relation_symbol.
  Definition atom_eq_dec := Base.atom_eq_dec.
  Definition argument_eq_dec := Base.argument_eq_dec.
  Definition binder_eq_dec := Base.binder_eq_dec.
  Definition action_eq_dec := Base.action_eq_dec.
  Definition action_argument_eq_dec := Base.action_argument_eq_dec.
  Definition world_term_eq_dec := world_expr_eq_dec.
  Definition relation_eq_dec := Base.relation_eq_dec.
  Definition atom_wfb := Base.atom_wfb.
  Definition binary_atom_wfb := Base.binary_atom_wfb.
  Definition extension_wfb := Base.extension_wfb.
  Definition coextension_wfb := Base.coextension_wfb.
  Definition action_wfb := Base.action_wfb.
  Definition world_term_wfb (_ : world_expr) := true.
  Definition custom_relation_wfb := Base.custom_relation_wfb.
  Definition world_name := WName.
  Definition world_support := world_names.
  Definition subst_world := world_substitute.
End Structured.
Module SS := CyclistRocq.LPL.Syntax.MakeSyntax Structured.
Module SM := CyclistRocq.LPL.Semantics.MakeSemantics Structured SS.
Definition structured_model : SM.model.
Proof.
  refine {| SM.carrier := bool; SM.carrier_inhabitant := false;
    SM.interpret_atom := fun p _ s => s=p;
    SM.interpret_binary_atom := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
    SM.interpret_extension := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
    SM.interpret_coextension := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
    SM.interpret_action := fun a _ s t => if a then t=negb s else t=s;
    SM.interpret_atomic_trace := fun a _ tr => exists s t, tr=[s;t] /\ (if a then t=negb s else t=s);
    SM.interpret_world_term := world_eval;
    SM.interpret_relation := fun _ _ => True |}.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros rho rho' u; induction u; intro H; cbn [world_eval].
    + apply H; now left.
    + now rewrite IHu.
  - intros rho x value u; unfold Structured.subst_world; induction u; cbn [world_substitute world_eval].
    + destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IHu.
Defined.
Definition structured_world : SM.world structured_model.
Proof. refine (SM.World structured_model (fun _ => false) (fun _ => [false]) _); discriminate. Defined.
Example structured_labels_are_interpreted :
  SM.eval_label structured_model structured_world
    (SS.Join (SS.StateLabel (WName 0)) (SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WName 0)))) = [false;true].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example structured_substitution :
  SS.subst_world_label 1 (WFlip (WName 0)) (SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WName 1))) = SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WFlip (WName 0))).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example custom_relation_payload : SM.relation_holds structured_model structured_world (SS.CustomRelation 7 [SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WName 0))]).
Proof. exact I. Qed.
Module SP := MakeProgress Structured SS SM.
Module SK.
  Module Core := MakeRules Structured SS SM SP.
  Module Model <: SM.INTERPRETATION.
    Definition interpretation := structured_model.
  End Model.
  Include Core.ForModel Model.
End SK.
Module SG := MakeRuleGeneration Structured SS SM SP SK.
Definition structured_root := SS.Jdg [SS.Occ (SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WName 0))) (SS.Atom true []) None]
  [SS.Occ (SS.Join SS.Empty (SS.StateLabel (WFlip (WName 0)))) (SS.Box (SS.Atomic true tt) (SS.First (SS.Atom true []))) None].
Example structured_action_rule_generated :
  match SG.generate_requested structured_root (SG.AtomicEigen SG.OnRight 0 1) with Some _ => true | None => false end = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions structured_labels_are_interpreted.
Print Assumptions boolean_atomic_run.

(** * An arbitrary protected component with an uninterpreted predicate.
    Actions may change the active component nondeterministically. No decision
    procedure or inductive definition of the protected predicate is assumed. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.PPL Require Import Instance.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import TraceSafety.
Import ListNotations.
Module Type PROTECTED_DATA.
  Parameter Active Protected : Type.
  Parameter active_inhabitant : Active.
  Parameter protected_inhabitant : Protected.
  Parameter property : Protected -> Prop.
  Parameter active_step : nat -> Active -> Active -> Prop.
End PROTECTED_DATA.
Module ProtectedProgram (D : PROTECTED_DATA).
Module V <: VOCABULARY.
  Definition action := nat.
  Definition proposition := unit.
  Definition relation_symbol := Empty_set.
  Definition action_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition proposition_eq_dec (x y : unit) : {x=y}+{x<>y}. Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition relation_eq_dec (x y : Empty_set) : {x=y}+{x<>y} := match x with end.
  Definition relation_wfb (x : Empty_set) (_ : nat) : bool := match x with end.
End V.
Module F <: FRAME V.
  Definition State := (D.Active * D.Protected)%type.
  Definition inhabitant := (D.active_inhabitant,D.protected_inhabitant).
  Definition step a (s t : State) := D.active_step a (fst s) (fst t) /\ snd t = snd s.
  Definition proposition_holds (_ : unit) (s : State) := D.property (snd s).
  Definition relation_holds (x : Empty_set) (_ : list (list State)) : Prop := match x with end.
End F.
Module Instance := MakeInstance V F.
Module S := Instance.Syn.
Module Sem := Instance.Sem.
Module Safety := MakeSafety Instance.Language Instance.Syn Instance.Sem.
Definition M := Instance.Model.interpretation.
Definition atom := S.Atom tt [].
Definition action x := S.Atomic x tt.
Definition nested := S.Seq (S.Star (S.Choice (action 0) (S.Seq (S.Test S.Truth) (action 1))))
  (S.Choice (action 2) (S.Star (action 1))).
Definition Inv (s : F.State) := D.property (snd s).
Lemma preserves a payload s t : Sem.interpret_action M a payload s t -> Inv s -> Inv t.
Proof. intros [_ Heq] H; unfold Inv in *; now rewrite Heq. Qed.
Theorem all_visited_preserved : trace_safe Inv (Sem.program_holds M nested).
Proof. exact (Safety.program_safe M Inv preserves nested). Qed.
Definition label := S.StateLabel 0.
Definition root := S.Jdg [S.Occ label atom None] [S.Occ label (S.Box nested (S.Always atom)) None].
Theorem arbitrary_predicate_invariant : Sem.Valid M root.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (Forall_inv Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  exists (S.Occ label (S.Box nested (S.Always atom)) None); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|]. intros execution result Hprogram Ho.
  apply Sem.overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution.
  apply (proj2 (Safety.always_head_forall M atom ltac:(intros s tail'; reflexivity) (Sem.eval_update M w 0 :: tail) ltac:(discriminate))).
  eapply all_visited_preserved; eauto.
Qed.
Definition witness_world (b : D.Protected) : Sem.world M.
Proof. refine (Sem.World M (fun _ => (D.active_inhabitant,b)) (fun _ => [(D.active_inhabitant,b)]) _); discriminate. Defined.
Theorem nonvacuity b : D.property b ->
  Sem.admissible M root (witness_world b) /\ Sem.left_holds M (witness_world b) root.(S.antecedent).
Proof. intro H; split; [apply Sem.judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity|]. constructor; [split; [discriminate|exact H]|constructor]. Qed.
End ProtectedProgram.
Module Concrete <: PROTECTED_DATA.
  Definition Active := nat.
  Definition Protected := bool.
  Definition active_inhabitant := 0.
  Definition protected_inhabitant := false.
  Definition property b := b=true.
  Definition active_step (_ x y : nat) := y=x \/ y=S x.
End Concrete.
Module Example := ProtectedProgram Concrete.
Example concrete_nonvacuity : Example.Sem.admissible Example.M Example.root (Example.witness_world true) /\
  Example.Sem.left_holds Example.M (Example.witness_world true) Example.root.(Example.S.antecedent).
Proof. apply Example.nonvacuity; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions Example.arbitrary_predicate_invariant.
Print Assumptions Example.all_visited_preserved.

(** * Two possible successors, a false box, and a genuine dead end. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations.
Example acquire_held : program_holds M (act Acquire) [Idle;Held].
Proof. exists Idle, Held; repeat split; auto. Qed.
Example acquire_released : program_holds M (act Acquire) [Idle;Released].
Proof. exists Idle, Released; repeat split; auto. Qed.
Theorem both_branches_safe : formula_holds M (Box (act Acquire) (Next safe)) [Idle].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (box_atomic M [] Idle Acquire tt (Next safe))).
  intros next Hstep; apply (proj2 (suffix_step M Idle [next] Falsity safe ltac:(discriminate))); left.
  change (next<>Bad); destruct Hstep as [_ [Hnext | Hnext]]; subst next; discriminate.
Qed.
Theorem one_branch_witnesses_diamond : formula_holds M (Diamond (act Acquire) (Next (atom IsHeld))) [Idle].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (diamond_atomic M [] Idle Acquire tt (Next (atom IsHeld)))); exists Held; split; [split; auto|].
  apply (proj2 (suffix_step M Idle [Held] Falsity (atom IsHeld) ltac:(discriminate))); left; reflexivity.
Qed.
Theorem not_every_branch_is_held : ~ formula_holds M (Box (act Acquire) (Next (atom IsHeld))) [Idle].
Proof.
  intro Hbox; pose proof ((proj1 (box_atomic M [] Idle Acquire tt (Next (atom IsHeld)))) Hbox Released ltac:(split; auto)) as H.
  apply (proj1 (suffix_step M Idle [Released] Falsity (atom IsHeld) ltac:(discriminate))) in H.
  destruct H as [Heq|[Hfalse _]]; [change (Released=Held) in Heq; discriminate|exact Hfalse].
Qed.
Example dead_end_box_vacuous : formula_holds M (Box (act Acquire) Falsity) [Dead].
Proof. apply (proj2 (box_atomic M [] Dead Acquire tt Falsity)); intros next [H _]; discriminate. Qed.
Example dead_end_diamond_false : ~ formula_holds M (Diamond (act Acquire) Truth) [Dead].
Proof. intro H; apply (proj1 (diamond_atomic M [] Dead Acquire tt Truth)) in H; destruct H as [next [[H _] _]]; discriminate. Qed.
Print Assumptions both_branches_safe.
Print Assumptions one_branch_witnesses_diamond.
Print Assumptions not_every_branch_is_held.

Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 (atom IsIdle)] [assertion l0 (Box (act Acquire) (Next safe))].
Theorem nondeterministic_box_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  change (eval_update M w 0 = Idle) in Hinitial.
  exists (assertion l0 (Box (act Acquire) (Next safe))); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|]. change (formula_holds M (Box (act Acquire) (Next safe)) [eval_update M w 0]).
  rewrite Hinitial; exact both_branches_safe.
Qed.
Example actual_initial_condition : left_holds M (constant_world Idle) root.(antecedent).
Proof. repeat constructor; discriminate. Qed.
Example admissible_initial_condition : admissible M root (constant_world Idle).
Proof. apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions nondeterministic_box_valid.

Proof.
  exists [Idle;Held], [Held;Released]; split; [exact acquire_held|].
  split; [exists Held, Released; split; [reflexivity|split; reflexivity]|].
  exists [Idle], Held, [Released]; auto.
Qed.
Example both_choice_branches : program_holds M (Choice p (act Stutter)) [Idle;Held] /\
  program_holds M (Choice p (act Stutter)) [Idle;Idle].
Proof. split; [left; exact acquire_held|right; exists Idle, Idle; repeat split; discriminate]. Qed.

Proof. exists 0; exists Idle; reflexivity. Qed.

Proof. intros [s H]; discriminate. Qed.

Proof.
  exists 1; exists [Idle;Held], [Held;Held]; split; [exact acquire_held|].
  split; [exists Held; reflexivity|]. exists [Idle], Held, [Held]; auto.
Qed.

Proof. exists 0; exists Idle; reflexivity. Qed.

  [assertion l0 (Box (Choice (Seq p q) (Star (Choice p (act Stutter)))) (First safe))].
Theorem regular_program_preserves_first_observation : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  exists (assertion l0 (Box (Choice (Seq p q) (Star (Choice p (act Stutter)))) (First safe))); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|]. intros execution result Hprogram Ho.
  apply overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution; exact Hinitial.
Qed.

Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Benchmarks/PPL/RuleCoverage.v:
(** * Executable examples of every public rule/request family

    Compare these expected ordered premise lists with RULE_EXPANSIONS.md.
    Each example computes a fixed request and checks its exact shape; semantic
    soundness comes from the kernel record the generator returned. Most
    principals are at position 1, after a nonempty surrounding context, to
    demonstrate that generation is not limited to the head of a sequent.

    The second part gives rejected requests and syntax, followed by assumption
    audits and explicit finite-scan/weakening regressions. These computations
    check the generator interface; they do not establish proof-search
    completeness or decide whether rejected goals are false. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.
Fixpoint judgments_eqb a b := match a,b with
  | [],[] => true | x::xs,y::ys => judgment_eqb x y && judgments_eqb xs ys | _,_ => false end.
(** Ignore proof fields when checking premise shape; retain full judgment
    syntax, including context order, labels and tags. A failed request also
    makes the shape check false, so an empty expected list cannot hide it. *)
Definition has_shape j req expected := match generate_requested j req with
  | Some r => judgments_eqb (map Cyclic.premise_judgment r.(Cyclic.rule_premises)) expected
  | None => false end.
Definition a := safe.
Definition b := atom IsIdle.
Definition p := act Acquire.
Definition q := act Release.
Definition u := 0.
Definition sigma := TraceLabel 0.
Definition joined := Join sigma (StateLabel u).
Definition stutter := Join joined (StateLabel u).
Definition guard_label := Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u).
Definition gamma := [assertion l1 (First Truth)].
Definition delta := [assertion l1 Falsity].
Definition lhs f := Jdg (gamma ++ [f]) delta.
Definition rhs f := Jdg gamma (delta ++ [f]).
(** Left schemes: atomic actions expose a successor world, sequence nests its
    modalities, and choice/star retain the catalog's two separate premises.
    Boolean and temporal schemes below preserve the same context split. *)
Example b_seq_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Seq.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box q a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_choice_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Choice.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box q a)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_star_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Star p) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Star.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box (Test Truth) a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box (Star p) a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_seq_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Seq.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond q a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_choice_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Choice.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond q a)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_star_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Star p) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Star.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond (Test Truth) a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond (Star p) a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example at_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a)) (Local OnLeft 1 "At.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example first_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First (Conj a b)))) (Local OnLeft 1 "First.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) (Conj a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example and_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Conj a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "And.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example or_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Disj a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Or.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Suffix.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma (Suffix a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example dualsuffix_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "DualSuffix.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma a]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma (DualSuffix a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Right schemes: conjunction/box-choice branch into premises, whereas
    disjunction/diamond-choice put both alternatives in one succedent. The
    literal label trees also check retention of action/test states. *)
Example b_seq_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Seq.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box q a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_choice_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Choice.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p a)]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box q a)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_star_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Star p) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Star.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box (Test Truth) a)]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box (Star p) a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_seq_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Seq.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond q a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_choice_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Choice.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p a);assertion sigma (Diamond q a)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_star_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Star p) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Star.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond (Test Truth) a);assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond (Star p) a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example at_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a)) (Local OnRight 1 "At.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example first_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First (Conj a b)))) (Local OnRight 1 "First.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) (Conj a b)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example and_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Conj a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "And.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma a]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example or_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Disj a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "Or.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma b])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "Suffix.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma a]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma (Suffix a b)])]) = true.
