(** * All visited states of every finite protocol execution stay safe.
    This is a direct semantic proof, separate from the cyclic certificates. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import TraceSafety.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations.
Module Safety := MakeSafety Machine.Language Machine.Syn Machine.Sem.
Definition Inv (s : machine_state) := s<>Bad.
Lemma actions_preserve action payload s t : interpret_action M action payload s t -> Inv s -> Inv t.
Proof. intros Hstep Hsafe; exact (action_safe action s t Hsafe Hstep). Qed.
Lemma every_program_safe p : trace_safe Inv (program_holds M p).
Proof. exact (Safety.program_safe M Inv actions_preserve p). Qed.
Lemma always_safe tr : tr<>[] -> (formula_holds M (Always safe) tr <-> Forall Inv tr).
Proof. intro Hne; exact (Safety.always_head_forall M safe ltac:(intros s tail; reflexivity) tr Hne). Qed.
Definition protocol := Choice (act Acquire) (Choice (act Release) (Choice (act Reset) (act Stutter))).
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 safe] [assertion l0 (Box (Star protocol) (Always safe))].
Theorem every_visited_state_safe : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  exists (assertion l0 (Box (Star protocol) (Always safe))); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|]. intros execution result Hprogram Ho.
  apply overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution.
  apply (proj2 (always_safe (eval_update M w 0 :: tail) ltac:(discriminate))); eapply every_program_safe; eauto.
Qed.
Example may_stop_immediately : program_holds M (Star protocol) [Idle;Idle].
Proof. exists 0; exists Idle; reflexivity. Qed.
Example may_stop_while_held : program_holds M (Star protocol) [Idle;Held;Held].
Proof.
  exists 1; exists [Idle;Held], [Held;Held]; split.
  - left; exists Idle, Held; repeat split; auto.
  - split; [exists Held; reflexivity|]. exists [Idle], Held, [Held]; auto.
Qed.
Example root_is_admissible : admissible M root (constant_world Idle).
Proof. apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity. Qed.
Example root_antecedent_holds : left_holds M (constant_world Idle) root.(antecedent).
Proof. repeat constructor; discriminate. Qed.
Print Assumptions every_visited_state_safe.
Benchmarks/PPL/Support.v:
(** * A small nondeterministic machine and explicit proof-script helpers. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.PPL Require Import Instance.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Progress Rules RuleGeneration Certification.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Inductive action := Acquire | Release | Reset | Stutter | Cycle.
Inductive proposition := Safe | IsIdle | IsHeld | IsReleased.
Inductive extra_relation := SameState.
Inductive machine_state := Idle | Held | Released | Bad | Dead.

Module Vocabulary <: VOCABULARY.
  Definition action := action.
  Definition proposition := proposition.
  Definition relation_symbol := extra_relation.
  Definition action_eq_dec (x y : action) : {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition proposition_eq_dec (x y : proposition) : {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition relation_eq_dec (x y : extra_relation) : {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition relation_wfb (_ : extra_relation) n := Nat.eqb n 2.
End Vocabulary.
Module Frame <: FRAME Vocabulary.
  Definition State := machine_state.
  Definition inhabitant := Idle.
  Definition step a s t : Prop := match a with
    | Acquire => s=Idle /\ (t=Held \/ t=Released)
    | Release => s=Held /\ t=Released
    | Reset => s=Released /\ t=Idle
    | Stutter => s<>Bad /\ t=s
    | Cycle => (s=Idle /\ (t=Held \/ t=Released)) \/ (s=Held /\ t=Released) \/ (s=Released /\ t=Idle) end.
  Definition proposition_holds p s : Prop := match p with
    | Safe => s<>Bad | IsIdle => s=Idle | IsHeld => s=Held | IsReleased => s=Released end.
  Definition relation_holds (_ : extra_relation) (arguments : list (list State)) : Prop :=
    exists s, arguments=[[s];[s]].
End Frame.
Module Machine := MakeInstance Vocabulary Frame.
Module Export Syn := Machine.Syn.
Module Export Sem := Machine.Sem.
Module Pr := MakeProgress Machine.Language Machine.Syn Machine.Sem.
Module MachineKernel.
  Module Core := MakeRules Machine.Language Machine.Syn Machine.Sem Pr.
  Module Model := Machine.Model.
  Include Core.ForModel Model.
End MachineKernel.
Module Export Kernel := MachineKernel.
Module Export Generation := MakeRuleGeneration Machine.Language Machine.Syn Machine.Sem Pr MachineKernel.
Module Export Cert := MakeCertification Machine.Language Machine.Syn Machine.Sem Pr MachineKernel.
Definition M := Machine.Model.interpretation.
Definition act a := Atomic a tt.
Definition atom p := Atom p [].
Definition safe := atom Safe.
Definition l0 := StateLabel 0.
Definition l1 := StateLabel 1.
Definition assertion l a := Occ l a None.
Definition traced l a t := Occ l a (Some t).
Definition constant_world (s : machine_state) : world M.
Proof. refine (World M (fun _ => s) (fun _ => [s]) _); discriminate. Defined.
Definition someb {A} (x : option A) := match x with Some _ => true | None => false end.
Definition require_rule (x : option Cyclic.rule_instance) (H : someb x = true) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof. destruct x as [r|]; [exact r|discriminate]. Defined.
Definition require_axiom (x : option Cyclic.axiom_instance) (H : someb x = true) : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof. destruct x as [a|]; [exact a|discriminate]. Defined.
Definition requested j req (H : someb (generate_requested j req) = true) := require_rule (generate_requested j req) H.
Definition generated_axiom j (H : someb (generate_axiom j) = true) := require_axiom (generate_axiom j) H.
Definition premise_at r k := match nth_error r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) k with
  | Some p => p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) | None => r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) end.
Lemma root_nonvacuous j : judgment_wfb j = true -> exists w, admissible M j w.
Proof. intro H; exists (constant_world Idle); apply judgment_wfb_admissible; exact H. Qed.

Lemma action_safe a s t : Frame.proposition_holds Safe s -> Frame.step a s t -> Frame.proposition_holds Safe t.
Proof. destruct a; cbn [Frame.step Frame.proposition_holds]; intros Hs Hstep; intuition congruence. Qed.
Benchmarks/PPL/Temporal.v:
(** * Temporal operators on finite traces

    Immediate and postponed suffix witnesses illustrate the one-step suffix
    equation. Next cannot postpone, and at a singleton it is false. Dual
    suffix has the complementary singleton boundary. These are finite-trace
    facts, not imported laws for infinite temporal streams. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Definition s0 := Idle.
Definition s1 := Held.
Example suffix_immediate : formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (atom IsIdle)) [s1;s0].
Proof. apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s1 [s0] Truth (atom IsIdle) ltac:(discriminate))); left; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_postponed : formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (atom IsIdle)) [s1;s1;s0].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s1 [s1;s0] Truth (atom IsIdle) ltac:(discriminate))).
  right; split; [exact I|exact suffix_immediate].
Qed.
Example next_cannot_postpone : ~ formula_holds M (Next (atom IsIdle)) [s1;s1;s0].
Proof. rewrite (suffix_step M s1 [s1;s0] Falsity (atom IsIdle)) by discriminate; cbn; intuition discriminate. Qed.
Example suffix_singleton_failure : ~ formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (atom IsIdle)) [s0].
Proof. apply suffix_singleton. Qed.
Example next_at_end : ~ formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s0].
Proof. apply next_singleton. Qed.
Example dual_suffix_singleton_success : formula_holds M (DualSuffix Falsity Falsity) [s0].
Proof. apply dual_suffix_singleton. Qed.
Example dual_suffix_success : formula_holds M (DualSuffix Falsity (atom IsIdle)) [s1;s0].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (dual_suffix_step M s1 [s0] Falsity (atom IsIdle) ltac:(discriminate))).
  split; [reflexivity|right; apply dual_suffix_singleton].
Qed.
(** [First] evaluates its complete body on a singleton, so even an original
    two-state stutter cannot make the nested [Next] true. *)
Example compound_first_state : ~ formula_holds M (First (Conj Truth (Next Truth))) [s0;s0].
Proof. intros [_ H]; exact (next_singleton M Truth s0 H). Qed.
(** The accumulated traces have lengths 1, 2 and 3. Their rank measure is
    1+2+3, not the number of history components. This checks the convention
    underlying Progress.v's minimum-counterexample inequalities. *)
Example sum_of_component_lengths : sequence_measure (execution_history [s0] [s1;s0]) = 6.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example execution_count_is_different : List.length (execution_history [s0] [s1;s0]) = 3.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
(** A suffix assertion at a singleton cannot hold. Used as an antecedent,
    it closes the sequent even with an empty succedent. The generated
    singleton-suffix axiom is certified as a one-node graph. *)
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 (Suffix Truth (atom IsIdle))] [].
Definition ax := generated_axiom root ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Theorem singleton_suffix_closes : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check ax)). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions singleton_suffix_closes.
Benchmarks/PPL/Tests.v:
(** * Stuttering tests and failed-execution modalities

    A test checks its guard on [s;s], so a guard containing [Next] can
    distinguish test execution from evaluating at a singleton state. Failed
    tests have no runs: their boxes are vacuous and their diamonds false.
    The last proof constructs a two-node generated certificate for that box. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.Benchmarks.PPL Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition s := Idle.
Example successful_test : program_holds M (Test safe) [s;s].
Proof. exists s; split; [reflexivity|change (Idle<>Bad); discriminate]. Qed.
Example failed_test : ~ program_holds M (Test Falsity) [s;s].
Proof. intros [start [_ H]]; exact H. Qed.
(** This guard is intentionally temporal rather than pure arithmetic. Its
    success on a stutter checks that tests use the full formula semantics. *)
Example singleton_sensitive_guard : ~ formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s].
Proof. apply next_singleton. Qed.
Example stutter_sensitive_guard : formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s;s].
Proof. apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s [s] Falsity Truth ltac:(discriminate))); now left. Qed.
Example sensitive_test_uses_stutter : program_holds M (Test (Next Truth)) [s;s].
Proof. exists s; split; [reflexivity|exact stutter_sensitive_guard]. Qed.
Example failed_box_is_vacuous : formula_holds M (Box (Test Falsity) Falsity) [s].
Proof. apply (proj2 (box_test M [] s Falsity Falsity)); cbn; tauto. Qed.
Example failed_diamond_is_false : ~ formula_holds M (Diamond (Test Falsity) Truth) [s].
Proof. rewrite (diamond_test M [] s Falsity Truth); cbn; tauto. Qed.
(** Box-test-right adds the false guard to the premise antecedent. That
    premise closes by false-left; no proof of the postcondition is needed
    because there is no successful execution of the test. *)
Definition root := Jdg [] [traced (Join Empty l0) (Box (Test Falsity) Falsity) 0].
Definition rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "B.Test.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at rule 0.
Definition ax := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 rule;Cyclic.CloseWith 1 ax].
Theorem failed_test_box_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions failed_test_box_valid.
Certification.v:
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia String Classical_Prop.

From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics Progress Rules.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.

(** * Turning an executable graph into a semantic certificate

    [Cyclic.raw_check] is deliberately executable, whereas
    [Cyclic.certificate] contains the semantic evidence used by the generic
    well-founded descent proof. This module proves once that the relevant
    successful Boolean checks expose all local data needed to build the
    evidence.

    Read the proof in three layers: structural reflection supplies a false
    successor and liveness; witness reflection supplies trace transitions;
    [certify_raw_check] combines them and [raw_check_sound] calls the generic
    soundness theorem. The final one-node helper is a small starting example.

    Nothing here changes the generic framework.  The lemmas inspect its public
    graph representation and use the [rule_counter_step] theorem already
    stored in every LPL rule instance. *)

Module MakeCertification (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn)
  (Pr : PROGRESS L Syn Sem) (Kernel : KERNEL L Syn Sem Pr).
(** These aliases share syntax, model and rule types with RuleGeneration.v.
    A graph can therefore contain the very rule records returned by that
    generator, with no translation or second kernel instantiation. *)
Export Syn Sem.
Module Export P := Kernel.P.
Module Export K := Kernel.

(** Start with small executable-data facts. Pair membership concerns tag
    numbers only; it says nothing yet about semantic rank inequalities. *)
Lemma pair_mem_spec pair pairs :
  Cyclic.pair_mem pair pairs = true <-> In pair pairs.
Proof.
  induction pairs as [|x xs IH]; simpl.
  - split; [discriminate|contradiction].
  - rewrite Bool.orb_true_iff, IH.
    unfold Cyclic.pair_eqb. destruct pair as [a b], x as [c d]; simpl.
    rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff, !Nat.eqb_eq.
    split.
    + intros [[-> ->] | Hin]; [now left|now right].
    + intros [Heq | Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. auto.
      * auto.
Qed.


(** The checker traverses a list with an explicit starting index. Keeping
    [start] separate from [offset] aligns the tail induction with graph node
    numbers; this pattern reappears for witness reflection below. *)
Lemma all_nodes_wfb_from_nth g nodes start offset n :
  Cyclic.all_nodes_wfb_from g start nodes = true ->
  nth_error nodes offset = Some n ->
  Cyclic.node_wfb g (start + offset) n = true.
Proof.
  revert nodes start n. induction offset as [|offset IH];
    intros [|x xs] start n Hall Hnth; simpl in Hnth; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hnth; subst n. simpl in Hall.
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hnode _].
    replace (start + 0) with start by lia. exact Hnode.
  - simpl in Hall. apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [_ Htail].
    specialize (IH xs (S start) n Htail Hnth).
    replace (start + S offset) with (S start + offset) by lia. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma structural_node_wfb g i n :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  Cyclic.node_at g i = Some n ->
  Cyclic.node_wfb g i n = true.
Proof.
  destruct g as [root nodes]. unfold Cyclic.structural_check.
  destruct nodes as [|first rest]; [discriminate|].
  simpl. intros Hall Hnode.
  (* [&&] is left associative in Rocq: the checker is parsed as
     [(root_ok && nodes_ok) && reachable_ok]. *)
  apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hall _].
  apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [_ Hnodes].
  change (Cyclic.all_nodes_wfb_from
    {| Cyclic.graph_root := root; Cyclic.graph_nodes := first :: rest |}
    0 (first :: rest) = true) in Hnodes.
  unfold Cyclic.node_at in Hnode; simpl in Hnode.
  eapply all_nodes_wfb_from_nth with (start := 0) (offset := i);
    [exact Hnodes|exact Hnode].
Qed.

Lemma structural_root_bound g :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  0 < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes).
Proof.
  destruct g as [root [|first rest]]; simpl; [discriminate|lia].
Qed.

(** The framework always starts at node index 0. The graph also stores a
    separate root judgment; structural checking proves that it agrees with
    that node, so validity of node 0 proves the advertised theorem. *)
Lemma structural_root_label g :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  Cyclic.label_at g 0 = g.(Cyclic.graph_root).
Proof.
  destruct g as [root [|first rest]]; simpl; [discriminate|].
  intro H. apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [H _].
  apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [Hroot _].
  apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hroot. exact Hroot.
Qed.

(** The target and premise lists of an inference node are checked in
    lockstep.  This lemma recovers the target belonging to a selected premise
    index, including the exact target label and its bounds proof. *)
Lemma targets_wfb_nth g source targets premises k p :
  Cyclic.targets_wfb_from g source targets premises = true ->
  nth_error premises k = Some p ->
  { target : nat |
    nth_error targets k = Some target /\
    target < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) /\
    Cyclic.label_at g target = p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) }.
Proof.
  revert targets premises p. induction k as [|k IH];
    intros [|target targets] [|prem premises] p Hall Hprem;
    simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hprem; subst prem.
    (* This four-way conjunction is parsed on the left as
       [(((bound && label) && edge_ok) && tail_ok)]. *)
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hall _].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hall _].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hbound Hlabel].
    apply Nat.ltb_lt in Hbound. apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hlabel.
    exists target. auto.
  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [_ Htail].
    specialize (IH targets premises p Htail Hprem).
    destruct IH as [chosen [Hchosen [Hbound' Hlabel']]].
    exists chosen. auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_map_premise_edge premises k p :
  nth_error premises k = Some p ->
  nth_error (map Cyclic.premise_edge premises) k =
    Some p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).
Proof. intro H. now rewrite nth_error_map, H. Qed.

(** Rule-node edges pair an ordered target list with the rule's ordered
    premise edges. Matching [nth_error] equations recover the actual graph
    edge selected by the rule's semantic counterstep. *)
Lemma combine_nth_in {A B : Type} (xs : list A) (ys : list B) k x y :
  nth_error xs k = Some x -> nth_error ys k = Some y ->
  In (x, y) (combine xs ys).
Proof.
  revert xs ys x y. induction k as [|k IH];
    intros [|a xs] [|b ys] x y Hx Hy; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hx; inversion Hy; subst. now left.
  - right. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma node_edge_from_rule_nth g i n r targets k p target :
  Cyclic.node_at g i = Some n ->
  n.(Cyclic.node_payload) = Cyclic.RuleNode r targets ->
  nth_error r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) k = Some p ->
  nth_error targets k = Some target ->
  Cyclic.edge_at g i target p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).
Proof.
  intros Hnode Hpayload Hprem Htarget. exists n. split; [exact Hnode|].
  unfold Cyclic.node_edges. rewrite Hpayload. simpl.
  eapply combine_nth_in; [exact Htarget|].
  now apply nth_error_map_premise_edge.
Qed.

Lemma edge_at_successor g i j e :
  Cyclic.edge_at g i j e -> In j (Cyclic.successors g i).
Proof.
  intros [n [Hnode Hedge]]. unfold Cyclic.successors. rewrite Hnode.
  apply in_map with (f := @fst nat Cyclic.edge_info) in Hedge. exact Hedge.
Qed.

(** A successful structural check rules out a false dead end.  The proof has
    four cases, one for each node payload:

    - an open node contradicts [node_wfb];
    - an axiom node contradicts the axiom's semantic theorem;
    - a rule node uses the rule's stored countermodel theorem and the checked
      target list;
    - a backlink node uses the same countermodel theorem, but its only premise
      is connected to the explicitly stored companion node.

    This is the semantic bridge between an executable proof graph and the
    abstract [cert_advance] field required by [Cyclic.certificate]. *)
Lemma structurally_checked_advance g i w :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  i < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) ->
  ~ Cyclic.holds (Cyclic.label_at g i) w ->
  { j : nat &
    { w' : LPLTheory.World &
      { e : Cyclic.edge_info |
        Cyclic.edge_at g i j e /\
        j < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) /\
        ~ Cyclic.holds (Cyclic.label_at g j) w' /\
        Cyclic.respects_edge (Cyclic.label_at g i)
          (Cyclic.label_at g j) w w' e } } }.
Proof.
  intros Hstruct Hibound Hfalse.
  (* Destruct the executable lookup itself.  Using a propositional
     [exists n, ...] here would later attempt to eliminate a [Prop] proof to
     build the dependent witness in [Type], which Rocq intentionally forbids. *)
  destruct (Cyclic.node_at g i) as [n|] eqn:Hnode.
  2: {
    unfold Cyclic.node_at in Hnode.
    apply nth_error_None in Hnode. lia.
  }
  pose proof (structural_node_wfb g i n Hstruct Hnode) as Hwf.
  assert (Hsource : Cyclic.label_at g i = n.(Cyclic.node_judgment)).
  { unfold Cyclic.label_at. now rewrite Hnode. }
  destruct n.(Cyclic.node_payload) as [|a|r targets|r target]
    eqn:Hpayload.
  all: unfold Cyclic.node_wfb in Hwf; rewrite Hpayload in Hwf.
  - (* An accepted graph never contains an open node. *)
    discriminate Hwf.
  - (* A false axiom would contradict the theorem packaged in the axiom. *)
    apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hwf.
    exfalso. apply Hfalse. rewrite Hsource, Hwf.
    exact (a.(Cyclic.axiom_theorem) w).
  - (* Ordinary inference node. *)
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hwf as [Hconclusion Htargets].
    apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hconclusion.
    assert (Hrulefalse : ~ Cyclic.holds r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) w).
    {
      intro Hholds. apply Hfalse.
      rewrite Hsource, Hconclusion. exact Hholds.
    }
    destruct (r.(Cyclic.rule_counter_step) w Hrulefalse)
      as [k [p [w' [Hpremise [Htargetfalse Hrespect]]]]].
    destruct (targets_wfb_nth g n.(Cyclic.node_judgment) targets
      r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) k p Htargets Hpremise)
      as [j [Htarget [Hjbound Hjlabel]]].
    exists j, w', p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).
    split.
    + eapply node_edge_from_rule_nth; eauto.
    + split; [exact Hjbound|]. split.
      * now rewrite Hjlabel.
      * rewrite Hsource, Hconclusion, Hjlabel. exact Hrespect.
  - (* Backlink node: the checker guarantees a unary premise at [target]. *)
    (* The backlink well-formedness test is a left-associated four-way
       conjunction.  Only its conclusion and unary-target components are
       needed here; the non-reflexivity and backlink-label tests remain part
       of the executable checker. *)
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hwf as [Hwf Htargetcheck].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hwf as [Hwf _].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hwf as [Hconclusion _].
    apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hconclusion.
    destruct r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) as [|p ps] eqn:Hps;
      simpl in Htargetcheck; try discriminate.
    destruct ps as [|extra ps']; simpl in Htargetcheck; try discriminate.
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Htargetcheck as [Htargetcheck _].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Htargetcheck as [Htargetbound Htargetlabel].
    apply Nat.ltb_lt in Htargetbound.
    apply judgment_eqb_spec in Htargetlabel.
    assert (Hrulefalse : ~ Cyclic.holds r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) w).
    {
      intro Hholds. apply Hfalse.
      rewrite Hsource, Hconclusion. exact Hholds.
    }
    destruct (r.(Cyclic.rule_counter_step) w Hrulefalse)
      as [k [chosen [w' [Hchosen [Htargetfalse Hrespect]]]]].
    rewrite Hps in Hchosen.
    destruct k as [|k]; simpl in Hchosen.
    2: destruct k; discriminate.
    inversion Hchosen; subst chosen.
    exists target, w', p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).
    split.
    + exists n. split; [exact Hnode|].
      unfold Cyclic.node_edges. rewrite Hpayload, Hps. simpl. now left.
    + split; [exact Htargetbound|]. split.
      * now rewrite Htargetlabel.
      * rewrite Hsource, Hconclusion, Htargetlabel. exact Hrespect.
Qed.

(** Repeatedly use [structurally_checked_advance] to construct a path of any
    requested finite length from a false node.  At length zero the current
    bounded node is already a path endpoint.  At successor length, the
    countermodel theorem chooses one false outgoing child and induction
    continues there. *)
Lemma false_has_path_of_length g fuel i w :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  i < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) ->
  ~ Cyclic.holds (Cyclic.label_at g i) w ->
  Cyclic.has_path_of_length g fuel i = true.
Proof.
  revert i w. induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros i w Hstruct Hibound Hfalse.
  - simpl. now apply Nat.ltb_lt.
  - simpl.
    destruct (structurally_checked_advance g i w Hstruct Hibound Hfalse)
      as [j [w' [e [Hedge [Hjbound [Hfalse' _]]]]]].
    apply existsb_exists. exists j. split.
    + now apply edge_at_successor with (e := e).
    + now apply (IH j w').
Qed.

(** [liveb] asks for a path whose length is exactly the number of stored
    nodes.  The preceding lemma therefore supplies precisely the certificate's
    liveness obligation. *)
Lemma structurally_checked_false_live g i w :
  Cyclic.structural_check g = true ->
  i < List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) ->
  ~ Cyclic.holds (Cyclic.label_at g i) w ->
  Cyclic.liveb g i = true.
Proof.
  intros Hstruct Hibound Hfalse. unfold Cyclic.liveb.
  now apply (false_has_path_of_length g
    (List.length g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes)) i w).
Qed.

(** Reflection for the small Boolean transition checker.  Keeping this proof
    separate makes the later witness argument read at the same abstraction
    level as [Cyclic.trace_transition]. *)
Lemma trace_transitionb_sound tw i j e :
  Cyclic.trace_transitionb tw i j e = true ->
  Cyclic.trace_transition tw i j e.
Proof.
  unfold Cyclic.trace_transitionb, Cyclic.trace_transition.
  (* The four cases are source/target tags present or absent. With two
     tags, the edge must route the pair and either mark strict rank progress
     or decrease the witness potential. Losing a selected tag is rejected;
     starting one is allowed; two absent tags require potential descent. *)
  destruct (Cyclic.witness_tag tw i) as [a|];
    destruct (Cyclic.witness_tag tw j) as [b|]; simpl.
  - intros H.
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [Hvalid Hstep].
    apply pair_mem_spec in Hvalid.
    apply Bool.orb_true_iff in Hstep as [Hprogress | Hpotential].
    + split; [exact Hvalid|]. left. now apply pair_mem_spec.
    + split; [exact Hvalid|]. right. now apply Nat.ltb_lt.
  - discriminate.
  - intros _. exact I.
  - intro H. now apply Nat.ltb_lt.
Qed.

(** Select the witness checks belonging to one node index.  As in
    [all_nodes_wfb_from_nth], [start] records the list index of the head and
    [offset] tells us how far to descend. *)
Lemma witness_edges_from_nth g tw nodes start offset n :
  Cyclic.witness_edges_from g tw start nodes = true ->
  nth_error nodes offset = Some n ->
  Cyclic.option_tag_wfb g tw (start + offset) = true /\
  forallb (Cyclic.edge_witnessb g tw (start + offset))
    (Cyclic.node_edges n) = true.
Proof.
  revert nodes start n. induction offset as [|offset IH];
    intros [|x xs] start n Hall Hnth; simpl in Hnth; try discriminate.
  - inversion Hnth; subst n. simpl in Hall.
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [Hhead _].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hhead as [Htag Hedges].
    replace (start + 0) with start by lia. auto.
  - simpl in Hall.
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff in Hall as [_ Htail].
    specialize (IH xs (S start) n Htail Hnth).
    replace (start + S offset) with (S start + offset) by lia. exact IH.
Qed.

(** A successful whole-graph witness check reflects to the propositional
    transition property on every edge whose target is live. *)
Lemma witness_check_transition g tw i j e :
  Cyclic.witness_check g tw = true ->
  Cyclic.edge_at g i j e ->
  Cyclic.liveb g j = true ->
  Cyclic.trace_transition tw i j e.
Proof.
  intros Hcheck [n [Hnode Hedge]] Hlive.
  unfold Cyclic.witness_check in Hcheck.
  unfold Cyclic.node_at in Hnode.
  destruct (witness_edges_from_nth g tw g.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) 0 i n
    Hcheck Hnode) as [_ Hedges].
  replace (0 + i) with i in Hedges by lia.
  apply forallb_forall with (x := (j, e)) in Hedges; [|exact Hedge].
  unfold Cyclic.edge_witnessb in Hedges. rewrite Hlive in Hedges.
  now apply trace_transitionb_sound.
Qed.

(** Package a graph only after *all* executable checks have returned [true].
    Notice that the relational trace checker is retained in the raw equation;
    the local witness provides the particular well-founded route consumed by
    the generic soundness proof. *)
Lemma raw_check_structural g tw :
  Cyclic.raw_check g tw = true -> Cyclic.structural_check g = true.
Proof.
  unfold Cyclic.raw_check. intro H.
  apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [H _].
  now apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [Hstruct _].
Qed.

Lemma raw_check_witness g tw :
  Cyclic.raw_check g tw = true -> Cyclic.witness_check g tw = true.
Proof.
  unfold Cyclic.raw_check. intro H.
  now apply Bool.andb_true_iff in H as [_ Hwitness].
Qed.

Definition certify_raw_check (g : Cyclic.graph) (tw : Cyclic.trace_witness)
    (Hcheck : Cyclic.raw_check g tw = true) : Cyclic.certificate.
Proof.
  (* The executable result is data evidence for each certificate field:
     root consistency, false-node liveness, countermodel advancement and
     witness transitions. No whole-graph soundness premise is assumed. *)
  refine
    {| Cyclic.cert_graph := g;
       Cyclic.cert_witness := tw;
       Cyclic.cert_root_bound :=
         structural_root_bound g (raw_check_structural g tw Hcheck);
       Cyclic.cert_root_label :=
         structural_root_label g (raw_check_structural g tw Hcheck);
       Cyclic.cert_false_live := _;
       Cyclic.cert_advance := _;
       Cyclic.cert_trace_transition := _ |}.
  - intros i w Hibound Hfalse.
    exact (structurally_checked_false_live g i w
      (raw_check_structural g tw Hcheck) Hibound Hfalse).
  - intros i w Hibound Hfalse.
    exact (structurally_checked_advance g i w
      (raw_check_structural g tw Hcheck) Hibound Hfalse).
  - intros i j e Hedge Hlive.
    exact (witness_check_transition g tw i j e
      (raw_check_witness g tw Hcheck) Hedge Hlive).
Defined.

(** The certificate retains the same graph and witness, so its executable
    check is exactly the original [Hcheck]. Reflection added semantic proofs
    without replacing the finite data that was checked. *)
Lemma certify_raw_check_check g tw Hcheck :
  Cyclic.check_certificate (certify_raw_check g tw Hcheck) = true.
Proof. exact Hcheck. Qed.

(** Public soundness theorem for explicit graphs. The caller supplies
    data [g], [tw] and the equation [raw_check g tw = true];
    all semantic validity then follows from this theorem and the unchanged
    generic cyclic framework. *)
Theorem raw_check_sound g tw :
  Cyclic.raw_check g tw = true ->
  Cyclic.Valid g.(Cyclic.graph_root).
Proof.
  intro Hcheck.
  (* All object-specific work is now inside the constructed certificate.
     The unchanged framework supplies the well-founded descent argument. *)
  apply (Cyclic.certificate_sound (certify_raw_check g tw Hcheck)).
  exact Hcheck.
Qed.

(** ** Acyclic certificates for theorem-backed leaves

    A manual script can close a node with a genuine object-logic axiom (for
    example identity or ex-falso).  The following one-node construction lets
    those leaves use the very same certificate interface as larger cyclic
    graphs.  It is also useful while testing rule generation independently of
    backlink discovery. *)
Definition empty_trace_witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun _ => None;
     Cyclic.witness_potential := fun _ => 0 |}.

(** A single axiom node has no outgoing edges and needs no selected trace
    tag or potential decrease. This example shows the full certification
    path without the additional bookkeeping of a cyclic graph. *)
Definition axiom_graph (a : Cyclic.axiom_instance) : Cyclic.graph :=
  {| Cyclic.graph_root := a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion);
     Cyclic.graph_nodes :=
       [{| Cyclic.node_judgment := a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion);
           Cyclic.node_payload := Cyclic.AxiomNode a |}] |}.

Lemma axiom_graph_raw_check a :
  Cyclic.raw_check (axiom_graph a) empty_trace_witness = true.
Proof.
  assert (Heq : judgment_eqb a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion)
    a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) = true).
  { now apply judgment_eqb_spec. }
  assert (HeqT : LPLTheory.judgment_eqb a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion)
    a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) = true).
  { exact Heq. }
  assert (Hnode : Cyclic.node_wfb (axiom_graph a) 0
    {| Cyclic.node_judgment := a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion);
       Cyclic.node_payload := Cyclic.AxiomNode a |} = true).
  {
    unfold Cyclic.node_wfb, axiom_graph. simpl.
    exact HeqT.
  }
  (* All graph lists now have at most one element. Unfolding the finite
     checkers reduces the goal to reflexive root/conclusion comparisons;
     the axiom's semantic theorem remains stored in its node payload. *)
  unfold axiom_graph in Hnode.
  unfold Cyclic.raw_check, Cyclic.structural_check, axiom_graph,
    Cyclic.node_wfb, Cyclic.all_nodes_wfb_from, Cyclic.all_reachableb,
    Cyclic.reachable_fuel, Cyclic.expand_seen, Cyclic.successors,
    Cyclic.node_at, Cyclic.node_edges, Cyclic.relational_check,
    Cyclic.graph_path_fuel, Cyclic.base_relations_from,
    Relations.relational_trace_check, Relations.path_closure,
    Relations.path_close_once, Relations.path_set_eqb,
    Cyclic.witness_check, Cyclic.witness_edges_from,
    Cyclic.option_tag_wfb, Cyclic.liveb, Cyclic.has_path_of_length,
    empty_trace_witness.
  simpl.
  now rewrite HeqT, Hnode.
Qed.

Definition certify_axiom (a : Cyclic.axiom_instance) : Cyclic.certificate :=
  certify_raw_check (axiom_graph a) empty_trace_witness
    (axiom_graph_raw_check a).

Lemma certify_axiom_check a :
  Cyclic.check_certificate (certify_axiom a) = true.
Proof. exact (axiom_graph_raw_check a). Qed.

End MakeCertification.
FOPL/Benchmarks/AssignmentChange.v:
(** * A six-node proof that assignment changes the next-state value

    Start from [x := 1] followed by [Next (x = 1)], without assuming an
    initial value for [x]. The script explicitly chooses assignment-right,
    a label-unit step, suffix-right, weakening and manual pure leaves.
    This example links update semantics, generated rules, trace metadata and
    certification in one acyclic proof. Booleans.v is a smaller introduction. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith ZArith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Definition postcondition := Equal x one.
Definition updated := AssignUpdate 0 one u0.
Definition root := Jdg [] [traced (Join Empty l0) (Box (Assign 0 one) (Next postcondition)) 0].
Definition assign_rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "B.Assign.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Assignment retains both the old state and the updated state. Remove the
    explicit empty prefix through a requested label-unit inference so the
    temporal rule sees its required initial-state/tail label shape. *)
Definition with_unit := premise_at assign_rule 0.
Definition suffix_goal := Jdg [] [traced (Join l0 (StateLabel updated)) (Next postcondition) 0].
Definition unit_rule := requested with_unit (UnitLabels suffix_goal [false] true true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition suffix_rule := requested suffix_goal (Local OnRight 0 "Suffix.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition first_leaf := Jdg [] [assertion (StateLabel updated) postcondition; assertion (StateLabel updated) Falsity].
Definition second_goal := premise_at suffix_rule 1.
Definition weakening := requested second_goal (Weaken OnRight 1) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition final_leaf := Jdg [] [assertion (StateLabel updated) postcondition].

(** [Next] is [Suffix Falsity postcondition]. Both suffix premises have the
    true updated-state equality available on the right; the second also has
    the recursive suffix occurrence, removed by the explicit weakening step.
    The two terminal constructors require these shallow equality proofs. *)
Definition close_first : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine (close_pure first_leaf eq_refl eq_refl _).
  intros w H; exists (assertion (StateLabel updated) postcondition); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Defined.
Definition close_final : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine (close_atoms final_leaf eq_refl eq_refl _).
  intros w H; exists (assertion (StateLabel updated) postcondition); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Defined.
(** Applying suffix-right at node 2 allocates nodes 3 and 4. Close node 3,
    weaken node 4 to its child 5, then close 5. The numbers are manual graph
    choices, not references to formulas' occurrence tags. *)
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 assign_rule; Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 unit_rule;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 2 suffix_rule; Cyclic.CloseWith 3 close_first; Cyclic.ApplyRule 4 weakening;
  Cyclic.CloseWith 5 close_final].
Definition graph := build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
Example builder_ok : build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Only the second suffix premise contains the recursive continuation.
    These checks prevent advertising principal progress on the first edge,
    where no recursive occurrence exists to follow. *)
Example first_suffix_edge_has_no_progress :
  match nth_error suffix_rule.(Cyclic.rule_premises) 0 with
  | Some p => p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).(Cyclic.edge_progress) | None => [(42,42)] end = [].
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example continuing_suffix_edge_progresses :
  match nth_error suffix_rule.(Cyclic.rule_premises) 1 with
  | Some p => p.(Cyclic.premise_edge).(Cyclic.edge_progress) | None => [] end = [(0,0)].
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example accepted : Cyclic.raw_check graph empty_trace_witness = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem assignment_changes_next_value : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound graph empty_trace_witness accepted). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions assignment_changes_next_value.

Example distinct_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags graph) = 1.
