FOPL/Benchmarks/Booleans.v:
(** * A first complete generated proof script

    Prove [modal -> modal or not modal] without unfolding the modality.
    Read the successive goal/rule/leaf definitions, then the script: node 0
    uses implication-right, node 1 disjunction-right, and node 2 identity.
    [vm_compute] verifies these fixed choices; it does not search for them. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition modal := Box (Test Truth) Truth.
Definition root := Jdg [] [assertion l0 (Impl modal (Disj modal (Neg modal)))].
Definition impl_rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "Impl.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition disj_goal := premise_at impl_rule 0.
Definition disj_rule := requested disj_goal (Local OnRight 0 "Or.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at disj_rule 0.
Definition ax := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Node indices follow the builder's allocation order. This graph is acyclic,
    so the witness can select no trace tags. [raw_check_sound] still verifies
    both graph consistency and the semantic records stored at its nodes. *)
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 impl_rule;Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 disj_rule;Cyclic.CloseWith 2 ax].
Theorem mixed_boolean_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions mixed_boolean_valid.
FOPL/Benchmarks/CheckerNegative.v:
(** * Why building a graph is weaker than certifying it

    All local rule records below have genuine semantic proofs. We deliberately
    arrange malformed or nonprogressing graphs around them to show which
    builder/structural/witness checks reject them. No invalid soundness lemma
    is postulated, and a successful [build_ok] is never used as validity. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition root := Jdg [] [traced l0 (Box (Test Truth) Falsity) 0].
Definition exact := requested root (BacklinkExact root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Identity followed by a backlink makes a closed, structurally correct
    cycle, but provides no strict semantic decrease. Constant potentials
    cannot justify its nonprogressing loop, so the full raw check rejects it. *)
Definition cyclic_build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 0 exact].
Definition cyclic_graph := cyclic_build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun _ => Some 0; Cyclic.witness_potential := fun _ => 0 |}.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_builds : cyclic_build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_is_structural : Cyclic.structural_check cyclic_graph = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonprogressing_cycle_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check cyclic_graph witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example open_node_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check (Cyclic.start_graph root) witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition dangling : Cyclic.graph := {| Cyclic.graph_root := root;
  Cyclic.graph_nodes := [{| Cyclic.node_judgment := root; Cyclic.node_payload := Cyclic.RuleNode exact [99] |}] |}.
Example dangling_rejected : Cyclic.raw_check dangling witness = false. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition bad_edge : Cyclic.edge_info := {| Cyclic.edge_valid := [(99,99)]; Cyclic.edge_progress := [] |}.
(** The absent tag 99 has fallback rank zero on both sides, so this identity
    edge satisfies the purely semantic inequalities. Its endpoint metadata is
    nevertheless syntactically invalid: tag 99 occurs in neither judgment.
    This separates semantic record construction from edge well-formedness,
    which both the generator boundary and full checker must enforce. *)
Definition malformed_tag_rule : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (counter_rule "Negative.absent-tag" root root bad_edge).
  intros w H; exists w; split; [exact H|]. split.
  - intros a b [Heq|Hno]; [inversion Heq; subst; apply Nat.le_refl|contradiction].
  - intros a b Hno; contradiction.
Defined.
Definition malformed_build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 malformed_tag_rule;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 0 exact].
Example malformed_tag_graph_builds : malformed_build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example malformed_tag_edge_rejected :
  Cyclic.raw_check malformed_build.(Cyclic.built_graph) witness = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example generator_boundary_rejects_absent_tags : someb (ensure_rule root (Some malformed_tag_rule)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Builder failures are more immediate: a closing record must have the
    node's exact conclusion, and a backlink must name an eligible earlier
    companion. Logical truth of some other judgment cannot repair a mismatch. *)
Definition true_root := Jdg [] [assertion l0 Truth].
Definition true_axiom := generated_axiom true_root ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Example mismatched_axiom_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.CloseWith 0 true_axiom]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example mismatched_rule_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script true_root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example wrong_companion_rejected :
  (Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 exact;Cyclic.AddBacklink 1 1 exact]).(Cyclic.build_ok) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
FOPL/Benchmarks/CounterLoop.v:
(** * A guarded decrement loop safe at every visited state

    This is a direct semantic invariant proof, separate from the cyclic
    prefix certificate in Cyclic.v. Prove one step safe, lift it to every
    finite iteration count with TraceSafety.v, then translate all-state
    safety into the object-language [Always] postcondition. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith Lia.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import TraceSafety.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.

Definition positive := Pred 2 [zero;x].
Definition loop_step := Seq (Test positive) (Assign 0 (dec x)).
Definition inv (s : state M) := (0 <= s 0%nat)%Z.

(** Unfold the test/assignment executions and their overlap to expose all
    three visited states: the guard stutter and the decremented state.
    The strict guard gives exactly the arithmetic premise needed for [lia]
    to show that subtracting one preserves nonnegativity. *)
Lemma step_safe : trace_safe inv (program_holds M loop_step).
Proof.
  intros s tail [testtrace [assigntrace [Htest [Hassign Ho]]]] Hinitial.
  destruct Htest as [start [Htest Hguard]]; subst testtrace.
  destruct Hassign as [start' Hassign]; subst assigntrace.
  apply (overlap_snoc M [start] start start') in Ho.
  destruct Ho as [Heq Htrace]; subst start'.
  change (s :: tail = [start;start;write M start 0 (eval_term M start (dec x))]) in Htrace.
  injection Htrace as Hs Htail; subst s tail.
  change (0 < start 0%nat)%Z in Hguard.
  repeat constructor; unfold inv in *; try assumption.
  change (0 <= start 0%nat - 1)%Z; lia.
Qed.

(** [n] remains arbitrary. [change] uses definitional equality of the generic
    trace-power helper and the model's finite-power semantics, allowing reuse
    of the proved compositional safety lemma. *)
Lemma every_finite_stop n s tail :
  finite_power M (program_holds M loop_step) n (s :: tail) -> inv s -> Forall inv (s :: tail).
Proof.
  change (trace_power (program_holds M loop_step) n (s :: tail) -> inv s -> Forall inv (s :: tail)).
  apply (power_safe inv (program_holds M loop_step) step_safe n).
Qed.

Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 nonnegative]
  [assertion l0 (Box (Star loop_step) (Always nonnegative))].
(** The initial singleton label aligns the star execution with its result.
    [always_pure_forall] then reduces the temporal claim to [Forall inv] over
    the complete execution, including intermediate test and assignment states. *)
Theorem guarded_counter_all_visited_nonnegative : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof.
  intros w Hadm Hrelations Hleft.
  pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  exists (assertion l0 (Box (Star loop_step) (Always nonnegative))); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|].
  change (formula_holds M (Box (Star loop_step) (Always nonnegative)) [eval_update M w u0]).
  intros execution result [n Hpower] Ho.
  apply overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution.
  apply (always_pure_forall M nonnegative); [reflexivity|discriminate|].
  exact (every_finite_stop n (eval_update M w u0) tail Hpower Hinitial).
Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

(** The guard does not force a star execution to reach zero: stopping at the
    zero-iteration stutter is allowed even when the counter starts at seven. *)
Example may_stop_before_exit : program_holds M (Star loop_step) [constant_state 7;constant_state 7].
Proof. exists 0, (constant_state 7); reflexivity. Qed.
Example zero_iterations_stutter s : finite_power M (program_holds M loop_step) 0 [s;s].
Proof. exists s; reflexivity. Qed.
Example zero_iterations_not_identity s : ~ finite_power M (program_holds M loop_step) 0 [s].
Proof. intros [t H]; discriminate. Qed.
Print Assumptions guarded_counter_all_visited_nonnegative.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Cyclic.v:
(** * An explicit cyclic star certificate

    This example is best read after Booleans.v and AssignmentChange.v. Follow
    the named intermediate goals, then the manual script and witness. Star
    unfolding creates a finite base branch and a recurrent assignment branch;
    substitutions bring that branch back to an earlier exact judgment.
    The source-level proof never invokes a graph or witness search. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith ZArith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

(** A real star cycle: an initial-state observation remains true while an
    arbitrary finite number of increments execute. This is a prefix property;
    the separate counter-loop benchmark checks every visited state. *)
Definition action := Assign 0 (inc x).
Definition body := First nonnegative.
(** The label already has an initial state, a nonempty trace-variable prefix
    extension, and a final state. The antecedent asserts the observation only
    at that initial state; [First] deliberately preserves that observation
    through every finite number of increments. *)
Definition prefix := Join l0 (TraceLabel 0).
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 nonnegative]
  [traced (Join prefix l1) (Box (Star action) body) 0].
Definition star_rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "B.Star.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition base_goal := premise_at star_rule 0.
Definition step_goal := premise_at star_rule 1.
(** Base branch: zero iterations are a true test, so its label gains a final
    stutter. Two explicit associations expose the original head state; then
    First-right reduces the goal to identity against the antecedent. *)
Definition test_rule := requested base_goal (Local OnRight 0 "B.Test.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition base_end := premise_at test_rule 0.
Definition base_mid := Jdg base_end.(antecedent)
  [assertion (Join (Join l0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) l1) body].
Definition base_head := Jdg base_end.(antecedent)
  [assertion (Join l0 (Join (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1) l1)) body].
Definition rotate_base_inner := requested base_end (RotateLabels base_mid [false] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition rotate_base_outer := requested base_mid (RotateLabels base_head [] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition first_rule := requested base_head (Local OnRight 0 "First.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at first_rule 0.
Definition leaf_axiom := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
(** Recurrent branch: execute one increment, regroup labels, then absorb the
    old final state into the trace variable and the new state into world name
    1. These are proved substitution inferences with corresponding world
    changes, not an unchecked syntactic identification of execution histories. *)
Definition assignment_rule := requested step_goal (Local OnRight 0 "B.Assign.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition after_assignment := premise_at assignment_rule 0.
Definition updated := AssignUpdate 0 (inc x) u1.
Definition after_world_sub := map_labels (subst_world_label 1 updated) root.
Definition after_trace_sub := map_labels (subst_trace_label 0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) after_world_sub.
Definition rotate_step := requested after_assignment (RotateLabels after_trace_sub [false] true) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition trace_sub := requested after_trace_sub (SubstituteTrace after_world_sub 0 (Join (TraceLabel 0) l1)) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition world_sub := requested after_world_sub (SubstituteWorld root 1 updated) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition backlink := requested root (BacklinkExact root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).

(** Star at node 0 allocates base node 1 and step node 2. Finish the base
    subtree first, then the recurrent branch; [AddBacklink 10 0] is the actual
    edge returning to the root. The exact backlink itself is nonprogressing. *)
Definition script := [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 star_rule; Cyclic.ApplyRule 1 test_rule;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 3 rotate_base_inner; Cyclic.ApplyRule 4 rotate_base_outer;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 5 first_rule; Cyclic.CloseWith 6 leaf_axiom;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 2 assignment_rule; Cyclic.ApplyRule 7 rotate_step;
  Cyclic.ApplyRule 8 trace_sub; Cyclic.ApplyRule 9 world_sub;
  Cyclic.AddBacklink 10 0 backlink].
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root script.
Definition graph := build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
(** Follow tag 0 through the live recurrent region. Potentials decrease on
    its nonprogressing edges and may reset across assignment's strict rank
    decrease (node 2 to node 7). They are proof-graph bookkeeping, not counter
    values or iteration counts. The finite base subtree needs no selected tag. *)
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun i => match i with 0 | 2 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 => Some 0 | _ => None end;
     Cyclic.witness_potential := fun i => match i with
       0 => 2 | 2 => 1 | 7 => 6 | 8 => 5 | 9 => 4 | 10 => 3 | _ => 0 end |}.
Example script_succeeds : build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example graph_size : List.length graph.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) = 11. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example real_backlink :
  match Cyclic.node_at graph 10 with
  | Some n => match n.(Cyclic.node_payload) with
    | Cyclic.BacklinkNode _ target => Nat.eqb target 0
    | _ => false end
  | None => false end = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example accepted : Cyclic.raw_check graph witness = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** The exported validity uses the accepted whole-graph certificate, not a
    finite unrolling or a separate semantic proof of this prefix property. *)
Theorem star_prefix_invariant : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound graph witness accepted). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions star_prefix_invariant.

Example distinct_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags graph) = 1.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
FOPL/Benchmarks/CyclicTags.v:
(** * A cyclic certificate with explicit occurrence-tag renaming

    Reuse Cyclic.v's proof up to its final backlink, insert a rule changing
    tag 0 to tag 7, then backlink with the explicit inverse mapping. Formulas,
    labels and context order stay exact; the witness must now follow the
    changed occurrence name at node 11. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support Cyclic.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Module PrefixCycle := CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks.Cyclic.
Definition root := PrefixCycle.root.
Definition retagged := rename_tags (rename_lookup [(0,7)]) root.
(** [BacklinkTags] returns a local nonprogressing rule. It can be used by
    [ApplyRule] as an ordinary inference or supplied to [AddBacklink] for a
    graph edge to a companion; the request alone creates no graph cycle. *)
Definition forward := requested root (BacklinkTags [(0,7)] retagged) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition backward := requested retagged (BacklinkTags [(7,0)] root) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition script := firstn 10 PrefixCycle.script ++ [Cyclic.ApplyRule 10 forward;Cyclic.AddBacklink 11 0 backward].
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root script.
Definition graph := build.(Cyclic.built_graph).
(** The extra renaming edge needs one more potential level in the recurrent
    branch. Strict progress still comes from the inherited assignment rule,
    never from changing a tag or closing the backlink. *)
Definition witness : Cyclic.trace_witness :=
  {| Cyclic.witness_tag := fun i => match i with
       | 0 | 2 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 => Some 0 | 11 => Some 7 | _ => None end;
     Cyclic.witness_potential := fun i => match i with
       | 0 => 2 | 2 => 1 | 7 => 7 | 8 => 6 | 9 => 5 | 10 => 4 | 11 => 3 | _ => 0 end |}.
Example build_succeeds : build.(Cyclic.build_ok) = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example graph_size : List.length graph.(Cyclic.graph_nodes) = 12. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example checked : Cyclic.raw_check graph witness = true. Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem explicit_tag_renaming_cycle : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound graph witness checked). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. exact PrefixCycle.nonvacuity. Qed.
Print Assumptions explicit_tag_renaming_cycle.

Example distinct_tag_count : List.length (Cyclic.all_graph_tags graph) = 2.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Labels.v:
(** * Label append, units and admissibility

    The semantic examples contrast ordinary label append with shared-endpoint
    program composition. The final one-node certificate shows how even a
    simple generated axiom reaches validity through [raw_check_sound]. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith Lia.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.

(** World name 0 and world name 1 denote different states. Label append
    accepts this difference, and appending a state to itself keeps two copies. *)
Definition different_world : world M.
Proof.
  refine (World M (fun n => if Nat.eqb n 0 then constant_state 0 else constant_state 1)
    (fun _ => [constant_state 0]) _); discriminate.
Defined.
Example empty_left_unit : eval_label M different_world (Join Empty l0) = eval_label M different_world l0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example empty_right_unit : eval_label M different_world (Join l0 Empty) = eval_label M different_world l0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example same_state_stutters : eval_label M different_world (Join l0 l0) = [constant_state 0; constant_state 0].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example different_states_retained : eval_label M different_world (Join l0 l1) = [constant_state 0; constant_state 1].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example different_states_admissible : label_admissible M different_world (Join l0 l1).
Proof. discriminate. Qed.
(** [Empty] is legal inside a label, but cannot be the complete label of an
    assertion. Truth-right must respect this syntax/admissibility boundary. *)
Example empty_complete_rejected : judgment_wfb (Jdg [] [assertion Empty Truth]) = false.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example empty_axiom_rejected : someb (generate_axiom (Jdg [] [assertion Empty Truth])) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example unit_component_accepted : judgment_wfb (Jdg [] [assertion (Join Empty l0) Truth]) = true.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
(** Program overlap is a different operation: its two traces must share one
    state, which appears just once in the result. To refute equality of two
    state functions below, observe their values at program variable 0. *)
Example overlap_requires_matching_endpoint :
  ~ overlap M [constant_state 0] [constant_state 1;constant_state 1] [constant_state 0;constant_state 1].
Proof.
  intro H; apply overlap_list_singleton in H as [tail [Heq _]].
  injection Heq as Hstate Htail. apply (f_equal (fun s : state M => s 0)) in Hstate; discriminate.
Qed.
Example overlap_retains_one_endpoint :
  overlap M [constant_state 0;constant_state 1] [constant_state 1;constant_state 0]
    [constant_state 0;constant_state 1;constant_state 0].
Proof. exists [constant_state 0], (constant_state 1), [constant_state 0]; auto. Qed.

(** Close the explicit goal with a generated structural axiom, package it as
    a one-node graph, then invoke the same certification theorem used by the
    larger cyclic examples. The separate nonvacuity fact supplies a world
    where this goal's assertion labels really are admissible. *)
Definition root := Jdg [] [assertion (Join Empty l0) Truth].
Definition ax := generated_axiom root ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Theorem unit_label_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check ax)). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions unit_label_valid.
FOPL/Benchmarks/NestedProgram.v:
(** * Nested regular programs preserving an uninterpreted observation

    Parameterize the predicate itself, not just its arguments. The program
    changes variable 0 while the observation depends only on variable 1.
    Structural safety lemmas handle nested sequence, choice and star, then
    [Always] states the result at every visited state. This is a direct
    semantic proof and assumes no decision procedure for the predicate. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Rules RuleGeneration Certification.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import TraceSafety.
Import ListNotations.

Module Type PROPERTY.
  Parameter holds : Z -> Prop.
End PROPERTY.
(** Build a shared kernel with the supplied predicate interpreted as an
    arbitrary Rocq proposition. The following proof can only preserve its
    existing truth; it cannot compute or invent a proof of [Property.holds]. *)
Module ArbitraryPredicate (Property : PROPERTY).
  Module Kernel.
    Module Core := MakeRules ZSignature.
    Module Model <: Core.Pr.Sem.INTERPRETATION.
      Definition interpretation := Core.Pr.Sem.Model Z 0%Z ZKernel.Model.fn
        (fun _ args => match args with [x] => Property.holds x | _ => False end).
    End Model.
    Include Core.ForModel Model.
  End Kernel.
  Module Export G := MakeRuleGeneration ZSignature Kernel.
  Definition invariant (s : state M) := Property.holds (s 1).
  Definition observation := Pred 0 [Var 1].
  Definition increment := Assign 0 (Fun 2 [Var 0]).
  Definition decrement := Assign 0 (Fun 3 [Var 0]).
  Definition nested := Seq (Choice (Seq increment decrement) (Test Truth))
    (Star (Choice increment (Seq (Test Truth) decrement))).

  (** Safety of any assignment to variable 0 follows from [write_other] at
      variable 1. No condition on the replacement term or algebraic property
      of the observation is needed for this semantic preservation argument. *)
  Lemma assignment_safe t : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Assign 0 t)).
  Proof.
    intros s tail [start Htrace] Hinitial; injection Htrace as Hs Htail; subst s tail.
    constructor; [exact Hinitial|]. constructor; [|constructor].
    unfold invariant in *; rewrite write_other by discriminate; exact Hinitial.
  Qed.
  Lemma test_safe : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Test Truth)).
  Proof.
    intros s tail [start [Htrace _]] Hinitial; injection Htrace as Hs Htail; subst;
      repeat constructor; exact Hinitial.
  Qed.
  (** Small adapters expose the generic composition/choice/power lemmas in
      the instantiated program syntax. The nested proof then mirrors the
      program tree, with induction on finite powers hidden in [star_safe]. *)
  Lemma seq_safe a b : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M a) ->
    trace_safe invariant (program_holds M b) -> trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Seq a b)).
  Proof. apply compose_safe. Qed.
  Lemma union_safe a b : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M a) ->
    trace_safe invariant (program_holds M b) -> trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Choice a b)).
  Proof. apply choice_safe. Qed.
  Lemma star_safe a : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M a) -> trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Star a)).
  Proof.
    intros Ha s tail [n Hpower] Hinitial.
    change (trace_power (program_holds M a) n (s :: tail)) in Hpower.
    exact (power_safe invariant (program_holds M a) Ha n s tail Hpower Hinitial).
  Qed.
  Lemma nested_safe : trace_safe invariant (program_holds M (Star nested)).
  Proof.
    apply star_safe, seq_safe.
    - apply union_safe; [apply seq_safe; apply assignment_safe|apply test_safe].
    - apply star_safe, union_safe; [apply assignment_safe|].
      apply seq_safe; [apply test_safe|apply assignment_safe].
  Qed.
  Definition root := Jdg [Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) observation None]
    [Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) (Box (Star nested) (Always observation)) None].
  (** As in CounterLoop.v, convert whole-execution safety into [Always] of a
      pure atom. This proves every intermediate state's observation, not just
      a property of the final state or a [First] assertion about the prefix. *)
  Theorem preserves_uninterpreted_predicate_at_every_state : Cyclic.Valid root.
  Proof.
    intros w Hadm Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
    exists (Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) (Box (Star nested) (Always observation)) None); split; [now left|].
    split; [discriminate|].
    change (formula_holds M (Box (Star nested) (Always observation)) [eval_update M w (Base 0)]).
    intros execution result Hprogram Ho; apply overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution.
    apply always_pure_forall; [reflexivity|discriminate|].
    exact (nested_safe (eval_update M w (Base 0)) tail Hprogram Hinitial).
  Qed.
  Definition witness_world : world M.
  Proof. refine (World M (fun _ _ => 0%Z) (fun _ => [fun _ => 0%Z]) _); discriminate. Defined.
  Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
  Proof. exists witness_world; apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity. Qed.
End ArbitraryPredicate.
(** One concrete instantiation closes the module parameters for the printed
    assumption audit. The theorem above was already proved for every supplied
    predicate, independently of this existential arithmetic definition. *)
Module EvenProperty <: PROPERTY.
  Definition holds z := exists k, z = (2 * k)%Z.
End EvenProperty.
Module Example := ArbitraryPredicate EvenProperty.
Print Assumptions Example.preserves_uninterpreted_predicate_at_every_state.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Quantifiers.v:
(** * Quantifier proofs, capture avoidance and eigenvariable freshness

    The first two-node graph proves universal reflexivity using an explicit
    fresh variable and a manual atomic leaf. The remaining examples explain
    why substitution renames binders and why eigenvariable freshness must
    inspect labels as well as formula bodies and surrounding contexts. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.

Definition quantified := All 0 (Equal x x).
Definition root := Jdg [] [assertion l0 quantified].
(** Choose program variable 1 as the eigenvariable for binder 0. The generator
    checks this concrete choice, then the premise is the familiar [y = y]. *)
Definition rule := requested root (Eigen OnRight 0 1) ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := Jdg [] [assertion l0 (Equal y y)].
Definition ax : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine (close_atoms leaf eq_refl eq_refl _); intros w Hleft.
  exists (assertion l0 (Equal y y)); split; [now left|]; split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Defined.
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 rule;Cyclic.CloseWith 1 ax].
Theorem universal_reflexivity : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

(** Substituting [y] for [x] in [forall y, x = y] must rename the old bound
    [y] first. The result has fresh binder 2, with the replacement [y] still
    free. The semantic examples contrast it with the naively captured tautology.
    Shadowing is different: [forall x] blocks substitution for [x] entirely. *)
Example capture_is_avoided : formula_eq_dec
  (subst_fo 0 y (All 1 (Equal x y))) (All 2 (Equal y (Var 2))) = left eq_refl.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example shadowed_variable_is_not_substituted :
  pureb (subst_fo 0 one (All 0 (Equal x zero))) = true /\
  fol_size (subst_fo 0 one (All 0 (Equal x zero))) = fol_size (All 0 (Equal x zero)).
Proof. split; reflexivity. Qed.
Example captured_formula_differs_semantically :
  ~ fol_holds M (subst_fo 0 y (All 1 (Equal x y))) (constant_state 0).
Proof. intro H; specialize (H 1%Z); discriminate. Qed.
Example naive_capture_would_be_true : fol_holds M (All 1 (Equal y y)) (constant_state 0).
Proof. intro d; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nested_shadowing : formula_wfb (All 0 (Impl (Pred 0 [x]) (Ex 0 (Equal x x)))) = true.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** The pre-adoption eigenvariable example is retained as a countermodel,
    without constructing an unsound inference record. The label itself sets
    [y] to zero, so the proposed premise [y = 0] holds regardless of the base
    environment. Its proposed conclusion [forall x, x = 0] is false over
    integers. Rejecting this eigenvariable prevents that invalid inference. *)
Definition bad_label := StateLabel (AssignUpdate 1 zero u0).
Definition bad_conclusion := Jdg [] [assertion bad_label (All 0 (Equal x zero))].
Definition bad_premise := Jdg [] [assertion bad_label (Equal y zero)].
Lemma bad_premise_is_valid : Cyclic.Valid bad_premise.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hl; exists (assertion bad_label (Equal y zero)); split; [now left|];
    split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Qed.
Lemma bad_conclusion_has_admissible_countermodel :
  admissible M bad_conclusion (constant_world 0) /\ ~ denote M bad_conclusion (constant_world 0).
Proof.
  split; [apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity|].
  intro H; specialize (H ltac:(apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity) ltac:(constructor) ltac:(constructor)).
  destruct H as [o [[Heq|[]] [_ Hholds]]]; subst o.
  specialize (Hholds 1%Z); discriminate.
Qed.
Example stale_label_eigenvariable_rejected :
  someb (generate_requested bad_conclusion (Eigen OnRight 0 1)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Print Assumptions universal_reflexivity.
FOPL/Benchmarks/RegularPrograms.v:
(** * Concrete executions of regular programs

    Construct assignment, sequence, choice and finite-star traces directly
    from their semantic witnesses. Star includes its zero-power final
    stutter, which explains the extra endpoint in positive-iteration traces.
    The final validity is a first-state observation, not an all-state safety
    claim; CounterLoop.v and NestedProgram.v prove the latter kind. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Definition s0 := constant_state 0.
Definition s1 := write M s0 0 1%Z.
Definition s2 := write M s1 1 1%Z.
Definition p := Assign 0 one.
Definition q := Assign 1 x.
(** The second assignment reads the state after the first. The sequence
    witness gives each two-state execution and their shared middle endpoint. *)
Example two_assignment_sequence : program_holds M (Seq p q) [s0;s1;s2].
Proof.
  exists [s0;s1], [s1;s2]; split; [exists s0; reflexivity|].
  split; [exists s1; reflexivity|]. exists [s0], s1, [s2]; auto.
Qed.
Example nondeterministic_left : program_holds M (Choice p (Assign 0 zero)) [s0;s1].
Proof. left; exists s0; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nondeterministic_right : program_holds M (Choice p (Assign 0 zero)) [s0;s0].
Proof. right; exists s0; change ([s0;s0] = [s0;write M s0 0 (s0 0)]); now rewrite write_current. Qed.
(** Existential witnesses choose the finite iteration count explicitly.
    For nested star, one outer iteration may itself use zero inner iterations. *)
Example star_zero : program_holds M (Star p) [s0;s0].
Proof. exists 0, s0; reflexivity. Qed.
Example star_one_has_final_stutter : program_holds M (Star p) [s0;s1;s1].
Proof.
  exists 1, [s0;s1], [s1;s1]; split; [exists s0; reflexivity|].
  split; [exists s1; reflexivity|]. exists [s0], s1, [s1]; auto.
Qed.
Example nested_iteration : program_holds M (Star (Star p)) [s0;s0;s0].
Proof.
  exists 1, [s0;s0], [s0;s0]; split; [exists 0, s0; reflexivity|].
  split; [exists s0; reflexivity|]. exists [s0], s0, [s0]; auto.
Qed.
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 nonnegative]
  [assertion l0 (Box (Choice (Seq p q) (Star p)) (First nonnegative))].
(** Extending a trace never changes its first state. The proof therefore
    uses only the overlap endpoint/head equation, independent of which
    nondeterministic branch or finite iteration count was chosen. *)
Theorem regular_program_preserves_first_observation : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof.
  intros w Ha Hrelations Hleft; pose proof (proj1 (left_singleton w _) Hleft) as [_ Hinitial].
  exists (assertion l0 (Box (Choice (Seq p q) (Star p)) (First nonnegative))); split; [now left|].
  split; [discriminate|]. intros execution result Hprogram Ho.
  apply overlap_list_singleton in Ho as [tail [Heq ->]]; subst execution.
  exact Hinitial.
Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions regular_program_preserves_first_observation.
FOPL/Benchmarks/RuleCoverage.v:
(** * Executable examples of every public rule/request family

    Compare these expected ordered premise lists with RULE_EXPANSIONS.md.
    Each example computes a fixed request and checks its exact shape; semantic
    soundness comes from the kernel record the generator returned. Most
    principals are at position 1, after a nonempty surrounding context, to
    demonstrate that generation is not limited to the head of a sequent.

    The second part gives rejected requests and syntax, followed by assumption
    audits and explicit finite-scan/weakening regressions. These computations
    check the generator interface; they do not establish proof-search
    completeness or decide whether rejected goals are false. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith ZArith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.
Fixpoint judgments_eqb a b := match a,b with
  | [],[] => true | x::xs,y::ys => judgment_eqb x y && judgments_eqb xs ys | _,_ => false end.
(** Ignore proof fields when checking premise shape; retain full judgment
    syntax, including context order, labels and tags. A failed request also
    makes the shape check false, so an empty expected list cannot hide it. *)
Definition has_shape j req expected := match generate_requested j req with
  | Some r => judgments_eqb (map Cyclic.premise_judgment r.(Cyclic.rule_premises)) expected
  | None => false end.
Definition a := nonnegative.
Definition b := iszero.
Definition p := Assign 0 one.
Definition q := Assign 1 x.
Definition u := u0.
Definition sigma := TraceLabel 0.
Definition joined := Join sigma (StateLabel u).
Definition after := Join joined (StateLabel (AssignUpdate 0 one u)).
Definition stutter := Join joined (StateLabel u).
Definition guard_label := Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u).
Definition gamma := [assertion l1 (First Truth)].
Definition delta := [assertion l1 Falsity].
Definition lhs f := Jdg (gamma ++ [f]) delta.
Definition rhs f := Jdg gamma (delta ++ [f]).
(** Left schemes: assignment exposes an updated state, sequence nests its
    modalities, and choice/star retain the catalog's two separate premises.
    Boolean and temporal schemes below preserve the same context split. *)
Example b_assign_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion joined (Box p a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Assign.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion after a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_seq_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Seq.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box q a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_choice_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Choice.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box q a)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_star_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Box (Star p) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Star.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box (Test Truth) a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box (Star p) a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_assign_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion joined (Diamond p a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Assign.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion after a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_seq_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Seq.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond q a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_choice_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Choice.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond q a)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_star_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Star p) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Star.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond (Test Truth) a)]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond (Star p) a))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example at_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a)) (Local OnLeft 1 "At.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example first_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First (Conj a b)))) (Local OnLeft 1 "First.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) (Conj a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example and_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Conj a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "And.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example or_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Disj a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Or.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Suffix.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma (Suffix a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example dualsuffix_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "DualSuffix.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma a]) delta;Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma (DualSuffix a b)]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Right schemes: conjunction/box-choice branch into premises, whereas
    disjunction/diamond-choice put both alternatives in one succedent. The
    literal label trees also check retention of assignment/test states. *)
Example b_assign_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion joined (Box p a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Assign.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion after a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_seq_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Seq.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box q a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_choice_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Choice.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p a)]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box q a)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_star_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Box (Star p) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Star.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box (Test Truth) a)]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Box p (Box (Star p) a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_assign_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion joined (Diamond p a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Assign.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion after a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_seq_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Seq p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Seq.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond q a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_choice_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Choice p q) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Choice.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond p a);assertion sigma (Diamond q a)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_star_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Diamond (Star p) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Star.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (Diamond (Test Truth) a);assertion sigma (Diamond p (Diamond (Star p) a))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example at_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a)) (Local OnRight 1 "At.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example first_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First (Conj a b)))) (Local OnRight 1 "First.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion (StateLabel u) (Conj a b)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example and_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Conj a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "And.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma a]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example or_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Disj a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "Or.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma b])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "Suffix.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma a]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b;assertion sigma (Suffix a b)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example dualsuffix_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "DualSuffix.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma b]);Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma a;assertion sigma (DualSuffix a b)])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Test rules have explicit guard occurrences at the stutter label. Some
    schemes require that guard in the input context; later negative examples
    check that a missing or different guard cannot be consumed accidentally. *)
Example b_test_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion joined (Box (Test b) a))) (Local OnRight 1 "B.Test.R") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion guard_label b]) (delta ++ [assertion stutter a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example b_test_l : has_shape (Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion joined (Box (Test b) a);assertion guard_label b]) delta) (Local OnLeft 1 "B.Test.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion stutter a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_test_r : has_shape (Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion guard_label b]) (delta ++ [assertion joined (Diamond (Test b) a)])) (Local OnRight 1 "D.Test.R") ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion stutter a])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example d_test_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion joined (Diamond (Test b) a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "D.Test.L") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion stutter a;assertion guard_label b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example not_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Neg a))) (Local OnRight 1 "Not.R") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example not_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Neg a))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Not.L") ([Jdg gamma (assertion sigma a :: delta)]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example impl_r : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Impl a b))) (Local OnRight 1 "Impl.R") ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma a]) (delta ++ [assertion sigma b])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example impl_l : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Impl a b))) (Local OnLeft 1 "Impl.L") ([Jdg gamma (assertion sigma a :: delta);Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma b]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Parameterized requests explicitly choose weakening positions, quantifier
    terms/eigenvariables, sorted substitutions, cut contexts, permutations and
    companion tag mappings. These are caller inputs rather than guessed data. *)
Example weakening_onleft : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (First a))) (Weaken OnLeft 1) ([Jdg gamma delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example weakening_onright : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (First a))) (Weaken OnRight 1) ([Jdg gamma delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example all_onleft : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (All 0 (Equal x zero)))) (Instantiate OnLeft 1 one) ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (subst_fo 0 (one) (Equal x zero))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example ex_onright : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (Ex 0 (Equal x zero)))) (Instantiate OnRight 1 one) ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (subst_fo 0 (one) (Equal x zero))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example all_onright : has_shape (rhs (assertion sigma (All 0 (Equal x zero)))) (Eigen OnRight 1 5) ([Jdg gamma (delta ++ [assertion sigma (subst_fo 0 (Var 5) (Equal x zero))])]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example ex_onleft : has_shape (lhs (assertion sigma (Ex 0 (Equal x zero)))) (Eigen OnLeft 1 5) ([Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion sigma (subst_fo 0 (Var 5) (Equal x zero))]) delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition world_sub_original := Jdg [assertion l0 a] [assertion sigma (Box p a)].
Example world_sub : has_shape (map_labels (subst_world_label 0 (AssignUpdate 0 one u0)) world_sub_original) (SubstituteWorld world_sub_original 0 (AssignUpdate 0 one u0)) ([world_sub_original]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition trace_sub_original := Jdg [assertion l0 a] [assertion sigma (Box p a)].
Example trace_sub : has_shape (map_labels (subst_trace_label 0 (Join l0 l1)) trace_sub_original) (SubstituteTrace trace_sub_original 0 (Join l0 l1)) ([trace_sub_original]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example cut_two_contexts : has_shape (Jdg (gamma ++ [assertion l0 a]) (delta ++ [assertion l1 b])) (Cut gamma [assertion l0 a] delta [assertion l1 b] (assertion sigma Truth)) ([Jdg gamma (assertion sigma Truth :: delta);Jdg [assertion l0 a;assertion sigma Truth] [assertion l1 b]]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example exchange_onleft : has_shape (Jdg [assertion l0 a;assertion l1 b] delta) (ExchangeAdjacent OnLeft 0) ([Jdg [assertion l1 b;assertion l0 a] delta]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example exchange_onright : has_shape (Jdg gamma [assertion l0 a;assertion l1 b]) (ExchangeAdjacent OnRight 0) ([Jdg gamma [assertion l1 b;assertion l0 a]]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition tagged_goal := Jdg [] [traced sigma (Box p a) 0].
Definition retagged_goal := Jdg [] [traced sigma (Box p a) 7].
Example exact_backlink : has_shape (tagged_goal) (BacklinkExact tagged_goal) ([tagged_goal]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example tag_backlink : has_shape (tagged_goal) (BacklinkTags [(0,7)] retagged_goal) ([retagged_goal]) = true.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
(** Rejected syntax cannot obtain a generated rule merely because its outer
    constructor matches. In particular purity is recursive, tags belong only
    to traceable succedents, and eigenvariable freshness includes update
    targets in labels. A malformed instantiating term is rejected even when
    the bound variable is unused in the body. *)
Example reject_empty_complete : someb (generate_axiom (Jdg [] [assertion Empty Truth])) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_malformed_arity : judgment_wfb (Jdg [] [assertion l0 (Pred 0 [])]) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_modal_body : formula_wfb (All 0 (Box p a)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_nested_modal_body : formula_wfb (Ex 0 (Conj a (All 1 (Box p b)))) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_temporal_body : formula_wfb (All 0 (Next a)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_duplicate_tags : judgment_wfb (Jdg [] [traced sigma (Box p a) 0;traced sigma (Box q a) 0]) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_tag_on_left : judgment_wfb (Jdg [traced sigma (Box p a) 0] []) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_tag_on_atom : judgment_wfb (Jdg [] [traced l0 a 0]) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_empty_substitution : someb (generate_requested tagged_goal (SubstituteTrace tagged_goal 0 Empty)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example reject_wrong_position : someb (generate_requested tagged_goal (Weaken OnRight 3)) = false.
Proof. vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
