FOPL/Benchmarks/Signatures.v:
(** * Independence from a specific signature or semantic domain

    The first functor proves equality reflexivity over any nonempty model
    with arbitrary predicate interpretations. A second, Boolean signature
    demonstrates that symbol types themselves need not be natural numbers.
    The final example rules out treating semantic functions as constructors. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool ZArith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Rules RuleGeneration Certification.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations.
Module Type ARBITRARY_MODEL.
  (** These parameters provide neither decidable semantic truth nor algebraic
      laws. The proof in [Symbolic] can only use what this interface states. *)
  Parameter carrier : Type.
  Parameter point : carrier.
  Parameter fn : nat -> list carrier -> carrier.
  Parameter pr : nat -> list carrier -> Prop.
End ARBITRARY_MODEL.
Module Symbolic (A : ARBITRARY_MODEL).
  Module Kernel.
    Module Core := MakeRules ZSignature.
    Module Model <: Core.Pr.Sem.INTERPRETATION.
      Definition interpretation := Core.Pr.Sem.Model A.carrier A.point A.fn A.pr.
    End Model.
    Include Core.ForModel Model.
  End Kernel.
  Module Export G := MakeRuleGeneration ZSignature Kernel.
  Module Export C := MakeCertification ZSignature Kernel.
  Definition root := Jdg [] [Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) (Equal (Var 0) (Var 0)) None].
  (** Atomic equality is discharged manually in Rocq, not by a model-specific
      solver. This works because [t = t] only needs semantic reflexivity. *)
  Definition ax : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
  Proof.
    refine (close_atoms root eq_refl eq_refl _); intros w Hleft.
    exists (Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) (Equal (Var 0) (Var 0)) None); split; [now left|];
      split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
  Defined.
  Theorem arbitrary_model_reflexivity : Cyclic.Valid root.
  Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check ax)). Qed.
  Definition witness_world : world M.
  Proof. refine (World M (fun _ _ => A.point) (fun _ => [fun _ => A.point]) _); discriminate. Defined.
  Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
  Proof. exists witness_world; apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity. Qed.
End Symbolic.

(** The same kernel API also works with [bool] function symbols and one
    predicate symbol. Symbol equality is decidable independently of whatever
    semantic carrier a model for this signature might choose. *)
Module BooleanSignature <: SIGNATURE.
  Definition function_symbol := bool.
  Definition predicate_symbol := unit.
  Definition function_eq_dec := Bool.bool_dec.
  Definition predicate_eq_dec : forall x y : unit, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition function_arity (f : bool) := if f then 1 else 0.
  Definition predicate_arity (_ : unit) := 1.
End BooleanSignature.
Module BooleanKernel.
  Module Core := MakeRules BooleanSignature.
  Module Model <: Core.Pr.Sem.INTERPRETATION.
    Definition interpretation := Core.Pr.Sem.Model bool false
      (fun f args => match f,args with true,[x] => x | _,_ => false end)
      (fun _ args => args = [true]).
  End Model.
  Include Core.ForModel Model.
End BooleanKernel.
Module BooleanInstance.
  Module Export G := MakeRuleGeneration BooleanSignature BooleanKernel.
  Module Export C := MakeCertification BooleanSignature BooleanKernel.
  Definition root := Jdg [] [Occ (StateLabel (Base 0)) Truth None].
  (** This dependent match is the direct form of Support.v's extraction
      helper: computing the option also determines the evidence required to
      return its axiom, making the [None] branch contradictory. *)
  Definition ax := match generate_axiom root as result return
    (match result with Some _ => True | None => False end) -> Cyclic.axiom_instance with
    | Some a => fun _ => a | None => fun H => False_rect _ H end I.
  Theorem boolean_signature_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
  Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check ax)). Qed.
  Definition witness_world : world M.
  Proof. refine (World M (fun _ _ => false) (fun _ => [fun _ => false]) _); discriminate. Defined.
  Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
  Proof. exists witness_world; apply judgment_wfb_admissible; reflexivity. Qed.
End BooleanInstance.

Import Generation Cert.
(** Function 5 maps both distinct arguments to zero in the integer model.
    This is allowed for an arbitrary function interpretation; no injectivity
    principle may be inferred from its reified [Fun] syntax. *)
Example functions_are_not_constructors : eval_term M (constant_state 0) (Fun 5 [zero]) =
  eval_term M (constant_state 0) (Fun 5 [one]) /\ eval_term M (constant_state 0) zero <> eval_term M (constant_state 0) one.
Proof. split; [reflexivity|discriminate]. Qed.
Print Assumptions BooleanInstance.boolean_signature_valid.

Module ZArbitraryModel <: ARBITRARY_MODEL.
  Definition carrier := Z.
  Definition point := 0%Z.
  Definition fn := ZKernel.Model.fn.
  Definition pr := ZKernel.Model.pred.
End ZArbitraryModel.
Module SymbolicZ := Symbolic ZArbitraryModel.
Print Assumptions SymbolicZ.arbitrary_model_reflexivity.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Support.v:
(** * Shared vocabulary for the integer benchmarks

    This is a useful first example of instantiating the generic development.
    It builds one signature/model kernel, shares it with generation and
    certification, then defines short names and proof-carrying request helpers.
    Booleans.v shows a small complete graph using these helpers; Cyclic.v
    adds a real backlink and a manually supplied progress witness. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith ZArith Lia String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Semantics Rules RuleGeneration Certification.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Module ZSignature <: SIGNATURE.
  (** Natural numbers here name symbols; they are not semantic values.
      Functions 0/1 are constants, 2/3 are increment/decrement, 4 is addition;
      function 5 deliberately has a constant interpretation. Predicates 0/1
      are nonnegativity/zero, 2/3 are less-than/equality. *)
  Definition function_symbol := nat.
  Definition predicate_symbol := nat.
  Definition function_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition predicate_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition function_arity f := match f with 0 | 1 => 0 | 2 | 3 | 5 => 1 | _ => 2 end.
  Definition predicate_arity p := match p with 0 | 1 => 1 | _ => 2 end.
End ZSignature.
(** Instantiate [MakeRules] only once. Its [Core.Pr.Sem] owns the model type;
    including [Core.ForModel Model] supplies the chosen model's rule API.
    Passing this same [ZKernel] to both consumers avoids distinct inductive
    types from repeated generative functor applications. *)
Module ZKernel.
  Module Core := MakeRules ZSignature.
  Module Model <: Core.Pr.Sem.INTERPRETATION.
    Definition fn f (args : list Z) : Z :=
      match f, args with
      | 0, _ => 0%Z | 1, _ => 1%Z | 2, [x] => (x+1)%Z | 3, [x] => (x-1)%Z
      | 4, [x;y] => (x+y)%Z | _, _ => 0%Z end.
    Definition pred p (args : list Z) : Prop :=
      match p, args with
      | 0, [x] => (0 <= x)%Z | 1, [x] => (x = 0)%Z
      | 2, [x;y] => (x < y)%Z | 3, [x;y] => (x = y)%Z | _, _ => False end.
    Definition interpretation := Core.Pr.Sem.Model Z 0%Z fn pred.
  End Model.
  Include Core.ForModel Model.
End ZKernel.
Module Export Generation := MakeRuleGeneration ZSignature ZKernel.
Module Export Cert := MakeCertification ZSignature ZKernel.

(** Program variables [x]/[y], world names [u0]/[u1], and tags below are
    different syntactic roles even when their underlying numbers coincide.
    [assertion] is untagged; [traced] attaches an explicit occurrence tag. *)
Definition x := Var 0.
Definition y := Var 1.
Definition zero := Fun 0 [].
Definition one := Fun 1 [].
Definition inc t := Fun 2 [t].
Definition dec t := Fun 3 [t].
Definition plus a b := Fun 4 [a;b].
Definition nonnegative := Pred 0 [x].
Definition iszero := Pred 1 [x].
Definition u0 := Base 0.
Definition u1 := Base 1.
Definition l0 := StateLabel u0.
Definition l1 := StateLabel u1.
Definition assertion l a := Occ l a None.
Definition traced l a t := Occ l a (Some t).
(** Constant environments are simple admissibility witnesses. They assign
    a nonempty singleton to each trace variable; they need not satisfy the
    antecedents of every benchmark. Nonvacuity here concerns label domains. *)
Definition constant_state (z : Z) : state M := fun _ => z.
Definition constant_world (z : Z) : world M.
Proof. refine (World M (fun _ => constant_state z) (fun _ => [constant_state z]) _); discriminate. Defined.

(** A benchmark first proves that a requested generation result is [Some],
    usually by [vm_compute; reflexivity], then extracts its verified record.
    These helpers do not discover a rule or synthesize its semantic proof. *)
Definition someb {A} (value : option A) := match value with Some _ => true | None => false end.
Definition require_rule (value : option Cyclic.rule_instance) (H : someb value = true) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof. destruct value as [r|]; [exact r|discriminate]. Defined.
Definition require_axiom (value : option Cyclic.axiom_instance) (H : someb value = true) : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof. destruct value as [a|]; [exact a|discriminate]. Defined.
Definition requested j req (H : someb (generate_requested j req) = true) := require_rule (generate_requested j req) H.
Definition generated_axiom j (H : someb (generate_axiom j) = true) := require_axiom (generate_axiom j) H.
(** Scripts explicitly select a premise index. The fallback only totalizes
    this convenience function; later builder/checker equations still verify
    the real premise judgments and reject an incorrect script. *)
Definition premise_at r k := match nth_error r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) k with
  | Some p => p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) | None => r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) end.

Lemma root_nonvacuous j : judgment_wfb j = true -> exists w, admissible M j w.
Proof. intro H; exists (constant_world 0); apply judgment_wfb_admissible; exact H. Qed.

Lemma concrete_valid j : relations j = [] -> Cyclic.Valid j -> admissible M j (constant_world 0) ->
  left_holds M (constant_world 0) j.(antecedent) -> right_holds M (constant_world 0) j.(succedent).
Proof. intros Hrel Hvalid Ha Hl; apply (Hvalid (constant_world 0) Ha); [rewrite Hrel; constructor|exact Hl]. Qed.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Temporal.v:
(** * Temporal operators on finite traces

    Immediate and postponed suffix witnesses illustrate the one-step suffix
    equation. Next cannot postpone, and at a singleton it is false. Dual
    suffix has the complementary singleton boundary. These are finite-trace
    facts, not imported laws for infinite temporal streams. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Definition s0 := constant_state 0.
Definition s1 := constant_state 1.
Example suffix_immediate : formula_holds M (Suffix Truth iszero) [s1;s0].
Proof. apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s1 [s0] Truth iszero ltac:(discriminate))); left; reflexivity. Qed.
Example suffix_postponed : formula_holds M (Suffix Truth iszero) [s1;s1;s0].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s1 [s1;s0] Truth iszero ltac:(discriminate))).
  right; split; [exact I|exact suffix_immediate].
Qed.
Example next_cannot_postpone : ~ formula_holds M (Next iszero) [s1;s1;s0].
Proof. rewrite (suffix_step M s1 [s1;s0] Falsity iszero) by discriminate; cbn; intuition discriminate. Qed.
Example suffix_singleton_failure : ~ formula_holds M (Suffix Truth iszero) [s0].
Proof. apply suffix_singleton. Qed.
Example next_at_end : ~ formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s0].
Proof. apply next_singleton. Qed.
Example dual_suffix_singleton_success : formula_holds M (DualSuffix Falsity Falsity) [s0].
Proof. apply dual_suffix_singleton. Qed.
Example dual_suffix_success : formula_holds M (DualSuffix Falsity iszero) [s1;s0].
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (dual_suffix_step M s1 [s0] Falsity iszero ltac:(discriminate))).
  split; [reflexivity|right; apply dual_suffix_singleton].
Qed.
(** [First] evaluates its complete body on a singleton, so even an original
    two-state stutter cannot make the nested [Next] true. *)
Example compound_first_state : ~ formula_holds M (First (Conj Truth (Next Truth))) [s0;s0].
Proof. intros [_ H]; exact (next_singleton M Truth s0 H). Qed.
(** The accumulated traces have lengths 1, 2 and 3. Their rank measure is
    1+2+3, not the number of history components. This checks the convention
    underlying Progress.v's minimum-counterexample inequalities. *)
Example sum_of_component_lengths : sequence_measure (execution_history [s0] [s1;s0]) = 6.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example execution_count_is_different : List.length (execution_history [s0] [s1;s0]) = 3.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
(** A suffix assertion at a singleton cannot hold. Used as an antecedent,
    it closes the sequent even with an empty succedent. The generated
    singleton-suffix axiom is certified as a one-node graph. *)
Definition root := Jdg [assertion l0 (Suffix Truth iszero)] [].
Definition ax := generated_axiom root ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Theorem singleton_suffix_closes : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check ax)). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions singleton_suffix_closes.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Tests.v:
(** * Stuttering tests and failed-execution modalities

    A test checks its guard on [s;s], so a guard containing [Next] can
    distinguish test execution from evaluating at a singleton state. Failed
    tests have no runs: their boxes are vacuous and their diamonds false.
    The last proof constructs a two-node generated certificate for that box. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith String.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Open Scope string_scope.
Definition s := constant_state 0.
Example successful_test : program_holds M (Test nonnegative) [s;s].
Proof. exists s; split; [reflexivity|change (0<=0)%Z; reflexivity]. Qed.
Example failed_test : ~ program_holds M (Test Falsity) [s;s].
Proof. intros [start [_ H]]; exact H. Qed.
(** This guard is intentionally temporal rather than pure arithmetic. Its
    success on a stutter checks that tests use the full formula semantics. *)
Example singleton_sensitive_guard : ~ formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s].
Proof. apply next_singleton. Qed.
Example stutter_sensitive_guard : formula_holds M (Next Truth) [s;s].
Proof. apply (proj2 (suffix_step M s [s] Falsity Truth ltac:(discriminate))); now left. Qed.
Example sensitive_test_uses_stutter : program_holds M (Test (Next Truth)) [s;s].
Proof. exists s; split; [reflexivity|exact stutter_sensitive_guard]. Qed.
Example failed_box_is_vacuous : formula_holds M (Box (Test Falsity) Falsity) [s].
Proof. apply (proj2 (box_test M [] s Falsity Falsity)); cbn; tauto. Qed.
Example failed_diamond_is_false : ~ formula_holds M (Diamond (Test Falsity) Truth) [s].
Proof. rewrite (diamond_test M [] s Falsity Truth); cbn; tauto. Qed.
(** Box-test-right adds the false guard to the premise antecedent. That
    premise closes by false-left; no proof of the postcondition is needed
    because there is no successful execution of the test. *)
Definition root := Jdg [] [traced (Join Empty l0) (Box (Test Falsity) Falsity) 0].
Definition rule := requested root (Local OnRight 0 "B.Test.R") ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition leaf := premise_at rule 0.
Definition ax := generated_axiom leaf ltac:(vm_compute; reflexivity).
Definition build := Cyclic.run_script root [Cyclic.ApplyRule 0 rule;Cyclic.CloseWith 1 ax].
Theorem failed_test_box_valid : Cyclic.Valid root.
Proof. apply (raw_check_sound build.(Cyclic.built_graph) empty_trace_witness); vm_compute; reflexivity. Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists w, admissible M root w.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions failed_test_box_valid.
FOPL/Benchmarks/Updates.v:
(** * Update evaluation and retained intermediate states

    Updates describe individual states and evaluate inside out. These small
    computations show dependent assignments and preservation of other
    variables; explicit label components then retain the intermediate states.
    The final atomic leaf proof is valid in every label environment. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Benchmarks Require Import Support.
Import ListNotations Generation Cert.
Definition w := constant_world 0.
Definition first_update := AssignUpdate 0 (inc x) u0.
Definition second_update := AssignUpdate 0 (inc x) first_update.
Definition dependent_update := AssignUpdate 1 (plus x one) first_update.
Example identity_assignment : eval_update M w (AssignUpdate 0 x u0) 0 = 0%Z.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example assignment_changes_value : eval_update M w first_update 0 = 1%Z.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example reads_previous_update : eval_update M w second_update 0 = 2%Z.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example dependent_assignments : eval_update M w dependent_update 1 = 2%Z.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example other_variable_unchanged : eval_update M w dependent_update 0 = 1%Z.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Example every_intermediate_state_retained :
  map (fun s : state M => s 0) (eval_label M w (Join (Join l0 (StateLabel first_update)) (StateLabel second_update))) = [0%Z;1%Z;2%Z].
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
(** Unlike the computations at [w], this goal makes no assumption on its
    base state: the last update overwrites [x] with one. [close_atoms] requires
    the shallow proof explicitly before the one-node certificate is built. *)
Definition grounded := Jdg [] [assertion (StateLabel (AssignUpdate 0 one (AssignUpdate 0 zero u0))) (Equal x one)].
Definition grounded_ax : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine (close_atoms grounded eq_refl eq_refl _); intros world Hleft.
  exists (assertion (StateLabel (AssignUpdate 0 one (AssignUpdate 0 zero u0))) (Equal x one));
    split; [now left|]; split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Defined.
Theorem dependent_update_terminal_valid : Cyclic.Valid grounded.
Proof. exact (raw_check_sound (axiom_graph grounded_ax) empty_trace_witness (axiom_graph_raw_check grounded_ax)). Qed.
Example nonvacuity : exists world, admissible M grounded world.
Proof. apply root_nonvacuous; reflexivity. Qed.

Print Assumptions dependent_update_terminal_valid.
FOPL/Certification.v:
(** * FOPL uses the shared checker-reflection theorem unchanged. *)
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Rules.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Certification.

Module MakeCertification (S : SIGNATURE) (Kernel : KERNEL S).
Module Export Checked := CyclistRocq.LPL.Certification.MakeCertification
  Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Syn.Language Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Syn.Shared
  Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Shared Kernel.Core.Pr.Shared Kernel.SharedKernel.
Module Export Sem := Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.
Module Export Syn := Sem.Syn.
Module Export P := Kernel.P.
Export Kernel.
End MakeCertification.
FOPL/Compatibility.v:
(** * Preservation against the frozen, import-only legacy oracle.
    Production modules never import LegacyReference. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop Logic.ClassicalDescription.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Semantics.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.LegacyReference Require Import Progress.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Progress.
Import ListNotations.
Module MakeCompatibility (S : SIGNATURE).
Module OldRanks := CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.LegacyReference.Progress.MakeProgress S.
Module Old := OldRanks.Sem.
Module New := CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.Semantics.MakeSemantics S.
Module O := Old.Syn.
Module NF := New.Syn.
Module N := NF.Shared.
(* Pass the semantic module's canonical syntax path. Alias chains in module
   arguments lose inductive sharing in Rocq 9.1's independent checker. *)
Module NewRanks := CyclistRocq.LPL.Progress.MakeProgress New.Syn.Language New.Syn.Shared New.Shared.
Fixpoint translate_term (t : O.term) : NF.term := match t with
| O.Var x => NF.Var x | O.Fun f args => NF.Fun f (map translate_term args) end.
Fixpoint translate_formula (a : O.formula) : N.formula := match a with
| O.Truth => N.Truth | O.Falsity => N.Falsity
| O.Pred p args => N.Atom p (map translate_term args)
| O.Equal a b => N.BinaryAtom (translate_term a) (translate_term b)
| O.Neg a => N.Neg (translate_formula a)
| O.Conj a b => N.Conj (translate_formula a) (translate_formula b)
| O.Disj a b => N.Disj (translate_formula a) (translate_formula b)
| O.Impl a b => N.Impl (translate_formula a) (translate_formula b)
| O.All x a => N.Extension x (translate_formula a)
| O.Ex x a => N.Coextension x (translate_formula a)
| O.First a => N.First (translate_formula a)
| O.Suffix a b => N.Suffix (translate_formula a) (translate_formula b)
| O.DualSuffix a b => N.DualSuffix (translate_formula a) (translate_formula b)
| O.Box p a => N.Box (translate_program p) (translate_formula a)
| O.Diamond p a => N.Diamond (translate_program p) (translate_formula a) end
with translate_program (p : O.program) : N.program := match p with
| O.Assign x t => N.Atomic x (translate_term t) | O.Test a => N.Test (translate_formula a)
| O.Seq a b => N.Seq (translate_program a) (translate_program b)
| O.Choice a b => N.Choice (translate_program a) (translate_program b)
| O.Star a => N.Star (translate_program a) end.
Fixpoint translate_update (u : O.update) : NF.update := match u with
| O.Base x => NF.Base x
| O.AssignUpdate x t u => NF.AssignUpdate x (translate_term t) (translate_update u) end.
Fixpoint translate_label (l : O.label) : N.label := match l with
| O.Empty => N.Empty | O.StateLabel u => N.StateLabel (translate_update u)
| O.TraceLabel x => N.TraceLabel x | O.Join a b => N.Join (translate_label a) (translate_label b) end.
Definition translate_occurrence o := N.Occ (translate_label o.(O.occurrence_label))
  (translate_formula o.(O.occurrence_formula)) o.(O.occurrence_tag).
Definition translate_judgment j := N.Jdg (map translate_occurrence j.(O.antecedent)) (map translate_occurrence j.(O.succedent)).
Lemma translate_term_wfb t : NF.term_wfb (translate_term t) = O.term_wfb t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [x|f args]; cbn [translate_term NF.term_wfb O.term_wfb]; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite length_map; f_equal; induction args as [|a args IHargs]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. now rewrite IH, IHargs.
Qed.
Lemma translate_terms_wfb args : forallb NF.term_wfb (map translate_term args) = forallb O.term_wfb args.
Proof. induction args; cbn; [reflexivity|]. now rewrite translate_term_wfb, IHargs. Qed.
Lemma translate_pureb a : N.pureb (translate_formula a) = O.pureb a.
Proof. induction a; cbn [translate_formula N.pureb O.pureb]; rewrite ?IHa, ?IHa1, ?IHa2; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma translate_formula_program_wfb :
  (forall a, N.formula_wfb (translate_formula a) = O.formula_wfb a) /\
  (forall p, N.program_wfb (translate_program p) = O.program_wfb p).
Proof.
  apply O.formula_program_mutind; intros;
    cbn [translate_formula translate_program N.formula_wfb N.program_wfb O.formula_wfb O.program_wfb];
    unfold NF.Language.atom_wfb, NF.Language.binary_atom_wfb, NF.Language.coextension_wfb, NF.Language.extension_wfb, NF.Language.action_wfb;
    rewrite ?length_map, ?translate_terms_wfb, ?translate_term_wfb, ?translate_pureb; congruence.
Qed.
Lemma translate_update_wfb u : NF.update_wfb (translate_update u) = O.update_wfb u.
Proof. induction u; cbn [translate_update NF.update_wfb O.update_wfb]; rewrite ?translate_term_wfb, ?IHu; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma translate_label_wfb l : N.label_wfb (translate_label l) = O.label_wfb l.
Proof.
  induction l; cbn [translate_label N.label_wfb O.label_wfb]; unfold NF.Language.world_term_wfb;
    rewrite ?translate_update_wfb, ?IHl1, ?IHl2; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma translate_label_nonempty l : N.label_nonemptyb (translate_label l) = O.label_nonemptyb l.
Proof. induction l; cbn [translate_label N.label_nonemptyb O.label_nonemptyb]; congruence. Qed.
Lemma translate_traceable a : N.traceableb (translate_formula a) = O.traceableb a.
Proof. destruct a; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma translate_occurrence_wfb side o : N.occurrence_wfb side (translate_occurrence o) = O.occurrence_wfb side o.
Proof.
  unfold N.occurrence_wfb, O.occurrence_wfb; cbn [translate_occurrence N.occurrence_label N.occurrence_formula N.occurrence_tag].
  rewrite translate_label_wfb, translate_label_nonempty, (proj1 translate_formula_program_wfb), translate_traceable; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma translate_context_wfb side context : forallb (N.occurrence_wfb side) (map translate_occurrence context) = forallb (O.occurrence_wfb side) context.
Proof. induction context; cbn; [reflexivity|]. now rewrite translate_occurrence_wfb, IHcontext. Qed.
Lemma translate_tags j : N.judgment_tags (translate_judgment j) = O.judgment_tags j.
Proof.
  unfold N.judgment_tags, O.judgment_tags, translate_judgment, N.Jdg; cbn [N.succedent].
  induction (O.succedent j) as [|o rest IH]; cbn [map flat_map translate_occurrence N.occurrence_tag]; [reflexivity|]. now rewrite IH.
Qed.
Theorem translate_judgment_wfb j : N.judgment_wfb (translate_judgment j) = O.judgment_wfb j.
Proof.
  unfold N.judgment_wfb, O.judgment_wfb; rewrite translate_tags.
  cbn [translate_judgment N.Jdg N.relations N.antecedent N.succedent forallb]; rewrite !translate_context_wfb; reflexivity.
Qed.
Module ForModel (I : Old.INTERPRETATION).
Definition M := I.interpretation.
Definition translated_model := New.Model (Old.domain M) (Old.domain_inhabitant M) (Old.interpret_function M) (Old.interpret_predicate M).
Module NewModel <: New.Shared.INTERPRETATION.
  Definition interpretation := New.general_model translated_model.
End NewModel.
Module NR := NewRanks.ForModel NewModel.
Module OR := OldRanks.ForModel I.
Definition translate_world (w : Old.world M) : New.world translated_model :=
  New.World translated_model (Old.world_mapping M w) (Old.trace_mapping M w) (Old.trace_mapping_nonempty M w).
Definition untranslate_world (w : New.world translated_model) : Old.world M :=
  Old.World M (New.world_mapping translated_model w) (New.trace_mapping translated_model w) (New.trace_mapping_nonempty translated_model w).
Lemma world_roundtrip w : translate_world (untranslate_world w) = w.
Proof. destruct w; reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma translate_term_eval t : forall s, New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term t) = Old.eval_term M s t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [x|f args]; intro s;
    cbn [translate_term New.eval_term Old.eval_term translated_model New.interpret_function]; [reflexivity|].
  f_equal; rewrite map_map; induction args as [|a args IHargs]; [reflexivity|].
  change (New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term a) ::
    map (fun t => New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term t)) args =
    Old.eval_term M s a :: map (Old.eval_term M s) args).
  rewrite IH, IHargs; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma power_iff (R T : list (Old.state M) -> Prop) : (forall tr, R tr <-> T tr) -> forall n tr, Old.finite_power M R n tr <-> Old.finite_power M T n tr.
Proof.
  intros H n; induction n; intro tr; cbn [Old.finite_power]; [reflexivity|].
  unfold Old.compose; setoid_rewrite H; setoid_rewrite IHn; reflexivity.
Qed.
Theorem formula_program_semantics :
  (forall a tr, New.Shared.formula_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_formula a) tr <-> Old.formula_holds M a tr) /\
  (forall p tr, New.Shared.program_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_program p) tr <-> Old.program_holds M p tr).
Proof.
  apply O.formula_program_mutind.
  - intros [|s tail]; reflexivity.
  - intros [|s tail]; reflexivity.
  - intros p args [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change (Old.interpret_predicate M p (map (New.eval_term translated_model s) (map translate_term args)) <-> Old.interpret_predicate M p (map (Old.eval_term M s) args)).
    rewrite map_map; assert (map (fun t => New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term t)) args = map (Old.eval_term M s) args) as ->.
    { apply map_ext; intro t; apply translate_term_eval. } reflexivity.
  - intros a b [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change (New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term a) = New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term b) <-> Old.eval_term M s a = Old.eval_term M s b).
    now rewrite !translate_term_eval.
  - intros a IH [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change (~ New.Shared.formula_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_formula a) (s::tail) <-> ~ Old.formula_holds M a (s::tail)); now rewrite IH.
  - intros a Ha b Hb [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; rewrite Ha, Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; rewrite Ha, Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; rewrite Ha, Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros x a Ha [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change ((forall value, New.Shared.formula_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_formula a) (map (fun s => Old.write M s x value) (s::tail))) <-> forall value, Old.formula_holds M a (map (fun s => Old.write M s x value) (s::tail))).
    setoid_rewrite Ha; reflexivity.
  - intros x a Ha [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change ((exists value, New.Shared.formula_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_formula a) (map (fun s => Old.write M s x value) (s::tail))) <-> exists value, Old.formula_holds M a (map (fun s => Old.write M s x value) (s::tail))).
    setoid_rewrite Ha; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. apply Ha.
  - intros a Ha b Hb [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; setoid_rewrite Ha; setoid_rewrite Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; setoid_rewrite Ha; setoid_rewrite Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros p Hp a Ha [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; setoid_rewrite Hp; setoid_rewrite Ha; reflexivity.
  - intros p Hp a Ha [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [translate_formula New.Shared.formula_holds Old.formula_holds]; setoid_rewrite Hp; setoid_rewrite Ha; reflexivity.
  - intros x t tr.
    change ((exists s, tr=[s;New.write translated_model s x (New.eval_term translated_model s (translate_term t))]) <-> exists s, tr=[s;Old.write M s x (Old.eval_term M s t)]).
    setoid_rewrite translate_term_eval; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha tr. cbn [translate_program New.Shared.program_holds Old.program_holds]; setoid_rewrite Ha; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb tr. cbn [translate_program New.Shared.program_holds Old.program_holds]; unfold New.Shared.compose, Old.compose; setoid_rewrite Ha; setoid_rewrite Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb tr. cbn [translate_program New.Shared.program_holds Old.program_holds]; rewrite Ha, Hb; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha tr.
    change ((exists n, Old.finite_power M (New.Shared.program_holds (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_program a)) n tr) <-> exists n, Old.finite_power M (Old.program_holds M a) n tr).
    split; intros [n H]; exists n; [apply (proj1 (power_iff _ _ Ha n tr))|apply (proj2 (power_iff _ _ Ha n tr))]; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma update_evaluation u : forall w,
  New.eval_world_term translated_model (Old.world_mapping M w) (translate_update u) = Old.eval_update M w u.
Proof.
  induction u; intro w; cbn [translate_update New.eval_world_term Old.eval_update]; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IHu, translate_term_eval; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma translate_update_eval u w :
  New.eval_update translated_model (translate_world w) (translate_update u) = Old.eval_update M w u.
Proof. apply update_evaluation. Qed.
Lemma translate_label_eval l : forall w,
  New.Shared.eval_label (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_world w) (translate_label l) = Old.eval_label M w l.
Proof.
  induction l; intro w; cbn [translate_label New.Shared.eval_label Old.eval_label]; try reflexivity.
  - change ([New.eval_update translated_model (translate_world w) (translate_update u)] = [Old.eval_update M w u]); now rewrite translate_update_eval.
  - now rewrite IHl1, IHl2.
Qed.
Lemma labelled_semantics o w :
  New.labelled_holds translated_model (translate_world w) (translate_occurrence o) <-> Old.labelled_holds M w o.
Proof.
  unfold New.labelled_holds, New.Shared.labelled_holds, Old.labelled_holds,
    New.Shared.label_admissible, Old.label_admissible.
  cbn [translate_occurrence N.occurrence_label N.occurrence_formula].
  rewrite !translate_label_eval, (proj1 formula_program_semantics); reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma context_admissibility context w :
  Forall (fun o => New.Shared.label_admissible (New.general_model translated_model) (translate_world w) (N.occurrence_label o)) (map translate_occurrence context) <->
  Forall (fun o => Old.label_admissible M w (O.occurrence_label o)) context.
Proof.
  rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall.
  unfold New.Shared.label_admissible, Old.label_admissible; cbn [translate_occurrence N.occurrence_label].
  setoid_rewrite translate_label_eval; reflexivity.
Qed.
Theorem admissibility_preserved j w :
  New.admissible translated_model (translate_judgment j) (translate_world w) <-> Old.admissible M j w.
Proof.
  unfold New.admissible, New.Shared.admissible, Old.admissible.
  cbn [translate_judgment N.Jdg N.antecedent N.succedent N.relations].
  rewrite <- map_app, context_admissibility.
  split; [tauto|intro H; split; [exact H|constructor]].
Qed.
Lemma left_context_semantics context w :
  New.left_holds translated_model (translate_world w) (map translate_occurrence context) <-> Old.left_holds M w context.
Proof.
  unfold New.left_holds, New.Shared.left_holds, Old.left_holds; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall.
  setoid_rewrite labelled_semantics; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma right_context_semantics context w :
  New.right_holds translated_model (translate_world w) (map translate_occurrence context) <-> Old.right_holds M w context.
Proof.
  unfold New.right_holds, New.Shared.right_holds, Old.right_holds; setoid_rewrite in_map_iff; split.
  - intros [o [[original [Heq Hin]] Hholds]]; subst o; exists original; split; [exact Hin|apply labelled_semantics; exact Hholds].
  - intros [o [Hin Hholds]]; exists (translate_occurrence o); split; [exists o; auto|apply labelled_semantics; exact Hholds].
Qed.
Theorem denotation_preserved j w :
  New.denote translated_model (translate_judgment j) (translate_world w) <-> Old.denote M j w.
Proof.
  change ((New.admissible translated_model (translate_judgment j) (translate_world w) ->
    New.relations_hold translated_model (translate_world w) [] ->
    New.left_holds translated_model (translate_world w) (map translate_occurrence j.(O.antecedent)) ->
    New.right_holds translated_model (translate_world w) (map translate_occurrence j.(O.succedent))) <-> Old.denote M j w).
  rewrite admissibility_preserved, left_context_semantics, right_context_semantics.
  assert (New.relations_hold translated_model (translate_world w) []) as Hrel by constructor.
  unfold Old.denote; tauto.
Qed.
Theorem validity_preserved j : New.Valid translated_model (translate_judgment j) <-> Old.Valid M j.
Proof.
  split; intros H w.
  - apply (proj1 (denotation_preserved j w)); apply H.
  - rewrite <- (world_roundtrip w); apply (proj2 (denotation_preserved j (untranslate_world w))); apply H.
Qed.

Lemma execution_sequences_preserved p tr history :
  NR.execution_sequence tr (translate_program p) history <-> OR.execution_sequence tr p history.
Proof.
  unfold NR.execution_sequence, OR.execution_sequence.
  setoid_rewrite (proj2 formula_program_semantics); reflexivity.
Qed.
Theorem counterexamples_preserved a : forall tr history,
  NR.counterexample (translate_formula a) tr history <-> OR.counterexample a tr history.
Proof.
  induction a; intros tr history;
    match goal with |- NR.counterexample (translate_formula ?a) _ _ <-> _ =>
      pose proof (proj1 formula_program_semantics a tr) as Hsem end;
    cbn [translate_formula NR.counterexample OR.counterexample]; try (rewrite Hsem; reflexivity).
  setoid_rewrite execution_sequences_preserved; setoid_rewrite IHa; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma measures_preserved a tr n :
  NR.measure_possible (translate_formula a) tr n <-> OR.measure_possible a tr n.
Proof. unfold NR.measure_possible, OR.measure_possible; setoid_rewrite counterexamples_preserved; reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem minima_preserved a tr :
  NR.minimum_counterexample (translate_formula a) tr = OR.minimum_counterexample a tr.
Proof.
  destruct (classic (exists n, NR.measure_possible (translate_formula a) tr n)) as [Hnew|Hnone].
  - assert (exists n, OR.measure_possible a tr n) as Hold by (destruct Hnew as [n H]; exists n; apply measures_preserved; exact H).
    destruct (NR.minimum_spec _ _ Hnew) as [Hn Hnle].
    destruct (OR.minimum_spec _ _ Hold) as [Ho Hole].
    pose proof (Hnle _ (proj2 (measures_preserved _ _ _) Ho)).
    pose proof (Hole _ (proj1 (measures_preserved _ _ _) Hn)); lia.
  - assert (~ exists n, OR.measure_possible a tr n) as Hold.
    { intros [n H]; apply Hnone; exists n; apply measures_preserved; exact H. }
    unfold NR.minimum_counterexample, OR.minimum_counterexample.
    destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, NR.measure_possible (translate_formula a) tr n)); [contradiction|].
    destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, OR.measure_possible a tr n)); [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.
Theorem occurrence_ranks_preserved o w :
  NR.occurrence_rank (translate_occurrence o) (translate_world w) = OR.occurrence_rank o w.
Proof.
  unfold NR.occurrence_rank, OR.occurrence_rank; cbn [translate_occurrence N.occurrence_label N.occurrence_formula].
  rewrite translate_label_eval; apply minima_preserved.
Qed.
Theorem context_ranks_preserved context w tag :
  NR.rank_in_context (map translate_occurrence context) (translate_world w) tag = OR.rank_in_context context w tag.
Proof.
  induction context as [|o context IH]; cbn [map NR.rank_in_context OR.rank_in_context translate_occurrence N.occurrence_tag]; [reflexivity|].
  destruct (O.occurrence_tag o) as [t|]; [destruct (Nat.eqb tag t)|]; try exact IH.
  apply occurrence_ranks_preserved.
Qed.

FOPL/LegacyReference/Progress.v:
(** * Semantic ranks for cyclic traces

    Read Semantics.v first. This module describes counterexample histories,
    assigns them a mathematical minimum measure, and proves the inequalities
    needed by traced rules. It finishes by instantiating Framework.THEORY.
    Rules.v packages these inequalities into proof-producing countersteps.

    A trace is a list of states; a history is a list of such traces. Its
    measure sums their lengths. A premise may describe a longer accumulated
    trace yet have smaller rank because an outer execution-history component
    has been removed. No execution enumeration or program evaluator is used
    to compute these semantic minima. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.ClassicalDescription Logic.ConstructiveEpsilon.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.LegacyReference Require Import Syntax Semantics.
From CyclistRocq.Cyclic Require Import Framework.
Import ListNotations.

Module MakeProgress (S : SIGNATURE).
Module Export Sem := MakeSemantics S.

Module ForModel (I : INTERPRETATION).
(** Fix the model once for the framework instance. [trace] is just a local
    abbreviation for the semantic state-list type at that model. *)
Definition M := I.interpretation.
Definition trace := Sem.trace M.

(** [execution_history prefix rest] includes the initial prefix and each
    subsequent accumulated trace. Its measure is the SUM of their lengths,
    never merely the number of transitions. *)
Fixpoint execution_history (prefix rest : trace) : list trace :=
  prefix :: match rest with
    | [] => []
    | s :: tail => execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) tail
    end.

(** Record the successive accumulated prefixes produced by one execution
    that starts at the current trace's last state. [rest <> []] ensures an
    actual transition, including the stutters of tests and zero iterations. *)
Definition execution_sequence (tr : trace) (p : program) (history : list trace) : Prop :=
  exists s rest result, program_holds M p (s :: rest) /\
    rest <> [] /\ overlap M tr (s :: rest) result /\
    history = execution_history tr rest.

(** A box fails through an execution and a failing body. Join their histories
    by overlapping the shared final trace once; this use of [overlap_list]
    is at the level of lists of traces, not labels. For any non-box formula,
    failure is represented by the singleton history containing its trace. *)
Fixpoint counterexample (a : formula) (tr : trace) (history : list trace) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | Box p body => exists run final_run rest,
      execution_sequence tr p run /\
      last run [] = final_run /\
      counterexample body final_run rest /\ overlap_list run rest history
  | _ => ~ formula_holds M a tr /\ history = [tr]
  end.

Definition sequence_measure (history : list trace) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun tr n => length tr + n) 0 history.

Definition measure_possible a tr n :=
  exists history, counterexample a tr history /\ sequence_measure history = n.

(** Classical existence checks and the standard least-number construction
    give a mathematical minimum in [nat], even if a program has infinitely
    many executions. The fallback 0 is confined to empty counterexample sets.
    [minimum_spec] supplies both attainment and minimality when a witness
    exists; later false-trace lemmas always establish that existence first. *)
Definition minimum_counterexample a tr : nat :=
  match excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n) with
  | left H => proj1_sig (epsilon_smallest (measure_possible a tr)
      (fun n => excluded_middle_informative (measure_possible a tr n)) H)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Lemma minimum_spec a tr : (exists n, measure_possible a tr n) ->
  measure_possible a tr (minimum_counterexample a tr) /\
  forall n, measure_possible a tr n -> minimum_counterexample a tr <= n.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold minimum_counterexample.
  destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n)) as [Hex|Hno]; [|contradiction].
  destruct (epsilon_smallest (measure_possible a tr)
    (fun n => excluded_middle_informative (measure_possible a tr n)) Hex) as [n [Hn Hmin]].
  cbn. auto.
Qed.

Lemma execution_history_last prefix rest :
  last (execution_history prefix rest) [] = prefix ++ rest.
Proof.
  revert prefix. induction rest as [|s rest IH]; intro prefix.
  - cbn; now rewrite app_nil_r.
  - change (last (prefix :: execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) rest) [] = prefix ++ s :: rest).
    assert (exists tail, execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) rest = (prefix ++ [s]) :: tail) as Hex.
    { destruct rest; eexists; reflexivity. }
    destruct Hex as [tail Heq].
    rewrite Heq. change (last ((prefix ++ [s]) :: tail) [] = prefix ++ s :: rest).
    rewrite <- Heq, IH, <- app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma execution_history_head prefix rest :
  exists tail, execution_history prefix rest = prefix :: tail.
Proof. destruct rest; eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma execution_history_result tr p history :
  execution_sequence tr p history ->
  exists execution, program_holds M p execution /\ overlap M tr execution (last history []).
Proof.
  intros [s [rest [result [Hp [_ [Ho ->]]]]]].
  exists (s :: rest); split; [exact Hp|]. rewrite execution_history_last.
  destruct Ho as [prefix [s' [tail [Htr [Heq _]]]]].
  inversion Heq; subst. unfold overlap, overlap_list.
  exists prefix, s', tail. repeat split; auto. rewrite <- app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma counterexample_head a tr history : counterexample a tr history ->
  exists tail, history = tr :: tail.
Proof.
  revert tr history. induction a; intros tr history H; cbn [counterexample] in H;
    try (destruct H as [_ ->]; exists []; reflexivity).
  destruct H as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [tail [result [_ [_ [_ Hrun]]]]]]; subst run.
  destruct (execution_history_head tr tail) as [run_tail Hrun].
  destruct Ho as [prefix [endtr [rest_tail [Hleft [_ ->]]]]].
  rewrite Hrun in Hleft. destruct prefix as [|first prefix].
  - cbn in Hleft; inversion Hleft; subst. exists rest_tail; reflexivity.
  - cbn in Hleft; inversion Hleft; subst. eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** These two directions connect histories back to truth: a counterexample
    refutes the formula, and a false formula on a nonempty trace has a
    counterexample. Their proofs recurse through boxes rather than assuming
    that every semantic failure has already been supplied as finite data. *)
Lemma counterexample_false a tr history : tr <> [] ->
  counterexample a tr history -> ~ formula_holds M a tr.
Proof.
  revert tr history. induction a; intros tr history Hne Hce;
    cbn [counterexample] in Hce; try tauto.
  destruct Hce as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest _]]]]]].
  destruct (execution_history_result _ _ _ Hrun) as [execution [Hp Ho]].
  rewrite Hfinal in Ho.
  destruct (overlap_nonempty M _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hfinal_ne]].
  pose proof (IHa final rest Hfinal_ne Hrest) as Hbad.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]. cbn [formula_holds].
  intro H; apply Hbad; eapply H; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma list_split_last {A : Type} (xs : list A) default : xs <> [] ->
  exists prefix, xs = prefix ++ [last xs default].
Proof.
  induction xs as [|x xs IH]; intro Hne; [contradiction|].
  destruct xs as [|y xs].
  - exists []; reflexivity.
  - destruct (IH ltac:(discriminate)) as [prefix Hp].
    exists (x :: prefix). cbn in *; now rewrite <- Hp.
Qed.

(** For a false box, extract a failing execution from its universal meaning,
    recurse on the body, and overlap its counterexample with the execution
    history. [program_length] supplies the nonempty sequence of steps. *)
Lemma counterexample_exists a tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  exists history, counterexample a tr history.
Proof.
  revert tr. induction a; intros tr Hne Hfalse;
    try solve [exists [tr]; cbn [counterexample]; auto].
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds] in Hfalse.
  apply not_all_ex_not in Hfalse as [execution Hfalse].
  apply not_all_ex_not in Hfalse as [result Hfalse].
  assert (program_holds M p execution /\ overlap M (s :: tail) execution result /\
    ~ formula_holds M a result) as [Hp [Ho Hbad]] by tauto.
  destruct (overlap_nonempty M _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hresult]].
  destruct (IHa result Hresult Hbad) as [rest Hrest].
  destruct (counterexample_head a result rest Hrest) as [rest_tail Hhead].
  pose proof (program_length M p execution Hp) as Hlength.
  destruct execution as [|start steps]; cbn in Hlength; [lia|].
  assert (steps <> []) as Hsteps by (intro Heq; subst; cbn in Hlength; lia).
  set (run := execution_history (s :: tail) steps).
  assert (last run [] = result) as Hlast.
  { unfold run; rewrite execution_history_last.
    destruct Ho as [prefix [lasts [reststeps [Htr [Hexec Hresult_eq]]]]].
    inversion Hexec; subst. rewrite Htr, <- app_assoc. reflexivity. }
  assert (run <> []) as Hrun_ne by (unfold run; destruct steps; discriminate).
  destruct (list_split_last run [] Hrun_ne) as [prefix Hprefix].
  rewrite Hlast in Hprefix.
  exists (prefix ++ result :: rest_tail).
  cbn [counterexample]. exists run, result, rest.
  split.
  - exists start, steps, result. auto.
  - split; [exact Hlast|]. split; [exact Hrest|].
    exists prefix, result, rest_tail. auto.
Qed.

Lemma false_minimum_exists a tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  exists n, measure_possible a tr n.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse; destruct (counterexample_exists a tr Hne Hfalse) as [history Hce].
  exists (sequence_measure history), history; auto.
Qed.

(** Non-box counterexamples have exactly one component, so their minimum is
    the length of that trace. Suffix descent will use this simple case. *)
Lemma nonbox_minimum a tr :
  (forall p b, a <> Box p b) -> tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  minimum_counterexample a tr = length tr.
Proof.
  intros Hshape Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec a tr (false_minimum_exists a tr Hne Hfalse)) as [Hmin Hleast].
  destruct Hmin as [history [Hce Hmeasure]].
  destruct a; cbn [counterexample] in Hce; try (destruct Hce as [_ ->]; cbn in Hmeasure; lia).
  exfalso; eapply Hshape; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Assignments and tests have a unique execution-history shape: the old
    accumulated trace followed by the trace with one appended state. For a
    test the shape is available exactly when its guard holds on [s;s]. *)
Lemma assignment_execution prefix s x t run :
  execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Assign x t) run <->
  run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]].
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [start [steps [result [[initial Heq] [_ [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
    inversion Heq; subst start steps. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    rewrite Hrun. reflexivity.
  - intro Hrun. exists s, [write M s x (eval_term M s t)],
      ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]).
    split; [exists s; reflexivity|]. split; [discriminate|].
    split; [apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hrun].
Qed.

Lemma test_execution prefix s guard run :
  execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Test guard) run <->
  formula_holds M guard [s;s] /\ run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]].
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [start [steps [result [[initial [Heq Hg]] [_ [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
    inversion Heq; subst start steps. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    split; [exact Hg|]. rewrite Hrun; reflexivity.
  - intros [Hg Hrun]. exists s, [s], ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]).
    split; [exists s; auto|]. split; [discriminate|].
    split; [apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hrun].
Qed.

Lemma atomic_counterexample p tr next (G : Prop) body history :
  (forall run, execution_sequence tr p run <-> G /\ run = [tr;next]) ->
  (counterexample (Box p body) tr history <->
    G /\ exists rest, counterexample body next rest /\ history = tr :: rest).
Proof.
  intro Hstep; cbn [counterexample]; split.
  - intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hce Ho]]]]]].
    apply Hstep in Hrun as [HG ->]. cbn in Hlast; subst final.
    destruct (counterexample_head _ _ _ Hce) as [tail Hrest].
    split; [exact HG|]. exists rest; split; [exact Hce|].
    rewrite Hrest in Ho. change (overlap_list ([tr] ++ [next]) (next :: tail) history) in Ho.
    apply overlap_list_snoc in Ho as [_ ->]. now rewrite Hrest.
  - intros [HG [rest [Hce ->]]].
    exists [tr;next], next, rest; split; [apply Hstep; auto|].
    split; [reflexivity|]. split; [exact Hce|].
    destruct (counterexample_head _ _ _ Hce) as [tail ->].
    exists [tr], next, tail; auto.
Qed.

(** Factor the unique-step case once. A box counterexample contributes
    [length tr] plus the body's counterexample measure at [next]. To prove
    equality of minima, compare an attained source minimum with an attained
    body minimum in both directions; an upper bound alone would not suffice. *)
Lemma atomic_minimum p tr next (G : Prop) body :
  tr <> [] -> next <> [] ->
  (forall run, execution_sequence tr p run <-> G /\ run = [tr;next]) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box p body) tr ->
  G /\ ~ formula_holds M body next /\
  minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr = length tr + minimum_counterexample body next.
Proof.
  intros Htr Hnext Hstep Hfalse.
  pose proof (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Htr Hfalse)) as [Hsource Hsource_least].
  destruct Hsource as [source_history [Hce Hmeasure]].
  apply (atomic_counterexample p tr next G body source_history Hstep) in Hce as [HG [rest [Hrest ->]]].
  pose proof (counterexample_false body next rest Hnext Hrest) as Hbad.
  pose proof (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hnext Hbad)) as [Htarget Htarget_least].
  destruct Htarget as [target_history [Htarget Htarget_measure]].
  split; [exact HG|]; split; [exact Hbad|].
  assert (minimum_counterexample body next <= sequence_measure rest) as Hlower.
  { apply Htarget_least; exists rest; auto. }
  assert (minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr <= length tr + minimum_counterexample body next) as Hupper.
  { apply Hsource_least; exists (tr :: target_history); split.
    - apply (atomic_counterexample p tr next G body _ Hstep); eauto.
    - change (length tr + sequence_measure target_history = length tr + minimum_counterexample body next). now rewrite Htarget_measure. }
  change (length tr + sequence_measure rest = minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr) in Hmeasure. lia.
Qed.

(** Removing this positive [length tr] contribution proves strict descent.
    Notice that the premise label retains both old and new states: the rank
    argument is about counterexample histories, not about shortening that
    label or pretending an assignment has a singleton execution. *)
Lemma assignment_decrease prefix s x t body :
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Assign x t) body) (prefix ++ [s]) ->
  minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]) <
  minimum_counterexample (Box (Assign x t) body) (prefix ++ [s]).
Proof.
  intro Hfalse.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Htr by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)] <> []) as Hnext
    by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert (forall run, execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Assign x t) run <-> True /\ run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]]) as Hstep.
  { intro run. rewrite assignment_execution. tauto. }
  destruct (atomic_minimum (Assign x t) (prefix ++ [s]) ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]) True body Htr Hnext Hstep Hfalse) as [_ [_ Hrank]].
  destruct prefix; cbn in *; lia.
Qed.

Lemma test_decrease prefix s guard body :
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Test guard) body) (prefix ++ [s]) ->
  minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]) <
  minimum_counterexample (Box (Test guard) body) (prefix ++ [s]).
Proof.
  intro Hfalse.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Htr by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s] <> []) as Hnext
    by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (atomic_minimum (Test guard) (prefix ++ [s]) ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s])
    (formula_holds M guard [s;s]) body Htr Hnext (test_execution prefix s guard) Hfalse) as [_ [_ Hrank]].
  destruct prefix; cbn in *; lia.
Qed.

(** Regrouping sequence executions preserves the entire accumulated history.
    The shared middle trace is overlapped once, so nesting two boxes neither
    duplicates that history component nor changes its summed measure. *)
Lemma execution_history_concat tr first second :
  overlap_list (execution_history tr first) (execution_history (tr ++ first) second)
    (execution_history tr (first ++ second)).
Proof.
  revert tr; induction first as [|s first IH]; intro tr.
  - cbn [app execution_history]. rewrite app_nil_r.
    apply overlap_list_singleton. destruct second; eexists; split; reflexivity.
  - change (overlap_list
      (tr :: execution_history (tr ++ [s]) first)
      (execution_history (tr ++ s :: first) second)
      (tr :: execution_history (tr ++ [s]) (first ++ second))).
    apply overlap_list_cons.
    + destruct first; discriminate.
    + eexists; split; [reflexivity|].
      replace (tr ++ s :: first) with ((tr ++ [s]) ++ first) by (rewrite <- app_assoc; reflexivity).
      exact (IH (tr ++ [s])).
Qed.

Lemma execution_sequence_seq tr a b run : execution_sequence tr (Seq a b) run ->
  exists first middle second,
    execution_sequence tr a first /\ last first [] = middle /\
    execution_sequence middle b second /\ overlap_list first second run.
Proof.
  intros [start [steps [result [Hprogram [Hsteps [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
  destruct Hprogram as [execA [execB [Ha [Hb Hexec]]]].
  assert (exists middle, overlap_list tr execA middle /\ overlap_list middle execB result) as Hmiddle.
  { apply overlap_list_assoc. exists (start :: steps); auto. }
  destruct Hmiddle as [middle [HoA HoB]].
  pose proof (program_length M a execA Ha) as HlenA.
  pose proof (program_length M b execB Hb) as HlenB.
  pose proof (overlap_list_append _ _ _ HoA) as Hmiddle_eq.
  pose proof (overlap_list_append _ _ _ Hexec) as Hexec_eq.
  destruct execA as [|startA tailA]; cbn in HlenA; [lia|].
  destruct execB as [|startB tailB]; cbn in HlenB; [lia|].
  assert (tailA <> []) as HtailA by (intro H; subst; cbn in HlenA; lia).
  assert (tailB <> []) as HtailB by (intro H; subst; cbn in HlenB; lia).
  cbn in Hmiddle_eq, Hexec_eq. inversion Hexec_eq; subst start steps.
  exists (execution_history tr tailA), middle, (execution_history middle tailB).
  split; [exists startA, tailA, middle; auto|].
  split; [rewrite execution_history_last; symmetry; exact Hmiddle_eq|].
  split; [exists startB, tailB, result; auto|].
  rewrite Hrun, Hmiddle_eq. apply execution_history_concat.
Qed.

Lemma counterexample_sequence tr a b body history :
  counterexample (Box (Seq a b) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box a (Box b body)) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample].
  intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct (execution_sequence_seq tr a b run Hrun) as [first [middle [second [Ha [Hmiddle [Hb Hjoin]]]]]].
  assert (last second [] = final) as Hlast.
  { transitivity (last run []); [symmetry; exact (overlap_list_last _ _ _ [] Hjoin)|exact Hfinal]. }
  assert (exists combined, overlap_list second rest combined /\ overlap_list first combined history) as Hcombined.
  { apply overlap_list_assoc. exists run; auto. }
  destruct Hcombined as [combined [Hsecond Hfirst]].
  exists first, middle, combined; split; [exact Ha|]. split; [exact Hmiddle|].
  split; [exists second, final, rest; auto|exact Hfirst].
Qed.

(** A measure-preserving map of counterexample witnesses gives nonincrease
    of minima: transport an attained source minimum, then bound the target
    minimum by that particular witness. *)
Lemma minimum_transport a b tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  (forall history, counterexample a tr history -> counterexample b tr history) ->
  ~ formula_holds M b tr /\ minimum_counterexample b tr <= minimum_counterexample a tr.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse Hmap.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply Hmap in Hce. pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hce) as Hbad.
  split; [exact Hbad|].
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hbad)) as [_ Hmin].
  apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sequence_nonincrease tr a b body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Seq a b) body) tr ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box a (Box b body)) tr /\
  minimum_counterexample (Box a (Box b body)) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Seq a b) body) tr.
Proof. intros Hne Hfalse; eapply minimum_transport; eauto using counterexample_sequence. Qed.

Lemma counterexample_choice tr a b body history :
  counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box a body) tr history \/ counterexample (Box b body) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample]; intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [steps [result [[Ha|Hb] [Hsteps [Hover Hhistory]]]]]];
    [left|right]; exists run, final, rest; split;
    try (exists s, steps, result; auto); auto.
Qed.

(** Choose a branch from a minimum source counterexample. Picking merely any
    false branch could give a larger minimum. Rules.v uses this joint result
    (branch falsity and its rank bound) to select one premise for an edge. *)
Lemma choice_nonincrease tr a b body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Choice a b) body) tr ->
  (~ formula_holds M (Box a body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box a body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr) \/
  (~ formula_holds M (Box b body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box b body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply counterexample_choice in Hce as [Ha|Hb]; [left|right].
  - pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Ha) as HbadA; split; [exact HbadA|].
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne HbadA)) as [_ Hmin].
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
  - pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hb) as HbadB; split; [exact HbadB|].
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne HbadB)) as [_ Hmin].
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

(** Split the finite iteration count into zero and successor cases. Zero
    becomes [Test Truth]; a successor becomes one body execution followed by
    the remaining star. Unfolding itself claims no strict progress. *)
Lemma counterexample_star tr a body history :
  counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box (Test Truth) body) tr history \/
  counterexample (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample]; intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [steps [result [[n Hn] [Hsteps [Hover Hhistory]]]]]].
  destruct n.
  - left; exists run, final, rest; split; [|auto].
    exists s, steps, result; split; [|auto].
    destruct Hn as [start Htrace]. exists start; split; [exact Htrace|exact I].
  - right. apply counterexample_sequence. cbn [counterexample].
    exists run, final, rest; split; [|auto].
    exists s, steps, result; split; [|auto].
    destruct Hn as [first [second [Ha [Hn Hex]]]].
    exists first, second; split; [exact Ha|]. split; [exists n; exact Hn|exact Hex].
Qed.

Lemma star_nonincrease tr a body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Star a) body) tr ->
  (~ formula_holds M (Box (Test Truth) body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box (Test Truth) body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr) \/
  (~ formula_holds M (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply counterexample_star in Hce as [Hce|Hce]; [left|right];
    pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hce) as Hbad;
    split; [exact Hbad| |exact Hbad|];
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hbad)) as [_ Hmin];
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

(** Continuing suffix obligations are non-box formulas. Both false ranks
    therefore equal their trace lengths, and removing one head state is a
    strict decrease. The caller must prove that the continuation is actually
    present and false on the chosen premise; the first suffix-right branch
    has no such recursive continuation. *)
Lemma suffix_decrease s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Suffix a b) (s :: tail) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Suffix a b) tail ->
  minimum_counterexample (Suffix a b) tail < minimum_counterexample (Suffix a b) (s :: tail).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hwhole Htail. rewrite !nonbox_minimum; try assumption; try discriminate.
  cbn; lia.
Qed.

Lemma dual_suffix_decrease s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (DualSuffix a b) (s :: tail) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (DualSuffix a b) tail ->
  minimum_counterexample (DualSuffix a b) tail < minimum_counterexample (DualSuffix a b) (s :: tail).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hwhole Htail. rewrite !nonbox_minimum; try assumption; try discriminate.
  cbn; lia.
Qed.

(** ** Rank preservation for fresh eigenvariables

    Lift Semantics.v's reversible state switch to every state of every
    history component. It transports executions and failures without changing
    list lengths. Equal sets of possible measures then give equal minima,
    including the documented fallback if both sets are empty. *)
Section CounterSwitch.
Context (v : nat) (f : domain M -> domain M) (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d).
Let T := switch M v f.
Let HT := switch_involutive M v f Hf.
Definition map_history := map (map T).

Lemma history_switch tr rest :
  map_history (execution_history tr rest) = execution_history (map T tr) (map T rest).
Proof.
  revert tr; induction rest as [|s rest IH]; intro tr; cbn [map_history execution_history map]; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH, map_app; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma last_map_history history : last (map_history history) [] = map T (last history []).
Proof.
  induction history as [|tr history IH]; [reflexivity|].
  destruct history; cbn [map_history map last] in *; assumption || reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma execution_switch tr p history : ~ In v (program_vars p) ->
  execution_sequence tr p history -> execution_sequence (map T tr) p (map_history history).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh [s [rest [result [Hp [Hrest [Ho ->]]]]]].
  exists (T s), (map T rest), (map T result); split.
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (switch_semantics M v f Hf) p Hfresh (s :: rest)) Hp).
  - split.
    + intro H; apply map_eq_nil in H; contradiction.
    + split; [exact (overlap_list_map T _ _ _ Ho)|apply history_switch].
Qed.

Lemma counterexample_switch_forward a : ~ In v (formula_vars a) -> forall tr history,
  counterexample a tr history -> counterexample a (map T tr) (map_history history).
Proof.
  induction a; intros Hfresh tr history Hce; cbn [counterexample] in *;
    try solve [destruct Hce as [Hbad ->]; split; [intro H; apply Hbad;
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (switch_semantics M v f Hf) _ Hfresh tr) H)|reflexivity]].
  assert (~ In v (program_vars p)) as Hp by (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (formula_vars a)) as Ha by (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  destruct Hce as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  exists (map_history run), (map T final), (map_history rest); split.
  - apply execution_switch; assumption.
  - split; [rewrite last_map_history; exact (f_equal (map T) Hlast)|]. split; [apply IHa; assumption|].
    exact (overlap_list_map (map T) _ _ _ Ho).
Qed.

Lemma map_history_measure history : sequence_measure (map_history history) = sequence_measure history.
Proof.
  induction history; cbn [map_history map sequence_measure] in *; [reflexivity|].
  change (length (map T a) + sequence_measure (map_history history) = length a + sequence_measure history).
  rewrite length_map, IHhistory; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma measure_switch a tr n : ~ In v (formula_vars a) ->
  (measure_possible a (map T tr) n <-> measure_possible a tr n).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; split; intros [history [Hce Hmeasure]]; exists (map_history history); split.
  - pose proof (counterexample_switch_forward a Hfresh _ _ Hce) as H.
    rewrite (map_involutive T HT tr) in H; exact H.
  - now rewrite map_history_measure.
  - apply counterexample_switch_forward; assumption.
  - now rewrite map_history_measure.
Qed.

End CounterSwitch.

Lemma minimum_extensional a tr b tr' :
  (forall n, measure_possible a tr n <-> measure_possible b tr' n) ->
  minimum_counterexample a tr = minimum_counterexample b tr'.
Proof.
  intro Heq; destruct (classic (exists n, measure_possible a tr n)) as [Ha|Ha].
  - assert (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n) as Hb by (destruct Ha as [n Hn]; exists n; apply Heq; exact Hn).
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ Ha) as [Hmina Hlea]. destruct (minimum_spec _ _ Hb) as [Hminb Hleb].
    specialize (Hlea _ (proj2 (Heq _) Hminb)); specialize (Hleb _ (proj1 (Heq _) Hmina)); lia.
  - assert (~ (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n)) as Hb by
      (intros [n Hn]; apply Ha; exists n; apply Heq; exact Hn).
    unfold minimum_counterexample; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n));
      [contradiction|]; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n));
      [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma minimum_switch v f (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d) a tr : ~ In v (formula_vars a) ->
  minimum_counterexample a (map (switch M v f) tr) = minimum_counterexample a tr.
Proof. intro Hfresh; apply minimum_extensional; intro n; apply (measure_switch v f Hf); exact Hfresh. Qed.
(** Turn semantic formula ranks into the interface expected by the graph
    framework. A well-formed succedent has unique tags, so looking up a tag
    identifies one occurrence. The empty-list fallback only totalizes lookup;
    it is not a substitute for proving decrease on real trace elements. *)
Definition occurrence_rank (o : occurrence) (w : world M) :=
  minimum_counterexample o.(occurrence_formula) (eval_label M w o.(occurrence_label)).

Fixpoint rank_in_context (context : list occurrence) (w : world M) (tag : nat) : nat :=
  match context with
  | [] => 0
  | o :: rest =>
      match o.(occurrence_tag) with
      | Some t => if Nat.eqb tag t then occurrence_rank o w else rank_in_context rest w tag
      | None => rank_in_context rest w tag
      end
  end.

(** Syntactic label substitution and its matching environment transformation
    produce identical interpreted traces, hence identical occurrence ranks.
    This is the rank half of the substitution rules in Rules.v. *)
Lemma rank_label_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label M w (f l) = eval_label M w' l) -> forall context tag,
  rank_in_context (map (map_label_occurrence f) context) w tag = rank_in_context context w' tag.
Proof.
  intros Hmap context; induction context as [|o rest IH]; intro tag; cbn [map rank_in_context map_label_occurrence occurrence_tag].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (occurrence_tag o) as [t|]; [destruct (Nat.eqb tag t)|]; try apply IH.
    unfold occurrence_rank; cbn [map_label_occurrence occurrence_label occurrence_formula]; now rewrite Hmap.
Qed.

(** Only succedent occurrences are trace elements. Missing tags have rank 0.
    True formulas have no counterexamples and receive the documented fallback
    0. False admissible formulas have the minimum specified above. *)
Module LPLTheory <: Framework.THEORY.
  Definition World := world M.
  Definition Judgment := judgment.
  Definition Sequent := World -> Prop.
  Definition judgment_eqb := Syn.judgment_eqb.
  Definition backlink_eqb := Syn.backlink_eqb.
  Definition denote := Sem.denote M.
  Definition tags := judgment_tags.
  Definition rank j w tag := rank_in_context j.(succedent) w tag.
End LPLTheory.

Module Cyclic := Framework.Make LPLTheory.

End ForModel.
End MakeProgress.
FOPL/LegacyReference/Semantics.v:
(** * Meaning of first-order labelled process logic

    Suggested reading order: the generic overlap relation; models, states and
    labels; the mutual formula/program interpretation; FOL substitution and
    sequent denotation; semantic rule equations; finally state-switch
    freshness. Progress.v builds ranks on top of these definitions.

    Two operations must stay distinct throughout: labels concatenate by list
    append, while executable program traces overlap a shared endpoint. All
    formulas are false on an empty trace; assertion admissibility makes the
    intended logical laws available on the nonempty traces used by rules. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop Classical_Pred_Type.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.FunctionalExtensionality.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.ClassicalDescription.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL.LegacyReference Require Import Syntax.
Import ListNotations.

Module MakeSemantics (S : SIGNATURE).
Module Export Syn := MakeSyntax S.

(** The same overlapping operation applies to traces and to sequences of
    traces, as in Section 2 and Definition 5.3 of the manuscript. *)
Definition overlap_list {A : Type} (a b c : list A) : Prop :=
  exists prefix s tail, a = prefix ++ [s] /\ b = s :: tail /\ c = prefix ++ s :: tail.

Lemma overlap_list_append {A} (a b c : list A) : overlap_list a b c -> c = a ++ tl b.
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]]. cbn; now rewrite <- app_assoc.
Qed.

Lemma last_append_nonempty {A} (prefix : list A) x tail default :
  last (prefix ++ x :: tail) default = last (x :: tail) default.
Proof.
  induction prefix as [|s prefix IH]; [reflexivity|].
  change (last (s :: (prefix ++ x :: tail)) default = last (x :: tail) default).
  destruct prefix; cbn in *; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_last {A} (a b c : list A) default :
  overlap_list a b c -> last c default = last b default.
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [_ [-> ->]]]]]. apply last_append_nonempty.
Qed.

Lemma map_involutive {A} (f : A -> A) (Hf : forall x, f (f x) = x) xs : map f (map f xs) = xs.
Proof. induction xs; cbn; [reflexivity|now rewrite Hf, IHxs]. Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_map {A B} (f : A -> B) a b c : overlap_list a b c ->
  overlap_list (map f a) (map f b) (map f c).
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]]. rewrite !map_app; cbn.
  exists (map f prefix), (f s), (map f tail); auto.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_head {A} (a b c : list A) : overlap_list a b c ->
  exists s tail tail', a = s :: tail /\ c = s :: tail'.
Proof.
  intros [[|x prefix] [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]]; cbn; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_singleton {A} (s : A) b c :
  overlap_list [s] b c <-> exists tail, b = s :: tail /\ c = b.
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [prefix [s' [tail [Heq [-> ->]]]]].
    assert (prefix = []) as ->.
    { apply (f_equal (@length A)) in Heq. rewrite length_app in Heq.
      destruct prefix; [reflexivity|cbn in Heq; lia]. }
    cbn in Heq. inversion Heq; subst; exists tail; auto.
  - intros [tail [-> ->]]. exists [], s, tail; auto.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_snoc {A} (prefix : list A) s start rest result :
  overlap_list (prefix ++ [s]) (start :: rest) result <->
  start = s /\ result = (prefix ++ [s]) ++ rest.
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [prefix' [middle [tail [Heq [Hstart ->]]]]].
    inversion Hstart; subst.
    apply app_inj_tail in Heq as [-> ->]. split; [reflexivity|].
    now rewrite <- app_assoc.
  - intros [-> ->]. exists prefix, s, rest. repeat split; auto.
    now rewrite <- app_assoc.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_cons {A} (s : A) a b c : a <> [] ->
  (overlap_list (s :: a) b c <-> exists tail, c = s :: tail /\ overlap_list a b tail).
Proof.
  intro Hne; split.
  - intros [[|x prefix] [middle [tail [Heq [Hb Hc]]]]].
    + cbn in Heq; inversion Heq; contradiction.
    + cbn in Heq, Hc. inversion Heq; subst.
      exists (prefix ++ middle :: tail); split; [reflexivity|].
      exists prefix, middle, tail; auto.
  - intros [tail [-> [prefix [middle [rest [-> [-> ->]]]]]]].
    exists (s :: prefix), middle, rest; auto.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_list_assoc {A} (a b c out : list A) :
  (exists ab, overlap_list a b ab /\ overlap_list ab c out) <->
  (exists bc, overlap_list b c bc /\ overlap_list a bc out).
Proof.
  (* Reassociate by peeling the first trace. The singleton case is the
     boundary where overlap contributes no additional prefix state. This
     list lemma later reassociates both program runs and counterexamples. *)
  revert b c out; induction a as [|s a IH]; intros b c out.
  - split; intros [middle [H1 H2]];
      [destruct H1 as [prefix [x [tail [Heq _]]]] |
       destruct H2 as [prefix [x [tail [Heq _]]]]];
      symmetry in Heq; apply app_eq_nil in Heq; destruct Heq; discriminate.
  - destruct a as [|t a].
    + split.
      * intros [ab [Hab Hout]]. apply overlap_list_singleton in Hab as [tail [-> ->]].
        exists out; split; [exact Hout|].
        destruct (overlap_list_head _ _ _ Hout) as [x [r [r' [Heq Hout_eq]]]].
        inversion Heq; subst. apply overlap_list_singleton; eauto.
      * intros [bc [Hbc Hout]]. apply overlap_list_singleton in Hout as [tail [Heq ->]].
        destruct (overlap_list_head _ _ _ Hbc) as [x [r [r' [Hb Hbc_eq]]]].
        rewrite Hbc_eq in Heq; inversion Heq; subst.
        exists (s :: r); split; [apply overlap_list_singleton; eauto|exact Hbc].
    + split.
      * intros [ab [Hab Hout]].
        apply overlap_list_cons in Hab as [abtail [-> Hab]]; [|discriminate].
        destruct (overlap_list_head _ _ _ Hab) as [x [r [r' [_ Habtail]]]].
        assert (abtail <> []) as Hne by (rewrite Habtail; discriminate).
        apply overlap_list_cons in Hout as [outtail [-> Hout]]; [|exact Hne].
        assert (exists bc, overlap_list b c bc /\ overlap_list (t :: a) bc outtail) as H.
        { apply IH. exists abtail; auto. }
        destruct H as [bc [Hbc Ha]]. exists bc; split; [exact Hbc|].
        apply overlap_list_cons; [discriminate|]. eauto.
      * intros [bc [Hbc Ha]].
        apply overlap_list_cons in Ha as [outtail [-> Ha]]; [|discriminate].
        assert (exists ab, overlap_list (t :: a) b ab /\ overlap_list ab c outtail) as H.
        { apply IH. exists bc; auto. }
        destruct H as [ab [Hab Hout]]. exists (s :: ab); split;
          apply overlap_list_cons; try (eexists; split; [reflexivity|eassumption]); try discriminate.
        destruct (overlap_list_head _ _ _ Hab) as [x [r [r' [_ ->]]]]; discriminate.
Qed.

(** Interpretations are total on argument lists; syntax checks enforce arity
    for actual object-language uses. No injectivity, disjoint constructors,
    decision procedure for truth, or arithmetic structure is assumed.
    [domain_inhabitant] witnesses nonemptiness and supports classical choice. *)
Record model : Type := Model {
  domain : Type;
  domain_inhabitant : domain;
  interpret_function : S.function_symbol -> list domain -> domain;
  interpret_predicate : S.predicate_symbol -> list domain -> Prop
}.

Section Interpretation.
Context (M : model).
(** A state assigns a model value to each program variable. The surrounding
    section generalizes the definitions and proofs over [M]; integer-specific
    reasoning only appears in the benchmarks. *)
Definition state := nat -> domain M.
Definition trace := list state.

Definition write (s : state) (x : nat) (value : domain M) : state :=
  fun y => if Nat.eqb x y then value else s y.

Lemma write_same s x v : write s x v x = v.
Proof. unfold write; now rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. Qed.
Lemma write_other s x y v : x <> y -> write s x v y = s y.
Proof. intro H; unfold write; apply Nat.eqb_neq in H; now rewrite H. Qed.

Fixpoint eval_term (s : state) (t : term) : domain M :=
  match t with
  | Var x => s x
  | Fun f ts => interpret_function M f (map (eval_term s) ts)
  end.

(** States are functions, so equalities between whole updated states use
    functional extensionality. These update laws also handle the shadowing
    and commuting writes encountered under named quantifiers. *)
Lemma write_shadow s x a b : write (write s x a) x b = write s x b.
Proof. apply functional_extensionality; intro y; unfold write; destruct (Nat.eqb x y); reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma write_commute s x y a b : x <> y ->
  write (write s x a) y b = write (write s y b) x a.
Proof.
  intro Hne; apply functional_extensionality; intro z; unfold write.
  destruct (Nat.eqb x z) eqn:Hx, (Nat.eqb y z) eqn:Hy; try reflexivity.
  apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hx, Hy; congruence.
Qed.
Lemma write_current s x : write s x (s x) = s.
Proof.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y; unfold write.
  destruct (Nat.eqb x y) eqn:H; [apply Nat.eqb_eq in H; subst|]; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The basic substitution equation: replacing a variable syntactically is
    equivalent to first evaluating its replacement in the original state,
    then changing that variable's semantic value. *)
Lemma eval_term_subst t : forall s x replacement,
  eval_term s (subst_term x replacement t) =
