    term-substitution operation for programs or temporal formulas. Public
    quantifier rules use the capture-avoiding [subst_fo] defined below. *)
Fixpoint raw_subst_fo (x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : formula :=
  match a with
  | Truth => Truth
  | Falsity => Falsity
  | Pred p ts => Pred p (map (subst_term x t) ts)
  | Equal l r => Equal (subst_term x t l) (subst_term x t r)
  | Neg a => Neg (raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | Conj a b => Conj (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | Disj a b => Disj (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | Impl a b => Impl (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | All y a => All y (if Nat.eqb x y then a else raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | Ex y a => Ex y (if Nat.eqb x y then a else raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | _ => a
  end.

Fixpoint free_forb (x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity | Pred _ _ | Equal _ _ => true
  | Neg a => free_forb x t a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b => free_forb x t a && free_forb x t b
  | All y a | Ex y a =>
      if Nat.eqb x y then true
      else negb (existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t)) && free_forb x t a
  | _ => false
  end.

(** Choosing one above the maximum is deterministic and needs no search for
    a witness. Collecting bound names too makes fresh renaming conservative. *)
Definition fresh_name (names : list nat) := Datatypes.S (fold_right Nat.max 0 names).

Lemma occursb_false x names : existsb (Nat.eqb x) names = false <-> ~ In x names.
Proof.
  rewrite <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists. split.
  - intros H Hin; apply H; exists x; split; [exact Hin|apply Nat.eqb_refl].
  - intros H [y [Hin Heq]]; apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq; subst; contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_name_not_in names : ~ In (fresh_name names) names.
Proof.
  assert (forall x, In x names -> x <= fold_right Nat.max 0 names) as Hbound.
  { induction names as [|a names IH]; cbn; [tauto|].
    intros x [->|Hin]; [apply Nat.le_max_l|]. eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply IH; exact Hin|apply Nat.le_max_r]. }
  intro Hin; specialize (Hbound _ Hin); unfold fresh_name in Hbound; lia.
Qed.

(** Renaming a binder changes its body before substitution recurses, so that
    body is not literally a subterm of the original input. A size bound gives
    a terminating fuel implementation; [raw_subst_size] justifies renaming
    without consuming additional formula depth. *)
Fixpoint fol_size (a : formula) : nat :=
  match a with
  | Neg a | All _ a | Ex _ a | First a | Box _ a | Diamond _ a => Datatypes.S (fol_size a)
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b => Datatypes.S (fol_size a + fol_size b)
  | _ => 1
  end.

Lemma raw_subst_size a x t : fol_size (raw_subst_fo x t a) = fol_size a.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [raw_subst_fo fol_size]; try congruence;
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [fol_size]; congruence.
Qed.

Lemma raw_subst_pure a x t : pureb a = true -> pureb (raw_subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb raw_subst_fo]; intro H; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply andb_true_iff in H; rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by tauto; reflexivity);
    try (apply IHa; exact H);
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [pureb]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma rename_free_for a u v : pureb a = true -> ~ In v (formula_vars a) -> free_forb u (Var v) a = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb free_forb formula_vars]; intros Hp Hv; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply IHa; assumption).
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x); [reflexivity|]. apply andb_true_iff; split.
    + apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false; cbn [term_vars]; intro H; destruct H; [subst|contradiction]; apply Hv; now left.
    + apply IHa; [exact Hp|intro H; apply Hv; now right].
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x); [reflexivity|]. apply andb_true_iff; split.
    + apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false; cbn [term_vars]; intro H; destruct H; [subst|contradiction]; apply Hv; now left.
    + apply IHa; [exact Hp|intro H; apply Hv; now right].
Qed.

(** Total capture-avoiding substitution. At a quantifier there are three
    cases: its binder shadows [x]; its binder would capture a name of [t]; or
    substitution may descend directly. In the second case, rename first to a
    name fresh for the body, replacement and substituted variable. The fuel
    is a proved structural bound; public callers do not choose it. *)
Fixpoint subst_fo_fuel (fuel x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : formula :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => a
  | Datatypes.S fuel =>
    match a with
    | Truth => Truth
    | Falsity => Falsity
    | Pred p ts => Pred p (map (subst_term x t) ts)
    | Equal l r => Equal (subst_term x t l) (subst_term x t r)
    | Neg a => Neg (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a)
    | Conj a b => Conj (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | Disj a b => Disj (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | Impl a b => Impl (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | All y body =>
        if Nat.eqb x y then a
        else if existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t) then
          let z := fresh_name (x :: y :: (formula_vars body ++ term_vars t)) in
          All z (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body))
        else All y (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t body)
    | Ex y body =>
        if Nat.eqb x y then a
        else if existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t) then
          let z := fresh_name (x :: y :: (formula_vars body ++ term_vars t)) in
          Ex z (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body))
        else Ex y (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t body)
    | _ => a
    end
  end.

Definition subst_fo x t a := subst_fo_fuel (fol_size a) x t a.

Lemma subst_fo_fuel_pure fuel : forall x t a, pureb a = true -> pureb (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros x t a Hp; [exact Hp|].
  destruct a; cbn [subst_fo_fuel pureb] in *; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply IH; exact Hp);
    try (apply andb_true_iff in Hp; rewrite !IH by tauto; reflexivity);
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [exact Hp| |exact Hp|];
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [pureb];
    apply IH; try (apply raw_subst_pure); exact Hp.
Qed.

(** These abbreviations inherit finite-trace suffix semantics. In particular
    [Next] is false at the last state; [Always] includes the current state.
    Their semantic boundary laws are proved in Semantics.v. *)
Definition Next a := Suffix Falsity a.
Definition Eventually a := Disj a (Suffix Truth a).
Definition Always a := Neg (Eventually (Neg a)).

(** An update is a description of one state, rooted at a world variable.
    [AssignUpdate x t previous] evaluates [t] after [previous], then writes
    [x]. It does not itself store the sequence of intermediate states. *)
Inductive update : Type :=
| Base (world_variable : nat)
| AssignUpdate (x : nat) (value : term) (previous : update).

Fixpoint update_eq_dec (a b : update) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof. decide equality; try apply term_eq_dec; apply Nat.eq_dec. Defined.

Fixpoint update_wfb (u : update) : bool :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => true
  | AssignUpdate _ t u => term_wfb t && update_wfb u
  end.

Fixpoint update_vars (u : update) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => []
  | AssignUpdate x t u => x :: (term_vars t ++ update_vars u)
  end.

(** Labels describe traces. [Join] is kept as a binary syntax tree so exact
    graph matching sees its parentheses; evaluation will use ordinary append.
    A separate label component is needed for each intermediate update state. *)
Inductive label : Type :=
| Empty
| StateLabel (u : update)
| TraceLabel (trace_variable : nat)
| Join (a b : label).

Fixpoint label_eq_dec (a b : label) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof. decide equality; try apply update_eq_dec; apply Nat.eq_dec. Defined.

Fixpoint label_wfb (l : label) : bool :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => update_wfb u
  | Join a b => label_wfb a && label_wfb b
  | _ => true
  end.

(** A join is nonempty when either component is nonempty. Empty components
    are valid units; only an empty complete assertion label is forbidden.
    Trace variables are nonempty because semantic worlds carry that proof. *)
Fixpoint label_nonemptyb (l : label) : bool :=
  match l with
  | Empty => false
  | StateLabel _ | TraceLabel _ => true
  | Join a b => label_nonemptyb a || label_nonemptyb b
  end.

(** These are program-variable names occurring in updates, for eigenvariable
    freshness. World and trace names belong to different syntactic sorts and
    must not be added just because all three are represented by [nat]. *)
Fixpoint label_vars (l : label) : list nat :=
  match l with
  | Empty | TraceLabel _ => []
  | StateLabel u => update_vars u
  | Join a b => label_vars a ++ label_vars b
  end.

(** Sorted label substitutions: a world name receives an update, and a trace
    name receives a label. No arbitrary trace can become the base of an update. *)
Fixpoint subst_world_update (x : nat) (replacement u : update) : update :=
  match u with
  | Base y => if Nat.eqb x y then replacement else u
  | AssignUpdate y t u => AssignUpdate y t (subst_world_update x replacement u)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_world_label (x : nat) (replacement : update) (l : label) : label :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => StateLabel (subst_world_update x replacement u)
  | Join a b => Join (subst_world_label x replacement a) (subst_world_label x replacement b)
  | _ => l
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trace_label (x : nat) (replacement l : label) : label :=
  match l with
  | TraceLabel y => if Nat.eqb x y then replacement else l
  | Join a b => Join (subst_trace_label x replacement a) (subst_trace_label x replacement b)
  | _ => l
  end.

(** Explicit label algebra, with a caller-selected path: [false] descends
    left, [true] descends right. At the selected node, [left = true] groups
    to the left. An inapplicable path/rotation leaves the relevant syntax
    unchanged. These operations perform no normalization search. *)
Fixpoint rotate_label (path : list bool) (left : bool) (l : label) : label :=
  match path with
  | [] => if left then
      match l with Join a (Join b c) => Join (Join a b) c | _ => l end
    else match l with Join (Join a b) c => Join a (Join b c) | _ => l end
  | direction :: path => match l with
    | Join a b => if direction then Join a (rotate_label path left b)
        else Join (rotate_label path left a) b
    | _ => l end
  end.

(** Use the same paths to insert or remove an explicit [Empty] component.
    Semantics.v proves that both label-algebra operations preserve evaluation. *)
Fixpoint unit_label (path : list bool) (on_left insert : bool) (l : label) : label :=
  match path with
  | [] => if insert then if on_left then Join Empty l else Join l Empty
      else if on_left then match l with Join Empty a => a | _ => l end
      else match l with Join a Empty => a | _ => l end
  | direction :: path => match l with
    | Join a b => if direction then Join a (unit_label path on_left insert b)
        else Join (unit_label path on_left insert a) b
    | _ => l end
  end.

(** Only these succedent formulas can be followed by a cyclic trace. A tag
    identifies an occurrence, not a formula's syntactic position in a list. *)
Definition traceableb (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with Box _ _ | Suffix _ _ | DualSuffix _ _ => true | _ => false end.

(** Tags are proof metadata: Semantics.v ignores them when interpreting
    truth, while Progress.v uses them to find the occurrence whose rank is
    followed. Distinct copies of the same labelled formula remain distinct
    occurrences and need distinct tags when both are tagged. *)
Record occurrence : Type := Occ {
  occurrence_label : label;
  occurrence_formula : formula;
  occurrence_tag : option nat
}.

(** [Jdg Gamma Delta] represents a two-sided sequent. Lists preserve exact
    order for graph checking; explicit exchange rules account for reordering.
    Semantically the antecedent is a conjunction and the succedent a
    disjunction, including their empty-list cases. *)
Record judgment : Type := Jdg {
  antecedent : list occurrence;
  succedent : list occurrence
}.

Definition map_label_occurrence (f : label -> label) o :=
  Occ (f o.(occurrence_label)) o.(occurrence_formula) o.(occurrence_tag).
Definition map_labels (f : label -> label) j :=
  Jdg (map (map_label_occurrence f) j.(antecedent)) (map (map_label_occurrence f) j.(succedent)).
Definition rename_occurrence_tag (f : nat -> nat) o :=
  Occ o.(occurrence_label) o.(occurrence_formula) (option_map f o.(occurrence_tag)).
Definition rename_tags (f : nat -> nat) j :=
  Jdg (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) j.(antecedent)) (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) j.(succedent)).

Definition occurrence_eq_dec : forall a b : occurrence, {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof.
  decide equality; [decide equality; apply Nat.eq_dec | apply formula_eq_dec | apply label_eq_dec].
Defined.

Definition judgment_eq_dec : forall a b : judgment, {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof. decide equality; apply list_eq_dec; apply occurrence_eq_dec. Defined.

Definition judgment_eqb a b := if judgment_eq_dec a b then true else false.
Lemma judgment_eqb_spec a b : judgment_eqb a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof. unfold judgment_eqb; destruct (judgment_eq_dec a b); intuition discriminate. Qed.

(** Exact equality includes tags. Backlink equality ignores only tags:
    labels, update histories, formulas, programs and context order must still
    match. Explicit tag-renaming rules later justify the corresponding ranks. *)
Definition erase_tag o := Occ o.(occurrence_label) o.(occurrence_formula) None.
Definition erase_tags j := Jdg (map erase_tag j.(antecedent)) (map erase_tag j.(succedent)).
Definition backlink_eqb a b := judgment_eqb (erase_tags a) (erase_tags b).

Definition occurrence_vars o := label_vars o.(occurrence_label) ++ formula_vars o.(occurrence_formula).
Definition judgment_vars j := flat_map occurrence_vars (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)).
Definition eigen_freshb v j l a :=
  negb (existsb (Nat.eqb v) (judgment_vars j ++ label_vars l ++ formula_vars a)).

(** The occurrence check combines four independent requirements: valid label
    syntax, nonempty complete label, valid formula syntax, and legal tagging.
    [right] rejects every antecedent tag, even on a box formula. *)
Definition occurrence_wfb (right : bool) o :=
  label_wfb o.(occurrence_label) && label_nonemptyb o.(occurrence_label) &&
  formula_wfb o.(occurrence_formula) &&
  match o.(occurrence_tag) with
  | None => true
  | Some _ => right && traceableb o.(occurrence_formula)
  end.

Definition judgment_tags j :=
  flat_map (fun o => match o.(occurrence_tag) with None => [] | Some n => [n] end)
    j.(succedent).

Fixpoint unique_tagsb (ts : list nat) :=
  match ts with
  | [] => true
  | t :: ts => negb (existsb (Nat.eqb t) ts) && unique_tagsb ts
  end.

(** Uniqueness makes lookup by tag unambiguous. The generic cyclic framework
    checks edge endpoints, but these object-language invariants belong here. *)
Definition judgment_wfb j :=
  forallb (occurrence_wfb false) j.(antecedent) &&
  forallb (occurrence_wfb true) j.(succedent) && unique_tagsb (judgment_tags j).

Lemma unique_tagsb_spec ts : unique_tagsb ts = true <-> NoDup ts.
Proof.
  induction ts as [|t ts IH]; cbn.
  - split; constructor.
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, negb_true_iff, IH.
    assert (existsb (Nat.eqb t) ts = false <-> ~ In t ts) as H.
    { rewrite <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists.
      split.
      - intros H Hin. apply H. exists t; split; [exact Hin | apply Nat.eqb_refl].
      - intros H [x [Hin Heq]]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq. subst; contradiction. }
    rewrite H. split; [intros [Hn Hd]; constructor; assumption | intro Hd; inversion Hd; auto].
Qed.

Lemma eigen_freshb_spec v j l a :
  eigen_freshb v j l a = true <->
  ~ In v (judgment_vars j ++ label_vars l ++ formula_vars a).
Proof.
  unfold eigen_freshb. rewrite negb_true_iff, <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists.
  split.
  - intros H Hin. apply H. exists v; split; [exact Hin | apply Nat.eqb_refl].
  - intros H [x [Hin Heq]]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq. subst; contradiction.
Qed.

(** Propositional specifications for the executable syntax boundary. In
    particular [pure_formula] is exactly D2's grammar, independently of the
    Boolean recognizer used by generators. *)
Inductive pure_formula : formula -> Prop :=
| PureTruth : pure_formula Truth
| PureFalsity : pure_formula Falsity
| PurePred p ts : pure_formula (Pred p ts)
| PureEqual t u : pure_formula (Equal t u)
| PureNeg a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (Neg a)
| PureConj a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Conj a b)
| PureDisj a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Disj a b)
| PureImpl a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Impl a b)
| PureAll x a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (All x a)
| PureEx x a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (Ex x a).

Lemma pureb_spec a : pureb a = true <-> pure_formula a.
Proof.
  split.
  - induction a; cbn [pureb]; intro H; try discriminate;
      try solve [constructor]; try solve [constructor; apply IHa; exact H].
    all: apply andb_true_iff in H as [Ha Hb]; constructor;
      [apply IHa1; exact Ha | apply IHa2; exact Hb].
  - intro H; induction H; cbn [pureb];
      rewrite ?IHpure_formula, ?IHpure_formula1, ?IHpure_formula2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive term_wf : term -> Prop :=
| WfVar x : term_wf (Var x)
| WfFun f ts : length ts = S.function_arity f ->
    Forall term_wf ts -> term_wf (Fun f ts).

Lemma term_wfb_spec t : term_wfb t = true <-> term_wf t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [x|f ts]; cbn [term_wfb].
  - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
  - assert (forallb term_wfb ts = true <-> Forall term_wf ts) as Hargs.
    { induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; cbn.
      - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
      - rewrite andb_true_iff, (IH a), IHts.
        split; [intros [Ha Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto]. }
    rewrite andb_true_iff, Nat.eqb_eq, Hargs.
    split; [intros [Harity Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto].
Qed.

Lemma terms_wfb_spec ts : forallb term_wfb ts = true <-> Forall term_wf ts.
Proof.
  induction ts as [|t ts IH]; cbn.
  - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, term_wfb_spec, IH.
    split; [intros [Ht Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto].
Qed.

(** These propositional specifications separate what well-formedness means
    from the executable checks. The mutual reflection proof follows the same
    formula/program induction principle used for semantic freshness later. *)
Fixpoint formula_wf (a : formula) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity => True
  | Pred p ts => length ts = S.predicate_arity p /\ Forall term_wf ts
  | Equal a b => term_wf a /\ term_wf b
  | Neg a | First a => formula_wf a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b =>
      formula_wf a /\ formula_wf b
  | All _ a | Ex _ a => pure_formula a /\ formula_wf a
  | Box p a | Diamond p a => program_wf p /\ formula_wf a
  end
with program_wf (p : program) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Assign _ t => term_wf t
  | Test a => formula_wf a
  | Seq a b | Choice a b => program_wf a /\ program_wf b
  | Star a => program_wf a
  end.

Lemma formula_program_wfb_spec :
  (forall a, formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a) /\
  (forall p, program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p).
Proof.
  apply formula_program_mutind; intros; cbn [formula_wfb program_wfb formula_wf program_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?Nat.eqb_eq, ?terms_wfb_spec, ?term_wfb_spec,
      ?pureb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma formula_wfb_spec a : formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.

Lemma program_wfb_spec p : program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.

Fixpoint update_wf u : Prop :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => True
  | AssignUpdate _ t u => term_wf t /\ update_wf u
  end.

Fixpoint label_wf l : Prop :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => update_wf u
  | Join a b => label_wf a /\ label_wf b
  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma update_wfb_spec u : update_wfb u = true <-> update_wf u.
Proof.
  induction u; cbn [update_wfb update_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?term_wfb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma label_wfb_spec l : label_wfb l = true <-> label_wf l.
Proof.
  induction l; cbn [label_wfb label_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?update_wfb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Definition occurrence_wf right o : Prop :=
  label_wf o.(occurrence_label) /\ label_nonemptyb o.(occurrence_label) = true /\
  formula_wf o.(occurrence_formula) /\
  match o.(occurrence_tag) with
  | None => True
  | Some _ => right = true /\ traceableb o.(occurrence_formula) = true
  end.

Definition judgment_wf j : Prop :=
  Forall (occurrence_wf false) j.(antecedent) /\
  Forall (occurrence_wf true) j.(succedent) /\ NoDup (judgment_tags j).

Lemma occurrence_wfb_spec right o : occurrence_wfb right o = true <-> occurrence_wf right o.
Proof.
  unfold occurrence_wfb, occurrence_wf.
  destruct (occurrence_tag o); rewrite !andb_true_iff, label_wfb_spec, formula_wfb_spec;
    intuition.
Qed.

(** This is the full syntax boundary available to a caller who wants to
    reason propositionally after computing [judgment_wfb]. Nonemptiness is
    related to semantic admissibility separately in Semantics.v. *)
Lemma judgment_wfb_spec j : judgment_wfb j = true <-> judgment_wf j.
Proof.
  unfold judgment_wfb, judgment_wf.
  rewrite !andb_true_iff, unique_tagsb_spec, !forallb_forall, !Forall_forall.
  setoid_rewrite occurrence_wfb_spec; tauto.
Qed.

(** Capture avoidance also preserves arities and the recursive pure-body
    invariant. These lemmas require the replacement term to be well formed;
    generators enforce that premise even for an unused replacement. *)
Lemma subst_term_wfb t : forall x replacement, term_wfb t = true ->
  term_wfb replacement = true -> term_wfb (subst_term x replacement t) = true.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [y|f ts]; intros x replacement Ht Hr;
    cbn [subst_term term_wfb] in *.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ht as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity; cbn. clear Harity. revert Hargs.
    induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; cbn; intro Hargs; [reflexivity|].
    apply andb_true_iff in Hargs as [Ha Hts].
    rewrite (IH a x replacement Ha Hr), (IHts Hts); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_terms_wfb ts x t : forallb term_wfb ts = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  forallb term_wfb (map (subst_term x t) ts) = true.
Proof.
  intros Hts Ht; induction ts as [|a ts IH]; cbn in *; [reflexivity|].
  apply andb_true_iff in Hts as [Ha Hts].
  rewrite subst_term_wfb by assumption. rewrite IH by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma raw_subst_wfb a x t : formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (raw_subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [raw_subst_fo formula_wfb]; intros Ha Ht;
    try exact Ha; try (apply IHa; assumption).
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity, subst_terms_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr].
    rewrite !subst_term_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [formula_wfb].
    + now rewrite Hp, Ha.
    + rewrite raw_subst_pure, IHa by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [formula_wfb].
    + now rewrite Hp, Ha.
    + rewrite raw_subst_pure, IHa by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_fuel_wfb fuel : forall a x t, formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros a x t Ha Ht; [exact Ha|].
  destruct a; cbn [subst_fo_fuel formula_wfb] in *; try exact Ha.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity, subst_terms_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr].
    rewrite !subst_term_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply IH; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [cbn [formula_wfb]; now rewrite Hp, Ha|].
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [formula_wfb];
      rewrite subst_fo_fuel_pure, IH by
        (try apply raw_subst_pure; try apply raw_subst_wfb; cbn [term_wfb]; auto);
      reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [cbn [formula_wfb]; now rewrite Hp, Ha|].
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [formula_wfb];
      rewrite subst_fo_fuel_pure, IH by
        (try apply raw_subst_pure; try apply raw_subst_wfb; cbn [term_wfb]; auto);
      reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_wfb a x t : formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof. apply subst_fo_fuel_wfb. Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_wf a x t : formula_wf a -> term_wf t -> formula_wf (subst_fo x t a).
Proof.
  intros Ha Ht; apply formula_wfb_spec, subst_fo_wfb;
    [now apply formula_wfb_spec | now apply term_wfb_spec].
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_pure a x t : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (subst_fo x t a).
Proof. intro Ha; apply pureb_spec, subst_fo_fuel_pure, pureb_spec; exact Ha. Qed.

Lemma subst_world_update_wfb u x replacement : update_wfb u = true ->
  update_wfb replacement = true -> update_wfb (subst_world_update x replacement u) = true.
Proof.
  induction u as [y|y t u IH]; cbn [subst_world_update update_wfb]; intros Hu Hr.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hu as [Ht Hu]. rewrite Ht, IH by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_world_label_wfb l x replacement : label_wfb l = true ->
  update_wfb replacement = true -> label_wfb (subst_world_label x replacement l) = true.
Proof.
  induction l; cbn [subst_world_label label_wfb]; intros Hl Hr; try reflexivity.
  - apply subst_world_update_wfb; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hl as [Ha Hb]. rewrite IHl1, IHl2 by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_trace_label_wfb l x replacement : label_wfb l = true ->
  label_wfb replacement = true -> label_wfb (subst_trace_label x replacement l) = true.
Proof.
  induction l as [|u|y|a IHa b IHb]; cbn [subst_trace_label label_wfb]; intros Hl Hr; try exact Hl.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hl as [Ha Hb]. rewrite IHa, IHb by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

End MakeSyntax.
FOPL/Progress.v:
(** * Semantic ranks for cyclic traces

    Read Semantics.v first. This module describes counterexample histories,
    assigns them a mathematical minimum measure, and proves the inequalities
    needed by traced rules. It finishes by instantiating Framework.THEORY.
    Rules.v packages these inequalities into proof-producing countersteps.

    A trace is a list of states; a history is a list of such traces. Its
    measure sums their lengths. A premise may describe a longer accumulated
    trace yet have smaller rank because an outer execution-history component
    has been removed. No execution enumeration or program evaluator is used
    to compute these semantic minima. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.ClassicalDescription Logic.ConstructiveEpsilon.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics.

  (SharedModel : Sem.Shared.INTERPRETATION with Definition interpretation := Sem.general_model I.interpretation)
  (Base : Shared.MODEL SharedModel).

Definition M := I.interpretation.
Lemma assignment_execution prefix s x t run :
  execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Assign x t) run <->
  run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]].
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [start [steps [result [[initial Heq] [_ [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
    inversion Heq; subst start steps. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    rewrite Hrun. reflexivity.
  - intro Hrun. exists s, [write M s x (eval_term M s t)],
      ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]).
    split; [exists s; reflexivity|]. split; [discriminate|].
    split; [apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hrun].
Qed.

Lemma assignment_decrease prefix s x t body :
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Assign x t) body) (prefix ++ [s]) ->
  minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]) <
  minimum_counterexample (Box (Assign x t) body) (prefix ++ [s]).
Proof.
  intro Hfalse.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Htr by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)] <> []) as Hnext
    by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert (forall run, execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Assign x t) run <-> True /\ run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]]) as Hstep.
  { intro run. rewrite assignment_execution. tauto. }
  destruct (atomic_minimum (Assign x t) (prefix ++ [s]) ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write M s x (eval_term M s t)]) True body Htr Hnext Hstep Hfalse) as [_ [_ Hrank]].
  destruct prefix; cbn in *; lia.
Qed.

Section CounterSwitch.
Context (v : nat) (f : domain M -> domain M) (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d).
Let T := switch M v f.
Let HT := switch_involutive M v f Hf.
Definition map_history := map (map T).

Lemma history_switch tr rest :
  map_history (execution_history tr rest) = execution_history (map T tr) (map T rest).
Proof.
  revert tr; induction rest as [|s rest IH]; intro tr; cbn [map_history execution_history map]; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite IH, map_app; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma last_map_history history : last (map_history history) [] = map T (last history []).
Proof.
  induction history as [|tr history IH]; [reflexivity|].
  destruct history; cbn [map_history map last] in *; assumption || reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma execution_switch tr p history : ~ In v (program_vars p) ->
  execution_sequence tr p history -> execution_sequence (map T tr) p (map_history history).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh [s [rest [result [Hp [Hrest [Ho ->]]]]]].
  exists (T s), (map T rest), (map T result); split.
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (switch_semantics M v f Hf) p Hfresh (s :: rest)) Hp).
  - split.
    + intro H; apply map_eq_nil in H; contradiction.
    + split; [exact (overlap_list_map T _ _ _ Ho)|apply history_switch].
Qed.

Lemma counterexample_switch_forward a : ~ In v (formula_vars a) -> forall tr history,
  counterexample a tr history -> counterexample a (map T tr) (map_history history).
Proof.
  induction a; intros Hfresh tr history Hce; cbn [counterexample] in *;
    try solve [destruct Hce as [Hbad ->]; split; [intro H; apply Hbad;
      exact (proj1 (proj1 (switch_semantics M v f Hf) _ Hfresh tr) H)|reflexivity]].
  assert (~ In v (program_vars p)) as Hp by (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (formula_vars a)) as Ha by (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  destruct Hce as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  exists (map_history run), (map T final), (map_history rest); split.
  - apply execution_switch; assumption.
  - split; [rewrite last_map_history; exact (f_equal (map T) Hlast)|]. split; [apply IHa; assumption|].
    exact (overlap_list_map (map T) _ _ _ Ho).
Qed.

Lemma map_history_measure history : sequence_measure (map_history history) = sequence_measure history.
Proof.
  induction history; cbn [map_history map sequence_measure] in *; [reflexivity|].
  change (length (map T a) + sequence_measure (map_history history) = length a + sequence_measure history).
  rewrite length_map, IHhistory; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma measure_switch a tr n : ~ In v (formula_vars a) ->
  (measure_possible a (map T tr) n <-> measure_possible a tr n).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; split; intros [history [Hce Hmeasure]]; exists (map_history history); split.
  - pose proof (counterexample_switch_forward a Hfresh _ _ Hce) as H.
    rewrite (map_involutive T HT tr) in H; exact H.
  - now rewrite map_history_measure.
  - apply counterexample_switch_forward; assumption.
  - now rewrite map_history_measure.
Qed.

End CounterSwitch.

Lemma minimum_switch v f (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d) a tr : ~ In v (formula_vars a) ->
  minimum_counterexample a (map (switch M v f) tr) = minimum_counterexample a tr.
Proof. intro Hfresh; apply minimum_extensional; intro n; apply (measure_switch v f Hf); exact Hfresh. Qed.
End ForModel.
End MakeProgress.
FOPL/RuleGeneration.v:
(** * Verified generation of one local inference

    This is the executable front end to Rules.v, not a proof-search driver.
    [generate_axiom] recognizes structural closing shapes; [generate_rules]
    scans eligible occurrences; [generate_requested] checks explicit caller
    choices. Successful results already contain semantic soundness proofs.

    To read the dense constructor cases, compare a rule's literal source and
    ordered target lists with RULE_EXPANSIONS.md and its kernel in Rules.v.
    [verified_build] supplies syntax evidence, then [ensure_rule] checks that
    the result really belongs to the caller's requested judgment. A [None]
    result means no verified candidate was generated, not semantic falsity. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String Lia Permutation.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature Rules.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import RuleGeneration.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Module MakeRuleGeneration (S : SIGNATURE) (Kernel : KERNEL S).
Module Export Common := CyclistRocq.LPL.RuleGeneration.MakeRuleGeneration
  Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Syn.Language Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Syn.Shared
  Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.Shared Kernel.Core.Pr.Shared Kernel.SharedKernel.
Module Export Sem := Kernel.Core.Pr.Sem.
Module Export Syn := Sem.Syn.
Module Export P := Kernel.P.
(* Export the supplied kernel directly. Copying its factory into another
   module alias loses generative sharing in Rocq 9.1's separate checker. *)
Export Kernel.
Definition fresh_eigen j l a := fresh_name (judgment_vars j ++ label_vars l ++ formula_vars a).
Definition right_special (lhs pre : list occurrence) (o : occurrence) (post : list occurrence) : list (option Cyclic.rule_instance) :=
  let j := right_conclusion lhs pre post o in
  let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
  let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | All u body => let v := fresh_eigen (Jdg lhs (pre ++ post)) l body in
    [guard (pureb body) (fun Hp => guard (eigen_freshb v (Jdg lhs (pre ++ post)) l body) (fun Hfresh =>
      verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (All u body) None))
        [right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)]
        (fun Hs Ht => universal_right lhs pre post l u v body Hp Hfresh Hs (Forall_inv Ht))))]
  | Box p body => match p with
    | Assign x t => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) => let tb := continue_tag ta body in
        [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_assignment_right lhs pre post sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    | _ => [] end
  | Diamond p body => match p with
    | Assign x t => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) => let tb := continue_tag ta body in
        [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Assign x t) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_assignment_right lhs pre post sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    | _ => [] end
  | _ => [] end.
Definition right_at lhs pre o post :=
  Common.right_regular_at [] lhs pre o post ++ right_special lhs pre o post.
Definition left_special (pre : list occurrence) (o : occurrence) (post rhs : list occurrence) : list (option Cyclic.rule_instance) :=
  let j := left_conclusion pre post rhs o in
  let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
  let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | Ex u body => let v := fresh_eigen (Jdg (pre ++ post) rhs) l body in
    [guard (pureb body) (fun Hp => guard (eigen_freshb v (Jdg (pre ++ post) rhs) l body) (fun Hfresh =>
      verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Ex u body) None))
        [left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)]
        (fun Hs Ht => existential_left pre post rhs l u v body Hp Hfresh Hs (Forall_inv Ht))))]
  | Box p body => match p with
    | Assign x t => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) =>
        [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body None]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_assignment_left pre post rhs sigma u x t body ta None Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    | _ => [] end
  | Diamond p body => match p with
    | Assign x t => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) =>
        [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Assign x t) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body None]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_assignment_left pre post rhs sigma u x t body ta None Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    | _ => [] end
  | _ => [] end.
Definition left_at pre o post rhs :=
  Common.left_regular_at [] pre o post rhs ++ left_special pre o post rhs.
Definition scan_right lhs pre rest := Common.scan_occurrences pre rest (fun p o q => right_at lhs p o q).
Definition scan_left pre rest rhs := Common.scan_occurrences pre rest (fun p o q => left_at p o q rhs).
Definition generate_rules j :=
  if pure_terminalb j then [] else
  accepted_rules j (scan_left [] j.(antecedent) j.(succedent) ++ scan_right j.(antecedent) [] j.(succedent)).

Theorem generate_rules_spec j r : In r (generate_rules j) -> r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof. unfold generate_rules; destruct (pure_terminalb j); [cbn; tauto|apply accepted_rules_spec]. Qed.

Inductive rule_request :=
| Local (location : side) (position : nat) (name : string)
| Weaken (location : side) (position : nat)
| Instantiate (location : side) (position : nat) (t : term)
| Eigen (location : side) (position variable : nat)
| SubstituteWorld (original : judgment) (variable : nat) (u : update)
| SubstituteTrace (original : judgment) (variable : nat) (l : label)
| Cut (gamma sigma delta lambda : list occurrence) (cutformula : occurrence)
| ExchangeAdjacent (location : side) (position : nat)
| BacklinkExact (companion : judgment)
| BacklinkTags (renaming : list (nat * nat)) (companion : judgment)
| RotateLabels (original : judgment) (path : list bool) (rotate_left : bool)
| UnitLabels (original : judgment) (path : list bool) (on_left insert : bool).

Definition requested_at j location n request :=
  let context := match location with OnLeft => j.(antecedent) | OnRight => j.(succedent) end in
  match at_position context n with
  | None => None
  | Some (pre,o,post) =>
    let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
    let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
    match request, location, o.(occurrence_formula) with
    | Local _ _ name, OnLeft, _ => named_candidate name (left_at pre o post j.(succedent))
    | Local _ _ name, OnRight, _ => named_candidate name (right_at j.(antecedent) pre o post)
    | Instantiate _ _ t, OnLeft, All u body => guard (term_wfb t) (fun _ => guard (pureb body) (fun Hp =>
        verified_build (left_conclusion pre post j.(succedent) (Occ l (All u body) None))
          (left_targets pre post j.(succedent) [[Occ l (subst_fo u t body) None]])
          (fun Hs Ht => universal_left pre post j.(succedent) l u body t Hp Hs Ht)))
    | Instantiate _ _ t, OnRight, Ex u body => guard (term_wfb t) (fun _ => guard (pureb body) (fun Hp =>
        verified_build (right_conclusion j.(antecedent) pre post (Occ l (Ex u body) None))
          (right_targets j.(antecedent) pre post [[Occ l (subst_fo u t body) None]])
          (fun Hs Ht => existential_right j.(antecedent) pre post l u body t Hp Hs Ht)))
    | Eigen _ _ v, OnRight, All u body => guard (pureb body) (fun Hp =>
        guard (eigen_freshb v (Jdg j.(antecedent) (pre ++ post)) l body) (fun Hfresh =>
          verified_build (right_conclusion j.(antecedent) pre post (Occ l (All u body) None))
            [right_conclusion j.(antecedent) pre post (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)]
            (fun Hs Ht => universal_right j.(antecedent) pre post l u v body Hp Hfresh Hs (Forall_inv Ht))))
    | Eigen _ _ v, OnLeft, Ex u body => guard (pureb body) (fun Hp =>
        guard (eigen_freshb v (Jdg (pre ++ post) j.(succedent)) l body) (fun Hfresh =>
          verified_build (left_conclusion pre post j.(succedent) (Occ l (Ex u body) None))
            [left_conclusion pre post j.(succedent) (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)]
            (fun Hs Ht => existential_left pre post j.(succedent) l u v body Hp Hfresh Hs (Forall_inv Ht))))
    | _, _, _ => None
    end
  end.

(** The common requests are translated literally; FOPL adds only binders
    and deterministic assignment candidates. *)
Definition shared_request request : option Common.rule_request :=
  match request with
  | Local loc n name => Some (Common.Local loc n name)
  | Weaken loc n => Some (Common.Weaken loc n)
  | Instantiate _ _ _ | Eigen _ _ _ => None
  | SubstituteWorld original x u => Some (Common.SubstituteWorld original x u)
  | SubstituteTrace original x l => Some (Common.SubstituteTrace original x l)
  | Cut gamma sigma delta lambda cut => Some (Common.Cut gamma sigma delta lambda cut)
  | ExchangeAdjacent loc n => Some (Common.ExchangeAdjacent loc n)
  | BacklinkExact companion => Some (Common.BacklinkExact companion)
  | BacklinkTags renaming companion => Some (Common.BacklinkTags renaming companion)
  | RotateLabels original path direction => Some (Common.RotateLabels original path direction)
  | UnitLabels original path on_left insert => Some (Common.UnitLabels original path on_left insert)
  end.
Definition raw_requested j request :=
  match request with
  | Local loc n _ | Instantiate loc n _ | Eigen loc n _ => requested_at j loc n request
  | _ => match shared_request request with
    | Some common => Common.raw_requested j.(relations) j common
    | None => None end
  end.
Definition generate_requested j request :=
  match request with
  | BacklinkTags renaming companion =>
      if judgment_eqb (rename_tags (rename_lookup renaming) j) companion
      then ensure_rule j (raw_requested j request) else None
  | _ => ensure_rule j (raw_requested j request)
  end.

Theorem generate_requested_spec j request r : generate_requested j request = Some r ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof.
  unfold generate_requested; destruct request; try apply ensure_rule_spec.
  destruct (judgment_eqb _ _); [apply ensure_rule_spec|discriminate].
Qed.
End MakeRuleGeneration.
FOPL/Rules.v:
(** * Theorem-backed local rule kernels

    Every rule record must provide two proofs: validity follows from valid
    premises, and a false conclusion yields one false premise/world respecting
    all trace pairs on that selected edge. Ordinary logical soundness alone
    does not establish the second, rank-sensitive obligation.

    Read the common context/local-rule helpers first, then one simple Boolean
    rule. The [_base] modal rules establish semantics; [enhance_right] and
    [redecorate] add proved principal trace pairs. Later sections handle
    changed worlds for substitution/eigenvariables, backlinks, and manual
    pure leaves. RULE_EXPANSIONS.md fixes the ordered premises of each rule.

    Most constructors end with [Defined] so local generation can compute
    their conclusions, premises and edge metadata. Their proof obligations
    are still checked by Rocq, not trusted assertions. *)

Definition box_assignment_right_base lhs pre post sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  right_label_equivalent "B.Assign.R" lhs pre post
    (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)
    (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => assignment_label M w sigma u x t body ta tb).
Definition box_assignment_left pre post rhs sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  left_label_equivalent "B.Assign.L" pre post rhs
    (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)
    (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => assignment_label M w sigma u x t body ta tb).
Definition diamond_assignment_right lhs pre post sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  right_label_equivalent "D.Assign.R" lhs pre post
    (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Assign x t) body) ta)
    (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => diamond_assignment_label M w sigma u x t body ta tb).
Definition diamond_assignment_left pre post rhs sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  left_label_equivalent "D.Assign.L" pre post rhs
    (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Assign x t) body) ta)
    (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => diamond_assignment_label M w sigma u x t body ta tb).
Definition box_assignment_right (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (sigma : label) (u : update)
    (x : nat) (t : term) (body : formula) (ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true)
      (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb]]))
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (enhance_right (box_assignment_right_base lhs pre post sigma u x t body ta tb Hs Ht)
    lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta)
    [Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb] true
    Hs Ht eq_refl eq_refl _).
  intros w Hne Hbad.
  assert (~ formula_holds M (Box (Assign x t) body)
    (eval_label M w sigma ++ [eval_update M w u])) as Hfalse.
  { intro H; apply Hbad; split; assumption. }
  pose proof (assignment_decrease (eval_label M w sigma) (eval_update M w u) x t body Hfalse) as Hrank.
  exists (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb).
  split; [cbn; auto|]. split.
  - intro H; apply Hbad; apply (proj2 (assignment_label M w sigma u x t body ta tb)); exact H.
  - assert (occurrence_rank
      (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tb) w <
      occurrence_rank (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) ta) w) as Hstrict by exact Hrank.
    split; [lia|intro H; exact Hstrict].
Defined.

Lemma occurrence_rank_switch v f (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d) o w :
  ~ In v (occurrence_vars o) ->
  occurrence_rank o (switch_world M v f w) = occurrence_rank o w.
Proof.
  intro Hfresh;
  change (minimum_counterexample o.(occurrence_formula) (eval_label M (switch_world M v f w) o.(occurrence_label)) =
    minimum_counterexample o.(occurrence_formula) (eval_label M w o.(occurrence_label))).
  rewrite switch_label.
  - apply (minimum_switch v f Hf); intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
Qed.

Lemma retained_edge_switch_respects source target v f (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d) w :
  judgment_wfb source = true -> judgment_wfb target = true ->
  (forall o tag, In o source.(succedent) -> o.(occurrence_tag) = Some tag -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) ->
  Cyclic.respects_edge source target w (switch_world M v f w) (retained_edge source target).
Proof.
  intros Hs Ht Hfresh; split.
  - intros a b Hin; apply retained_pairs_spec in Hin as [-> [o [Hsocc [Htocc Htag]]]].
    unfold LPLTheory.rank.
    rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ o _ (wf_unique _ Hs) Hsocc Htag).
    rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ o _ (wf_unique _ Ht) Htocc Htag).
    rewrite occurrence_rank_switch; [apply Nat.le_refl|exact Hf|eapply Hfresh; eauto].
  - intros a b H; inversion H.
Qed.

Lemma context_variable_fresh j v : ~ In v (judgment_vars j) ->
  forall o, In o (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)) -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh o Hin Hv; apply Hfresh; apply in_flat_map; exists o; auto.
Qed.

Definition universal_left pre post rhs l u body t Hpure Hs Ht :=
  left_one "All.L" pre post rhs (Occ l (All u body) None) (Occ l (subst_fo u t body) None) Hs Ht
    (fun w H => conj (proj1 H) (all_instantiation M body u t _ Hpure (proj1 H) (proj2 H))).
Definition existential_right lhs pre post l u body t Hpure Hs Ht :=
  right_one "Ex.R" lhs pre post (Occ l (Ex u body) None) (Occ l (subst_fo u t body) None) Hs Ht
    (fun w Hne H => conj Hne (ex_instantiation M body u t _ Hpure Hne (proj2 H))).

(** Eigenvariable rules change the countermodel world. A failing universal
    supplies a value [d]; swap it with the principal head's current [v] value
    in every state. Freshness for contexts, body and principal label makes
    the instance fail while preserving all context truths and trace ranks.
    Existential-left below uses the corresponding satisfying witness. *)
Definition universal_right (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (l : label) (u v : nat) (body : formula)
    (Hpure : pureb body = true)
    (Hfresh : eigen_freshb v (Jdg lhs (pre ++ post)) l body = true)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (All u body) None)) = true)
    (Ht : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)) = true)
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (counter_rule "All.R"
    (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (All u body) None))
    (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None))
    (retained_edge (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (All u body) None))
    (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)))).
  intros w Hfalse.
  apply eigen_freshb_spec in Hfresh.
  assert (~ In v (judgment_vars (Jdg lhs (pre ++ post)))) as Hctx by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (label_vars l)) as Hlabel by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (formula_vars body)) as Hbody by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  pose proof (context_variable_fresh _ _ Hctx) as Hocc.
  destruct (false_right_parts _ _ _ _ _ Hfalse) as [Hleft [Hpre [Hprincipal Hpost]]].
  pose proof (wellformed_principal _ _ _ _ w Hs) as Hne.
  change (eval_label M w l <> []) in Hne.
  destruct (eval_label M w l) as [|s tail] eqn:Hlabel_eval; [contradiction|].
  assert (~ (forall d, fol_holds M body (write M s u d))) as Hnotall.
  { intro Hall; apply Hprincipal; split; [change (eval_label M w l <> []); rewrite Hlabel_eval; discriminate|].
    change (formula_holds M (All u body) (eval_label M w l)); rewrite Hlabel_eval.
    apply (pure_head M (All u body) Hpure); exact Hall. }
  (* This choice is mathematical countermodel evidence, not a generator
     choosing a quantifier term. The model's inhabitant makes [epsilon] total. *)
  set (d := epsilon (inhabits (domain_inhabitant M)) (fun d => ~ fol_holds M body (write M s u d))).
  assert (~ fol_holds M body (write M s u d)) as Hbad.
  { unfold d; apply epsilon_spec; now apply not_all_ex_not. }
  set (f := swap_values M (s v) d).
  set (w' := switch_world M v f w).
  assert (forall o, In o lhs -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hl_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (forall o, In o pre -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hpre_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (forall o, In o post -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hpost_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; auto).
  exists w'; split.
  - intro Hden; pose proof (proj1 (denote_wf _ w' Ht) Hden (Forall_nil _)) as Hraw.
    assert (left_holds M w' lhs) as Hl'.
    { unfold w'; apply (proj2 (switch_left_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w lhs Hl_fresh)); exact Hleft. }
    specialize (Hraw Hl'); cbn [right_conclusion succedent Common.right_conclusion] in Hraw; rewrite right_app, right_cons in Hraw.
    destruct Hraw as [Hpre'|[Hinst|Hpost']].
    + apply Hpre; apply (proj1 (switch_right_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w pre Hpre_fresh)); exact Hpre'.
    + destruct Hinst as [_ Hinst]; apply Hbad.
      apply (proj1 (eigen_instance M w l u v body d s tail Hlabel_eval Hlabel Hpure Hbody)); exact Hinst.
    + apply Hpost; apply (proj1 (switch_right_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w post Hpost_fresh)); exact Hpost'.
  - unfold w'; apply retained_edge_switch_respects; try assumption; [apply swap_values_involutive|].
    intros o tag Hin Htag; cbn [right_conclusion succedent Common.right_conclusion] in Hin.
    apply in_app_iff in Hin as [Hin|[Heq|Hin]].
    + apply Hpre_fresh; exact Hin.
    + subst o; discriminate.
    + apply Hpost_fresh; exact Hin.
Defined.

Definition existential_left (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (l : label) (u v : nat) (body : formula)
    (Hpure : pureb body = true)
    (Hfresh : eigen_freshb v (Jdg (pre ++ post) rhs) l body = true)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Ex u body) None)) = true)
    (Ht : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)) = true)
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (counter_rule "Ex.L"
    (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Ex u body) None))
    (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None))
    (retained_edge (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Ex u body) None))
    (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None)))).
  intros w Hfalse; apply eigen_freshb_spec in Hfresh.
  assert (~ In v (judgment_vars (Jdg (pre ++ post) rhs))) as Hctx by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (label_vars l)) as Hlabel by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (formula_vars body)) as Hbody by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  pose proof (context_variable_fresh _ _ Hctx) as Hocc.
  destruct (false_sequent M _ _ Hfalse) as [Hadm [Hleft Hright]].
  cbn [left_conclusion antecedent Common.left_conclusion] in Hleft; rewrite left_app, left_cons in Hleft.
  destruct Hleft as [Hpre [Hprincipal Hpost]].
  destruct Hprincipal as [Hne Hprincipal]; change (eval_label M w l <> []) in Hne.
  destruct (eval_label M w l) as [|s tail] eqn:Hlabel_eval; [contradiction|].
  change (formula_holds M (Ex u body) (eval_label M w l)) in Hprincipal.
  rewrite Hlabel_eval, (pure_head M (Ex u body) Hpure) in Hprincipal.
  set (d := epsilon (inhabits (domain_inhabitant M)) (fun d => fol_holds M body (write M s u d))).
  assert (fol_holds M body (write M s u d)) as Hgood by (unfold d; apply epsilon_spec; exact Hprincipal).
  set (f := swap_values M (s v) d).
  set (w' := switch_world M v f w).
  assert (forall o, In o pre -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hpre_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (forall o, In o post -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hpost_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (forall o, In o rhs -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hr_fresh by
    (intros o Hin; apply Hocc; cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; auto).
  exists w'; split.
  - intro Hden; pose proof (proj1 (denote_wf _ w' Ht) Hden (Forall_nil _)) as Hraw.
    assert (left_holds M w' (pre ++ Occ l (subst_fo u (Var v) body) None :: post)) as Hl'.
    { unfold left_holds; rewrite left_app, left_cons; split.
      - unfold w'; apply (proj2 (switch_left_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w pre Hpre_fresh)); exact Hpre.
      - split.
        + split.
          * apply (wellformed_left_principal _ _ _ _ w' Ht).
          * apply (proj2 (eigen_instance M w l u v body d s tail Hlabel_eval Hlabel Hpure Hbody)); exact Hgood.
        + unfold w'; apply (proj2 (switch_left_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w post Hpost_fresh)); exact Hpost. }
    specialize (Hraw Hl').
    apply (proj1 (switch_right_context M v f (swap_values_involutive M _ _) w rhs Hr_fresh)) in Hraw.
    destruct Hraw as [o [Hin Ho]]; apply (Hright o Hin); exact Ho.
  - unfold w'; apply retained_edge_switch_respects; try assumption; [apply swap_values_involutive|].
    intros o tag Hin Htag; apply Hr_fresh; exact Hin.
Defined.

Definition pure_terminalb j :=
  forallb (fun o => match occurrence_label o with
    | StateLabel _ => pureb o.(occurrence_formula)
    | _ => false end) (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)).

Definition atom_terminalb j :=
  forallb (fun o => match occurrence_label o, occurrence_formula o with
    | StateLabel _, Pred _ _ | StateLabel _, Equal _ _ => true
    | _, _ => false end) (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)).

(** Here the caller supplies the actual shallow sequent proof in Rocq.
    The shape checks restrict the interface but do not decide pure truth.
    [close_atoms] is the manuscript's narrower atom/equality boundary;
    [close_pure] separately permits compound pure formulas at state updates. *)
Definition close_pure j (_ : judgment_wfb j = true) (_ : pure_terminalb j = true)
    (H : forall w, left_holds M w j.(antecedent) -> right_holds M w j.(succedent))
    : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine {| Cyclic.axiom_name := "Pure.manual"; Cyclic.axiom_conclusion := j |}.
  intros w Ha Hrelations; apply H.
Defined.

Definition close_atoms j (_ : judgment_wfb j = true) (_ : atom_terminalb j = true)
    (H : forall w, left_holds M w j.(antecedent) -> right_holds M w j.(succedent))
    : Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  refine {| Cyclic.axiom_name := "At.manual"; Cyclic.axiom_conclusion := j |}.
  intros w Ha Hrelations; apply H.
Defined.

(** * Meaning of first-order labelled process logic

    Suggested reading order: the generic overlap relation; models, states and
    labels; the mutual formula/program interpretation; FOL substitution and
    sequent denotation; semantic rule equations; finally state-switch
    freshness. Progress.v builds ranks on top of these definitions.

    Two operations must stay distinct throughout: labels concatenate by list
    append, while executable program traces overlap a shared endpoint. All
    formulas are false on an empty trace; assertion admissibility makes the
    intended logical laws available on the nonempty traces used by rules. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop Classical_Pred_Type.

Record model : Type := Model {
  domain : Type;
  domain_inhabitant : domain;
  interpret_function : S.function_symbol -> list domain -> domain;
  interpret_predicate : S.predicate_symbol -> list domain -> Prop
}.

Section Interpretation.
Context (M : model).
(** A state assigns a model value to each program variable. The surrounding
    section generalizes the definitions and proofs over [M]; integer-specific
    reasoning only appears in the benchmarks. *)
Definition state := nat -> domain M.
Definition trace := list state.

Definition write (s : state) (x : nat) (value : domain M) : state :=
  fun y => if Nat.eqb x y then value else s y.

Lemma write_same s x v : write s x v x = v.
Proof. unfold write; now rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. Qed.
Lemma write_other s x y v : x <> y -> write s x v y = s y.
Proof. intro H; unfold write; apply Nat.eqb_neq in H; now rewrite H. Qed.

Fixpoint eval_term (s : state) (t : term) : domain M :=
  match t with
  | Var x => s x
  | Fun f ts => interpret_function M f (map (eval_term s) ts)
  end.

(** States are functions, so equalities between whole updated states use
    functional extensionality. These update laws also handle the shadowing
    and commuting writes encountered under named quantifiers. *)
Lemma write_shadow s x a b : write (write s x a) x b = write s x b.
Proof. apply functional_extensionality; intro y; unfold write; destruct (Nat.eqb x y); reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma write_commute s x y a b : x <> y ->
  write (write s x a) y b = write (write s y b) x a.
Proof.
  intro Hne; apply functional_extensionality; intro z; unfold write.
  destruct (Nat.eqb x z) eqn:Hx, (Nat.eqb y z) eqn:Hy; try reflexivity.
  apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hx, Hy; congruence.
Qed.
Lemma write_current s x : write s x (s x) = s.
Proof.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y; unfold write.
  destruct (Nat.eqb x y) eqn:H; [apply Nat.eqb_eq in H; subst|]; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The basic substitution equation: replacing a variable syntactically is
    equivalent to first evaluating its replacement in the original state,
    then changing that variable's semantic value. *)
Lemma eval_term_subst t : forall s x replacement,
  eval_term s (subst_term x replacement t) =
  eval_term (write s x (eval_term s replacement)) t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [y|f ts]; intros s x replacement; cbn [subst_term eval_term].
  - unfold write; destruct (Nat.eqb x y); reflexivity.
  - f_equal. rewrite map_map. induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; cbn; [reflexivity|].
    rewrite (IH a s x replacement), IHts; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Coincidence only needs agreement on variables actually used by a term.
    The nested induction on argument lists supplies the recursive hypotheses
    that ordinary induction on the nested [term] datatype does not provide. *)
Lemma eval_term_coincidence t : forall s s',
  (forall x, In x (term_vars t) -> s x = s' x) -> eval_term s t = eval_term s' t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [y|f ts]; intros s s' H; cbn [eval_term].
  - apply H; cbn; auto.
  - f_equal. cbn [term_vars] in H. revert H.
    induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; intro H; cbn; [reflexivity|].
    f_equal.
    + apply (IH a s s'). intros x Hx; apply H; apply in_app_iff; auto.
    + apply IHts. intros x Hx; apply H; apply in_app_iff; auto.
Qed.

Lemma eval_term_fresh t s x value : ~ In x (term_vars t) ->
  eval_term (write s x value) t = eval_term s t.
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; apply eval_term_coincidence. intros y Hy; apply write_other; congruence.
Qed.

(** The first-order model is interpreted once into the common frame.
    These are concrete proofs of the abstract frame laws, not new axioms. *)
Fixpoint eval_world_term (rho : nat -> state) (u : update) : state :=
  match u with
  | Base x => rho x
  | AssignUpdate x t previous =>
      let s := eval_world_term rho previous in write s x (eval_term s t)
  end.
Definition general_model : Shared.model.
Proof.
  refine {| Shared.carrier := state;
    Shared.carrier_inhabitant := fun _ => domain_inhabitant M;
    Shared.interpret_atom := fun p ts s => interpret_predicate M p (map (eval_term s) ts);
    Shared.interpret_binary_atom := fun a b s => eval_term s a = eval_term s b;
    Shared.interpret_extension := fun x child tr => forall value, child (map (fun s => write s x value) tr);
    Shared.interpret_coextension := fun x child tr => exists value, child (map (fun s => write s x value) tr);
    Shared.interpret_action := fun x t s next => next = write s x (eval_term s t);
    Shared.interpret_atomic_trace := fun x t tr => exists s, tr = [s;write s x (eval_term s t)];
    Shared.interpret_world_term := eval_world_term;
    Shared.interpret_relation := fun symbol _ => match symbol with end |}.
  - intros x t tr; split.
    + intros [s ->]; exists s, (write s x (eval_term s t)); auto.
    + intros [s [next [-> ->]]]; exists s; reflexivity.
  - intros rho x; reflexivity.
  - intros rho rho' u; induction u; intro H; cbn [eval_world_term].
    + apply H; now left.
    + rewrite IHu; [reflexivity|exact H].
  - intros rho x replacement u; unfold Language.subst_world; induction u; cbn [eval_world_term subst_world_update].
    + destruct (Nat.eqb x world_variable); reflexivity.
    + now rewrite IHu.
Defined.

Fixpoint fol_holds (a : formula) (s : state) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | Truth => True
  | Falsity => False
  | Pred p ts => interpret_predicate M p (map (eval_term s) ts)
  | Equal a b => eval_term s a = eval_term s b
  | Neg a => ~ fol_holds a s
  | Conj a b => fol_holds a s /\ fol_holds b s
  | Disj a b => fol_holds a s \/ fol_holds b s
  | Impl a b => fol_holds a s -> fol_holds b s
  | All x a => forall value, fol_holds a (write s x value)
  | Ex x a => exists value, fol_holds a (write s x value)
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma fol_fresh a : pureb a = true -> forall s x value,
  ~ In x (formula_vars a) -> (fol_holds a (write s x value) <-> fol_holds a s).
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb]; intro Hp; try discriminate;
    intros s u value Hfresh; cbn [fol_holds formula_vars] in *; try tauto.
  - assert (map (eval_term (write s u value)) args = map (eval_term s) args) as Heq.
    { apply map_ext_in; intros t Hin; apply eval_term_fresh.
      intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_flat_map; exists t; auto. }
    now rewrite Heq.
  - rewrite !eval_term_fresh; try tauto; intros H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - now rewrite IHa by assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2; try assumption; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2; try assumption; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2; try assumption; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - assert (u <> x) as Hux by (intro Heq; subst u; apply Hfresh; now left).
    assert (~ In u (formula_vars a)) as Hbody by (intro Hin; apply Hfresh; now right).
    split; intros H v; specialize (H v).
    + rewrite write_commute in H by exact Hux. apply (proj1 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u value Hbody)); exact H.
    + rewrite write_commute by exact Hux. apply (proj2 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u value Hbody)); exact H.
  - assert (u <> x) as Hux by (intro Heq; subst u; apply Hfresh; now left).
    assert (~ In u (formula_vars a)) as Hbody by (intro Hin; apply Hfresh; now right).
    split; intros [v H]; exists v.
    + rewrite write_commute in H by exact Hux. apply (proj1 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u value Hbody)); exact H.
    + rewrite write_commute by exact Hux. apply (proj2 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u value Hbody)); exact H.
Qed.

(** Raw substitution is sound under [free_forb]. In the quantifier cases,
    freshness of the binder in [t] keeps the replacement's evaluated value
    fixed while writes are commuted. The public theorem below removes this
    side condition by renaming conflicting binders first. *)
Lemma raw_subst_correct a : pureb a = true -> forall s u t,
  free_forb u t a = true ->
  (fol_holds (raw_subst_fo u t a) s <-> fol_holds a (write s u (eval_term s t))).
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb]; intro Hp; try discriminate;
    intros s u t Hfree; cbn [raw_subst_fo free_forb fol_holds] in *; try tauto.
  - rewrite map_map. assert (map (fun a => eval_term s (subst_term u t a)) args =
      map (eval_term (write s u (eval_term s t))) args) as Heq.
    { apply map_ext; intro a; apply eval_term_subst. }
    now rewrite Heq.
  - now rewrite !eval_term_subst.
  - now rewrite IHa by assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff in Hfree as [Hfa Hfb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption; tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff in Hfree as [Hfa Hfb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption; tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff in Hfree as [Hfa Hfb].
    rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption; tauto.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x) eqn:Hux.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hux; subst u. cbn [fol_holds]. setoid_rewrite write_shadow; reflexivity.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hux; apply andb_true_iff in Hfree as [Hfresh Hfree].
      apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false in Hfresh. cbn [fol_holds].
      split; intros H v; specialize (H v).
      * apply (proj1 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u t Hfree)) in H.
        rewrite eval_term_fresh in H by exact Hfresh.
        rewrite write_commute in H by congruence. exact H.
      * apply (proj2 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u t Hfree)).
        rewrite eval_term_fresh by exact Hfresh. rewrite write_commute by congruence. exact H.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x) eqn:Hux.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hux; subst u. cbn [fol_holds]. setoid_rewrite write_shadow; reflexivity.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hux; apply andb_true_iff in Hfree as [Hfresh Hfree].
      apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false in Hfresh. cbn [fol_holds].
      split; intros [v H]; exists v.
      * apply (proj1 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u t Hfree)) in H.
        rewrite eval_term_fresh in H by exact Hfresh.
        rewrite write_commute in H by congruence. exact H.
      * apply (proj2 (IHa Hp (write s x v) u t Hfree)).
        rewrite eval_term_fresh by exact Hfresh. rewrite write_commute by congruence. exact H.
Qed.

(** Alpha-conversion is a semantic theorem about the raw renaming helper.
    Freshness includes nested bound names, so the chosen new binder cannot
    collide with a binder deeper in the body. [alpha_ex] is the existential
    counterpart used by the same substitution algorithm. *)
Lemma alpha_all body y z s : pureb body = true -> ~ In z (formula_vars body) -> z <> y ->
  (fol_holds (All z (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body)) s <-> fol_holds (All y body) s).
Proof.
  intros Hp Hfresh Hzy; cbn [fol_holds].
  split; intros H v; specialize (H v).
  - apply (proj1 (raw_subst_correct body Hp (write s z v) y (Var z)
      (rename_free_for body y z Hp Hfresh))) in H.
    cbn [eval_term] in H; rewrite write_same, write_commute in H by exact Hzy.
    apply (proj1 (fol_fresh body Hp (write s y v) z v Hfresh)); exact H.
  - apply (proj2 (raw_subst_correct body Hp (write s z v) y (Var z)
      (rename_free_for body y z Hp Hfresh))).
    cbn [eval_term]; rewrite write_same, write_commute by exact Hzy.
    apply (proj2 (fol_fresh body Hp (write s y v) z v Hfresh)); exact H.
Qed.

Lemma alpha_ex body y z s : pureb body = true -> ~ In z (formula_vars body) -> z <> y ->
  (fol_holds (Ex z (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body)) s <-> fol_holds (Ex y body) s).
Proof.
  intros Hp Hfresh Hzy; cbn [fol_holds].
  split; intros [v H]; exists v.
  - apply (proj1 (raw_subst_correct body Hp (write s z v) y (Var z)
      (rename_free_for body y z Hp Hfresh))) in H.
    cbn [eval_term] in H; rewrite write_same, write_commute in H by exact Hzy.
    apply (proj1 (fol_fresh body Hp (write s y v) z v Hfresh)); exact H.
  - apply (proj2 (raw_subst_correct body Hp (write s z v) y (Var z)
      (rename_free_for body y z Hp Hfresh))).
    cbn [eval_term]; rewrite write_same, write_commute by exact Hzy.
    apply (proj2 (fol_fresh body Hp (write s y v) z v Hfresh)); exact H.
Qed.

(** Lift a body substitution equation through a nonconflicting binder.
    Factoring out this write-commutation argument keeps the fuel proof's
    capture and no-capture branches focused on their different bodies. *)
Lemma all_subst_congruence body result y u t : y <> u -> ~ In y (term_vars t) ->
  (forall s, fol_holds result s <-> fol_holds body (write s u (eval_term s t))) -> forall s,
  (fol_holds (All y result) s <-> fol_holds (All y body) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
Proof.
  intros Hy Hfresh IH s; cbn [fol_holds].
  split; intros H v; specialize (H v).
  - apply (proj1 (IH _)) in H. rewrite eval_term_fresh in H by exact Hfresh.
    rewrite write_commute in H by exact Hy; exact H.
  - apply (proj2 (IH _)); rewrite eval_term_fresh by exact Hfresh.
    rewrite write_commute by exact Hy; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma ex_subst_congruence body result y u t : y <> u -> ~ In y (term_vars t) ->
  (forall s, fol_holds result s <-> fol_holds body (write s u (eval_term s t))) -> forall s,
  (fol_holds (Ex y result) s <-> fol_holds (Ex y body) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
Proof.
  intros Hy Hfresh IH s; cbn [fol_holds].
  split; intros [v H]; exists v.
  - apply (proj1 (IH _)) in H. rewrite eval_term_fresh in H by exact Hfresh.
    rewrite write_commute in H by exact Hy; exact H.
  - apply (proj2 (IH _)); rewrite eval_term_fresh by exact Hfresh.
    rewrite write_commute by exact Hy; exact H.
Qed.

(** Induct on fuel rather than the original body: after alpha-renaming, the
    recursive argument is newly constructed syntax. [raw_subst_size] proves
    that it still fits the smaller fuel bound. At each binder, first handle
    shadowing, then separate capture from direct descent. *)
Lemma subst_fo_fuel_correct fuel : forall a, pureb a = true -> fol_size a <= fuel -> forall s u t,
  (fol_holds (subst_fo_fuel fuel u t a) s <-> fol_holds a (write s u (eval_term s t))).
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros a Hp Hsize s u t.
  - destruct a; cbn [fol_size] in Hsize; lia.
  - destruct a; cbn [pureb fol_size] in Hp, Hsize; try discriminate;
      cbn [subst_fo_fuel fol_holds]; try tauto.
    + rewrite map_map. assert (map (fun a => eval_term s (subst_term u t a)) args =
        map (eval_term (write s u (eval_term s t))) args) as Heq.
      { apply map_ext; intro a; apply eval_term_subst. } now rewrite Heq.
    + now rewrite !eval_term_subst.
    + rewrite IH by (assumption || lia); tauto.
    + apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; rewrite !IH by (assumption || lia); tauto.
    + apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; rewrite !IH by (assumption || lia); tauto.
    + apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; rewrite !IH by (assumption || lia); tauto.
    + destruct (Nat.eqb u x) eqn:Hux.
      * apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hux; subst u; cbn [fol_holds]; setoid_rewrite write_shadow; reflexivity.
      * apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hux; destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x) (term_vars t)) eqn:Hcapture.
        -- set (z := fresh_name (u :: x :: (formula_vars a ++ term_vars t))).
           assert (~ In z (u :: x :: (formula_vars a ++ term_vars t))) as Hz by apply fresh_name_not_in.
           assert (z <> u /\ z <> x /\ ~ In z (formula_vars a) /\ ~ In z (term_vars t)) as [Hzu [Hzx [Hzbody Hzt]]].
           { repeat split; intro H; apply Hz; cbn; try (left; congruence);
             try (right; left; congruence); right; right; apply in_app_iff; auto. }
           change (fol_holds (All z (subst_fo_fuel fuel u t (raw_subst_fo x (Var z) a))) s <-> fol_holds (All x a) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
           transitivity (fol_holds (All z (raw_subst_fo x (Var z) a)) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
           ++ apply all_subst_congruence; try assumption.
              intro state'; apply IH; [apply raw_subst_pure; exact Hp|rewrite raw_subst_size; lia].
           ++ apply alpha_all; assumption.
        -- apply all_subst_congruence; [congruence|now apply occursb_false|].
           intro state'; apply IH; [exact Hp|lia].
    + destruct (Nat.eqb u x) eqn:Hux.
      * apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hux; subst u; cbn [fol_holds]; setoid_rewrite write_shadow; reflexivity.
      * apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hux; destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x) (term_vars t)) eqn:Hcapture.
        -- set (z := fresh_name (u :: x :: (formula_vars a ++ term_vars t))).
           assert (~ In z (u :: x :: (formula_vars a ++ term_vars t))) as Hz by apply fresh_name_not_in.
           assert (z <> u /\ z <> x /\ ~ In z (formula_vars a) /\ ~ In z (term_vars t)) as [Hzu [Hzx [Hzbody Hzt]]].
           { repeat split; intro H; apply Hz; cbn; try (left; congruence);
             try (right; left; congruence); right; right; apply in_app_iff; auto. }
           change (fol_holds (Ex z (subst_fo_fuel fuel u t (raw_subst_fo x (Var z) a))) s <-> fol_holds (Ex x a) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
           transitivity (fol_holds (Ex z (raw_subst_fo x (Var z) a)) (write s u (eval_term s t))).
           ++ apply ex_subst_congruence; try assumption.
              intro state'; apply IH; [apply raw_subst_pure; exact Hp|rewrite raw_subst_size; lia].
           ++ apply alpha_ex; assumption.
        -- apply ex_subst_congruence; [congruence|now apply occursb_false|].
           intro state'; apply IH; [exact Hp|lia].
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_correct a s u t : pureb a = true ->
  (fol_holds (subst_fo u t a) s <-> fol_holds a (write s u (eval_term s t))).
Proof. intro Hp; apply subst_fo_fuel_correct; [exact Hp|lia]. Qed.

(** This is the bridge from uniform-value trace quantification to ordinary
    FOL. Pure bodies cannot observe the tail, so writing one value to every
    state has precisely the usual first-state FOL meaning. This restriction
    is essential for the quantifier instantiation rules. *)
Lemma pure_head a : pureb a = true -> forall s tail,
  formula_holds a (s :: tail) <-> fol_holds a s.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb]; intro Hp; try discriminate;
    intros s tail; cbn [formula_holds fol_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term]; try tauto.
  - rewrite IHa by exact Hp. tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1 by exact Ha. rewrite IHa2 by exact Hb. tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1 by exact Ha. rewrite IHa2 by exact Hb. tauto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb].
    rewrite IHa1 by exact Ha. rewrite IHa2 by exact Hb. tauto.
  - split; intros H v; specialize (IHa Hp (write s x v) (map (fun s => write s x v) tail));
      [apply IHa; apply H | apply IHa; apply H].
  - split; intros [v H]; exists v;
      specialize (IHa Hp (write s x v) (map (fun s => write s x v) tail));
      apply IHa; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma pure_singleton a s tail : pureb a = true ->
  (formula_holds a (s :: tail) <-> formula_holds a [s]).
Proof. intro H; rewrite !pure_head by exact H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma box_assignment prefix s x t a :
  formula_holds (Box (Assign x t) a) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  formula_holds a ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write s x (eval_term s t)]).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
