  cbn [formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term]. split.
  - intro H; eapply H.
    + exists s; reflexivity.
    + rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto.
  - intros Ha execution result [start ->] Ho.
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->]. now rewrite Htr.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_assignment prefix s x t a :
  formula_holds (Diamond (Assign x t) a) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  formula_holds a ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [write s x (eval_term s t)]).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term]. split.
  - intros [execution [result [[start ->] [Ho Ha]]]].
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->]. now rewrite Htr in Ha.
  - intro Ha. exists [s; write s x (eval_term s t)], ((head :: tail) ++ [write s x (eval_term s t)]).
    split; [exists s; reflexivity|]. split; [rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Ha].
Qed.

Lemma assignment_label w sigma u x t body tag tag' :
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Assign x t) body) tag) <->
   labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tag')).
Proof.
  unfold labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, label_admissible, Shared.label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label Shared.eval_label general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
  rewrite box_assignment.
  assert (eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u]) ++
    [write (eval_update w u) x (eval_term (eval_update w u) t)] <> []) by
    (intro H'; apply app_eq_nil in H'; destruct H'; discriminate).
  tauto.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_assignment_label w sigma u x t body tag tag' :
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Assign x t) body) tag) <->
   labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel (AssignUpdate x t u))) body tag')).
Proof.
  unfold labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, label_admissible, Shared.label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label Shared.eval_label general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
  rewrite diamond_assignment.
  assert (eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u]) ++
    [write (eval_update w u) x (eval_term (eval_update w u) t)] <> []) by
    (intro H'; apply app_eq_nil in H'; destruct H'; discriminate).
  tauto.
Qed.

Lemma pure_head_label w u sigma body tag tag' : pureb body = true ->
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) body tag) <->
   labelled_holds w (Occ (StateLabel u) body tag')).
Proof.
  intro Hp; unfold labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, label_admissible, Shared.label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label Shared.eval_label general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
  rewrite (pure_singleton body (eval_update w u) (eval_label w sigma) Hp).
  split; intros [_ H]; split; try discriminate; exact H.
Qed.

Section StateSwitch.
Context (v : nat) (f : domain M -> domain M) (Hf : forall d, f (f d) = d).
Definition switch s := write s v (f (s v)).

Lemma switch_involutive s : switch (switch s) = s.
Proof. unfold switch; rewrite write_same, write_shadow, Hf; apply write_current. Qed.
Lemma switch_write s x d : x <> v -> switch (write s x d) = write (switch s) x d.
Proof.
  intro Hx; unfold switch; rewrite write_other by exact Hx.
  apply write_commute; exact Hx.
Qed.
Lemma switch_term t s : ~ In v (term_vars t) -> eval_term (switch s) t = eval_term s t.
Proof. apply eval_term_fresh. Qed.
Lemma switch_map_involutive tr : map switch (map switch tr) = tr.
Proof. apply map_involutive, switch_involutive. Qed.

(** For an involution, a forward preservation theorem already gives an
    equivalence: apply preservation twice and cancel the two switches. *)
Lemma switch_predicate_iff (Q : trace -> Prop) :
  (forall tr, Q tr -> Q (map switch tr)) -> forall tr, Q (map switch tr) <-> Q tr.
Proof.
  intros H tr; split; [intro HQ; specialize (H _ HQ); now rewrite switch_map_involutive in H|apply H].
Qed.

Lemma switch_compose R T :
  (forall tr, R (map switch tr) <-> R tr) ->
  (forall tr, T (map switch tr) <-> T tr) -> forall tr,
  compose R T (map switch tr) <-> compose R T tr.
Proof.
  intros HR HT; apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr [a [b [Ha [Hb Ho]]]].
  exists (map switch a), (map switch b); split; [apply HR; exact Ha|].
  split; [apply HT; exact Hb|]. now apply overlap_list_map.
Qed.

Lemma switch_power R : (forall tr, R (map switch tr) <-> R tr) -> forall n tr,
  finite_power R n (map switch tr) <-> finite_power R n tr.
Proof.
  intros HR n; induction n as [|n IH].
  - apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr [s ->]; exists (switch s); reflexivity.
  - cbn [finite_power Shared.finite_power]; apply switch_compose; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma switch_box p a :
  (forall tr, program_holds p (map switch tr) <-> program_holds p tr) ->
  (forall tr, formula_holds a (map switch tr) <-> formula_holds a tr) -> forall tr,
  formula_holds (Box p a) (map switch tr) <-> formula_holds (Box p a) tr.
Proof.
  intros Hp Ha; apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr Hbox.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [map formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term] in *.
  intros execution result Hprogram Hover.
  pose proof (overlap_list_map switch _ _ _ Hover) as Ho.
  change (overlap_list (map switch (map switch (s :: tail)))
    (map switch execution) (map switch result)) in Ho.
  rewrite switch_map_involutive in Ho.
  apply (proj1 (Ha result)). eapply Hbox; [apply Hp; exact Hprogram|exact Ho].
Qed.

Lemma switch_diamond p a :
  (forall tr, program_holds p (map switch tr) <-> program_holds p tr) ->
  (forall tr, formula_holds a (map switch tr) <-> formula_holds a tr) -> forall tr,
  formula_holds (Diamond p a) (map switch tr) <-> formula_holds (Diamond p a) tr.
Proof.
  intros Hp Ha; apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr Hdiamond.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [map formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term] in *.
  destruct Hdiamond as [execution [result [Hprogram [Hover Hbody]]]].
  exists (map switch execution), (map switch result); split; [apply Hp; exact Hprogram|].
  split; [exact (overlap_list_map switch (s :: tail) execution result Hover)|apply Ha; exact Hbody].
Qed.

(** The mutual induction follows every formula and program constructor.
    Freshness excludes assignment targets as well as read variables, so
    writes commute with the switch. Quantifiers likewise have different
    binders. The modal cases use reversible execution transport; suffix
    cases use their one-step equations and induction on finite traces. *)
Lemma switch_semantics :
  (forall a, ~ In v (formula_vars a) -> forall tr,
    formula_holds a (map switch tr) <-> formula_holds a tr) /\
  (forall p, ~ In v (program_vars p) -> forall tr,
    program_holds p (map switch tr) <-> program_holds p tr).
Proof.
  apply formula_program_mutind.
  - intros Hfresh [|s tail]; reflexivity.
  - intros Hfresh [|s tail]; reflexivity.
  - intros p args Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [map formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    assert (map (eval_term (switch s)) args = map (eval_term s) args) as Heq.
    { apply map_ext_in; intros t Hin; apply switch_term.
      intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_flat_map; exists t; auto. }
    now rewrite Heq.
  - intros a b Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [map formula_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    rewrite !switch_term; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); reflexivity.
  - intros a IH Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change (~ formula_holds a (map switch (s :: tail)) <-> ~ formula_holds a (s :: tail)).
    now rewrite IH by exact Hfresh.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change ((formula_holds a (map switch (s :: tail)) /\ formula_holds b (map switch (s :: tail))) <->
      (formula_holds a (s :: tail) /\ formula_holds b (s :: tail))).
    rewrite Ha, Hb; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change ((formula_holds a (map switch (s :: tail)) \/ formula_holds b (map switch (s :: tail))) <->
      (formula_holds a (s :: tail) \/ formula_holds b (s :: tail))).
    rewrite Ha, Hb; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|].
    change ((formula_holds a (map switch (s :: tail)) -> formula_holds b (map switch (s :: tail))) <->
      (formula_holds a (s :: tail) -> formula_holds b (s :: tail))).
    rewrite Ha, Hb; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); tauto.
  - intros x a IH Hfresh tr.
    assert (x <> v) as Hx by (intro H; subst; apply Hfresh; now left).
    assert (~ In v (formula_vars a)) as Ha by (intro H; apply Hfresh; now right).
    destruct tr as [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [formula_holds map Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    assert (forall d, map (fun s => write s x d) (map switch (s :: tail)) =
      map switch (map (fun s => write s x d) (s :: tail))) as Hmaps.
    { intro d; rewrite !map_map; apply map_ext; intro state'; symmetry; apply switch_write; exact Hx. }
    change ((forall d, formula_holds a (map (fun s => write s x d) (map switch (s :: tail)))) <->
      (forall d, formula_holds a (map (fun s => write s x d) (s :: tail)))).
    split; intros H d; specialize (H d).
    + rewrite Hmaps in H; apply (proj1 (IH Ha _)); exact H.
    + rewrite Hmaps; apply (proj2 (IH Ha _)); exact H.
  - intros x a IH Hfresh tr.
    assert (x <> v) as Hx by (intro H; subst; apply Hfresh; now left).
    assert (~ In v (formula_vars a)) as Ha by (intro H; apply Hfresh; now right).
    destruct tr as [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]. cbn [formula_holds map Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    assert (forall d, map (fun s => write s x d) (map switch (s :: tail)) =
      map switch (map (fun s => write s x d) (s :: tail))) as Hmaps.
    { intro d; rewrite !map_map; apply map_ext; intro state'; symmetry; apply switch_write; exact Hx. }
    change ((exists d, formula_holds a (map (fun s => write s x d) (map switch (s :: tail)))) <->
      (exists d, formula_holds a (map (fun s => write s x d) (s :: tail)))).
    split; intros [d H]; exists d.
    + rewrite Hmaps in H; apply (proj1 (IH Ha _)); exact H.
    + rewrite Hmaps; apply (proj2 (IH Ha _)); exact H.
  - intros a IH Hfresh [|s tail]; [reflexivity|]; change (formula_holds a (map switch [s]) <-> formula_holds a [s]); apply IH; exact Hfresh.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh tr.
    assert (~ In v (formula_vars a) /\ ~ In v (formula_vars b)) as [Hfa Hfb]
      by (split; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
    induction tr as [|s tail IH]; [reflexivity|]. destruct tail as [|t tail].
    + cbn [map]; split; intro H; exfalso; eapply suffix_singleton; exact H.
    + change (formula_holds (Suffix a b) (switch s :: map switch (t :: tail)) <-> formula_holds (Suffix a b) (s :: t :: tail)).
      rewrite !suffix_step by discriminate. rewrite Ha, Hb, IH by assumption; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh tr.
    assert (~ In v (formula_vars a) /\ ~ In v (formula_vars b)) as [Hfa Hfb]
      by (split; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
    induction tr as [|s tail IH]; [reflexivity|]. destruct tail as [|t tail].
    + cbn [map]; split; intro H; apply dual_suffix_singleton.
    + change (formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) (switch s :: map switch (t :: tail)) <-> formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) (s :: t :: tail)).
      rewrite !dual_suffix_step by discriminate. rewrite Ha, Hb, IH by assumption; reflexivity.
  - intros p Hp a Ha Hfresh; apply switch_box;
      [apply Hp|apply Ha]; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - intros p Hp a Ha Hfresh; apply switch_diamond;
      [apply Hp|apply Ha]; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - intros x t Hfresh. apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr [s ->].
    assert (x <> v) as Hx by (intro H; subst; apply Hfresh; now left).
    assert (~ In v (term_vars t)) as Ht by (intro H; apply Hfresh; now right).
    cbn [map]. exists (switch s). rewrite switch_write by exact Hx.
    rewrite switch_term by exact Ht; reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha Hfresh; apply switch_predicate_iff; intros tr [s [-> Hguard]].
    exists (switch s); split; [reflexivity|]. apply (proj2 (Ha Hfresh [s;s])); exact Hguard.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh; apply switch_compose;
      [apply Ha|apply Hb]; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - intros a Ha b Hb Hfresh tr; cbn [program_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    rewrite Ha, Hb; try (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto); reflexivity.
  - intros a Ha Hfresh tr; cbn [program_holds Shared.formula_holds Shared.program_holds general_model general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term].
    setoid_rewrite (switch_power (program_holds a) (Ha Hfresh)); reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Switch every state in both label environments. Mapping a nonempty trace
    preserves nonemptiness, so the environment remains a valid [world]. The
    following lemmas lift the semantic switch through updates, labels and
    whole contexts under the same syntactic freshness condition. *)
Definition switch_world (w : world) : world.
Proof.
  refine (World (fun x => switch (world_mapping w x))
    (fun x => map switch (trace_mapping w x)) _).
  intros x Heq; apply map_eq_nil in Heq; apply (trace_mapping_nonempty w x); exact Heq.
Defined.

Lemma switch_update w u : ~ In v (update_vars u) ->
  eval_update (switch_world w) u = switch (eval_update w u).
Proof.
  induction u; intro Hfresh; cbn [eval_update Shared.eval_update general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term]; [reflexivity|].
  assert (x <> v) as Hx by (intro H; subst; apply Hfresh; now left).
  assert (~ In v (term_vars value)) as Ht by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (update_vars u)) as Hu by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; right; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  specialize (IHu Hu).
  change (eval_world_term (world_mapping (switch_world w)) u = switch (eval_world_term (world_mapping w) u)) in IHu.
  unfold world_mapping in IHu.
  rewrite IHu; rewrite switch_term by exact Ht.
  symmetry; apply switch_write; exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma switch_label w l : ~ In v (label_vars l) ->
  eval_label (switch_world w) l = map switch (eval_label w l).
Proof.
  induction l; intro Hfresh; cbn [eval_label Shared.eval_label general_model eval_world_term Shared.interpret_atom Shared.interpret_binary_atom Shared.interpret_extension Shared.interpret_coextension Shared.interpret_atomic_trace Shared.interpret_world_term]; try reflexivity.
  - now rewrite switch_update by exact Hfresh.
  - rewrite IHl1, IHl2, map_app; try reflexivity;
      intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
Qed.

Lemma switch_labelled w o : ~ In v (occurrence_vars o) ->
  (labelled_holds (switch_world w) o <-> labelled_holds w o).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh.
  assert (~ In v (label_vars o.(occurrence_label))) as Hl by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  assert (~ In v (formula_vars o.(occurrence_formula))) as Ha by
    (intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto).
  unfold labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, Shared.labelled_holds, label_admissible, Shared.label_admissible; rewrite switch_label by exact Hl.
  rewrite (proj1 switch_semantics _ Ha).
  assert (map switch (eval_label w o.(occurrence_label)) <> [] <-> eval_label w o.(occurrence_label) <> []) as Hne.
  { split; intros H Heq; [apply H; now rewrite Heq|apply map_eq_nil in Heq; contradiction]. }
  tauto.
Qed.

Lemma switch_left_context w context :
  (forall o, In o context -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) ->
  (left_holds (switch_world w) context <-> left_holds w context).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; unfold left_holds, Shared.left_holds; rewrite !Forall_forall.
  split; intros H o Hin.
  - apply (proj1 (switch_labelled w o (Hfresh o Hin))); apply H; exact Hin.
  - apply (proj2 (switch_labelled w o (Hfresh o Hin))); apply H; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma switch_right_context w context :
  (forall o, In o context -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) ->
  (right_holds (switch_world w) context <-> right_holds w context).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; unfold right_holds, Shared.right_holds; split; intros [o [Hin Ho]]; exists o; split; try exact Hin.
  - apply (proj1 (switch_labelled w o (Hfresh o Hin))); exact Ho.
  - apply (proj2 (switch_labelled w o (Hfresh o Hin))); exact Ho.
Qed.

(** The legacy first-order fragment has an empty relational context. *)
Lemma switch_denote w j : relations j = [] -> ~ In v (judgment_vars j) ->
  (denote j (switch_world w) <-> denote j w).
Proof.
  intros Hrel Hfresh.
  assert (forall o, In o (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)) -> ~ In v (occurrence_vars o)) as Hocc.
  { intros o Hin Hvar; apply Hfresh; apply in_flat_map; exists o; auto. }
  assert (admissible j (switch_world w) <-> admissible j w) as Hadm.
  { unfold admissible, Shared.admissible; rewrite Hrel.
    split; intros [H _]; split; try constructor;
      rewrite Forall_forall in *; intros o Hin;
      specialize (H o Hin); unfold Shared.label_admissible in *;
      rewrite switch_label in * by (intro Hv; apply (Hocc o Hin); apply in_app_iff; auto);
      unfold eval_label in *.
    - intro Heq; apply H; now rewrite Heq.
    - intro Heq; apply map_eq_nil in Heq; contradiction. }
  assert (left_holds (switch_world w) j.(antecedent) <-> left_holds w j.(antecedent)) as Hl.
  { apply switch_left_context; intros o Hin; apply Hocc; apply in_app_iff; auto. }
  assert (right_holds (switch_world w) j.(succedent) <-> right_holds w j.(succedent)) as Hr.
  { apply switch_right_context; intros o Hin; apply Hocc; apply in_app_iff; auto. }
  assert (Shared.relations_hold general_model (switch_world w) []) as R1 by constructor.
  assert (Shared.relations_hold general_model w []) as R2 by constructor.
  unfold denote, Shared.denote; rewrite Hadm, Hl, Hr, Hrel; tauto.
Qed.

End StateSwitch.

(** Exchange two arbitrary model values and fix all other values. Classical
    equality is used internally; the model interface still requires no
    executable equality decision. Swapping also works when the values agree. *)
Definition swap_values (a b d : domain M) : domain M :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (d = a) then b
  else if excluded_middle_informative (d = b) then a else d.

Lemma swap_values_left a b : swap_values a b a = b.
Proof. unfold swap_values; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (a = a)); congruence. Qed.
Lemma swap_values_right a b : swap_values a b b = a.
Proof.
  unfold swap_values; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (b = a)); [congruence|].
  destruct (excluded_middle_informative (b = b)); congruence.
Qed.
Lemma swap_values_involutive a b d : swap_values a b (swap_values a b d) = d.
Proof.
  destruct (excluded_middle_informative (d = a)) as [->|Hda]; [now rewrite swap_values_left, swap_values_right|].
  destruct (excluded_middle_informative (d = b)) as [->|Hdb]; [now rewrite swap_values_right, swap_values_left|].
  assert (swap_values a b d = d) as Hd.
  { unfold swap_values; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (d = a)); [contradiction|].
    destruct (excluded_middle_informative (d = b)); [contradiction|reflexivity]. }
  now rewrite Hd.
Qed.

Lemma fol_write_fresh body s u v value other : pureb body = true -> ~ In v (formula_vars body) ->
  (fol_holds body (write (write s v other) u value) <-> fol_holds body (write s u value)).
Proof.
  intros Hp Hv; destruct (Nat.eq_dec u v) as [->|Huv].
  - now rewrite write_shadow.
  - rewrite write_commute by congruence; apply fol_fresh; assumption.
Qed.

(** If the head's current [v] value is exchanged with [d], evaluating the
    fresh-variable instance in the switched world means evaluating the
    quantified body with [u := d] in the original head state. Label freshness
    is essential: an update mentioning [v] could otherwise overwrite it. *)
Lemma eigen_instance w l u v body d s tail :
  eval_label w l = s :: tail -> ~ In v (label_vars l) ->
  pureb body = true -> ~ In v (formula_vars body) ->
  (formula_holds (subst_fo u (Var v) body)
    (eval_label (switch_world v (swap_values (s v) d) w) l) <->
   fol_holds body (write s u d)).
Proof.
  intros Hlabel Hl Hp Hv.
  rewrite switch_label by exact Hl; rewrite Hlabel.
  change (formula_holds (subst_fo u (Var v) body)
    (switch v (swap_values (s v) d) s :: map (switch v (swap_values (s v) d)) tail) <-> fol_holds body (write s u d)).
  rewrite (pure_head (subst_fo u (Var v) body)) by (apply subst_fo_fuel_pure; exact Hp).
  rewrite subst_fo_correct by exact Hp.
  cbn [eval_term]; unfold switch; rewrite write_same, swap_values_left.
  apply fol_write_fresh; assumption.
Qed.

(** Arbitrary-term instantiation reduces via [pure_head] to the proved FOL
    substitution theorem. It does not assert a substitution law for a modal
    quantifier body or freeze a term's value across a changing program run. *)
Lemma all_instantiation body u t tr : pureb body = true -> tr <> [] ->
  formula_holds (All u body) tr -> formula_holds (subst_fo u t body) tr.
Proof.
  intros Hp Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|].
  rewrite (pure_head (All u body)) by exact Hp.
  rewrite (pure_head (subst_fo u t body)) by (apply subst_fo_fuel_pure; exact Hp).
  rewrite subst_fo_correct by exact Hp. cbn [fol_holds]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ex_instantiation body u t tr : pureb body = true -> tr <> [] ->
  formula_holds (subst_fo u t body) tr -> formula_holds (Ex u body) tr.
Proof.
  intros Hp Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|].
  rewrite (pure_head (Ex u body)) by exact Hp.
  rewrite (pure_head (subst_fo u t body)) by (apply subst_fo_fuel_pure; exact Hp).
  rewrite subst_fo_correct by exact Hp. cbn [fol_holds]; eauto.
Qed.

(** For a pure observation, [Always] is exactly the observation at every
    visited state. The complex benchmarks use this to turn finite-trace
    safety induction into an object-language temporal validity theorem. *)
Lemma always_pure_forall a tr : pureb a = true -> tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Always a) tr <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds a [s]) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hp; induction tr as [|s tail IH]; intro Hne; [contradiction|].
  destruct tail as [|t tail].
  - unfold Always, Eventually; rewrite !nonempty_neg by discriminate.
    change (~ (~ formula_holds a [s] \/ formula_holds (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) [s]) <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds a [s]) [s]).
    rewrite Forall_cons_iff. pose proof (suffix_singleton Truth (Neg a) s) as Hsuffix.
    split; [intro H; split; [tauto|constructor]|intros [H _]; tauto].
  - specialize (IH ltac:(discriminate)).
    unfold Always, Eventually in *.
    rewrite nonempty_neg in * by discriminate.
    change (~ (formula_holds (Neg a) (s :: t :: tail) \/
      formula_holds (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) (s :: t :: tail)) <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds a [s]) (s :: t :: tail)).
    rewrite nonempty_neg, suffix_step by discriminate.
    rewrite nonempty_neg by discriminate.
    change (formula_holds Truth (t :: tail)) with True.
    rewrite (pure_singleton a s (t :: tail) Hp).
    change (~ (formula_holds (Neg a) (t :: tail) \/ formula_holds (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) (t :: tail)) <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds a [s]) (t :: tail)) in IH.
    rewrite nonempty_neg in IH by discriminate.
    fold formula_holds in *.
    rewrite (pure_singleton a t tail Hp) in *.
    change (formula_holds Truth (t :: tail)) with True.
    rewrite Forall_cons_iff. tauto.
Qed.

End Interpretation.

(** Package a chosen model for the later [ForModel] functors. This module
    type belongs to this particular syntax/semantics functor instance. *)
Module Type INTERPRETATION.
  Parameter interpretation : model.
End INTERPRETATION.
End MakeSemantics.
FOPL/Signature.v:
(** * The vocabulary of the object logic

    Start here, then read Syntax.v and Semantics.v. A [SIGNATURE] supplies
    names and argument counts; a semantic model later assigns meanings to
    those names. Keeping the two interfaces separate lets the same syntax be
    interpreted over integers, Booleans, or an arbitrary nonempty carrier. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List.

(** Finitary, single-sorted signatures. Equality is required only for syntax;
    models need neither decidable equality nor decidable predicate truth. *)
Module Type SIGNATURE.
  (** Function and predicate symbols occupy separate namespaces. A constant
      is simply a function symbol whose arity is zero. *)
  Parameter function_symbol predicate_symbol : Type.
  (** These decisions compare names in reified syntax. They make executable
      formula/judgment comparison possible without comparing model values. *)
  Parameter function_eq_dec : forall x y : function_symbol, {x = y} + {x <> y}.
  Parameter predicate_eq_dec : forall x y : predicate_symbol, {x = y} + {x <> y}.
  (** Syntax.v checks list lengths against these arities before a concrete
      rule instance can cross the well-formedness boundary. *)
  Parameter function_arity : function_symbol -> nat.
  Parameter predicate_arity : predicate_symbol -> nat.
End SIGNATURE.
FOPL/Syntax.v:
(** * Reified syntax and its executable checks

    This file defines data, not truth in a model. Read it in four parts:
    terms and mutually defined formulas/programs; named FOL substitution;
    updates and labels; occurrences, judgments and reflected syntax checks.
    Semantics.v gives these objects meanings, and RuleGeneration.v uses the
    Boolean checks to construct rules together with their required evidence.

    Names ending in [b] return Booleans; later [_spec] lemmas connect those
    computations to propositions. [Defined] keeps equality decisions and
    other computational proofs transparent so generators can reduce them. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia.
From CyclistRocq.LPL.FOPL Require Import Signature.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax.
Import ListNotations.

Module MakeSyntax (S : SIGNATURE).

(** Program variables, world variables, trace variables and occurrence tags
    occupy distinct syntactic fields. Quantifiers bind named program variables.
    Raw applications have checked arities; raw quantified bodies have checked
    purity. The rule boundary must require [judgment_wfb]. *)
Inductive term : Type :=
| Var (x : nat)
| Fun (f : S.function_symbol) (args : list term).

Fixpoint term_eq_dec (x y : term) : {x = y} + {x <> y}.
Proof.
  decide equality; try apply Nat.eq_dec; try apply S.function_eq_dec.
  apply list_eq_dec; exact term_eq_dec.
Defined.

(** Lists make terms easy to construct. The price is that arity correctness
    is checked explicitly rather than built into the type of [Fun]. *)
Fixpoint term_wfb (t : term) : bool :=
  match t with
  | Var _ => true
  | Fun f ts => Nat.eqb (length ts) (S.function_arity f) && forallb term_wfb ts
  end.

Fixpoint term_vars (t : term) : list nat :=
  match t with
  | Var x => [x]
  | Fun _ ts => flat_map term_vars ts
  end.

(** Terms have no binders, so substitution here is a structural traversal.
    Binder capture is handled by the formula substitution operations below. *)
Fixpoint subst_term (x : nat) (replacement t : term) : term :=
  match t with
  | Var y => if Nat.eqb x y then replacement else t
  | Fun f ts => Fun f (map (subst_term x replacement) ts)
  end.

Inductive update : Type :=
| Base (world_variable : nat)
| AssignUpdate (x : nat) (value : term) (previous : update).

Fixpoint update_eq_dec (a b : update) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof. decide equality; try apply term_eq_dec; apply Nat.eq_dec. Defined.

Fixpoint update_wfb (u : update) : bool :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => true
  | AssignUpdate _ t u => term_wfb t && update_wfb u
  end.

Fixpoint update_vars (u : update) : list nat :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => []
  | AssignUpdate x t u => x :: (term_vars t ++ update_vars u)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_world_update (x : nat) (replacement u : update) : update :=
  match u with
  | Base y => if Nat.eqb x y then replacement else u
  | AssignUpdate y t u => AssignUpdate y t (subst_world_update x replacement u)
  end.

Fixpoint update_world_names u : list nat := match u with
  | Base x => [x] | AssignUpdate _ _ u => update_world_names u end.
Module Language <: LANGUAGE.
  Definition atom_symbol := S.predicate_symbol.
  Definition argument := term.
  Definition binder := nat.
  Definition action_symbol := nat.
  Definition action_argument := term.
  Definition world_term := update.
  Definition relation_symbol := Empty_set.
  Definition atom_eq_dec := S.predicate_eq_dec.
  Definition argument_eq_dec := term_eq_dec.
  Definition binder_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition action_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition action_argument_eq_dec := term_eq_dec.
  Definition world_term_eq_dec := update_eq_dec.
  Definition relation_eq_dec (x y : relation_symbol) : {x=y}+{x<>y} := match x with end.
  Definition atom_wfb p ts := Nat.eqb (length ts) (S.predicate_arity p) && forallb term_wfb ts.
  Definition binary_atom_wfb a b := term_wfb a && term_wfb b.
  Definition extension_wfb (_ : binder) (pure : bool) := pure.
  Definition coextension_wfb := extension_wfb.
  Definition action_wfb (_ : nat) t := term_wfb t.
  Definition world_term_wfb := update_wfb.
  Definition custom_relation_wfb (x : relation_symbol) (_ : nat) : bool := match x with end.
  Definition world_name := Base.
  Definition world_support := update_world_names.
  Definition subst_world := subst_world_update.
End Language.
Module Export Shared := CyclistRocq.LPL.Syntax.MakeSyntax Language.
Notation Pred := Atom.
Notation Equal := BinaryAtom.
Notation All := Extension.
Notation Ex := Coextension.
Notation Assign := Atomic.
Fixpoint formula_vars (a : formula) : list nat :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity => []
  | Pred _ ts => flat_map term_vars ts
  | Equal a b => term_vars a ++ term_vars b
  | Neg a | First a => formula_vars a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b =>
      formula_vars a ++ formula_vars b
  | All x a | Ex x a => x :: formula_vars a
  | Box p a | Diamond p a => program_vars p ++ formula_vars a
  end
with program_vars (p : program) : list nat :=
  match p with
  | Assign x t => x :: term_vars t
  | Test a => formula_vars a
  | Seq a b | Choice a b => program_vars a ++ program_vars b
  | Star a => program_vars a
  end.

(** Binding-aware substitution on pure syntax. This raw helper stops at a
    binder for [x], but does not rename other binders. [free_forb] supplies a
    sufficient no-capture condition for its semantic correctness theorem.
    Nonpure constructors are left unchanged; this is not an unrestricted
    term-substitution operation for programs or temporal formulas. Public
    quantifier rules use the capture-avoiding [subst_fo] defined below. *)
Fixpoint raw_subst_fo (x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : formula :=
  match a with
  | Truth => Truth
  | Falsity => Falsity
  | Pred p ts => Pred p (map (subst_term x t) ts)
  | Equal l r => Equal (subst_term x t l) (subst_term x t r)
  | Neg a => Neg (raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | Conj a b => Conj (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | Disj a b => Disj (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | Impl a b => Impl (raw_subst_fo x t a) (raw_subst_fo x t b)
  | All y a => All y (if Nat.eqb x y then a else raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | Ex y a => Ex y (if Nat.eqb x y then a else raw_subst_fo x t a)
  | _ => a
  end.

Fixpoint free_forb (x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity | Pred _ _ | Equal _ _ => true
  | Neg a => free_forb x t a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b => free_forb x t a && free_forb x t b
  | All y a | Ex y a =>
      if Nat.eqb x y then true
      else negb (existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t)) && free_forb x t a
  | _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint fol_size (a : formula) : nat :=
  match a with
  | Neg a | All _ a | Ex _ a | First a | Box _ a | Diamond _ a => Datatypes.S (fol_size a)
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b => Datatypes.S (fol_size a + fol_size b)
  | _ => 1
  end.

Lemma raw_subst_size a x t : fol_size (raw_subst_fo x t a) = fol_size a.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [raw_subst_fo fol_size]; try congruence;
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [fol_size]; congruence.
Qed.

Lemma raw_subst_pure a x t : pureb a = true -> pureb (raw_subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb raw_subst_fo]; intro H; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply andb_true_iff in H; rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by tauto; reflexivity);
    try (apply IHa; exact H);
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [pureb]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma rename_free_for a u v : pureb a = true -> ~ In v (formula_vars a) -> free_forb u (Var v) a = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [pureb free_forb formula_vars]; intros Hp Hv; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply IHa; assumption).
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hp as [Ha Hb]; apply andb_true_iff; split;
      [apply IHa1|apply IHa2]; try assumption; intro H; apply Hv; apply in_app_iff; auto.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x); [reflexivity|]. apply andb_true_iff; split.
    + apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false; cbn [term_vars]; intro H; destruct H; [subst|contradiction]; apply Hv; now left.
    + apply IHa; [exact Hp|intro H; apply Hv; now right].
  - destruct (Nat.eqb u x); [reflexivity|]. apply andb_true_iff; split.
    + apply negb_true_iff, occursb_false; cbn [term_vars]; intro H; destruct H; [subst|contradiction]; apply Hv; now left.
    + apply IHa; [exact Hp|intro H; apply Hv; now right].
Qed.

(** Total capture-avoiding substitution. At a quantifier there are three
    cases: its binder shadows [x]; its binder would capture a name of [t]; or
    substitution may descend directly. In the second case, rename first to a
    name fresh for the body, replacement and substituted variable. The fuel
    is a proved structural bound; public callers do not choose it. *)
Fixpoint subst_fo_fuel (fuel x : nat) (t : term) (a : formula) : formula :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => a
  | Datatypes.S fuel =>
    match a with
    | Truth => Truth
    | Falsity => Falsity
    | Pred p ts => Pred p (map (subst_term x t) ts)
    | Equal l r => Equal (subst_term x t l) (subst_term x t r)
    | Neg a => Neg (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a)
    | Conj a b => Conj (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | Disj a b => Disj (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | Impl a b => Impl (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t b)
    | All y body =>
        if Nat.eqb x y then a
        else if existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t) then
          let z := fresh_name (x :: y :: (formula_vars body ++ term_vars t)) in
          All z (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body))
        else All y (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t body)
    | Ex y body =>
        if Nat.eqb x y then a
        else if existsb (Nat.eqb y) (term_vars t) then
          let z := fresh_name (x :: y :: (formula_vars body ++ term_vars t)) in
          Ex z (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t (raw_subst_fo y (Var z) body))
        else Ex y (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t body)
    | _ => a
    end
  end.

Definition subst_fo x t a := subst_fo_fuel (fol_size a) x t a.

Lemma subst_fo_fuel_pure fuel : forall x t a, pureb a = true -> pureb (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros x t a Hp; [exact Hp|].
  destruct a; cbn [subst_fo_fuel pureb] in *; try discriminate; try reflexivity;
    try (apply IH; exact Hp);
    try (apply andb_true_iff in Hp; rewrite !IH by tauto; reflexivity);
    destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [exact Hp| |exact Hp|];
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [pureb];
    apply IH; try (apply raw_subst_pure); exact Hp.
Qed.

Fixpoint label_vars (l : label) : list nat :=
  match l with
  | Empty | TraceLabel _ => []
  | StateLabel u => update_vars u
  | Join a b => label_vars a ++ label_vars b
  end.

Definition occurrence_vars o := label_vars o.(occurrence_label) ++ formula_vars o.(occurrence_formula).
Definition judgment_vars j := flat_map occurrence_vars (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)).
Definition eigen_freshb v j l a :=
  negb (existsb (Nat.eqb v) (judgment_vars j ++ label_vars l ++ formula_vars a)).

Lemma eigen_freshb_spec v j l a :
  eigen_freshb v j l a = true <->
  ~ In v (judgment_vars j ++ label_vars l ++ formula_vars a).
Proof.
  unfold eigen_freshb. rewrite negb_true_iff, <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists.
  split.
  - intros H Hin. apply H. exists v; split; [exact Hin | apply Nat.eqb_refl].
  - intros H [x [Hin Heq]]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq. subst; contradiction.
Qed.

Inductive term_wf : term -> Prop :=
| WfVar x : term_wf (Var x)
| WfFun f ts : length ts = S.function_arity f ->
    Forall term_wf ts -> term_wf (Fun f ts).

Lemma term_wfb_spec t : term_wfb t = true <-> term_wf t.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [x|f ts]; cbn [term_wfb].
  - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
  - assert (forallb term_wfb ts = true <-> Forall term_wf ts) as Hargs.
    { induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; cbn.
      - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
      - rewrite andb_true_iff, (IH a), IHts.
        split; [intros [Ha Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto]. }
    rewrite andb_true_iff, Nat.eqb_eq, Hargs.
    split; [intros [Harity Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto].
Qed.

Lemma terms_wfb_spec ts : forallb term_wfb ts = true <-> Forall term_wf ts.
Proof.
  induction ts as [|t ts IH]; cbn.
  - split; intro H; [constructor | reflexivity].
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, term_wfb_spec, IH.
    split; [intros [Ht Hts]; constructor; assumption | intro H; inversion H; auto].
Qed.

(** These propositional specifications separate what well-formedness means
    from the executable checks. The mutual reflection proof follows the same
    formula/program induction principle used for semantic freshness later. *)
Fixpoint formula_wf (a : formula) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity => True
  | Pred p ts => length ts = S.predicate_arity p /\ Forall term_wf ts
  | Equal a b => term_wf a /\ term_wf b
  | Neg a | First a => formula_wf a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b =>
      formula_wf a /\ formula_wf b
  | All _ a | Ex _ a => pure_formula a /\ formula_wf a
  | Box p a | Diamond p a => program_wf p /\ formula_wf a
  end
with program_wf (p : program) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Assign _ t => term_wf t
  | Test a => formula_wf a
  | Seq a b | Choice a b => program_wf a /\ program_wf b
  | Star a => program_wf a
  end.

Lemma formula_program_wfb_spec :
  (forall a, formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a) /\
  (forall p, program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p).
Proof.
  apply formula_program_mutind; intros; cbn [formula_wfb program_wfb formula_wf program_wf Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb];
    unfold Language.atom_wfb, Language.binary_atom_wfb, Language.coextension_wfb, Language.extension_wfb, Language.action_wfb in *;
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?Nat.eqb_eq, ?terms_wfb_spec, ?term_wfb_spec,
      ?pureb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma formula_wfb_spec a : formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.

Lemma program_wfb_spec p : program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.

Fixpoint update_wf u : Prop :=
  match u with
  | Base _ => True
  | AssignUpdate _ t u => term_wf t /\ update_wf u
  end.

Fixpoint label_wf l : Prop :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => update_wf u
  | Join a b => label_wf a /\ label_wf b
  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma update_wfb_spec u : update_wfb u = true <-> update_wf u.
Proof.
  induction u; cbn [update_wfb update_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?term_wfb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma label_wfb_spec l : label_wfb l = true <-> label_wf l.
Proof.
  induction l; cbn [label_wfb label_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff, ?update_wfb_spec; intuition.
Qed.

Definition occurrence_wf right o : Prop :=
  label_wf o.(occurrence_label) /\ label_nonemptyb o.(occurrence_label) = true /\
  formula_wf o.(occurrence_formula) /\
  match o.(occurrence_tag) with
  | None => True
  | Some _ => right = true /\ traceableb o.(occurrence_formula) = true
  end.

Definition judgment_wf j : Prop :=
  Forall (fun r => relation_wfb r = true) j.(relations) /\
  Forall (occurrence_wf false) j.(antecedent) /\
  Forall (occurrence_wf true) j.(succedent) /\ NoDup (judgment_tags j).

Lemma occurrence_wfb_spec right o : occurrence_wfb right o = true <-> occurrence_wf right o.
Proof.
  unfold occurrence_wfb, occurrence_wf.
  destruct (occurrence_tag o); rewrite !andb_true_iff, label_wfb_spec, formula_wfb_spec;
    intuition.
Qed.

(** This is the full syntax boundary available to a caller who wants to
    reason propositionally after computing [judgment_wfb]. Nonemptiness is
    related to semantic admissibility separately in Semantics.v. *)
Lemma judgment_wfb_spec j : judgment_wfb j = true <-> judgment_wf j.
Proof.
  unfold judgment_wfb, judgment_wf.
  rewrite !andb_true_iff, unique_tagsb_spec, !forallb_forall, !Forall_forall.
  setoid_rewrite occurrence_wfb_spec; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_term_wfb t : forall x replacement, term_wfb t = true ->
  term_wfb replacement = true -> term_wfb (subst_term x replacement t) = true.
Proof.
  revert t; fix IH 1; intro t; destruct t as [y|f ts]; intros x replacement Ht Hr;
    cbn [subst_term term_wfb] in *.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ht as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity; cbn. clear Harity. revert Hargs.
    induction ts as [|a ts IHts]; cbn; intro Hargs; [reflexivity|].
    apply andb_true_iff in Hargs as [Ha Hts].
    rewrite (IH a x replacement Ha Hr), (IHts Hts); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_terms_wfb ts x t : forallb term_wfb ts = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  forallb term_wfb (map (subst_term x t) ts) = true.
Proof.
  intros Hts Ht; induction ts as [|a ts IH]; cbn in *; [reflexivity|].
  apply andb_true_iff in Hts as [Ha Hts].
  rewrite subst_term_wfb by assumption. rewrite IH by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma raw_subst_wfb a x t : formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (raw_subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction a; cbn [raw_subst_fo formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb]; intros Ha Ht; unfold Language.atom_wfb, Language.binary_atom_wfb, Language.coextension_wfb, Language.extension_wfb, Language.action_wfb in *;
    try exact Ha; try (apply IHa; assumption).
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity, subst_terms_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr].
    rewrite !subst_term_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite IHa1, IHa2 by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb].
    + now rewrite Hp, Ha.
    + rewrite raw_subst_pure, IHa by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb].
    + now rewrite Hp, Ha.
    + rewrite raw_subst_pure, IHa by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_fuel_wfb fuel : forall a x t, formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (subst_fo_fuel fuel x t a) = true.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|fuel IH]; intros a x t Ha Ht; [exact Ha|].
  destruct a; cbn [subst_fo_fuel formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb] in *; unfold Language.atom_wfb, Language.binary_atom_wfb, Language.coextension_wfb, Language.extension_wfb, Language.action_wfb in *; try exact Ha.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Harity Hargs].
    rewrite length_map, Harity, subst_terms_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr].
    rewrite !subst_term_wfb by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply IH; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hl Hr]. rewrite !IH by assumption. reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb]; now rewrite Hp, Ha|].
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb];
      rewrite subst_fo_fuel_pure, IH by
        (try apply raw_subst_pure; try apply raw_subst_wfb; cbn [term_wfb]; auto);
      reflexivity.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Ha as [Hp Ha]. destruct (Nat.eqb x x0); [cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb]; now rewrite Hp, Ha|].
    destruct (existsb (Nat.eqb x0) (term_vars t)); cbn [formula_wfb Language.atom_wfb Language.binary_atom_wfb Language.extension_wfb Language.coextension_wfb Language.action_wfb];
      rewrite subst_fo_fuel_pure, IH by
        (try apply raw_subst_pure; try apply raw_subst_wfb; cbn [term_wfb]; auto);
      reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_wfb a x t : formula_wfb a = true -> term_wfb t = true ->
  formula_wfb (subst_fo x t a) = true.
Proof. apply subst_fo_fuel_wfb. Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_wf a x t : formula_wf a -> term_wf t -> formula_wf (subst_fo x t a).
Proof.
  intros Ha Ht; apply formula_wfb_spec, subst_fo_wfb;
    [now apply formula_wfb_spec | now apply term_wfb_spec].
Qed.

Lemma subst_fo_pure a x t : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (subst_fo x t a).
Proof. intro Ha; apply pureb_spec, subst_fo_fuel_pure, pureb_spec; exact Ha. Qed.

Lemma subst_world_update_wfb u x replacement : update_wfb u = true ->
  update_wfb replacement = true -> update_wfb (subst_world_update x replacement u) = true.
Proof.
  induction u as [y|y t u IH]; cbn [subst_world_update update_wfb]; intros Hu Hr.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hu as [Ht Hu]. rewrite Ht, IH by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_world_label_wfb l x replacement : label_wfb l = true ->
  update_wfb replacement = true -> label_wfb (subst_world_label x replacement l) = true.
Proof.
  induction l; cbn [subst_world_label label_wfb]; intros Hl Hr; try reflexivity.
  - apply subst_world_update_wfb; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hl as [Ha Hb]. rewrite IHl1, IHl2 by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_trace_label_wfb l x replacement : label_wfb l = true ->
  label_wfb replacement = true -> label_wfb (subst_trace_label x replacement l) = true.
Proof.
  induction l as [|u|y|a IHa b IHb]; cbn [subst_trace_label label_wfb]; intros Hl Hr; try exact Hl.
  - destruct (Nat.eqb x y); assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hl as [Ha Hb]. rewrite IHa, IHb by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

End MakeSyntax.
PPL/Instance.v:
(** * Plain PPL instances over arbitrary user vocabularies and frames.

    An action name is arbitrary data. Its interpretation can be infinite,
    nondeterministic and undecidable. Propositions are arbitrary predicates.
    No first-order term, assignment or quantifier is required here. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics Progress Rules RuleGeneration Certification.
Import ListNotations.

Module Type VOCABULARY.
  Parameter action proposition relation_symbol : Type.
  Parameter action_eq_dec : forall x y : action, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter proposition_eq_dec : forall x y : proposition, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter relation_eq_dec : forall x y : relation_symbol, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter relation_wfb : relation_symbol -> nat -> bool.
End VOCABULARY.

Module MakeLanguage (V : VOCABULARY) <: LANGUAGE.
  Definition atom_symbol := V.proposition.
  Definition argument := Empty_set.
  Definition binder := Empty_set.
  Definition action_symbol := V.action.
  Definition action_argument := unit.
  Definition world_term := nat.
  Definition relation_symbol := V.relation_symbol.
  Definition atom_eq_dec := V.proposition_eq_dec.
  Definition argument_eq_dec (x y : argument) : {x=y}+{x<>y} := match x with end.
  Definition binder_eq_dec := argument_eq_dec.
  Definition action_eq_dec := V.action_eq_dec.
  Definition action_argument_eq_dec (x y : unit) : {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Proof. decide equality. Defined.
  Definition world_term_eq_dec := Nat.eq_dec.
  Definition relation_eq_dec := V.relation_eq_dec.
  Definition atom_wfb (_ : atom_symbol) (args : list argument) := Nat.eqb (length args) 0.
  Definition binary_atom_wfb (x y : argument) : bool := match x with end.
  Definition extension_wfb (x : binder) (_ : bool) : bool := match x with end.
  Definition coextension_wfb := extension_wfb.
  Definition action_wfb (_ : action_symbol) (_ : unit) := true.
  Definition world_term_wfb (_ : nat) := true.
  Definition custom_relation_wfb := V.relation_wfb.
  Definition world_name (x : nat) := x.
  Definition world_support (x : nat) := [x].
  Definition subst_world x replacement u := if Nat.eqb x u then replacement else u.
End MakeLanguage.

Module Type FRAME (V : VOCABULARY).
  Parameter State : Type.
  Parameter inhabitant : State.
  Parameter step : V.action -> State -> State -> Prop.
  Parameter proposition_holds : V.proposition -> State -> Prop.
  Parameter relation_holds : V.relation_symbol -> list (list State) -> Prop.
End FRAME.

Module MakeInstance (V : VOCABULARY) (F : FRAME V).
  Module Language := MakeLanguage V.
  Module Syn := MakeSyntax Language.
  Module Sem := MakeSemantics Language Syn.
  Module Model <: Sem.INTERPRETATION.
    Definition interpretation : Sem.model.
    Proof.
      refine {| Sem.carrier := F.State;
        Sem.carrier_inhabitant := F.inhabitant;
        Sem.interpret_atom := fun p _ s => F.proposition_holds p s;
        Sem.interpret_binary_atom := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
        Sem.interpret_extension := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
        Sem.interpret_coextension := fun x _ _ => match x with end;
        Sem.interpret_action := fun a _ s t => F.step a s t;
        Sem.interpret_atomic_trace := fun a _ tr => exists s t, tr=[s;t] /\ F.step a s t;
        Sem.interpret_world_term := fun rho x => rho x;
        Sem.interpret_relation := F.relation_holds |}.
      - intros; reflexivity.
      - intros; reflexivity.
      - intros rho rho' u H; apply H; now left.
      - intros rho x replacement u; unfold Language.subst_world;
          destruct (Nat.eqb x u); reflexivity.
    Defined.
  End Model.
End MakeInstance.
Progress.v:
(** * Semantic ranks for cyclic traces

    Read Semantics.v first. This module describes counterexample histories,
    assigns them a mathematical minimum measure, and proves the inequalities
    needed by traced rules. It finishes by instantiating Framework.THEORY.
    Rules.v packages these inequalities into proof-producing countersteps.

    A trace is a list of states; a history is a list of such traces. Its
    measure sums their lengths. A premise may describe a longer accumulated
    trace yet have smaller rank because an outer execution-history component
    has been removed. No execution enumeration or program evaluator is used
    to compute these semantic minima. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia Classical_Prop.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.ClassicalDescription Logic.ConstructiveEpsilon.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics.
From CyclistRocq.Cyclic Require Import Framework.
Import ListNotations.

Module MakeProgress (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn).
Export Syn Sem.
(** Fix an interpretation once so that ranks and the cyclic framework use
    the very same model. The outer functor shares the existing syntax and
    semantics modules; [ForModel] supplies their remaining model parameter. *)
Module ForModel (I : Sem.INTERPRETATION).
Definition M := I.interpretation.
Definition trace := Sem.trace M.

(** [execution_history prefix rest] includes the initial prefix and each
    subsequent accumulated trace. Its measure is the SUM of their lengths,
    never merely the number of transitions. For example, prefix [[s]] and
    rest [[t;u]] produce [[[s];[s;t];[s;t;u]]], with measure [1+2+3]. *)
Fixpoint execution_history (prefix rest : trace) : list trace :=
  prefix :: match rest with
    | [] => []
    | s :: tail => execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) tail
    end.

(** Record the successive accumulated prefixes produced by one execution
    that starts at the current trace's last state. [rest <> []] ensures an
    actual transition, including the stutters of tests and zero iterations. *)
Definition execution_sequence (tr : trace) (p : program) (history : list trace) : Prop :=
  exists s rest result, program_holds M p (s :: rest) /\
    rest <> [] /\ overlap M tr (s :: rest) result /\
    history = execution_history tr rest.

(** A box fails through an execution and a failing body. Join their histories
    by overlapping the shared final trace once; this use of [overlap_list]
    is at the level of lists of traces, not labels. For any non-box formula,
    failure is represented by the singleton history containing its trace. *)
Fixpoint counterexample (a : formula) (tr : trace) (history : list trace) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | Box p body => exists run final_run rest,
      execution_sequence tr p run /\
      last run [] = final_run /\
      counterexample body final_run rest /\ overlap_list run rest history
  | _ => ~ formula_holds M a tr /\ history = [tr]
  end.

Definition sequence_measure (history : list trace) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun tr n => length tr + n) 0 history.

(** Collect attainable measures as a predicate on natural numbers. Keeping
    the actual history existential lets the minimum range over arbitrarily
    many executions without requiring a list of all possible executions. *)
Definition measure_possible a tr n :=
  exists history, counterexample a tr history /\ sequence_measure history = n.

(** Classical existence checks and the standard least-number construction
    give a mathematical minimum in [nat], even if a program has infinitely
    many executions. The fallback 0 is confined to empty counterexample sets.
    [minimum_spec] supplies both attainment and minimality when a witness
    exists; later false-trace lemmas always establish that existence first. *)
Definition minimum_counterexample a tr : nat :=
  match excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n) with
  | left H => proj1_sig (epsilon_smallest (measure_possible a tr)
      (fun n => excluded_middle_informative (measure_possible a tr n)) H)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Lemma minimum_spec a tr : (exists n, measure_possible a tr n) ->
  measure_possible a tr (minimum_counterexample a tr) /\
  forall n, measure_possible a tr n -> minimum_counterexample a tr <= n.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold minimum_counterexample.
  destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n)) as [Hex|Hno]; [|contradiction].
  destruct (epsilon_smallest (measure_possible a tr)
    (fun n => excluded_middle_informative (measure_possible a tr n)) Hex) as [n [Hn Hmin]].
  cbn. auto.
Qed.

Lemma execution_history_last prefix rest :
  last (execution_history prefix rest) [] = prefix ++ rest.
Proof.
  revert prefix. induction rest as [|s rest IH]; intro prefix.
  - cbn; now rewrite app_nil_r.
  - change (last (prefix :: execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) rest) [] = prefix ++ s :: rest).
    assert (exists tail, execution_history (prefix ++ [s]) rest = (prefix ++ [s]) :: tail) as Hex.
    { destruct rest; eexists; reflexivity. }
    destruct Hex as [tail Heq].
    rewrite Heq. change (last ((prefix ++ [s]) :: tail) [] = prefix ++ s :: rest).
    rewrite <- Heq, IH, <- app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma execution_history_head prefix rest :
  exists tail, execution_history prefix rest = prefix :: tail.
Proof. destruct rest; eexists; reflexivity. Qed.

(** The last accumulated prefix is exactly a semantic execution result.
    This connects the explicit history representation to the overlap
    relation used by the box clause in Semantics.v. *)
Lemma execution_history_result tr p history :
  execution_sequence tr p history ->
  exists execution, program_holds M p execution /\ overlap M tr execution (last history []).
Proof.
  intros [s [rest [result [Hp [_ [Ho ->]]]]]].
  exists (s :: rest); split; [exact Hp|]. rewrite execution_history_last.
  destruct Ho as [prefix [s' [tail [Htr [Heq _]]]]].
  inversion Heq; subst. unfold overlap, overlap_list.
  exists prefix, s', tail. repeat split; auto. rewrite <- app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** A counterexample history always starts with the trace it refutes.
    This is the boundary fact that lets a box execution history overlap
    its body's counterexample at one shared accumulated trace. *)
Lemma counterexample_head a tr history : counterexample a tr history ->
  exists tail, history = tr :: tail.
Proof.
  revert tr history. induction a; intros tr history H; cbn [counterexample] in H;
    try (destruct H as [_ ->]; exists []; reflexivity).
  destruct H as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [tail [result [_ [_ [_ Hrun]]]]]]; subst run.
  destruct (execution_history_head tr tail) as [run_tail Hrun].
  destruct Ho as [prefix [endtr [rest_tail [Hleft [_ ->]]]]].
  rewrite Hrun in Hleft. destruct prefix as [|first prefix].
  - cbn in Hleft; inversion Hleft; subst. exists rest_tail; reflexivity.
  - cbn in Hleft; inversion Hleft; subst. eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** These two directions connect histories back to truth: a counterexample
    refutes the formula, and a false formula on a nonempty trace has a
    counterexample. Their proofs recurse through boxes rather than assuming
    that every semantic failure has already been supplied as finite data. *)
Lemma counterexample_false a tr history : tr <> [] ->
  counterexample a tr history -> ~ formula_holds M a tr.
Proof.
  revert tr history. induction a; intros tr history Hne Hce;
    cbn [counterexample] in Hce; try tauto.
  destruct Hce as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest _]]]]]].
  destruct (execution_history_result _ _ _ Hrun) as [execution [Hp Ho]].
  rewrite Hfinal in Ho.
  destruct (overlap_nonempty M _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hfinal_ne]].
  pose proof (IHa final rest Hfinal_ne Hrest) as Hbad.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]. cbn [formula_holds].
  intro H; apply Hbad; eapply H; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma list_split_last {A : Type} (xs : list A) default : xs <> [] ->
  exists prefix, xs = prefix ++ [last xs default].
Proof.
  induction xs as [|x xs IH]; intro Hne; [contradiction|].
  destruct xs as [|y xs].
  - exists []; reflexivity.
  - destruct (IH ltac:(discriminate)) as [prefix Hp].
    exists (x :: prefix). cbn in *; now rewrite <- Hp.
Qed.

(** For a false box, extract a failing execution from its universal meaning,
    recurse on the body, and overlap its counterexample with the execution
    history. [program_length] supplies the nonempty sequence of steps. *)
Lemma counterexample_exists a tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  exists history, counterexample a tr history.
Proof.
  revert tr. induction a; intros tr Hne Hfalse;
    try solve [exists [tr]; cbn [counterexample]; auto].
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds] in Hfalse.
  apply not_all_ex_not in Hfalse as [execution Hfalse].
  apply not_all_ex_not in Hfalse as [result Hfalse].
  assert (program_holds M p execution /\ overlap M (s :: tail) execution result /\
    ~ formula_holds M a result) as [Hp [Ho Hbad]] by tauto.
  destruct (overlap_nonempty M _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hresult]].
  destruct (IHa result Hresult Hbad) as [rest Hrest].
  destruct (counterexample_head a result rest Hrest) as [rest_tail Hhead].
  pose proof (program_length M p execution Hp) as Hlength.
  destruct execution as [|start steps]; cbn in Hlength; [lia|].
  assert (steps <> []) as Hsteps by (intro Heq; subst; cbn in Hlength; lia).
  set (run := execution_history (s :: tail) steps).
  assert (last run [] = result) as Hlast.
  { unfold run; rewrite execution_history_last.
    destruct Ho as [prefix [lasts [reststeps [Htr [Hexec Hresult_eq]]]]].
    inversion Hexec; subst. rewrite Htr, <- app_assoc. reflexivity. }
  assert (run <> []) as Hrun_ne by (unfold run; destruct steps; discriminate).
  destruct (list_split_last run [] Hrun_ne) as [prefix Hprefix].
  rewrite Hlast in Hprefix.
  exists (prefix ++ result :: rest_tail).
  cbn [counterexample]. exists run, result, rest.
  split.
  - exists start, steps, result. auto.
  - split; [exact Hlast|]. split; [exact Hrest|].
    exists prefix, result, rest_tail. auto.
Qed.

Lemma false_minimum_exists a tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  exists n, measure_possible a tr n.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse; destruct (counterexample_exists a tr Hne Hfalse) as [history Hce].
  exists (sequence_measure history), history; auto.
Qed.

(** Non-box counterexamples have exactly one component, so their minimum is
    the length of that trace. Suffix descent will use this simple case. *)
Lemma nonbox_minimum a tr :
  (forall p b, a <> Box p b) -> tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  minimum_counterexample a tr = length tr.
Proof.
  intros Hshape Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec a tr (false_minimum_exists a tr Hne Hfalse)) as [Hmin Hleast].
  destruct Hmin as [history [Hce Hmeasure]].
  destruct a; cbn [counterexample] in Hce; try (destruct Hce as [_ ->]; cbn in Hmeasure; lia).
  exfalso; eapply Hshape; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma test_execution prefix s guard run :
  execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Test guard) run <->
  formula_holds M guard [s;s] /\ run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]].
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [start [steps [result [[initial [Heq Hg]] [_ [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
    inversion Heq; subst start steps. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    split; [exact Hg|]. rewrite Hrun; reflexivity.
  - intros [Hg Hrun]. exists s, [s], ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]).
    split; [exists s; auto|]. split; [discriminate|].
    split; [apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hrun].
Qed.

(** In this helper, "atomic" means a uniquely specified one-step history
    under condition [G]. It applies to tests; arbitrary nondeterministic
    atomic programs use [atomic_minimum_successor] below instead. *)
Lemma atomic_counterexample p tr next (G : Prop) body history :
  (forall run, execution_sequence tr p run <-> G /\ run = [tr;next]) ->
  (counterexample (Box p body) tr history <->
    G /\ exists rest, counterexample body next rest /\ history = tr :: rest).
Proof.
  intro Hstep; cbn [counterexample]; split.
  - intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hce Ho]]]]]].
    apply Hstep in Hrun as [HG ->]. cbn in Hlast; subst final.
    destruct (counterexample_head _ _ _ Hce) as [tail Hrest].
    split; [exact HG|]. exists rest; split; [exact Hce|].
    rewrite Hrest in Ho. change (overlap_list ([tr] ++ [next]) (next :: tail) history) in Ho.
    apply overlap_list_snoc in Ho as [_ ->]. now rewrite Hrest.
  - intros [HG [rest [Hce ->]]].
    exists [tr;next], next, rest; split; [apply Hstep; auto|].
    split; [reflexivity|]. split; [exact Hce|].
    destruct (counterexample_head _ _ _ Hce) as [tail ->].
    exists [tr], next, tail; auto.
Qed.

(** Factor the unique-step case once. A box counterexample contributes
    [length tr] plus the body's counterexample measure at [next]. To prove
    equality of minima, compare an attained source minimum with an attained
    body minimum in both directions; an upper bound alone would not suffice. *)
Lemma atomic_minimum p tr next (G : Prop) body :
  tr <> [] -> next <> [] ->
  (forall run, execution_sequence tr p run <-> G /\ run = [tr;next]) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box p body) tr ->
  G /\ ~ formula_holds M body next /\
  minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr = length tr + minimum_counterexample body next.
Proof.
  intros Htr Hnext Hstep Hfalse.
  pose proof (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Htr Hfalse)) as [Hsource Hsource_least].
  destruct Hsource as [source_history [Hce Hmeasure]].
  apply (atomic_counterexample p tr next G body source_history Hstep) in Hce as [HG [rest [Hrest ->]]].
  pose proof (counterexample_false body next rest Hnext Hrest) as Hbad.
  pose proof (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hnext Hbad)) as [Htarget Htarget_least].
  destruct Htarget as [target_history [Htarget Htarget_measure]].
  split; [exact HG|]; split; [exact Hbad|].
  assert (minimum_counterexample body next <= sequence_measure rest) as Hlower.
  { apply Htarget_least; exists rest; auto. }
  assert (minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr <= length tr + minimum_counterexample body next) as Hupper.
  { apply Hsource_least; exists (tr :: target_history); split.
    - apply (atomic_counterexample p tr next G body _ Hstep); eauto.
    - change (length tr + sequence_measure target_history = length tr + minimum_counterexample body next). now rewrite Htarget_measure. }
  change (length tr + sequence_measure rest = minimum_counterexample (Box p body) tr) in Hmeasure. lia.
Qed.

Lemma test_decrease prefix s guard body :
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Test guard) body) (prefix ++ [s]) ->
  minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]) <
  minimum_counterexample (Box (Test guard) body) (prefix ++ [s]).
Proof.
  intro Hfalse.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Htr by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s] <> []) as Hnext
    by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (atomic_minimum (Test guard) (prefix ++ [s]) ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s])
    (formula_holds M guard [s;s]) body Htr Hnext (test_execution prefix s guard) Hfalse) as [_ [_ Hrank]].
  destruct prefix; cbn in *; lia.
Qed.

(** Regrouping sequence executions preserves the entire accumulated history.
    The shared middle trace is overlapped once, so nesting two boxes neither
    duplicates that history component nor changes its summed measure. *)
Lemma execution_history_concat tr first second :
  overlap_list (execution_history tr first) (execution_history (tr ++ first) second)
    (execution_history tr (first ++ second)).
Proof.
  revert tr; induction first as [|s first IH]; intro tr.
  - cbn [app execution_history]. rewrite app_nil_r.
    apply overlap_list_singleton. destruct second; eexists; split; reflexivity.
  - change (overlap_list
      (tr :: execution_history (tr ++ [s]) first)
      (execution_history (tr ++ s :: first) second)
      (tr :: execution_history (tr ++ [s]) (first ++ second))).
    apply overlap_list_cons.
    + destruct first; discriminate.
    + eexists; split; [reflexivity|].
      replace (tr ++ s :: first) with ((tr ++ [s]) ++ first) by (rewrite <- app_assoc; reflexivity).
      exact (IH (tr ++ [s])).
Qed.

Lemma execution_sequence_seq tr a b run : execution_sequence tr (Seq a b) run ->
  exists first middle second,
    execution_sequence tr a first /\ last first [] = middle /\
    execution_sequence middle b second /\ overlap_list first second run.
Proof.
  intros [start [steps [result [Hprogram [Hsteps [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
  destruct Hprogram as [execA [execB [Ha [Hb Hexec]]]].
  assert (exists middle, overlap_list tr execA middle /\ overlap_list middle execB result) as Hmiddle.
  { apply overlap_list_assoc. exists (start :: steps); auto. }
  destruct Hmiddle as [middle [HoA HoB]].
  pose proof (program_length M a execA Ha) as HlenA.
  pose proof (program_length M b execB Hb) as HlenB.
  pose proof (overlap_list_append _ _ _ HoA) as Hmiddle_eq.
  pose proof (overlap_list_append _ _ _ Hexec) as Hexec_eq.
  destruct execA as [|startA tailA]; cbn in HlenA; [lia|].
  destruct execB as [|startB tailB]; cbn in HlenB; [lia|].
  assert (tailA <> []) as HtailA by (intro H; subst; cbn in HlenA; lia).
  assert (tailB <> []) as HtailB by (intro H; subst; cbn in HlenB; lia).
  cbn in Hmiddle_eq, Hexec_eq. inversion Hexec_eq; subst start steps.
  exists (execution_history tr tailA), middle, (execution_history middle tailB).
  split; [exists startA, tailA, middle; auto|].
  split; [rewrite execution_history_last; symmetry; exact Hmiddle_eq|].
  split; [exists startB, tailB, result; auto|].
  rewrite Hrun, Hmiddle_eq. apply execution_history_concat.
Qed.

Lemma counterexample_sequence tr a b body history :
  counterexample (Box (Seq a b) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box a (Box b body)) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample].
  intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct (execution_sequence_seq tr a b run Hrun) as [first [middle [second [Ha [Hmiddle [Hb Hjoin]]]]]].
  assert (last second [] = final) as Hlast.
  { transitivity (last run []); [symmetry; exact (overlap_list_last _ _ _ [] Hjoin)|exact Hfinal]. }
  assert (exists combined, overlap_list second rest combined /\ overlap_list first combined history) as Hcombined.
  { apply overlap_list_assoc. exists run; auto. }
  destruct Hcombined as [combined [Hsecond Hfirst]].
  exists first, middle, combined; split; [exact Ha|]. split; [exact Hmiddle|].
  split; [exists second, final, rest; auto|exact Hfirst].
Qed.

(** A measure-preserving map of counterexample witnesses gives nonincrease
    of minima: transport an attained source minimum, then bound the target
    minimum by that particular witness. *)
Lemma minimum_transport a b tr : tr <> [] -> ~ formula_holds M a tr ->
  (forall history, counterexample a tr history -> counterexample b tr history) ->
  ~ formula_holds M b tr /\ minimum_counterexample b tr <= minimum_counterexample a tr.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse Hmap.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply Hmap in Hce. pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hce) as Hbad.
  split; [exact Hbad|].
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hbad)) as [_ Hmin].
  apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sequence_nonincrease tr a b body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Seq a b) body) tr ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box a (Box b body)) tr /\
  minimum_counterexample (Box a (Box b body)) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Seq a b) body) tr.
Proof. intros Hne Hfalse; eapply minimum_transport; eauto using counterexample_sequence. Qed.

Lemma counterexample_choice tr a b body history :
  counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box a body) tr history \/ counterexample (Box b body) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample]; intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [steps [result [[Ha|Hb] [Hsteps [Hover Hhistory]]]]]];
    [left|right]; exists run, final, rest; split;
    try (exists s, steps, result; auto); auto.
Qed.

(** Choose a branch from a minimum source counterexample. Picking merely any
    false branch could give a larger minimum. Rules.v uses this joint result
    (branch falsity and its rank bound) to select one premise for an edge. *)
Lemma choice_nonincrease tr a b body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Choice a b) body) tr ->
  (~ formula_holds M (Box a body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box a body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr) \/
  (~ formula_holds M (Box b body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box b body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Choice a b) body) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply counterexample_choice in Hce as [Ha|Hb]; [left|right].
  - pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Ha) as HbadA; split; [exact HbadA|].
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne HbadA)) as [_ Hmin].
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
  - pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hb) as HbadB; split; [exact HbadB|].
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne HbadB)) as [_ Hmin].
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

(** Split the finite iteration count into zero and successor cases. Zero
    becomes [Test Truth]; a successor becomes one body execution followed by
    the remaining star. Unfolding itself claims no strict progress. *)
Lemma counterexample_star tr a body history :
  counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr history ->
  counterexample (Box (Test Truth) body) tr history \/
  counterexample (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr history.
Proof.
  cbn [counterexample]; intros [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hlast [Hrest Ho]]]]]].
  destruct Hrun as [s [steps [result [[n Hn] [Hsteps [Hover Hhistory]]]]]].
  destruct n.
  - left; exists run, final, rest; split; [|auto].
    exists s, steps, result; split; [|auto].
    destruct Hn as [start Htrace]. exists start; split; [exact Htrace|exact I].
  - right. apply counterexample_sequence. cbn [counterexample].
    exists run, final, rest; split; [|auto].
    exists s, steps, result; split; [|auto].
    destruct Hn as [first [second [Ha [Hn Hex]]]].
    exists first, second; split; [exact Ha|]. split; [exists n; exact Hn|exact Hex].
Qed.

Lemma star_nonincrease tr a body : tr <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Star a) body) tr ->
  (~ formula_holds M (Box (Test Truth) body) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box (Test Truth) body) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr) \/
  (~ formula_holds M (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr /\
    minimum_counterexample (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr <= minimum_counterexample (Box (Star a) body) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hfalse.
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] _].
  apply counterexample_star in Hce as [Hce|Hce]; [left|right];
    pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hne Hce) as Hbad;
    split; [exact Hbad| |exact Hbad|];
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hne Hbad)) as [_ Hmin];
    apply Hmin; exists history; auto.
Qed.

(** Continuing suffix obligations are non-box formulas. Both false ranks
    therefore equal their trace lengths, and removing one head state is a
    strict decrease. The caller must prove that the continuation is actually
    present and false on the chosen premise; the first suffix-right branch
    has no such recursive continuation. *)
Lemma suffix_decrease s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Suffix a b) (s :: tail) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (Suffix a b) tail ->
  minimum_counterexample (Suffix a b) tail < minimum_counterexample (Suffix a b) (s :: tail).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hwhole Htail. rewrite !nonbox_minimum; try assumption; try discriminate.
  cbn; lia.
Qed.

Lemma dual_suffix_decrease s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  ~ formula_holds M (DualSuffix a b) (s :: tail) ->
  ~ formula_holds M (DualSuffix a b) tail ->
  minimum_counterexample (DualSuffix a b) tail < minimum_counterexample (DualSuffix a b) (s :: tail).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hwhole Htail. rewrite !nonbox_minimum; try assumption; try discriminate.
  cbn; lia.
Qed.

(** Equal sets of attainable measures have equal minima, including the
    empty-set fallback. This compares measures only; histories themselves
    need not have equal syntax or equal state lists. *)
Lemma minimum_extensional a tr b tr' :
  (forall n, measure_possible a tr n <-> measure_possible b tr' n) ->
  minimum_counterexample a tr = minimum_counterexample b tr'.
Proof.
  intro Heq; destruct (classic (exists n, measure_possible a tr n)) as [Ha|Ha].
  - assert (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n) as Hb by (destruct Ha as [n Hn]; exists n; apply Heq; exact Hn).
    destruct (minimum_spec _ _ Ha) as [Hmina Hlea]. destruct (minimum_spec _ _ Hb) as [Hminb Hleb].
    specialize (Hlea _ (proj2 (Heq _) Hminb)); specialize (Hleb _ (proj1 (Heq _) Hmina)); lia.
  - assert (~ (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n)) as Hb by
      (intros [n Hn]; apply Ha; exists n; apply Heq; exact Hn).
    unfold minimum_counterexample; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible a tr n));
