      [contradiction|]; destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists n, measure_possible b tr' n));
      [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

(** Each atomic action contributes one new state; all possible
    successors remain available in the relational model. *)
Lemma atomic_execution prefix s action payload run :
  execution_sequence (prefix ++ [s]) (Atomic action payload) run <->
  exists next, interpret_action M action payload s next /\
    run = [prefix ++ [s]; (prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]].
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [start [steps [result [Hp [_ [Ho Hrun]]]]]].
    cbn [program_holds] in Hp; apply atomic_trace_law in Hp.
    destruct Hp as [initial [next [Heq Hstep]]].
    inversion Heq; subst start steps. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    exists next; split; [exact Hstep|]. rewrite Hrun; reflexivity.
  - intros [next [Hstep Hrun]].
    exists s, [next], ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]); split.
    + cbn [program_holds]; apply atomic_trace_law; exists s, next; auto.
    + split; [discriminate|]. split; [apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hrun].
Qed.

(** A minimizing source counterexample selects ONE successor. Picking an
    unrelated successor would not establish this inequality. *)
Lemma atomic_minimum_successor prefix s action payload body :
  ~ formula_holds M (Box (Atomic action payload) body) (prefix ++ [s]) ->
  exists next, interpret_action M action payload s next /\
    ~ formula_holds M body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]) /\
    minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]) <
    minimum_counterexample (Box (Atomic action payload) body) (prefix ++ [s]).
Proof.
  intro Hfalse.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Htr by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Htr Hfalse)) as [[history [Hce Hmeasure]] Hleast].
  cbn [counterexample] in Hce.
  destruct Hce as [run [final [rest [Hrun [Hfinal [Hrest Hjoin]]]]]].
  apply atomic_execution in Hrun as [next [Hstep ->]].
  cbn in Hfinal; subst final.
  assert ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next] <> []) as Hnext by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  pose proof (counterexample_false _ _ _ Hnext Hrest) as Hbad.
  destruct (counterexample_head _ _ _ Hrest) as [tail Hhead].
  rewrite Hhead in Hjoin.
  change (overlap_list ([prefix ++ [s]] ++ [(prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]])
    (((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]) :: tail) history) in Hjoin.
  apply overlap_list_snoc in Hjoin as [_ Hhistory].
  assert (history = (prefix ++ [s]) :: rest) as ->.
  { rewrite Hhead, Hhistory; reflexivity. }
  (* The attained source measure is [length current + measure rest]. The
     body's minimum is at most [measure rest], and the current trace is
     nonempty, so removing that component gives a strict decrease. *)
  destruct (minimum_spec _ _ (false_minimum_exists _ _ Hnext Hbad)) as [_ Htarget].
  assert (minimum_counterexample body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]) <= sequence_measure rest) as Hbound.
  { apply Htarget; exists rest; auto. }
  exists next; split; [exact Hstep|]. split; [exact Hbad|].
  change (length (prefix ++ [s]) + sequence_measure rest =
    minimum_counterexample (Box (Atomic action payload) body) (prefix ++ [s])) in Hmeasure.
  rewrite length_app in Hmeasure; cbn in Hmeasure; lia.
Qed.

(** Tags identify occurrences; the occurrence's formula and interpreted
    label determine its rank. Renaming the tag alone cannot change it. *)
Definition occurrence_rank (o : occurrence) (w : world M) :=
  minimum_counterexample o.(occurrence_formula) (eval_label M w o.(occurrence_label)).

(** Look up the first matching tag, falling back to 0 if absent. The syntax
    checker enforces uniqueness on well-formed succedents, and Rules.v proves
    that lookup then equals the rank of the intended occurrence. *)
Fixpoint rank_in_context (context : list occurrence) (w : world M) (tag : nat) : nat :=
  match context with
  | [] => 0
  | o :: rest =>
      match o.(occurrence_tag) with
      | Some t => if Nat.eqb tag t then occurrence_rank o w else rank_in_context rest w tag
      | None => rank_in_context rest w tag
      end
  end.

(** Syntactic label substitution and its matching environment transformation
    produce identical interpreted traces, hence identical occurrence ranks.
    This is the rank half of the substitution rules in Rules.v. *)
Lemma rank_label_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label M w (f l) = eval_label M w' l) -> forall context tag,
  rank_in_context (map (map_label_occurrence f) context) w tag = rank_in_context context w' tag.
Proof.
  intros Hmap context; induction context as [|o rest IH]; intro tag; cbn [map rank_in_context map_label_occurrence occurrence_tag].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (occurrence_tag o) as [t|]; [destruct (Nat.eqb tag t)|]; try apply IH.
    unfold occurrence_rank; cbn [map_label_occurrence occurrence_label occurrence_formula]; now rewrite Hmap.
Qed.

(** Only succedent occurrences are trace elements. Missing tags have rank 0.
    True formulas have no counterexamples and receive the documented fallback
    0. False admissible formulas have the minimum specified above. *)
Module LPLTheory <: Framework.THEORY.
  Definition World := world M.
  Definition Judgment := judgment.
  Definition Sequent := World -> Prop.
  Definition judgment_eqb := Syn.judgment_eqb.
  Definition backlink_eqb := Syn.backlink_eqb.
  Definition denote := Sem.denote M.
  Definition tags := judgment_tags.
  Definition rank j w tag := rank_in_context j.(succedent) w tag.
End LPLTheory.

Module Cyclic := Framework.Make LPLTheory.

End ForModel.
Module Type MODEL (I : Sem.INTERPRETATION).
  Include ForModel I.
End MODEL.
End MakeProgress.
Module Type PROGRESS (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn).
  Include MakeProgress L Syn Sem.
End PROGRESS.
RuleGeneration.v:
(** * Verified generation of one local inference

    This is the executable front end to Rules.v, not a proof-search driver.
    [generate_axiom] recognizes structural closing shapes; [generate_rules_in_context]
    scans eligible occurrences; [generate_requested_in_context] checks explicit caller
    choices. Successful results already contain semantic soundness proofs.

    To read the dense constructor cases, compare a rule's literal source and
    ordered target lists with RULE_EXPANSIONS.md and its kernel in Rules.v.
    [verified_build] supplies syntax evidence, then [ensure_rule] checks that
    the result really belongs to the caller's requested judgment. A [None]
    result means no verified candidate was generated, not semantic falsity. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith String Lia Permutation.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics Progress Rules.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Module MakeRuleGeneration (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn)
  (Pr : PROGRESS L Syn Sem) (Kernel : KERNEL L Syn Sem Pr).
(** Reuse the same instantiated kernel as Certification.v. Applying the
    syntax/rule functors again would create distinct inductive types, even
    with the same signature and model; aliases preserve their identity. *)
Export Syn Sem.
Module Export P := Kernel.P.
Module Export K := Kernel.

(** Dependent Boolean branching turns a successful computation into evidence
    available to the constructor. The false branch cannot construct a rule
    requiring that side condition, and therefore returns [None]. *)
Definition guard (b : bool) (build : b = true -> option Cyclic.rule_instance)
    : option Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof. destruct b eqn:H; [exact (build eq_refl)|exact None]. Defined.

(** Check every premise as well as the source. The resulting [Forall] proof
    is passed to an already proved kernel, never accepted as an axiom. *)
Definition verified_build source targets
    (build : judgment_wfb source = true -> Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) targets -> Cyclic.rule_instance)
    : option Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  destruct (judgment_wfb source) eqn:Hs; [|exact None].
  destruct (forallb judgment_wfb targets) eqn:Ht; [|exact None].
  apply Some, (build eq_refl). apply Forall_forall; intros j Hin; apply (proj1 (forallb_forall _ _) Ht j Hin).
Defined.

(** Semantic rule records alone do not enforce the object-language policy.
    This final boundary also checks trace-pair endpoints and that progressing
    pairs belong to the valid pairs, using the unchanged framework's checker. *)
Definition rule_wfb r := judgment_wfb r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) &&
  forallb (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) &&
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge))
    r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).

Definition ensure_rule j candidate :=
  match candidate with
  | None => None
  | Some r => if judgment_eqb r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) j && rule_wfb r then Some r else None
  end.

Theorem ensure_rule_spec j candidate r : ensure_rule j candidate = Some r ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof.
  unfold ensure_rule; destruct candidate as [r'|]; [|discriminate].
  destruct (judgment_eqb r'.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) j && rule_wfb r') eqn:Hcheck; [|discriminate].
  intro Heq; inversion Heq; subst r'. apply andb_true_iff in Hcheck as [Hconclusion Hwf].
  apply judgment_eqb_spec in Hconclusion. split; [exact Hconclusion|].
  unfold rule_wfb in Hwf; apply andb_true_iff in Hwf as [Hs Hps].
  rewrite Hconclusion in *; split; [exact Hs|]. apply Forall_forall; intros p Hin.
  apply andb_true_iff. exact (proj1 (forallb_forall _ _) Hps p Hin).
Qed.

(** New subformulas receive deterministic fresh tags only when traceable.
    An unfolding may instead continue the principal's existing tag. Distinct
    offsets separate new siblings when both appear in the same premise;
    [rule_wfb] remains the final uniqueness check. *)
Definition tag_for j offset a := if traceableb a then Some (fresh_name (judgment_tags j) + offset) else None.
Definition continue_tag (tag : option nat) a := if traceableb a then tag else None.


(** Generate at one selected right occurrence. [pre]/[post] preserve the
    surrounding context. Inner label matches are intentional: atomic-action
    and test rules require an exposed final state, whereas temporal rules require
    an exposed initial state. Callers can request explicit label algebra to
    present these shapes; no normalization is attempted here. *)
Section RelationContext.
Context (R : list relation_atom).
Local Notation Jdg := (Rdg R).
(** The local aliases fix [R] for ordinary logical rules. Atomic rules and
    relational structural rules are called with explicit contexts because
    their premise may add, remove or duplicate a relation. *)
Local Notation atom_head_left := (K.atom_head_left R).

Local Notation weakening_right := (K.weakening_right R).

(** Finite local action-rule candidates. No action relation is evaluated.
    The eigenvariable candidates take an explicit fresh number [y]; the
    ordinary scan below chooses it with [fresh_name]. Use-candidates take a
    relation position instead, so no semantic successor search is involved. *)
Definition atomic_boxright_candidate lhs pre o post y :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula), o.(occurrence_label) with
  | Box (Atomic action payload) body, Join sigma (StateLabel u) =>
    let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in let tb := continue_tag ta body in
    let source := right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Atomic action payload) body) ta) in
    guard (world_freshb y source) (fun Hfresh =>
      verified_build source
        [Rdg (R ++ [action_relation action payload u (L.world_name y)]) lhs
          (pre ++ Occ (action_label sigma u (L.world_name y)) body tb :: post)]
        (fun Hs Ht => box_atomic_right R lhs pre post sigma u action payload body y ta tb Hs (Forall_inv Ht) Hfresh))
  | _, _ => None end.
Definition atomic_diamondleft_candidate pre o post rhs y :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula), o.(occurrence_label) with
  | Diamond (Atomic action payload) body, Join sigma (StateLabel u) =>
    let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
    let source := left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Atomic action payload) body) ta) in
    guard (world_freshb y source) (fun Hfresh =>
      verified_build source
        [Rdg (R ++ [action_relation action payload u (L.world_name y)])
          (pre ++ Occ (action_label sigma u (L.world_name y)) body None :: post) rhs]
        (fun Hs Ht => diamond_atomic_left R pre post rhs sigma u action payload body y ta None Hs (Forall_inv Ht) Hfresh))
  | _, _ => None end.
(** The relation pattern extracts a potential target world term [v]. It
    reconstructs the required action, payload and source from the principal;
    [ensure_rule] later compares that entire conclusion with the input. Thus
    an unrelated relation with the same target shape is still rejected. *)
Definition atomic_boxleft_candidate Rpre relation Rpost pre o post rhs :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula), o.(occurrence_label), relation with
  | Box (Atomic action payload) body, Join sigma (StateLabel u), ActionRelation _ _ _ (StateLabel v) =>
    verified_build
      (Rdg (Rpre ++ action_relation action payload u v :: Rpost) (pre ++ Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Atomic action payload) body) o.(occurrence_tag) :: post) rhs)
      [Rdg (Rpre ++ Rpost) (pre ++ Occ (action_label sigma u v) body None :: post) rhs]
      (fun Hs Ht => box_atomic_left Rpre Rpost pre post rhs sigma u v action payload body o.(occurrence_tag) None Hs (Forall_inv Ht))
  | _, _, _ => None end.
Definition atomic_diamondright_candidate Rpre relation Rpost lhs pre o post :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula), o.(occurrence_label), relation with
  | Diamond (Atomic action payload) body, Join sigma (StateLabel u), ActionRelation _ _ _ (StateLabel v) =>
    let tb := tag_for (Rdg R lhs (pre ++ o :: post)) 0 body in
    verified_build
      (Rdg (Rpre ++ action_relation action payload u v :: Rpost) lhs (pre ++ Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Atomic action payload) body) o.(occurrence_tag) :: post))
      [Rdg (Rpre ++ Rpost) lhs (pre ++ Occ (action_label sigma u v) body tb :: post)]
      (fun Hs Ht => diamond_atomic_right Rpre Rpost lhs pre post sigma u v action payload body o.(occurrence_tag) tb Hs (Forall_inv Ht))
  | _, _, _ => None end.
(** Preserve the exact relation position using a prefix and suffix, just as
    the occurrence scan does for formula contexts. Candidates may fail;
    [accepted_rules] later removes failed or mismatched constructions. *)
Fixpoint scan_relations pre rest
    (build : list relation_atom -> relation_atom -> list relation_atom -> option Cyclic.rule_instance) :=
  match rest with
  | [] => []
  | relation :: post => build pre relation post :: scan_relations (pre ++ [relation]) post build
  end.

(** Each branch lists complete local alternatives, not subsequent search
    steps. In [right_targets], [[o1];[o2]] builds two premises, whereas
    [[o1;o2]] builds one premise with two succedent alternatives. *)
Definition right_at (lhs pre : list occurrence) (o : occurrence) (post : list occurrence) : list (option Cyclic.rule_instance) :=
  let j := right_conclusion lhs pre post o in
  let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
  let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | Conj a b => let tb := tag_for j 0 a in let tc := tag_for j 1 b in
    [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Conj a b) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l a tb];[Occ l b tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => conjunction_right lhs pre post l a b ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
  | Disj a b => let tb := tag_for j 0 a in let tc := tag_for j 1 b in
    [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Disj a b) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l a tb;Occ l b tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => disjunction_right lhs pre post l a b ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
  | Neg a => [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Neg a) ta))
      ([Jdg (lhs ++ [Occ l a None]) (pre ++ post)]) (fun Hs Ht => negation_right lhs pre post l a ta None Hs Ht)]
  | Impl a b => let tc := tag_for j 0 b in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Impl a b) ta))
      ([Jdg (lhs ++ [Occ l a None]) (pre ++ Occ l b tc :: post)]) (fun Hs Ht => implication_right lhs pre post l a b ta None tc Hs Ht)]
  | Box p body => match p with
    | Seq a b => let tb := continue_tag ta (Box a (Box b body)) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Box (Seq a b) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Box a (Box b body)) tb]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_sequence_right lhs pre post l a b body ta tb Hs Ht)]
    | Choice a b => let tb := continue_tag ta (Box a body) in let tc := continue_tag ta (Box b body) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Box (Choice a b) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Box a body) tb];[Occ l (Box b body) tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_choice_right lhs pre post l a b body ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
    | Star a => let tb := continue_tag ta (Box (Test Truth) body) in let tc := continue_tag ta (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Box (Star a) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Box (Test Truth) body) tb];[Occ l (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_star_right lhs pre post l a body ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
    | Atomic _ _ => [atomic_boxright_candidate lhs pre o post (fresh_name (judgment_world_names j))]
    | Test guard => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) => let tb := continue_tag ta body in
        [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Test guard) body) ta))
        [Jdg (lhs ++ [Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard None]) (pre ++ Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body tb :: post)]
        (fun Hs Ht => box_test_right lhs pre post sigma u guard body ta tb Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    end
  | Diamond p body => match p with
    | Seq a b => let tb := tag_for j 0 (Diamond a (Diamond b body)) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Diamond (Seq a b) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Diamond a (Diamond b body)) tb]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_sequence_right lhs pre post l a b body ta tb Hs Ht)]
    | Choice a b => let tb := tag_for j 0 (Diamond a body) in let tc := tag_for j 1 (Diamond b body) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Diamond (Choice a b) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Diamond a body) tb;Occ l (Diamond b body) tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_choice_right lhs pre post l a b body ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
    | Star a => let tb := tag_for j 0 (Diamond (Test Truth) body) in let tc := tag_for j 1 (Diamond a (Diamond (Star a) body)) in [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Diamond (Star a) body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l (Diamond (Test Truth) body) tb;Occ l (Diamond a (Diamond (Star a) body)) tc]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_star_right lhs pre post l a body ta tb tc Hs Ht)]
    | Atomic _ _ => scan_relations [] R (fun rp rel rq => atomic_diamondright_candidate rp rel rq lhs pre o post)
    | Test guard => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) => let tb := tag_for j 0 body in
        (* This scheme consumes a guard at the final antecedent position.
           Reconstructing that occurrence is safe because [ensure_rule]
           accepts only an exact match with the original judgment. *)
        let gamma := firstn (Nat.pred (List.length lhs)) lhs in
        [verified_build (right_conclusion (gamma ++ [Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard None]) pre post
          (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Test guard) body) ta))
          [Jdg gamma (pre ++ Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body tb :: post)]
          (fun Hs Ht => diamond_test_right gamma pre post sigma u guard body ta tb Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    end
  | First body => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => let tb := tag_for j 0 body in
      [verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First body) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ (StateLabel u) body tb]]) (fun Hs Ht => first_right lhs pre post u sigma body ta tb Hs Ht)]
    | _ => [] end
  | Suffix a b => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => let tb := tag_for j 0 b in let tc := tag_for j 1 a in let td := ta in
      [guard (label_nonemptyb sigma) (fun Htail => verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ sigma b tb; Occ sigma a tc];[Occ sigma b tb; Occ sigma (Suffix a b) td]]) (fun Hs Ht => suffix_right lhs pre post u sigma a b ta tb tc td Htail Hs Ht))]
    | _ => [] end
  | DualSuffix a b => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => let tb := tag_for j 0 b in let tc := tag_for j 1 a in let td := ta in
      [guard (label_nonemptyb sigma) (fun Htail => verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b) ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ sigma b tb];[Occ sigma a tc; Occ sigma (DualSuffix a b) td]]) (fun Hs Ht => dual_suffix_right lhs pre post u sigma a b ta tb tc td Htail Hs Ht))]
    | _ => [] end
  | a => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => [guard (atomb a) (fun Ha => verified_build (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a ta)) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ (StateLabel u) a None]]) (fun Hs Ht => atom_head_right lhs pre post u sigma a ta None Hs Ht Ha))]
    | _ => [] end
  end.

(** Left generation mirrors the same catalog, including its two-premise
    box-choice/star rules. A few test schemes consume a separately positioned
    guard occurrence; [ensure_rule] checks the reconstructed source exactly,
    preventing a near match from silently changing the caller's context. *)
Definition left_at (pre : list occurrence) (o : occurrence) (post rhs : list occurrence) : list (option Cyclic.rule_instance) :=
  let j := left_conclusion pre post rhs o in
  let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
  let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | Conj a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Conj a b) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l a None;Occ l b None]]) (fun Hs Ht => conjunction_left pre post rhs l a b ta None None Hs Ht)]
  | Disj a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Disj a b) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l a None];[Occ l b None]]) (fun Hs Ht => disjunction_left pre post rhs l a b ta None None Hs Ht)]
  | Neg a => let tb := tag_for j 0 a in
    [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Neg a) ta)) ([Jdg (pre ++ post) (Occ l a tb :: rhs)]) (fun Hs Ht => negation_left pre post rhs l a ta tb Hs Ht)]
  | Impl a b => let tb := tag_for j 0 a in
    [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Impl a b) ta)) ([Jdg (pre ++ post) (Occ l a tb :: rhs);Jdg (pre ++ Occ l b None :: post) rhs]) (fun Hs Ht => implication_left pre post rhs l a b ta tb None Hs Ht)]
  | Box p body => match p with
    | Seq a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Box (Seq a b) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Box a (Box b body)) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_sequence_left pre post rhs l a b body ta None Hs Ht)]
    | Choice a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Box (Choice a b) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Box a body) None];[Occ l (Box b body) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_choice_left pre post rhs l a b body ta None None Hs Ht)]
    | Star a => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Box (Star a) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Box (Test Truth) body) None];[Occ l (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => box_star_left pre post rhs l a body ta None None Hs Ht)]
    | Atomic _ _ => scan_relations [] R (fun rp rel rq => atomic_boxleft_candidate rp rel rq pre o post rhs)
    | Test guard => match l, post with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u), _ :: rest =>
        [verified_build (Jdg (pre ++ Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Test guard) body) ta :: Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard None :: rest) rhs)
          [Jdg (pre ++ Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body None :: rest) rhs]
          (fun Hs Ht => box_test_left pre rest rhs sigma u guard body ta None Hs Ht)]
      | _, _ => [] end
    end
  | Diamond p body => match p with
    | Seq a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Diamond (Seq a b) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Diamond a (Diamond b body)) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_sequence_left pre post rhs l a b body ta None Hs Ht)]
    | Choice a b => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Diamond (Choice a b) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Diamond a body) None];[Occ l (Diamond b body) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_choice_left pre post rhs l a b body ta None None Hs Ht)]
    | Star a => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Diamond (Star a) body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l (Diamond (Test Truth) body) None];[Occ l (Diamond a (Diamond (Star a) body)) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => diamond_star_left pre post rhs l a body ta None None Hs Ht)]
    | Atomic _ _ => [atomic_diamondleft_candidate pre o post rhs (fresh_name (judgment_world_names j))]
    | Test guard => match l with
      | Join sigma (StateLabel u) =>
        [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Test guard) body) ta))
          [Jdg (pre ++ Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body None :: Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard None :: post) rhs]
          (fun Hs Ht => diamond_test_left pre post rhs sigma u guard body ta None Hs Ht)]
      | _ => [] end
    end
  | First body => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => [verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First body) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ (StateLabel u) body None]]) (fun Hs Ht => first_left pre post rhs u sigma body ta None Hs Ht)]
    | _ => [] end
  | Suffix a b => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => [guard (label_nonemptyb sigma) (fun Htail => verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ sigma b None];[Occ sigma a None;Occ sigma (Suffix a b) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => suffix_left pre post rhs u sigma a b ta None None None Htail Hs Ht))]
    | _ => [] end
  | DualSuffix a b => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => [guard (label_nonemptyb sigma) (fun Htail => verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b) ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ sigma b None;Occ sigma a None];[Occ sigma b None;Occ sigma (DualSuffix a b) None]]) (fun Hs Ht => dual_suffix_left pre post rhs u sigma a b ta None None None Htail Hs Ht))]
    | _ => [] end
  | a => match l with
    | Join (StateLabel u) sigma => [guard (atomb a) (fun Ha => verified_build (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) a ta)) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ (StateLabel u) a None]]) (fun Hs Ht => atom_head_left pre post rhs u sigma a ta None Hs Ht Ha))]
    | _ => [] end
  end.

(** FOPL uses these restricted dispatchers to reuse the common cases while
    supplying its own assignment/binder handling. Only the generic atomic
    modality cases are excluded here; the full PPL scan uses [left_at] and
    [right_at] directly. *)
Definition right_regular_at lhs pre o post :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | Box (Atomic _ _) _ | Diamond (Atomic _ _) _ => []
  | _ => right_at lhs pre o post end.
Definition left_regular_at pre o post rhs :=
  match o.(occurrence_formula) with
  | Box (Atomic _ _) _ | Diamond (Atomic _ _) _ => []
  | _ => left_at pre o post rhs end.

(** Move one occurrence at a time from [rest] into [pre]. This finite scan
    preserves order and covers non-head positions. It enumerates local
    alternatives only; it never recurses into newly generated proof goals. *)
Fixpoint scan_occurrences pre rest
    (build : list occurrence -> occurrence -> list occurrence -> list (option Cyclic.rule_instance)) :=
  match rest with
  | [] => []
  | o :: post => build pre o post ++ scan_occurrences (pre ++ [o]) post build end.
Definition scan_right lhs pre rest := scan_occurrences pre rest (fun p o q => right_at lhs p o q).
Definition scan_left pre rest rhs := scan_occurrences pre rest (fun p o q => left_at p o q rhs).
Fixpoint accepted_rules j candidates :=
  match candidates with
  | [] => []
  | candidate :: rest => match ensure_rule j candidate with
    | Some r => r :: accepted_rules j rest | None => accepted_rules j rest end
  end.
(** The generic scan includes ordinary propositional decomposition, even
    for pure formulas. It has no language-specific quantifier rules or truth
    oracle; the separate FOPL facade imposes its own manual pure boundary. *)
Definition generate_rules_in_context j :=
  accepted_rules j (scan_left [] j.(antecedent) j.(succedent) ++ scan_right j.(antecedent) [] j.(succedent)).

Theorem accepted_rules_spec j candidates r : In r (accepted_rules j candidates) ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof.
  induction candidates as [|candidate rest IH]; cbn; [contradiction|].
  destruct (ensure_rule j candidate) as [r'|] eqn:H; [intros [->|Hin]|intro Hin];
    [eapply ensure_rule_spec; exact H|apply IH; exact Hin|apply IH; exact Hin].
Qed.
(** These guarantees describe successful candidates, not completeness of the
    scan. Semantic soundness is already stored in each returned rule record. *)
Theorem generate_rules_spec j r : In r (generate_rules_in_context j) -> r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof. unfold generate_rules_in_context; apply accepted_rules_spec. Qed.

Definition ensure_axiom j candidate :=
  match candidate with None => None | Some a =>
    if judgment_eqb a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) j then Some a else None end.

(** The axiom scans carry inclusion proofs while traversing a sublist, so a
    discovered matching occurrence comes with its membership in the original
    judgment. Only identity, false-left, truth-right and singleton suffix-left
    are recognized; arbitrary atomic truth needs a caller's shallow proof. *)
Fixpoint identity_scan j (Hwf : judgment_wfb j = true) o (Hl : In o j.(antecedent)) context
    (Hsub : forall r, In r context -> In r j.(succedent)) : option Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  destruct context as [|r rest]; [exact None|].
  destruct (label_eq_dec o.(occurrence_label) r.(occurrence_label)) as [Hlabel|Hlabel].
  - destruct (formula_eq_dec o.(occurrence_formula) r.(occurrence_formula)) as [Hformula|Hformula].
    + exact (Some (identity_axiom j Hwf o r Hl (Hsub r (or_introl eq_refl)) Hlabel Hformula)).
    + exact (identity_scan j Hwf o Hl rest (fun r Hin => Hsub r (or_intror Hin))).
  - exact (identity_scan j Hwf o Hl rest (fun r Hin => Hsub r (or_intror Hin))).
Defined.

Definition first_axiom (a b : option Cyclic.axiom_instance) := match a with Some a => Some a | None => b end.

Fixpoint left_axiom_scan j (Hwf : judgment_wfb j = true) context (Hsub : forall o, In o context -> In o j.(antecedent))
    : option Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  destruct context as [|o rest]; [exact None|].
  refine (first_axiom (identity_scan j Hwf o (Hsub o (or_introl eq_refl)) j.(succedent) (fun r Hin => Hin)) _).
  destruct (formula_eq_dec o.(occurrence_formula) Falsity) as [Hfalse|Hfalse].
  - exact (Some (falsity_left_axiom j Hwf o (Hsub o (or_introl eq_refl)) Hfalse)).
  - destruct (occurrence_formula o) eqn:Hformula.
    all: try (lazymatch type of Hformula with
      | _ = Suffix ?a ?b => destruct (occurrence_label o) eqn:Hlabel;
          try exact (Some (suffix_singleton_axiom j Hwf o u a b (Hsub o (or_introl eq_refl)) Hlabel Hformula))
      end).
    all: exact (left_axiom_scan j Hwf rest (fun o Hin => Hsub o (or_intror Hin))).
Defined.

Fixpoint right_axiom_scan j (Hwf : judgment_wfb j = true) context (Hsub : forall o, In o context -> In o j.(succedent))
    : option Cyclic.axiom_instance.
Proof.
  destruct context as [|o rest]; [exact None|].
  destruct (formula_eq_dec o.(occurrence_formula) Truth) as [Htruth|Htruth].
  - exact (Some (truth_right_axiom j Hwf o (Hsub o (or_introl eq_refl)) Htruth)).
  - exact (right_axiom_scan j Hwf rest (fun o Hin => Hsub o (or_intror Hin))).
Defined.

(** The decision returns the equality proof [Hwf] needed by every axiom
    constructor. Weakening is deliberately absent: it always leaves one
    premise, even when that premise is the empty-context sequent. *)
Definition generate_axiom (j : judgment) : option Cyclic.axiom_instance :=
  match Bool.bool_dec (judgment_wfb j) true with
  | left Hwf => ensure_axiom j (first_axiom (left_axiom_scan j Hwf j.(antecedent) (fun o Hin => Hin))
    (right_axiom_scan j Hwf j.(succedent) (fun o Hin => Hin)))
  | right _ => None end.

Lemma ensure_axiom_spec j candidate a : ensure_axiom j candidate = Some a -> a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) = j.
Proof.
  unfold ensure_axiom; destruct candidate as [a'|]; [|discriminate].
  destruct (judgment_eqb a'.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) j) eqn:Heq; [|discriminate].
  intro H; inversion H; subst; now apply judgment_eqb_spec in Heq.
Qed.
Theorem generate_axiom_spec j a : generate_axiom j = Some a ->
  a.(Cyclic.axiom_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true.
Proof.
  unfold generate_axiom; destruct (Bool.bool_dec (judgment_wfb j) true) as [Hwf|Hwf]; [|discriminate].
  intro H; split; [eapply ensure_axiom_spec; exact H|exact Hwf].
Qed.

Inductive side := OnLeft | OnRight.
(** Requests make caller choices explicit: eigenvariables, substitutions,
    cut partitions, rule names and backlink companions.
    Positions are zero-based. The label-algebra requests also take an explicit
    tree path; supplying an original judgment fixes the intended premise. *)
Inductive rule_request :=
| Local (location : side) (position : nat) (name : string)
| Weaken (location : side) (position : nat)
| SubstituteWorld (original : judgment) (variable : nat) (u : L.world_term)
| SubstituteTrace (original : judgment) (variable : nat) (l : label)
| Cut (gamma sigma delta lambda : list occurrence) (cutformula : occurrence)
| ExchangeAdjacent (location : side) (position : nat)
| BacklinkExact (companion : judgment)
| BacklinkTags (renaming : list (nat * nat)) (companion : judgment)
| RotateLabels (original : judgment) (path : list bool) (rotate_left : bool)
| UnitLabels (original : judgment) (path : list bool) (on_left insert : bool)
| AtomicEigen (location : side) (position successor : nat)
| AtomicUse (location : side) (position relation_index : nat)
| WeakenRelation (position : nat)
| ContractRelation (position : nat)
| ExchangeRelation (position : nat)
| CutRelations (Rgamma Rsigma : list relation_atom)
    (gamma sigma delta lambda : list occurrence) (cutformula : occurrence).

(** Finite tag mappings use the first matching pair and otherwise leave a
    tag unchanged. The generated target's well-formedness rejects collisions;
    [generate_requested_in_context] also checks the entire supplied companion judgment. *)
Fixpoint rename_lookup renaming x :=
  match renaming with [] => x | (a,b)::rest => if Nat.eqb x a then b else rename_lookup rest x end.

(** Return a context split only for an existing zero-based position. [pre]
    has [n] entries, and the suffix skips both those entries and the selected
    occurrence. Out-of-range requests fail with [None]. *)
Definition at_position (context : list occurrence) n :=
  match nth_error context n with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (firstn n context, o, skipn (Datatypes.S n) context)
  end.

(** A [Local] request chooses by the kernel's rule-name string, rather than
    by the candidate's position in a list. The caller still chooses the
    principal occurrence separately with [at_position]. *)
Fixpoint named_candidate name candidates :=
  match candidates with
  | [] => None
  | None :: rest => named_candidate name rest
  | Some r :: rest => if String.eqb name r.(Cyclic.rule_name) then Some r else named_candidate name rest
  end.

(** Recover the exact context split, then dispatch local, weakening or
    adjacent-exchange requests. Language-specific term instantiation belongs
    to an instance's request layer, not this generic dispatcher. *)
Definition requested_at j location n request :=
  let context := match location with OnLeft => j.(antecedent) | OnRight => j.(succedent) end in
  match at_position context n with
  | None => None
  | Some (pre,o,post) =>
    let l := o.(occurrence_label) in
    let ta := o.(occurrence_tag) in
    match request, location, o.(occurrence_formula) with
    | Local _ _ name, OnLeft, _ => named_candidate name (left_at pre o post j.(succedent))
    | Local _ _ name, OnRight, _ => named_candidate name (right_at j.(antecedent) pre o post)
    | Weaken _ _, OnLeft, _ => verified_build (left_conclusion pre post j.(succedent) o)
        (left_targets pre post j.(succedent) [[]]) (fun Hs Ht => weakening_left pre post j.(succedent) o Hs Ht)
    | Weaken _ _, OnRight, _ => verified_build (right_conclusion j.(antecedent) pre post o)
        (right_targets j.(antecedent) pre post [[]]) (fun Hs Ht => weakening_right j.(antecedent) pre post o Hs Ht)
    | ExchangeAdjacent _ _, OnLeft, _ => match post with
      | next :: tail => verified_build (Jdg (pre ++ o :: next :: tail) j.(succedent))
          [Jdg (pre ++ next :: o :: tail) j.(succedent)]
          (fun Hs Ht => exchange_rule _ _ Hs Ht eq_refl
            (Permutation_app_head pre (perm_swap next o tail)) (Permutation_refl _))
      | [] => None end
    | ExchangeAdjacent _ _, OnRight, _ => match post with
      | next :: tail => verified_build (Jdg j.(antecedent) (pre ++ o :: next :: tail))
          [Jdg j.(antecedent) (pre ++ next :: o :: tail)]
          (fun Hs Ht => exchange_rule _ _ Hs Ht eq_refl
            (Permutation_refl _) (Permutation_app_head pre (perm_swap next o tail)))
      | [] => None end
    | _, _, _ => None
    end
  end.

(** Non-positional requests construct their literal source and premise
    judgments here. For substitution the original is the premise and its
    substituted image is the conclusion. The public wrapper below checks
    that this constructed conclusion equals [j]. *)
Definition atomic_eigen_requested j location n y :=
  let context := match location with OnLeft => j.(antecedent) | OnRight => j.(succedent) end in
  match at_position context n with
  | None => None
  | Some (pre,o,post) => match location with
    | OnRight => atomic_boxright_candidate j.(antecedent) pre o post y
    | OnLeft => atomic_diamondleft_candidate pre o post j.(succedent) y end
  end.
Definition atomic_use_requested j location n relation_index :=
  let context := match location with OnLeft => j.(antecedent) | OnRight => j.(succedent) end in
  match at_position context n, nth_error R relation_index with
  | Some (pre,o,post), Some relation =>
    let rp := firstn relation_index R in let rq := skipn (S relation_index) R in
    match location with
    | OnLeft => atomic_boxleft_candidate rp relation rq pre o post j.(succedent)
    | OnRight => atomic_diamondright_candidate rp relation rq j.(antecedent) pre o post end
  | _, _ => None end.
(** As in the kernel, contraction is read backward: the conclusion has one
    copy of the selected relation and its premise has two. Weakening instead
    removes the selected relation in the premise. *)
Definition relation_requested j n (contract : bool) :=
  match nth_error R n with
  | None => None
  | Some relation => let rp := firstn n R in let rq := skipn (S n) R in
    let source := Rdg (rp ++ relation :: rq) j.(antecedent) j.(succedent) in
    if contract then
      verified_build source [Rdg (rp ++ relation :: relation :: rq) j.(antecedent) j.(succedent)]
        (fun Hs Ht => relation_contraction rp rq relation j.(antecedent) j.(succedent) Hs Ht)
    else
      verified_build source [Rdg (rp ++ rq) j.(antecedent) j.(succedent)]
        (fun Hs Ht => relation_weakening rp rq relation j.(antecedent) j.(succedent) Hs Ht)
  end.
Definition relation_exchange_requested j n :=
  match skipn n R with
  | a :: b :: rest => let rp := firstn n R in
      verified_build (Rdg (rp ++ a :: b :: rest) j.(antecedent) j.(succedent))
        [Rdg (rp ++ b :: a :: rest) j.(antecedent) j.(succedent)]
        (fun Hs Ht => relation_exchange _ _ Hs Ht eq_refl eq_refl
          (Permutation_app_head rp (perm_swap b a rest)))
  | _ => None end.

(** This dispatcher builds candidates before the final input comparison.
    Substitution and label algebra start from an explicit [original]
    premise; cuts start from supplied context partitions. The wrapper must
    verify that their reconstructed conclusion is exactly the requested [j]. *)
Definition raw_requested j request :=
  match request with
  | CutRelations Rgamma Rsigma gamma sigma delta lambda cutformula =>
      verified_build (Rdg (Rgamma ++ Rsigma) (gamma ++ sigma) (delta ++ lambda))
        [Rdg Rgamma gamma (cutformula :: delta);Rdg Rsigma (sigma ++ [cutformula]) lambda]
        (fun Hs Ht => cut_relations Rgamma Rsigma gamma sigma delta lambda cutformula Hs Ht)
  | AtomicEigen location n y => atomic_eigen_requested j location n y
  | AtomicUse location n index => atomic_use_requested j location n index
  | WeakenRelation n => relation_requested j n false
  | ContractRelation n => relation_requested j n true
  | ExchangeRelation n => relation_exchange_requested j n
  | Local location n _ | Weaken location n | ExchangeAdjacent location n =>
      requested_at j location n request
  | SubstituteWorld original x u => guard (L.world_term_wfb u) (fun _ =>
      verified_build (map_labels (subst_world_label x u) original) [original]
        (fun Hs Ht => world_substitution_rule original x u (Forall_inv Ht) Hs))
  | SubstituteTrace original x l => guard (label_wfb l) (fun _ => guard (label_nonemptyb l) (fun Hne =>
      verified_build (map_labels (subst_trace_label x l) original) [original]
        (fun Hs Ht => trace_substitution_rule original x l Hne (Forall_inv Ht) Hs)))
  | UnitLabels original path on_left insert =>
      verified_build (map_labels (unit_label path on_left insert) original) [original]
        (fun Hs Ht => label_unit_rule original path on_left insert (Forall_inv Ht) Hs)
  | RotateLabels original path rotate_left =>
      verified_build (map_labels (rotate_label path rotate_left) original) [original]
        (fun Hs Ht => label_rotation_rule original path rotate_left (Forall_inv Ht) Hs)
  | Cut gamma sigma delta lambda cutformula =>
      verified_build (Jdg (gamma ++ sigma) (delta ++ lambda))
        [Jdg gamma (cutformula :: delta);Jdg (sigma ++ [cutformula]) lambda]
        (fun Hs Ht => cut_rule gamma sigma delta lambda cutformula Hs Ht)
  | BacklinkExact companion => verified_build companion [companion]
      (fun Hs Ht => exact_backlink companion Hs)
  | BacklinkTags renaming companion =>
      verified_build j [rename_tags (rename_lookup renaming) j]
        (fun Hs Ht => tag_renaming_backlink j (rename_lookup renaming) Hs (Forall_inv Ht))
  end.

(** Tag-renaming needs an extra companion comparison because its kernel can
    construct a renamed judgment directly from [j]. Exact backlinks instead
    reconstruct the source from their companion and are checked by the same
    [ensure_rule] conclusion equality as every other request. *)
Definition generate_requested_in_context j request :=
  match request with
  | BacklinkTags renaming companion =>
      if judgment_eqb (rename_tags (rename_lookup renaming) j) companion
      then ensure_rule j (raw_requested j request) else None
  | _ => ensure_rule j (raw_requested j request)
  end.

Theorem generate_requested_spec j request r : generate_requested_in_context j request = Some r ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof.
  unfold generate_requested_in_context; destruct request; try apply ensure_rule_spec.
  destruct (judgment_eqb _ _); [apply ensure_rule_spec|discriminate].
Qed.
End RelationContext.
(** Public entry points specialize the context parameter to [j]'s own
    relation list, so ordinary callers need supply only the judgment and,
    when appropriate, a request. The following theorems expose the same
    checked syntax and edge guarantees after that specialization. *)
Definition generate_rules j := generate_rules_in_context (relations j) j.
Definition generate_requested j req := generate_requested_in_context (relations j) j req.
Theorem all_generated_rules_spec j r : In r (generate_rules j) ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof. apply generate_rules_spec. Qed.
Theorem requested_rule_spec j req r : generate_requested j req = Some r ->
  r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = j /\ judgment_wfb j = true /\
  Forall (fun p => judgment_wfb p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) = true /\
    Cyclic.edge_info_wfb j p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) p.(Cyclic.premise_edge) = true) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises).
Proof. apply generate_requested_spec. Qed.
End MakeRuleGeneration.
Rules.v:
(** * Theorem-backed local rule kernels

    Every rule record must provide two proofs: validity follows from valid
    premises, and a false conclusion yields one false premise/world respecting
    all trace pairs on that selected edge. Ordinary logical soundness alone
    does not establish the second, rank-sensitive obligation.

    Read the common context/local-rule helpers first, then one simple Boolean
    rule. The [_base] modal rules establish semantics; [enhance_right] and
    [redecorate] add proved principal trace pairs. Later sections handle
    changed worlds for substitution/eigenvariables, backlinks, and structural
    axioms. RULE_EXPANSIONS.md fixes the ordered premises of each rule.

    Most constructors end with [Defined] so local generation can compute
    their conclusions, premises and edge metadata. Their proof obligations
    are still checked by Rocq, not trusted assertions. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia String Classical_Prop Permutation.
From Stdlib Require Import Logic.ClassicalDescription Logic.ClassicalEpsilon.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics Progress.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Module MakeRulesForModel (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn)
    (Pr : PROGRESS L Syn Sem) (I : Sem.INTERPRETATION).
Import Syn Sem.
Module Export P := Pr.ForModel I.
(** Reuse the syntax helper to extract tags from any chosen occurrence list
    by placing that list in the succedent of a temporary judgment. *)
Definition context_tags (context : list occurrence) := judgment_tags (Jdg [] context).

(** Tag uniqueness allows a list lookup to be replaced by the rank of a known
    tagged member. Many edge proofs use this to reason about formulas rather
    than the mechanics of [rank_in_context]. *)
Lemma rank_context_occ context w o tag :
  NoDup (context_tags context) -> In o context -> occurrence_tag o = Some tag ->
  rank_in_context context w tag = occurrence_rank o w.
Proof.
  induction context as [|head rest IH]; cbn; [contradiction|].
  unfold context_tags in *; cbn in *.
  destruct (occurrence_tag head) as [t|] eqn:Htag; cbn in *.
  - intros Hunique Hin Ho. inversion Hunique as [|? ? Hnot Htail]; subst.
    destruct Hin as [->|Hin].
    + rewrite Ho in Htag; inversion Htag; subst. now rewrite Nat.eqb_refl.
    + destruct (Nat.eqb tag t) eqn:Heq.
      * apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq; subst tag. exfalso; apply Hnot.
        apply in_flat_map; exists o; split; [exact Hin|]. rewrite Ho; cbn; auto.
      * apply IH; assumption.
  - intros Hunique [->|Hin] Ho; [congruence|]. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Definition occurrence_eqb a b := if occurrence_eq_dec a b then true else false.
Lemma occurrence_eqb_spec a b : occurrence_eqb a b = true <-> a = b.
Proof. unfold occurrence_eqb; destruct (occurrence_eq_dec a b); intuition discriminate. Qed.

(** Retain a context pair only for an exactly unchanged occurrence in both
    succedents. The pair contains tags, not list indices, and carries no
    progress: its rank is equal because its formula and label are unchanged. *)
Fixpoint retained_pairs (source target : list occurrence) : list (nat * nat) :=
  match source with
  | [] => []
  | o :: rest =>
      match o.(occurrence_tag) with
      | None => retained_pairs rest target
      | Some t => if existsb (occurrence_eqb o) target
          then (t,t) :: retained_pairs rest target else retained_pairs rest target
      end
  end.

Lemma retained_pairs_spec source target a b : In (a,b) (retained_pairs source target) ->
  a = b /\ exists o, In o source /\ In o target /\ occurrence_tag o = Some a.
Proof.
  induction source as [|o rest IH]; cbn; [contradiction|].
  destruct (occurrence_tag o) as [t|] eqn:Ht.
  - destruct (existsb (occurrence_eqb o) target) eqn:Hmem.
    + intros [Heq|Hin].
      * inversion Heq; subst. split; [reflexivity|]. exists o; split; [now left|].
        apply existsb_exists in Hmem as [x [Hin Hx]].
        apply occurrence_eqb_spec in Hx; subst x; auto.
      * destruct (IH Hin) as [Hab [x [Hs [Htar Htag]]]]. split; [exact Hab|]. exists x; auto.
    + intro Hin; destruct (IH Hin) as [Hab [x [Hs [Htar Htag]]]]. split; [exact Hab|]. exists x; auto.
  - intro Hin; destruct (IH Hin) as [Hab [x [Hs [Htar Htag]]]]. split; [exact Hab|]. exists x; auto.
Qed.

Definition retained_edge source target : Cyclic.edge_info :=
  {| Cyclic.edge_valid := retained_pairs source.(succedent) target.(succedent);
     Cyclic.edge_progress := [] |}.

Lemma wf_unique j : judgment_wfb j = true -> NoDup (context_tags j.(succedent)).
Proof. unfold judgment_wfb, context_tags; rewrite !andb_true_iff; intros [_ H]; now apply unique_tagsb_spec. Qed.

Lemma retained_edge_respects source target w :
  judgment_wfb source = true -> judgment_wfb target = true ->
  Cyclic.respects_edge source target w w (retained_edge source target).
Proof.
  intros Hsource Htarget; split.
  - intros a b Hin; apply retained_pairs_spec in Hin as [-> [o [Hs [Ht Htag]]]].
    unfold LPLTheory.rank.
    rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ o _ (wf_unique _ Hsource) Hs Htag).
    rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ o _ (wf_unique _ Htarget) Ht Htag). lia.
  - intros a b H; inversion H.
Qed.

(** Finite semantic selection by classical truth cases. This is used in
    soundness proofs to return a dependent witness (index, judgment, failure
    proof); it is not an executable strategy for proving object-language
    goals or for deciding arbitrary predicate truth. *)
Definition false_premise (targets : list judgment) (w : world M)
    (H : ~ (forall j, In j targets -> denote M j w)) :
    { k : nat & { j : judgment | nth_error targets k = Some j /\ ~ denote M j w }}.
Proof.
  induction targets as [|head rest IH].
  - exfalso; apply H; cbn; tauto.
  - destruct (excluded_middle_informative (denote M head w)) as [Hhead|Hhead].
    + assert (~ (forall j, In j rest -> denote M j w)) as Hrest.
      { intro Hall; apply H; intros j [->|Hin]; auto. }
      destruct (IH Hrest) as [k [j [Hnth Hfalse]]]. exists (Datatypes.S k), j; cbn; auto.
    + exists 0, head; auto.
Defined.

(** A finite local semantic inference, with all retained context pairs proved
    simultaneously. [Hlocal] reasons at one world; the first record field
    lifts it to validity. Its contrapositive supplies a false premise for the
    second field. Source and premise well-formedness ensure that admissibility
    cannot make the required countermodel implication vacuous.
    The world stays unchanged here; substitution and eigenvariable rules use
    other constructors below. This constructor performs no proof search. *)
Definition local_rule (name : string) (source : judgment) (targets : list judgment)
    (Hsource : judgment_wfb source = true)
    (Htargets : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) targets)
    (Hlocal : forall w, (forall j, In j targets -> denote M j w) -> denote M source w)
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  let premise := constr:(fun j => {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := j;
    Cyclic.premise_edge := retained_edge source j |}) in
  refine {| Cyclic.rule_name := name; Cyclic.rule_conclusion := source;
    Cyclic.rule_premises := map premise targets |}.
  - intros Hall w; apply Hlocal; intros j Hin.
    apply (Hall {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := j; Cyclic.premise_edge := retained_edge source j |}).
    apply in_map_iff; exists j; auto.
  - intros w Hfalse.
    assert (~ (forall j, In j targets -> denote M j w)) as Hbad by (intro Hall; apply Hfalse; apply Hlocal; exact Hall).
    destruct (false_premise targets w Hbad) as [k [j [Hnth Hj]]].
    exists k, {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := j; Cyclic.premise_edge := retained_edge source j |}, w.
    split.
    + rewrite nth_error_map.
      exact (f_equal (option_map (fun j : judgment =>
        {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := j; Cyclic.premise_edge := retained_edge source j |})) Hnth).
    + split; [exact Hj|].
      apply retained_edge_respects; [exact Hsource|].
      rewrite Forall_forall in Htargets. apply Htargets; eapply nth_error_In; eauto.
Defined.

(** Project the world selected by a rule's dependent counterstep witness.
    [local_rule_world] records that ordinary local rules keep the world;
    later decoration proofs use it to reuse the selected false premise. *)
Definition counter_world r w H :=
  proj1_sig (projT2 (projT2 (r.(Cyclic.rule_counter_step) w H))).

Lemma local_rule_world name source targets Hs Ht Hlocal w Hfalse :
  counter_world (local_rule name source targets Hs Ht Hlocal) w Hfalse = w.
Proof.
  unfold counter_world, local_rule; cbn.
  match goal with |- context [false_premise ?targets ?w ?proof] =>
    destruct (false_premise targets w proof) as [k [j [Hnth Hbad]]] end.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Antecedents behave as conjunctions; succedents behave as disjunctions.
    These four equations turn list bookkeeping into propositional reasoning
    so each rule can concentrate on its principal connective. *)
Lemma left_app w a b : left_holds M w (a ++ b) <-> left_holds M w a /\ left_holds M w b.
Proof. apply Forall_app. Qed.
Lemma left_cons w o rest : left_holds M w (o :: rest) <-> labelled_holds M w o /\ left_holds M w rest.
Proof. apply Forall_cons_iff. Qed.
Lemma right_app w a b : right_holds M w (a ++ b) <-> right_holds M w a \/ right_holds M w b.
Proof. unfold right_holds; setoid_rewrite in_app_iff; firstorder. Qed.
Lemma right_cons w o rest : right_holds M w (o :: rest) <-> labelled_holds M w o \/ right_holds M w rest.
Proof. unfold right_holds; cbn; firstorder congruence. Qed.

Lemma denote_wf j w : judgment_wfb j = true ->
  (denote M j w <-> (relations_hold M w j.(relations) -> left_holds M w j.(antecedent) -> right_holds M w j.(succedent))).
Proof.
  intro Hwf; unfold denote. pose proof (judgment_wfb_admissible M j w Hwf); tauto.
Qed.

Section RelationContext.
Context (R : list relation_atom).
Local Notation Jdg := (Rdg R).
(** [pre] and [post] surround the selected principal occurrence. Each inner
    list in [alternatives] replaces that occurrence in one premise; the outer
    list orders the premises. For example, [[a];[b]] means two premises,
    whereas [[a;b]] means one premise containing both occurrences. *)
Definition right_conclusion lhs pre post principal := Jdg lhs (pre ++ principal :: post).
Definition right_targets lhs pre post alternatives :=
  map (fun replacement => Jdg lhs (pre ++ replacement ++ post)) alternatives.
Definition left_conclusion pre post rhs principal := Jdg (pre ++ principal :: post) rhs.
Definition left_targets pre post rhs alternatives :=
  map (fun replacement => Jdg (pre ++ replacement ++ post) rhs) alternatives.

(** For a right rule, if neither surrounding succedent context is already
    true, the premise disjunctions must establish the principal. For a left
    rule, a true principal supplies one true replacement context. These two
    helpers factor out sequent bookkeeping from each logical decomposition. *)
Definition right_many (name : string) (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (principal : occurrence) (alternatives : list (list occurrence))
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post alternatives))
    (Hdecompose : forall w, label_admissible M w principal.(occurrence_label) ->
      (forall replacement, In replacement alternatives -> right_holds M w replacement) ->
      labelled_holds M w principal) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (local_rule name _ _ Hs Ht). intros w Hall.
  apply (proj2 (denote_wf _ w Hs)). cbn [right_conclusion antecedent succedent].
  intros Hrelations Hlhs. rewrite right_app, right_cons.
  destruct (classic (right_holds M w pre \/ right_holds M w post)) as [[Hpre|Hpost]|Hnone]; auto.
  right; left. apply Hdecompose.
  - pose proof (judgment_wfb_admissible M _ w Hs) as Ha.
    destruct Ha as [Ha _]; rewrite Forall_forall in Ha.
    apply (Ha principal). cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; cbn; tauto.
  - intros replacement Hin.
    set (target := Jdg lhs (pre ++ replacement ++ post)).
    assert (In target (right_targets lhs pre post alternatives)) as Hmember.
    { apply in_map_iff; exists replacement; auto. }
    specialize (Hall target Hmember).
    rewrite Forall_forall in Ht.
    pose proof (proj1 (denote_wf target w (Ht target Hmember)) Hall) as Hraw.
    clear Hall; rename Hraw into Hall.
    specialize (Hall Hrelations Hlhs). unfold target in Hall; cbn in Hall.
    rewrite !right_app in Hall. tauto.
Defined.

Definition left_many (name : string) (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (principal : occurrence) (alternatives : list (list occurrence))
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs alternatives))
    (Hdecompose : forall w, labelled_holds M w principal ->
      exists replacement, In replacement alternatives /\ left_holds M w replacement)
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (local_rule name _ _ Hs Ht). intros w Hall.
  apply (proj2 (denote_wf _ w Hs)). cbn [left_conclusion antecedent succedent].
  intro Hrelations. rewrite left_app, left_cons. intros [Hpre [Hprincipal Hpost]].
  destruct (Hdecompose w Hprincipal) as [replacement [Hin Hreplacement]].
  set (target := Jdg (pre ++ replacement ++ post) rhs).
  assert (In target (left_targets pre post rhs alternatives)) as Hmember.
  { apply in_map_iff; exists replacement; auto. }
  specialize (Hall target Hmember).
  rewrite Forall_forall in Ht.
    pose proof (proj1 (denote_wf target w (Ht target Hmember)) Hall) as Hraw.
    clear Hall; rename Hraw into Hall.
  apply Hall; [exact Hrelations|]. unfold target; cbn. rewrite !left_app; auto.
Defined.

Lemma right_singleton w o : right_holds M w [o] <-> labelled_holds M w o.
Proof. unfold right_holds; cbn; firstorder congruence. Qed.
Lemma left_singleton w o : left_holds M w [o] <-> labelled_holds M w o.
Proof. unfold left_holds; rewrite Forall_cons_iff. split; [tauto|intro H; split; [exact H|constructor]]. Qed.

Lemma formula_conj tr a b : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds M (Conj a b) tr <-> formula_holds M a tr /\ formula_holds M b tr).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.
Lemma formula_disj tr a b : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds M (Disj a b) tr <-> formula_holds M a tr \/ formula_holds M b tr).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.
Lemma formula_impl tr a b : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds M (Impl a b) tr <-> (formula_holds M a tr -> formula_holds M b tr)).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.
Lemma formula_neg tr a : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds M (Neg a) tr <-> ~ formula_holds M a tr).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.

Lemma labelled_neg w l a ta tb : label_admissible M w l ->
  (labelled_holds M w (Occ l (Neg a) ta) <-> ~ labelled_holds M w (Occ l a tb)).
Proof.
  intro Hne; unfold labelled_holds; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula].
  rewrite formula_neg by exact Hne; tauto.
Qed.
Lemma labelled_impl w l a b ta tb tc : label_admissible M w l ->
  (labelled_holds M w (Occ l (Impl a b) ta) <->
   (labelled_holds M w (Occ l a tb) -> labelled_holds M w (Occ l b tc))).
Proof.
  intro Hne; unfold labelled_holds; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula].
  rewrite formula_impl by exact Hne; tauto.
Qed.

(** First examples of the helpers: right conjunction has two singleton
    replacement premises, while left conjunction has one two-occurrence
    replacement premise. Compare disjunction below for the opposite pattern.
    Unchanged context tags are already routed by [local_rule]. *)
Definition conjunction_right (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (l : label) (a b : formula) (tag ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Conj a b) tag)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l a ta]; [Occ l b tb]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (right_many "And.R" lhs pre post (Occ l (Conj a b) tag)
    [[Occ l a ta]; [Occ l b tb]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hne H. pose proof (H [Occ l a ta] ltac:(cbn; auto)) as Ha.
  pose proof (H [Occ l b tb] ltac:(cbn; auto)) as Hb.
  rewrite right_singleton in Ha, Hb. unfold labelled_holds in *; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula] in *.
  rewrite formula_conj by exact Hne; tauto.
Defined.

Definition conjunction_left (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (l : label) (a b : formula) (tag ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Conj a b) tag)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (left_many "And.L" pre post rhs (Occ l (Conj a b) tag)
    [[Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w [Hne H]. cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula] in Hne, H.
  rewrite formula_conj in H by exact Hne.
  exists [Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb]; split; [cbn; auto|].
  unfold left_holds; repeat constructor; unfold labelled_holds; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula]; tauto.
Defined.

Definition disjunction_right (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (l : label) (a b : formula) (tag ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l (Disj a b) tag)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (right_many "Or.R" lhs pre post (Occ l (Disj a b) tag)
    [[Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hne H. specialize (H [Occ l a ta; Occ l b tb] ltac:(cbn; auto)).
  rewrite right_cons, right_singleton in H.
  unfold labelled_holds in *; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula] in *; rewrite formula_disj by exact Hne; tauto.
Defined.

Definition disjunction_left (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (l : label) (a b : formula) (tag ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l (Disj a b) tag)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l a ta]; [Occ l b tb]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (left_many "Or.L" pre post rhs (Occ l (Disj a b) tag)
    [[Occ l a ta]; [Occ l b tb]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w [Hne H]; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula] in Hne, H; rewrite formula_disj in H by exact Hne.
  destruct H as [Ha|Hb]; [exists [Occ l a ta]|exists [Occ l b tb]];
    split; try (cbn; auto); apply left_singleton; split; assumption.
Defined.

(** Explicit one-premise weakening; neither constructor is an axiom. *)
Definition weakening_right (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (principal : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (right_many "Wk.R" lhs pre post principal [[]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hne Hall. specialize (Hall [] ltac:(cbn; auto)).
  destruct Hall as [o [Hin _]]; inversion Hin.
Defined.

Definition weakening_left (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (principal : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[]])) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (left_many "Wk.L" pre post rhs principal [[]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w H; exists []; split; [cbn; auto|constructor].
Defined.

(** Specialize context replacement to one occurrence, then to semantic
    equivalence of formulas or labelled assertions. These helpers establish
    ordinary soundness and retained-context routing; they do not yet route
    a changed principal trace occurrence. *)
Definition right_one (name : string) (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (principal replacement : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[replacement]]))
    (Hholds : forall w, label_admissible M w principal.(occurrence_label) ->
      labelled_holds M w replacement -> labelled_holds M w principal) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (right_many name lhs pre post principal [[replacement]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hne Hall; apply Hholds; [exact Hne|].
  apply right_singleton. apply Hall; cbn; auto.
Defined.

Definition left_one (name : string) (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (principal replacement : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[replacement]]))
    (Hholds : forall w, labelled_holds M w principal -> labelled_holds M w replacement) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (left_many name pre post rhs principal [[replacement]] Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hprincipal; exists [replacement]; split; [cbn; auto|].
  apply left_singleton, Hholds; exact Hprincipal.
Defined.

Definition right_equivalent (name : string) (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (l : label)
    (a b : formula) (ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post (Occ l a ta)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[Occ l b tb]]))
    (Heq : forall tr, tr <> [] -> (formula_holds M a tr <-> formula_holds M b tr)) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (right_one name lhs pre post (Occ l a ta) (Occ l b tb) Hs Ht _).
  intros w Hne [Ha Hb]; split; [exact Hne|]. cbn in Hb |- *.
  apply Heq; assumption.
Defined.

Definition left_equivalent (name : string) (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (l : label)
    (a b : formula) (ta tb : option nat)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs (Occ l a ta)) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[Occ l b tb]]))
    (Heq : forall tr, tr <> [] -> (formula_holds M a tr <-> formula_holds M b tr)) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine (left_one name pre post rhs (Occ l a ta) (Occ l b tb) Hs Ht _).
  intros w [Hne Ha]; split; [exact Hne|]. cbn in Ha |- *.
  apply Heq; assumption.
Defined.

Definition right_label_equivalent (name : string) (lhs pre post : list occurrence) (principal replacement : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (right_targets lhs pre post [[replacement]]))
    (Heq : forall w, labelled_holds M w principal <-> labelled_holds M w replacement) : Cyclic.rule_instance :=
  right_one name lhs pre post principal replacement Hs Ht (fun w Hne H => proj2 (Heq w) H).

Definition left_label_equivalent (name : string) (pre post rhs : list occurrence) (principal replacement : occurrence)
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (left_conclusion pre post rhs principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true) (left_targets pre post rhs [[replacement]]))
    (Heq : forall w, labelled_holds M w principal <-> labelled_holds M w replacement) : Cyclic.rule_instance :=
  left_one name pre post rhs principal replacement Hs Ht (fun w H => proj1 (Heq w) H).

(** Head-observation rules change the label according to a proved semantic
    equation. [First] explicitly restricts the body to the initial state;
    the suffix component of the original label is therefore discarded. *)
Definition first_right lhs pre post u sigma body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  right_label_equivalent "First.R" lhs pre post
    (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First body) ta) (Occ (StateLabel u) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => first_label M w u sigma body ta tb).
Definition first_left pre post rhs u sigma body ta tb Hs Ht :=
  left_label_equivalent "First.L" pre post rhs
    (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First body) ta) (Occ (StateLabel u) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => first_label M w u sigma body ta tb).

(** The manuscript's At rule only exposes atoms/equalities at the head.
    [First] above is the separate rule for an explicit singleton observation
    of an arbitrary compound formula. *)
Definition atomb a := match a with Atom _ _ | BinaryAtom _ _ => true | _ => false end.
Lemma atomb_pure a : atomb a = true -> pureb a = true.
Proof. destruct a; cbn; congruence. Qed.
Definition atom_head_right lhs pre post u sigma body ta tb Hs Ht (Ha : atomb body = true) :=
  right_label_equivalent "At.R" lhs pre post
    (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) body ta) (Occ (StateLabel u) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => atom_head_label M w u sigma body ta tb Ha).
Definition atom_head_left pre post rhs u sigma body ta tb Hs Ht (Ha : atomb body = true) :=
  left_label_equivalent "At.L" pre post rhs
    (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) body ta) (Occ (StateLabel u) body tb) Hs Ht
    (fun w => atom_head_label M w u sigma body ta tb Ha).

(** A changed principal can be followed only if both occurrences carry tags.
    Valid pairs require nonincrease; progressing pairs additionally require
    strict decrease. The edge also includes all unchanged context pairs. *)
Definition continuation_pairs (a b : occurrence) :=
  match a.(occurrence_tag), b.(occurrence_tag) with
  | Some x, Some y => [(x,y)]
  | _, _ => []
  end.

Definition continuation_edge source target a b (progress : bool) : Cyclic.edge_info :=
  {| Cyclic.edge_valid := retained_pairs source.(succedent) target.(succedent) ++ continuation_pairs a b;
     Cyclic.edge_progress := if progress then continuation_pairs a b else [] |}.

Lemma continuation_edge_respects source target a b progress w :
  judgment_wfb source = true -> judgment_wfb target = true ->
  In a source.(succedent) -> In b target.(succedent) ->
  occurrence_rank b w <= occurrence_rank a w ->
  (progress = true -> occurrence_rank b w < occurrence_rank a w) ->
  Cyclic.respects_edge source target w w (continuation_edge source target a b progress).
Proof.
  intros Hs Ht Ha Hb Hle Hlt; split.
  - intros x y Hin; apply in_app_iff in Hin as [Hret|Hcont].
    + exact (proj1 (retained_edge_respects source target w Hs Ht) x y Hret).
    + unfold continuation_pairs in Hcont.
      destruct (occurrence_tag a) as [ta|] eqn:Hta; [|contradiction].
      destruct (occurrence_tag b) as [tb|] eqn:Htb; [|contradiction].
      destruct Hcont as [Heq|Hno]; [inversion Heq; subst|contradiction].
      unfold LPLTheory.rank. rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ a _ (wf_unique _ Hs) Ha Hta).
      rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ b _ (wf_unique _ Ht) Hb Htb). exact Hle.
  - intros x y Hin.
    change (In (x,y) (if progress then continuation_pairs a b else [])) in Hin.
    destruct progress; [|contradiction].
    unfold continuation_pairs in Hin.
    destruct (occurrence_tag a) as [ta|] eqn:Hta; [|contradiction].
    destruct (occurrence_tag b) as [tb|] eqn:Htb; [|contradiction].
    destruct Hin as [Heq|Hno]; [inversion Heq; subst|contradiction].
    unfold LPLTheory.rank. rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ a _ (wf_unique _ Hs) Ha Hta).
    rewrite (rank_context_occ _ _ b _ (wf_unique _ Ht) Hb Htb). apply Hlt; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** A false sequent has true antecedents and no true succedent, including its
    principal. These lemmas preserve that fact when replacing a false right
    principal by a selected false continuation. *)
Lemma false_right_parts lhs pre post principal w :
  ~ denote M (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) w ->
  left_holds M w lhs /\ ~ right_holds M w pre /\
  ~ labelled_holds M w principal /\ ~ right_holds M w post.
Proof.
  intro Hfalse; destruct (false_sequent M _ _ Hfalse) as [Ha [Hl Hr]].
  split; [exact Hl|]. repeat split.
  - intros [o [Hin Ho]]; apply (Hr o); cbn; [rewrite in_app_iff; auto|exact Ho].
  - apply (Hr principal); cbn; rewrite in_app_iff; cbn; auto.
  - intros [o [Hin Ho]]; apply (Hr o); cbn; [rewrite in_app_iff; cbn; auto|exact Ho].
Qed.

Lemma false_right_replacement lhs pre post principal replacement w :
  judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post replacement) = true ->
  ~ denote M (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) w ->
  ~ labelled_holds M w replacement ->
  ~ denote M (right_conclusion lhs pre post replacement) w.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hfalse Hreplacement Htarget.
  destruct (false_right_parts _ _ _ _ _ Hfalse) as [Hl [Hpre [_ Hpost]]].
  pose proof (proj1 (denote_wf _ _ Hwf) Htarget (false_relations M _ _ Hfalse) Hl) as Hright.
  cbn [right_conclusion succedent] in Hright. rewrite right_app, right_cons in Hright. tauto.
Qed.

(** Replace only edge metadata after proving a stronger local counterstep.
    Ordinary local soundness is reused without altering any premise judgment. *)
Definition redecorate (r : Cyclic.rule_instance) (edge_for : judgment -> Cyclic.edge_info)
    (Hstep : forall w, ~ denote M r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) w ->
      { k : nat & { p : Cyclic.premise & { w' : world M |
        nth_error r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) k = Some p /\
        ~ denote M p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) w' /\
        Cyclic.respects_edge r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) w w'
          (edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment)) } } }) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  refine {| Cyclic.rule_name := r.(Cyclic.rule_name);
    Cyclic.rule_conclusion := r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion);
    Cyclic.rule_premises := map (fun p => {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment);
      Cyclic.premise_edge := edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) |}) r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) |}.
  - intros Hall; apply r.(Cyclic.rule_theorem); intros p Hin w.
    apply (Hall {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment);
      Cyclic.premise_edge := edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) |}).
    apply in_map_iff; exists p; auto.
  - intros w Hfalse; destruct (Hstep w Hfalse) as [k [p [w' [Hnth [Hbad Hedge]]]]].
    exists k, {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment);
      Cyclic.premise_edge := edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) |}, w'.
    split.
    + rewrite nth_error_map. exact (f_equal (option_map (fun p : Cyclic.premise =>
      {| Cyclic.premise_judgment := p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment);
         Cyclic.premise_edge := edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) |})) Hnth).
    + auto.
Defined.

Definition redecorate_sameworld r edge_for
    (Hworld : forall w H, counter_world r w H = w)
    (Hedge : forall w p, In p r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) ->
      ~ denote M r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) w -> ~ denote M p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) w ->
      Cyclic.respects_edge r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment) w w
        (edge_for p.(Cyclic.premise_judgment))) : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  apply (redecorate r edge_for). intros w Hfalse.
  specialize (Hworld w Hfalse); unfold counter_world in Hworld.
  destruct (r.(Cyclic.rule_counter_step) w Hfalse) as [k [p [w' [Hnth [Hp Hold]]]]].
  cbn in Hworld; subst w'. exists k, p, w; split; [exact Hnth|]; split; [exact Hp|].
  apply Hedge; try assumption; eapply nth_error_In; exact Hnth.
Defined.

(** Select an indexed member satisfying [Q] from a finite list, using
    classical cases on [Q]. The returned index identifies the exact premise
    stored in a rule record; it is distinct from a formula occurrence tag. *)
Definition finite_selection {A : Type} (xs : list A) (Q : A -> Prop)
    (H : exists x, In x xs /\ Q x) :
    { k : nat & { x : A | nth_error xs k = Some x /\ Q x }}.
Proof.
  induction xs as [|x xs IH].
  - exfalso; destruct H as [x [Hin _]]; inversion Hin.
  - destruct (excluded_middle_informative (Q x)) as [Hx|Hx].
    + exists 0, x; auto.
    + assert (exists y, In y xs /\ Q y) as Htail.
      { destruct H as [y [[->|Hin] Hy]]; [contradiction|eauto]. }
      destruct (IH Htail) as [k [y [Hnth Hy]]]. exists (Datatypes.S k), y; cbn; auto.
Defined.

Lemma nth_principal {A : Type} (pre post : list A) (principal default : A) :
  nth (List.length pre) (pre ++ principal :: post) default = principal.
Proof. induction pre; cbn; auto. Qed.

Lemma wellformed_principal lhs pre post principal w :
  judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true ->
  label_admissible M w principal.(occurrence_label).
Proof.
  intro Hwf; pose proof (judgment_wfb_admissible M _ w Hwf) as Ha.
  unfold admissible in Ha; rewrite Forall_forall in Ha; apply Ha.
  cbn; rewrite !in_app_iff; cbn; tauto.
Qed.

(** Strengthen a proved right rule with its principal rank pair. [Hselect]
    chooses one premise once, so all advertised context and principal pairs
    are respected on that same edge. *)
Definition enhance_right (r : Cyclic.rule_instance) lhs pre post principal replacements progress
    (Hs : judgment_wfb (right_conclusion lhs pre post principal) = true)
    (Ht : Forall (fun j => judgment_wfb j = true)
      (right_targets lhs pre post (map (fun o => [o]) replacements)))
    (Hsource : r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) = right_conclusion lhs pre post principal)
    (Hshape : map Cyclic.premise_judgment r.(Cyclic.rule_premises) =
      right_targets lhs pre post (map (fun o => [o]) replacements))
    (Hselect : forall w, label_admissible M w principal.(occurrence_label) ->
      ~ labelled_holds M w principal -> exists replacement,
        In replacement replacements /\ ~ labelled_holds M w replacement /\
        occurrence_rank replacement w <= occurrence_rank principal w /\
        (progress = true -> occurrence_rank replacement w < occurrence_rank principal w))
    : Cyclic.rule_instance.
Proof.
  (* Select a replacement together with its falsity and rank bounds before
     choosing the premise record. The resulting single edge respects every
     context pair and the principal pair at the same world. *)
  set (edge_for := fun target => continuation_edge r.(Cyclic.rule_conclusion) target principal
    (nth (List.length pre) target.(succedent) principal) progress).
  apply (redecorate r edge_for). intros w Hfalse.
  rewrite Hsource in Hfalse.
