Lemma eval_unit_label w path on_left insert l : eval_label w (unit_label path on_left insert l) = eval_label w l.
Proof.
  revert l; induction path as [|direction path IH]; intro l.
  - destruct insert, on_left; cbn [unit_label eval_label]; try reflexivity; try apply app_nil_r.
    + destruct l; try reflexivity; destruct l1; cbn [eval_label]; reflexivity.
    + destruct l; try reflexivity; destruct l2; cbn [eval_label]; try reflexivity; symmetry; apply app_nil_r.
  - destruct l; cbn [unit_label]; try reflexivity.
    destruct direction; cbn [eval_label]; now rewrite IH.
Qed.

(** Program composition overlaps exactly one shared endpoint. Unlike label
    evaluation it can fail, and it never deletes a stuttering transition. *)
Definition overlap : trace -> trace -> trace -> Prop := @overlap_list state.

Definition compose (R T : trace -> Prop) (tr : trace) : Prop :=
  exists a b, R a /\ T b /\ overlap a b tr.

(** The base case is the successful true test, not a singleton identity
    trace. Thus even zero iterations record [s;s], and a positive finite
    unfolding ends in the final stutter supplied by its zero-power tail. *)
Fixpoint finite_power (R : trace -> Prop) (n : nat) (tr : trace) : Prop :=
  match n with
  | 0 => exists s, tr = [s; s]
  | S n => compose R (finite_power R n) tr
  end.

(** Both the suffix and the removed prefix are nonempty. Suffix modalities
    therefore move strictly forward, and cannot succeed on a singleton. *)
Definition proper_suffix (small big : trace) : Prop :=
  small <> [] /\ exists prefix, prefix <> [] /\ big = prefix ++ small.

(** Atoms inspect the first state. [First] restricts its entire body to that
    singleton. [Suffix a b] chooses a later suffix satisfying [b], requiring
    [a] at each strictly intermediate suffix, but not at the current trace.
    Its dual is expressed by negating the corresponding failure condition.
    Boxes/diamonds extend the current trace by whole program executions;
    they test their body on the accumulated trace, not only its final state. *)
(** These mutually recursive functions return propositions, not Boolean
    evaluation results. Every formula, even [Truth] and [Neg a], is false
    on the empty trace. Consequently Boolean and modal equivalences below
    explicitly assume nonemptiness. Tests observe their guard on [s;s];
    any quantifier behavior is supplied by an extension interpretation. *)
Fixpoint formula_holds (a : formula) (tr : trace) : Prop :=
  match tr with
  | [] => False
  | s :: tail =>
    match a with
    | Truth => True
    | Falsity => False
    | Atom p ts => interpret_atom M p ts s
    | BinaryAtom a b => interpret_binary_atom M a b s
    | Neg a => ~ formula_holds a tr
    | Conj a b => formula_holds a tr /\ formula_holds b tr
    | Disj a b => formula_holds a tr \/ formula_holds b tr
    | Impl a b => formula_holds a tr -> formula_holds b tr
    | Extension x a => interpret_extension M x (formula_holds a) tr
    | Coextension x a => interpret_coextension M x (formula_holds a) tr
    | First a => formula_holds a [s]
    | Suffix a b =>
        exists suffix, proper_suffix suffix tr /\ formula_holds b suffix /\
          forall middle, proper_suffix suffix middle -> proper_suffix middle tr -> formula_holds a middle
    | DualSuffix a b =>
        ~ (exists suffix, proper_suffix suffix tr /\ ~ formula_holds b suffix /\
          forall middle, proper_suffix suffix middle -> proper_suffix middle tr -> ~ formula_holds a middle)
    | Box p a => forall execution result,
        program_holds p execution -> overlap tr execution result -> formula_holds a result
    | Diamond p a => exists execution result,
        program_holds p execution /\ overlap tr execution result /\ formula_holds a result
    end
  end
with program_holds (p : program) (tr : trace) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | Atomic x t => interpret_atomic_trace M x t tr
  | Test a => exists s, tr = [s; s] /\ formula_holds a [s; s]
  | Seq a b => compose (program_holds a) (program_holds b) tr
  | Choice a b => program_holds a tr \/ program_holds b tr
  | Star a => exists n, finite_power (program_holds a) n tr
  end.

Definition labelled_holds w o : Prop :=
  label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label) /\
  formula_holds o.(occurrence_formula) (eval_label w o.(occurrence_label)).
Definition relation_admissible w r := Forall (label_admissible w) (relation_labels r).
(** Action relations require singleton endpoint labels, while custom
    relations receive the full evaluated argument traces. A longer label
    cannot be silently treated as an action's first or last state. *)
Definition relation_holds w r := match r with
  | ActionRelation action payload source target =>
      exists s t, eval_label w source = [s] /\ eval_label w target = [t] /\
        interpret_action M action payload s t
  | CustomRelation symbol arguments => interpret_relation M symbol (map (eval_label w) arguments)
  end.
Definition relations_hold w context := Forall (relation_holds w) context.
Definition admissible j w :=
  Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label)) (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)) /\
  Forall (relation_admissible w) j.(relations).
Definition left_holds w context := Forall (labelled_holds w) context.
Definition right_holds w context := exists o, In o context /\ labelled_holds w o.
(** Sequent truth is an implication under admissibility and relational
    assumptions: every antecedent must hold, and some succedent must hold.
    [Valid] quantifies over label environments for the fixed model [M].
    It does not quantify over all models; the module remains parameterized
    so the same proofs can be instantiated for each model. *)
Definition denote j w := admissible j w -> relations_hold w j.(relations) ->
  left_holds w j.(antecedent) -> right_holds w j.(succedent).
Definition Valid j := forall w, denote j w.
(** A single equality of evaluated labels transports all semantic layers:
    relations, labelled assertions, admissibility, then the whole sequent.
    This factors the common argument used by both sorts of substitution. *)
Lemma relation_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label w (f l) = eval_label w' l) -> forall r,
  relation_holds w (map_relation f r) <-> relation_holds w' r.
Proof.
  intros H [a p s t|symbol arguments]; cbn [relation_holds map_relation].
  - now rewrite !H.
  - rewrite map_map. assert (map (fun l => eval_label w (f l)) arguments = map (eval_label w') arguments) as ->.
    { apply map_ext; exact H. } reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma relation_admissible_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label w (f l) = eval_label w' l) -> forall r,
  relation_admissible w (map_relation f r) <-> relation_admissible w' r.
Proof.
  intros H r; unfold relation_admissible. assert (relation_labels (map_relation f r) = map f (relation_labels r)) as -> by (destruct r; reflexivity).
  rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall. unfold label_admissible. setoid_rewrite H; reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma labelled_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label w (f l) = eval_label w' l) -> forall o,
  (labelled_holds w (map_label_occurrence f o) <-> labelled_holds w' o).
Proof.
  intros H o; unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible; cbn [map_label_occurrence occurrence_label occurrence_formula].
  now rewrite H.
Qed.

Lemma denote_mapping f w w' :
  (forall l, eval_label w (f l) = eval_label w' l) -> forall j,
  (denote (map_labels f j) w <-> denote j w').
Proof.
  intros Hmap j.
  assert (forall context, Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label))
      (map (map_label_occurrence f) context) <->
      Forall (fun o => label_admissible w' o.(occurrence_label)) context) as Hadm.
  { intro context; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall.
    unfold label_admissible; cbn [map_label_occurrence occurrence_label].
    setoid_rewrite Hmap; reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, left_holds w (map (map_label_occurrence f) context) <-> left_holds w' context) as Hl.
  { intro context; unfold left_holds; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall.
    setoid_rewrite (labelled_mapping f w w' Hmap); reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, right_holds w (map (map_label_occurrence f) context) <-> right_holds w' context) as Hr.
  { intro context; unfold right_holds; setoid_rewrite in_map_iff; split.
    - intros [o [[original [Heq Hin]] Ho]]. subst o; exists original; split; [exact Hin|].
      apply (labelled_mapping f w w' Hmap); exact Ho.
    - intros [o [Hin Ho]]. exists (map_label_occurrence f o); split.
      + exists o; auto.
      + apply (labelled_mapping f w w' Hmap); exact Ho. }
  assert (relations_hold w (map (map_relation f) j.(relations)) <-> relations_hold w' j.(relations)) as Hrel.
  { unfold relations_hold; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall; setoid_rewrite (relation_mapping f w w' Hmap); reflexivity. }
  assert (Forall (relation_admissible w) (map (map_relation f) j.(relations)) <-> Forall (relation_admissible w') j.(relations)) as Hra.
  { rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall; setoid_rewrite (relation_admissible_mapping f w w' Hmap); reflexivity. }
  unfold denote, admissible; cbn [map_labels antecedent succedent relations].
  rewrite <- map_app, Hadm, Hl, Hr, Hrel, Hra; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Truth is insensitive to tag renaming or erasure. These equations alone
    do not justify cyclic trace routing: Rules.v separately proves how ranks
    follow an explicit renaming and checks uniqueness of the resulting tags. *)
Lemma denote_tag_renaming f j w : denote (rename_tags f j) w <-> denote j w.
Proof.
  assert (forall o, labelled_holds w (rename_occurrence_tag f o) <-> labelled_holds w o) as Ho by (intro o; reflexivity).
  assert (forall context, Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label))
      (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) context) <->
      Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label)) context) as Ha.
  { intro context; rewrite Forall_map; reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, left_holds w (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) context) <-> left_holds w context) as Hl.
  { intro context; unfold left_holds; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall; reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, right_holds w (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) context) <-> right_holds w context) as Hr.
  { intro context; unfold right_holds; setoid_rewrite in_map_iff; split.
    - intros [o [[original [Heq Hin]] Hholds]]; subst o; exists original; auto.
    - intros [o [Hin Hholds]]; exists (rename_occurrence_tag f o); split; [exists o; auto|exact Hholds]. }
  unfold denote, admissible; cbn [rename_tags antecedent succedent relations]; rewrite <- map_app, Ha, Hl, Hr; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma denote_erase_tags j w : denote (erase_tags j) w <-> denote j w.
Proof.
  assert (forall o, labelled_holds w (erase_tag o) <-> labelled_holds w o) as Ho by (intro o; reflexivity).
  assert (forall context, Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label))
      (map (erase_tag) context) <->
      Forall (fun o => label_admissible w o.(occurrence_label)) context) as Ha.
  { intro context; rewrite Forall_map; reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, left_holds w (map (erase_tag) context) <-> left_holds w context) as Hl.
  { intro context; unfold left_holds; rewrite Forall_map, !Forall_forall; reflexivity. }
  assert (forall context, right_holds w (map (erase_tag) context) <-> right_holds w context) as Hr.
  { intro context; unfold right_holds; setoid_rewrite in_map_iff; split.
    - intros [o [[original [Heq Hin]] Hholds]]; subst o; exists original; auto.
    - intros [o [Hin Hholds]]; exists (erase_tag o); split; [exists o; auto|exact Hholds]. }
  unfold denote, admissible; cbn [erase_tags antecedent succedent relations]; rewrite <- map_app, Ha, Hl, Hr; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma backlink_eqb_denote a b w : backlink_eqb a b = true -> (denote a w <-> denote b w).
Proof.
  unfold backlink_eqb; intro Heq; apply judgment_eqb_spec in Heq.
  rewrite <- (denote_erase_tags a w), <- (denote_erase_tags b w); now rewrite Heq.
Qed.

Lemma valid_admissible j : Valid j <-> forall w, admissible j w ->
  relations_hold w j.(relations) -> left_holds w j.(antecedent) -> right_holds w j.(succedent).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma false_relations j w : ~ denote j w -> relations_hold w j.(relations).
Proof. unfold denote; tauto. Qed.
(** Classically, failure of the implication exposes a countermodel: labels
    are admissible, relational assumptions and antecedents hold, and every
    succedent is false. Rules.v repeatedly uses this decomposition when
    sending a countermodel backward to a premise. *)
Lemma false_sequent j w : ~ denote j w ->
  admissible j w /\ left_holds w j.(antecedent) /\
  forall o, In o j.(succedent) -> ~ labelled_holds w o.
Proof.
  unfold denote, right_holds; intros H.
  assert (admissible j w) as Ha by tauto.
  assert (relations_hold w j.(relations)) as Hrel by tauto.
  assert (left_holds w j.(antecedent)) as Hl by tauto.
  split; [exact Ha|]. split; [exact Hl|].
  intros o Hin Ho. apply H; intros _ _ _; exists o; auto.
Qed.
Lemma judgment_wfb_admissible j w : judgment_wfb j = true -> admissible j w.
Proof.
  unfold judgment_wfb, admissible; rewrite !andb_true_iff.
  intros [[[Hrelations Hl] Hr] _]; split.
  - apply Forall_app; split; apply Forall_forall;
      intros o Hin; [apply forallb_forall with (x:=o) in Hl | apply forallb_forall with (x:=o) in Hr];
      try assumption; unfold occurrence_wfb in *;
      repeat match goal with H : _ && _ = true |- _ => apply andb_true_iff in H as [H ?] end;
      apply label_nonemptyb_spec; assumption.
  - apply Forall_forall; intros r Hin.
    apply (proj1 (forallb_forall _ _) Hrelations r) in Hin.
    unfold relation_wfb in Hin; apply andb_true_iff in Hin as [_ Hlabels].
    unfold relation_admissible; apply Forall_forall; intros l Hmember.
    apply (proj1 (forallb_forall _ _) Hlabels l) in Hmember.
    apply andb_true_iff in Hmember as [_ Hne]; apply label_nonemptyb_spec; exact Hne.
Qed.
Lemma overlap_nonempty a b c : overlap a b c -> a <> [] /\ b <> [] /\ c <> [].
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]].
  repeat split; try discriminate; intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_length a b c : overlap a b c -> length c + 1 = length a + length b.
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]]. rewrite !length_app. cbn; lia.
Qed.

Lemma finite_power_length R :
  (forall tr, R tr -> 2 <= length tr) ->
  forall n tr, finite_power R n tr -> 2 <= length tr.
Proof.
  intros HR n; induction n; intros tr H.
  - destruct H as [s ->]; cbn; lia.
  - destruct H as [a [b [Ha [Hb Ho]]]].
    specialize (HR a Ha). specialize (IHn b Hb).
    pose proof (overlap_length a b tr Ho). lia.
Qed.

(** Every execution contains at least one transition, including tests and
    star-zero stutters. Overlap merges a shared state, not that transition.
    Progress.v relies on this fact when constructing execution histories. *)
Lemma program_length p : forall tr, program_holds p tr -> 2 <= length tr.
Proof.
  induction p; intros tr H; cbn [program_holds] in H.
  - apply atomic_trace_law in H. destruct H as [s [next [-> _]]]; cbn; lia.
  - destruct H as [s [-> _]]; cbn; lia.
  - destruct H as [a [b [Ha [Hb Ho]]]].
    specialize (IHp1 a Ha). specialize (IHp2 b Hb).
    pose proof (overlap_length a b tr Ho). lia.
  - destruct H; [apply IHp1 | apply IHp2]; assumption.
  - destruct H as [n H]; eapply finite_power_length; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma overlap_snoc prefix s start rest result :
  overlap (prefix ++ [s]) (start :: rest) result <->
  start = s /\ result = (prefix ++ [s]) ++ rest.
Proof. apply overlap_list_snoc. Qed.

(** Semantic equations for test rules. Splitting the current trace as
    [prefix ++ [s]] exposes its last state. A successful test appends one
    more [s], retaining the stutter in the accumulated trace. Boxes require
    the body when the guard holds; diamonds require both guard and body. *)
Lemma box_test prefix s guard a :
  formula_holds (Box (Test guard) a) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  (formula_holds guard [s;s] -> formula_holds a ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s])).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds]. split.
  - intros H Hg; eapply H.
    + exists s; auto.
    + rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto.
  - intros H execution result [start [-> Hg]] Ho.
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->]. rewrite Htr; auto.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_test prefix s guard a :
  formula_holds (Diamond (Test guard) a) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  formula_holds guard [s;s] /\ formula_holds a ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [s]).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds]. split.
  - intros [execution [result [[start [-> Hg]] [Ho Ha]]]].
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho. apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->]. rewrite <- Htr; auto.
  - intros [Hg Ha]; exists [s;s], ((head :: tail) ++ [s]); split; [exists s; auto|].
    split; [rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Ha].
Qed.

(** Reassociating overlapping executions turns sequence into nested boxes.
    Choice becomes conjunction for boxes and disjunction for diamonds. The
    star equations unfold an arbitrary finite power into its zero case or
    one execution followed by a smaller finite power. *)
Lemma box_sequence a b body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Box (Seq a b) body) tr <-> formula_holds (Box a (Box b body)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intros H execution middle Ha Ho.
    destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hmiddle]].
    destruct middle as [|m rest]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds].
    intros execution' result Hb Ho'.
    assert (exists both, overlap_list execution execution' both /\ overlap_list (s :: tail) both result) as Hcombined.
    { apply overlap_list_assoc; exists (m :: rest); auto. }
    destruct Hcombined as [both [Hboth Hresult]]. eapply H; [|exact Hresult].
    exists execution, execution'; auto.
  - intros H execution result [first [second [Ha [Hb Hexecution]]]] Ho.
    assert (exists middle, overlap_list (s :: tail) first middle /\ overlap_list middle second result) as Hmiddle.
    { apply overlap_list_assoc; exists execution; auto. }
    destruct Hmiddle as [middle [Ho1 Ho2]]. specialize (H first middle Ha Ho1).
    destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho1) as [_ [_ Hne']].
    destruct middle; [contradiction|]. eapply H; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma box_choice a b body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Box (Choice a b) body) tr <->
   formula_holds (Box a body) tr /\ formula_holds (Box b body) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intro H; split; intros execution result Hp Ho; eapply H; eauto.
  - intros [Ha Hb] execution result [Hp|Hp] Ho; [eapply Ha|eapply Hb]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma box_star a body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Box (Star a) body) tr <->
   formula_holds (Box (Test Truth) body) tr /\ formula_holds (Box a (Box (Star a) body)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne. rewrite <- box_sequence by exact Hne.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intro H; split.
    + intros execution result [start [-> _]] Ho. eapply H; [exists 0, start; reflexivity|exact Ho].
    + intros execution result [first [second [Ha [[n Hn] Hex]]]] Ho.
      apply (H execution result); [exists (S n), first, second; auto|exact Ho].
  - intros [H0 HS] execution result [n Hn] Ho. destruct n.
    + destruct Hn as [start ->]. eapply H0; [exists start; auto|exact Ho].
    + destruct Hn as [first [second [Ha [Hn Hex]]]].
      eapply HS; [exists first, second; split; [exact Ha|]; split; [exists n; exact Hn|exact Hex]|exact Ho].
Qed.

Lemma diamond_sequence a b body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Diamond (Seq a b) body) tr <-> formula_holds (Diamond a (Diamond b body)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intros [execution [result [[first [second [Ha [Hb Hexecution]]]] [Ho Hbody]]]].
    assert (exists middle, overlap_list (s :: tail) first middle /\ overlap_list middle second result) as Hmiddle.
    { apply overlap_list_assoc; exists execution; auto. }
    destruct Hmiddle as [middle [Ho1 Ho2]]. exists first, middle; split; [exact Ha|].
    split; [exact Ho1|]. destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho1) as [_ [_ Hne']].
    destruct middle as [|m rest]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds].
    exists second, result; auto.
  - intros [first [middle [Ha [Ho1 Hbody]]]].
    destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho1) as [_ [_ Hne']].
    destruct middle as [|m rest]; [contradiction|].
    destruct Hbody as [second [result [Hb [Ho2 Hbody]]]].
    assert (exists execution, overlap_list first second execution /\ overlap_list (s :: tail) execution result) as Hexecution.
    { apply overlap_list_assoc; exists (m :: rest); auto. }
    destruct Hexecution as [execution [Hex Ho]]. exists execution, result; split; [|auto].
    exists first, second; auto.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_choice a b body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Diamond (Choice a b) body) tr <->
   formula_holds (Diamond a body) tr \/ formula_holds (Diamond b body) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intros [execution [result [[Ha|Hb] [Ho Hbody]]]];
      [left|right]; exists execution, result; auto.
  - intros [[execution [result [Hp [Ho Hbody]]]]|[execution [result [Hp [Ho Hbody]]]]];
      exists execution, result; split; [now left|auto|now right|auto].
Qed.

Lemma diamond_star a body tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Diamond (Star a) body) tr <->
   formula_holds (Diamond (Test Truth) body) tr \/ formula_holds (Diamond a (Diamond (Star a) body)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; rewrite <- diamond_sequence by exact Hne.
  destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds program_holds].
  split.
  - intros [execution [result [[n Hn] [Ho Hbody]]]]. destruct n.
    + left; exists execution, result; split; [|auto]. destruct Hn as [start ->]; exists start; auto.
    + right; exists execution, result; split; [|auto].
      destruct Hn as [first [second [Ha [Hn Hex]]]].
      exists first, second; split; [exact Ha|]; split; [exists n; exact Hn|exact Hex].
  - intros [[execution [result [[start [-> _]] [Ho Hbody]]]]|
      [execution [result [[first [second [Ha [[n Hn] Hex]]]] [Ho Hbody]]]]].
    + exists [start;start], result; split; [exists 0, start; reflexivity|auto].
    + exists execution, result; split; [|auto]. exists (S n), first, second; auto.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_dual p a tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Diamond p a) tr <-> ~ formula_holds (Box p (Neg a)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds].
  split.
  - intros [execution [result [Hp [Ho Ha]]]] Hbox.
    specialize (Hbox execution result Hp Ho).
    destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hresult]].
    destruct result; [contradiction|]. exact (Hbox Ha).
  - intro Hbox; apply not_all_ex_not in Hbox as [execution Hbox].
    apply not_all_ex_not in Hbox as [result Hbox].
    assert (program_holds p execution /\ overlap (s :: tail) execution result /\
      ~ formula_holds (Neg a) result) as [Hp [Ho Hbad]] by tauto.
    exists execution, result; split; [exact Hp|]; split; [exact Ho|].
    destruct (overlap_nonempty _ _ _ Ho) as [_ [_ Hresult]].
    destruct result; [contradiction|]. cbn [formula_holds] in Hbad; tauto.
Qed.

(** Instantiate the test equations at evaluated labels. These forms match
    the literal label trees in RULE_EXPANSIONS.md, including both copies of
    a test state. Tags may differ because they do not affect truth. *)
Lemma box_test_label w sigma u guard body ta tb tg :
  labelled_holds w (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Box (Test guard) body) ta) <->
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard tg) ->
   labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body tb)).
Proof.
  unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label].
  rewrite box_test.
  assert (eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u]) ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H'; apply app_eq_nil in H'; destruct H'; discriminate).
  intuition discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma diamond_test_label w sigma u guard body ta tb tg :
  labelled_holds w (Occ (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (Diamond (Test guard) body) ta) <->
  labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)) guard tg) /\
  labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (Join sigma (StateLabel u)) (StateLabel u)) body tb).
Proof.
  unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label].
  rewrite diamond_test.
  assert (eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  assert ((eval_label w sigma ++ [eval_update w u]) ++ [eval_update w u] <> []) by
    (intro H'; apply app_eq_nil in H'; destruct H'; discriminate).
  intuition discriminate.
Qed.

(** [First] permits an arbitrary compound body at the singleton head.
    [atom_head_label] below establishes the same reduction without [First]
    only for the two atomic shapes. Extending that result to all [pureb]
    formulas requires laws about an instance's extension interpretations. *)
Lemma first_label w u sigma body tag tag' :
  labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (First body) tag) <->
  labelled_holds w (Occ (StateLabel u) body tag').
Proof.
  unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible; cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label formula_holds].
  split; intros [_ H]; split; try discriminate; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma atom_head_label w u sigma body tag tag' :
  (match body with Atom _ _ | BinaryAtom _ _ => true | _ => false end) = true ->
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) body tag) <->
   labelled_holds w (Occ (StateLabel u) body tag')).
Proof.
  destruct body; intro H; try discriminate;
    unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible;
    cbn [occurrence_label occurrence_formula eval_label formula_holds];
    split; intros [_ Hp]; split; try discriminate; exact Hp.
Qed.
Lemma proper_suffix_length a b : proper_suffix a b -> length a < length b.
Proof.
  intros [_ [prefix [Hp ->]]]. rewrite length_app.
  destruct prefix; [contradiction | cbn; lia].
Qed.

Lemma proper_suffix_step small s tail :
  proper_suffix small (s :: tail) <->
  (small = tail /\ tail <> []) \/ proper_suffix small tail.
Proof.
  split.
  - intros [Hne [prefix [Hp Heq]]]. destruct prefix as [|x prefix]; [contradiction|].
    cbn in Heq; injection Heq as Hsx Htail; subst x.
    destruct prefix as [|y prefix].
    + cbn in Htail; left; split; [symmetry; exact Htail|now rewrite Htail].
    + right; split; [exact Hne|]. exists (y :: prefix); split; [discriminate|exact Htail].
  - intros [[-> Hne]|[Hne [prefix [Hp ->]]]].
    + split; [exact Hne|]. exists [s]; split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
    + split; [exact Hne|]. exists (s :: prefix); split; [discriminate|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma proper_suffix_trans small middle big :
  proper_suffix small middle -> proper_suffix middle big -> proper_suffix small big.
Proof.
  intros [Hsmall [p [Hp ->]]] [_ [q [Hq ->]]].
  split; [exact Hsmall|]. exists (q ++ p); split.
  - intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; tauto.
  - apply app_assoc.
Qed.

Lemma suffix_clause a b tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Suffix a b) tr <->
    exists suffix, proper_suffix suffix tr /\ formula_holds b suffix /\
      forall middle, proper_suffix suffix middle -> proper_suffix middle tr -> formula_holds a middle).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.

(** One-state suffix unfolding: either [b] holds on the immediate tail, or
    [a] holds there and the same suffix obligation continues on that tail.
    The initial head state has no [a] obligation. The nonempty-tail premise
    separates this recurrence from the singleton boundary lemmas below. *)
Lemma suffix_step s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Suffix a b) (s :: tail) <->
   formula_holds b tail \/ (formula_holds a tail /\ formula_holds (Suffix a b) tail)).
Proof.
  intro Hne. rewrite (suffix_clause a b tail Hne).
  cbn [formula_holds]. split.
  - intros [small [Hsmall [Hb Ha]]].
    apply proper_suffix_step in Hsmall as [[-> _]|Hproper]; [now left|].
    right; split.
    + apply (Ha tail); [exact Hproper|]. apply proper_suffix_step; auto.
    + exists small; split; [exact Hproper|]; split; [exact Hb|].
      intros middle Hsm Hmt. apply Ha; [exact Hsm|].
      apply proper_suffix_step; now right.
  - intros [Hb|[Ha [small [Hproper [Hb Hmiddle]]]]].
    + exists tail; split; [apply proper_suffix_step; auto|]. split; [exact Hb|].
      intros middle Htm Hms.
      pose proof (proper_suffix_length _ _ Htm).
      pose proof (proper_suffix_length _ _ Hms). cbn in *; lia.
    + exists small; split; [apply proper_suffix_step; now right|]. split; [exact Hb|].
      intros middle Hsm Hms. apply proper_suffix_step in Hms as [[-> _]|Hmt];
        [exact Ha|eapply Hmiddle; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma nonempty_neg a tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (Neg a) tr <-> ~ formula_holds a tr).
Proof. destruct tr; cbn; tauto. Qed.

(** Make the negated dual definition usable as a rule equation; its later
    one-step law is obtained from suffix unfolding and classical logic. *)
Lemma dual_suffix_dual a b tr : tr <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) tr <-> ~ formula_holds (Suffix (Neg a) (Neg b)) tr).
Proof.
  intro Hne; destruct tr as [|s tail]; [contradiction|]; cbn [formula_holds].
  assert ((exists small, proper_suffix small (s :: tail) /\ ~ formula_holds b small /\
    forall middle, proper_suffix small middle -> proper_suffix middle (s :: tail) -> ~ formula_holds a middle) <->
    (exists small, proper_suffix small (s :: tail) /\ formula_holds (Neg b) small /\
    forall middle, proper_suffix small middle -> proper_suffix middle (s :: tail) -> formula_holds (Neg a) middle)) as H.
  { split; intros [small [Hp [Hb Ha]]]; exists small; split; [exact Hp| |exact Hp|].
    - split; [apply nonempty_neg; [exact (proj1 Hp)|exact Hb]|].
      intros middle Hsm Hmt; apply nonempty_neg; [exact (proj1 Hmt)|eauto].
    - split; [apply nonempty_neg in Hb; [exact Hb|exact (proj1 Hp)]|].
      intros middle Hsm Hmt; specialize (Ha middle Hsm Hmt).
      apply nonempty_neg in Ha; [exact Ha|exact (proj1 Hmt)]. }
  tauto.
Qed.

Lemma dual_suffix_step s tail a b : tail <> [] ->
  (formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) (s :: tail) <->
   formula_holds b tail /\ (formula_holds a tail \/ formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) tail)).
Proof.
  intro Hne. rewrite dual_suffix_dual by discriminate.
  rewrite suffix_step by exact Hne.
  rewrite !nonempty_neg by exact Hne.
  rewrite (dual_suffix_dual a b tail Hne). tauto.
Qed.

Lemma suffix_label w u sigma a b ta tb tc td : label_nonemptyb sigma = true ->
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (Suffix a b) ta) <->
    labelled_holds w (Occ sigma b tb) \/
    (labelled_holds w (Occ sigma a tc) /\ labelled_holds w (Occ sigma (Suffix a b) td))).
Proof.
  intro Hnonempty; apply (label_nonemptyb_spec w sigma) in Hnonempty.
  unfold label_admissible in Hnonempty.
  change (((eval_update w u :: eval_label w sigma) <> [] /\
    formula_holds (Suffix a b) (eval_update w u :: eval_label w sigma)) <->
    (eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds b (eval_label w sigma)) \/
    ((eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds a (eval_label w sigma)) /\
     (eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds (Suffix a b) (eval_label w sigma)))).
  rewrite suffix_step by exact Hnonempty. intuition discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma dual_suffix_label w u sigma a b ta tb tc td : label_nonemptyb sigma = true ->
  (labelled_holds w (Occ (Join (StateLabel u) sigma) (DualSuffix a b) ta) <->
    labelled_holds w (Occ sigma b tb) /\
    (labelled_holds w (Occ sigma a tc) \/ labelled_holds w (Occ sigma (DualSuffix a b) td))).
Proof.
  intro Hnonempty; apply (label_nonemptyb_spec w sigma) in Hnonempty.
  unfold label_admissible in Hnonempty.
  change (((eval_update w u :: eval_label w sigma) <> [] /\
    formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) (eval_update w u :: eval_label w sigma)) <->
    (eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds b (eval_label w sigma)) /\
    ((eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds a (eval_label w sigma)) \/
     (eval_label w sigma <> [] /\ formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) (eval_label w sigma)))).
  rewrite dual_suffix_step by exact Hnonempty. intuition discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma no_singleton_suffix s suffix : ~ proper_suffix suffix [s].
Proof.
  intro H. pose proof (proper_suffix_length _ _ H).
  destruct H as [Hne _]. destruct suffix; [contradiction | cbn in *; lia].
Qed.

Lemma suffix_singleton a b s : ~ formula_holds (Suffix a b) [s].
Proof. cbn; intros [suffix [Hp _]]; now apply (no_singleton_suffix s suffix). Qed.

Lemma next_singleton a s : ~ formula_holds (Next a) [s].
Proof. apply suffix_singleton. Qed.

Lemma dual_suffix_singleton a b s : formula_holds (DualSuffix a b) [s].
Proof. cbn; intros [suffix [Hp _]]; now apply (no_singleton_suffix s suffix). Qed.

(** ** Fresh world-label environments

    Updating a fresh world name changes how labels are interpreted, without
    rewriting semantic states or formula payloads. The support law shows
    that existing labels keep exactly the same traces. Hence even modal
    formulas keep their meanings without any transformation of executions.
    [eval_fresh_name] then lets an atomic rule name a chosen successor. *)
Lemma eval_update_fresh w x value u : ~ In x (L.world_support u) ->
  eval_update (replace_world w x value) u = eval_update w u.
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; unfold eval_update; apply world_support_law.
  intros y Hin; cbn [replace_world world_mapping].
  destruct (Nat.eqb x y) eqn:Heq; [apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq; subst; contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.
Lemma eval_label_fresh w x value l : ~ In x (label_world_names l) ->
  eval_label (replace_world w x value) l = eval_label w l.
Proof.
  induction l; intro Hfresh; cbn [eval_label]; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite eval_update_fresh; [reflexivity|exact Hfresh].
  - rewrite IHl1, IHl2; try reflexivity; intro H; apply Hfresh; apply in_app_iff; auto.
Qed.
Lemma eval_fresh_name w x value :
  eval_update (replace_world w x value) (L.world_name x) = value.
Proof.
  unfold eval_update; rewrite world_name_law; cbn [replace_world world_mapping]; now rewrite Nat.eqb_refl.
Qed.
Lemma fresh_occurrence j x o : world_freshb x j = true ->
  In o (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)) -> ~ In x (label_world_names o.(occurrence_label)).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh Hin Hbad; apply world_freshb_spec in Hfresh; apply Hfresh.
  unfold judgment_world_names; apply in_app_iff; right; apply in_flat_map; exists o; auto.
Qed.
Lemma fresh_relation_label j x r l : world_freshb x j = true ->
  In r j.(relations) -> In l (relation_labels r) -> ~ In x (label_world_names l).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh Hr Hl Hbad; apply world_freshb_spec in Hfresh; apply Hfresh.
  unfold judgment_world_names; apply in_app_iff; left; apply in_flat_map; exists r; split; [exact Hr|].
  apply in_flat_map; exists l; auto.
Qed.
Lemma labelled_fresh w x value o : ~ In x (label_world_names o.(occurrence_label)) ->
  (labelled_holds (replace_world w x value) o <-> labelled_holds w o).
Proof. intro H; unfold labelled_holds, label_admissible; now rewrite eval_label_fresh. Qed.
Lemma relation_fresh w x value r :
  (forall l, In l (relation_labels r) -> ~ In x (label_world_names l)) ->
  (relation_holds (replace_world w x value) r <-> relation_holds w r).
Proof.
  destruct r as [a p source target|symbol args]; intro H; cbn [relation_holds].
  - rewrite !eval_label_fresh; try reflexivity; apply H; cbn; auto.
  - assert (map (eval_label (replace_world w x value)) args = map (eval_label w) args) as ->.
    { apply map_ext_in; intros l Hin; apply eval_label_fresh, H; exact Hin. }
    reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma relations_fresh j w x value : world_freshb x j = true ->
  (relations_hold (replace_world w x value) j.(relations) <-> relations_hold w j.(relations)).
Proof.
  intro Hfresh; unfold relations_hold; rewrite !Forall_forall.
  split; intros H r Hin; specialize (H r Hin);
    assert (forall l, In l (relation_labels r) -> ~ In x (label_world_names l)) as Hlabels
      by (intros l Hl; eapply fresh_relation_label; eauto);
    apply (relation_fresh w x value r Hlabels); exact H.
Qed.
(** Atomic modalities quantify over successors of the current last state.
    The atomic-trace law and [overlap_snoc] eliminate the execution/result
    witnesses. These equations are the common semantic basis of all four
    atomic-action rules; no unique successor is assumed. *)
Lemma box_atomic prefix s action payload body :
  formula_holds (Box (Atomic action payload) body) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  forall next, interpret_action M action payload s next ->
    formula_holds body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds]; split.
  - intros H next Hstep; eapply H.
    + cbn [program_holds]; apply atomic_trace_law; exists s, next; auto.
    + rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto.
  - intros H execution result Hp Ho.
    cbn [program_holds] in Hp; apply atomic_trace_law in Hp.
    destruct Hp as [start [next [-> Hstep]]].
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho; apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    rewrite Htr; apply H; exact Hstep.
Qed.
Lemma diamond_atomic prefix s action payload body :
  formula_holds (Diamond (Atomic action payload) body) (prefix ++ [s]) <->
  exists next, interpret_action M action payload s next /\
    formula_holds body ((prefix ++ [s]) ++ [next]).
Proof.
  assert (prefix ++ [s] <> []) as Hne by (intro H; apply app_eq_nil in H; destruct H; discriminate).
  destruct (prefix ++ [s]) as [|head tail] eqn:Htr; [contradiction|].
  cbn [formula_holds]; split.
  - intros [execution [result [Hp [Ho Hbody]]]].
    cbn [program_holds] in Hp; apply atomic_trace_law in Hp.
    destruct Hp as [start [next [-> Hstep]]].
    rewrite <- Htr in Ho; apply overlap_snoc in Ho as [-> ->].
    exists next; split; [exact Hstep|]. rewrite Htr in Hbody; exact Hbody.
  - intros [next [Hstep Hbody]].
    exists [s;next], ((head::tail) ++ [next]); split.
    + cbn [program_holds]; apply atomic_trace_law; exists s, next; auto.
    + split; [rewrite <- Htr; apply overlap_snoc; auto|exact Hbody].
Qed.

End Interpretation.
Module Type INTERPRETATION.
  Parameter interpretation : model.
End INTERPRETATION.
End MakeSemantics.
Module Type SEMANTICS (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L).
  Include MakeSemantics L Syn.
End SEMANTICS.
Signature.v:
(** * Parameters of labelled process logic

    A language supplies only reified data and executable syntax checks.
    Semantic truth and state equality are deliberately absent here.

    Two atomic/extension slots preserve the existing first-order constructor
    interface without imposing first-order meanings on the shared theory.
    Plain PPL uses the first atomic slot, no extension tokens, and a unit
    action payload. Structured languages may use every slot. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List.

Module Type LANGUAGE.
  (** This module type is the syntactic interface that an instance implements.
      An [argument] belongs to an atom; an [action_argument] belongs to an
      atomic program; a [world_term] names a state in a label. Keeping these
      types separate prevents substitutions from mixing their roles. *)
  Parameter atom_symbol argument binder action_symbol action_argument world_term relation_symbol : Type.
  (** [{x=y}+{x<>y}] is a decision carrying a proof in either branch. These
      decisions let later checkers compare syntax without deciding whether
      any proposition holds in a semantic state. *)
  Parameter atom_eq_dec : forall x y : atom_symbol, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter argument_eq_dec : forall x y : argument, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter binder_eq_dec : forall x y : binder, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter action_eq_dec : forall x y : action_symbol, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter action_argument_eq_dec : forall x y : action_argument, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter world_term_eq_dec : forall x y : world_term, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  Parameter relation_eq_dec : forall x y : relation_symbol, {x=y}+{x<>y}.
  (** Checks ending in [wfb] return Booleans for use by executable generators.
      Atom/action checks validate payloads. Extension checks receive the
      body's [pureb] result, and custom relations receive their arity. The
      shared syntax checker separately checks all recursive children. *)
  Parameter atom_wfb : atom_symbol -> list argument -> bool.
  Parameter binary_atom_wfb : argument -> argument -> bool.
  Parameter extension_wfb coextension_wfb : binder -> bool -> bool.
  Parameter action_wfb : action_symbol -> action_argument -> bool.
  Parameter world_term_wfb : world_term -> bool.
  Parameter custom_relation_wfb : relation_symbol -> nat -> bool.
  (** [world_name x] embeds a bare name into the instance's world terms.
      [world_support u] lists names on which [u] may depend; it is used for
      eigenvariable freshness. [subst_world x replacement u] substitutes in
      [u]. Semantics.v requires interpretation laws connecting these three
      syntactic operations to environment lookup and update. *)
  Parameter world_name : nat -> world_term.
  Parameter world_support : world_term -> list nat.
  Parameter subst_world : nat -> world_term -> world_term -> world_term.
End LANGUAGE.
Syntax.v:
(** * Shared reified syntax, independent of any first-order theory.

    Atom payloads, action payloads, extension tokens, world terms and custom
    relation symbols come from LANGUAGE. Extensions have recursive children;
    they are not opaque semantic atoms. Exact equality includes relations and
    tags. World and trace names occupy different fields, even though their
    default representation is nat. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Arith Lia.
From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature.
Import ListNotations.
Module MakeSyntax (L : LANGUAGE).
(** Formulas contain programs in modalities; programs contain formulas in
    tests. The mutual definition permits both kinds of nesting. [Extension]
    and [Coextension] receive meanings from an instance, so their names alone
    do not make them quantifiers in this generic module. *)
Inductive formula : Type :=
| Truth | Falsity
| Atom (p : L.atom_symbol) (args : list L.argument)
| BinaryAtom (a b : L.argument)
| Neg (a : formula)
| Conj (a b : formula)
| Disj (a b : formula)
| Impl (a b : formula)
| Extension (x : L.binder) (body : formula)
| Coextension (x : L.binder) (body : formula)
| First (a : formula)
| Suffix (a b : formula)
| DualSuffix (a b : formula)
| Box (p : program) (a : formula)
| Diamond (p : program) (a : formula)
with program : Type :=
| Atomic (x : L.action_symbol) (value : L.action_argument)
| Test (guard : formula)
| Seq (a b : program)
| Choice (a b : program)
| Star (body : program).

(** A combined induction principle supplies hypotheses for both syntax
    trees. It is needed when a property crosses from a modality into its
    program and then back into a test formula. *)
Scheme formula_mut := Induction for formula Sort Prop
  with program_mut := Induction for program Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme formula_program_mutind from formula_mut, program_mut.

(** [decide equality] handles constructors; recursive calls and LANGUAGE's
    decisions handle their fields. [Defined] keeps these decisions reducible
    so Boolean checkers can compute with them. *)
Fixpoint formula_eq_dec (a b : formula) : {a = b} + {a <> b}
with program_eq_dec (a b : program) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof.
  - decide equality; try apply formula_eq_dec; try apply program_eq_dec;
      try apply L.argument_eq_dec; try apply L.binder_eq_dec; try apply L.atom_eq_dec.
    apply list_eq_dec; exact L.argument_eq_dec.
  - decide equality; try apply program_eq_dec; try apply formula_eq_dec;
      try apply L.action_argument_eq_dec; apply L.action_eq_dec.
Defined.

(** Purity here means membership in a syntactic nonmodal fragment. It does
    not by itself prove that a formula observes only the first state:
    extension interpretations are arbitrary until an instance supplies laws. *)
Fixpoint pureb (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity | Atom _ _ | BinaryAtom _ _ => true
  | Neg a | Extension _ a | Coextension _ a => pureb a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b => pureb a && pureb b
  | _ => false
  end.

(** Extension tokens select their own body policy. The checker supplies
    the nonmodal-fragment bit to that policy; FOPL requires it to be true. *)
Fixpoint formula_wfb (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with
  | Truth | Falsity => true
  | Atom p ts => L.atom_wfb p ts
  | BinaryAtom a b => L.binary_atom_wfb a b
  | Neg a | First a => formula_wfb a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b =>
      formula_wfb a && formula_wfb b
  | Extension x a => L.extension_wfb x (pureb a) && formula_wfb a
  | Coextension x a => L.coextension_wfb x (pureb a) && formula_wfb a
  | Box p a | Diamond p a => program_wfb p && formula_wfb a
  end
with program_wfb (p : program) : bool :=
  match p with
  | Atomic x t => L.action_wfb x t
  | Test a => formula_wfb a
  | Seq a b | Choice a b => program_wfb a && program_wfb b
  | Star a => program_wfb a
  end.

(** One greater than the largest used number is fresh, including when the
    list is empty. The same helper serves world names and occurrence tags;
    callers supply the list belonging to the intended namespace. *)
Definition fresh_name (names : list nat) := Datatypes.S (fold_right Nat.max 0 names).

Lemma occursb_false x names : existsb (Nat.eqb x) names = false <-> ~ In x names.
Proof.
  rewrite <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists. split.
  - intros H Hin; apply H; exists x; split; [exact Hin|apply Nat.eqb_refl].
  - intros H [y [Hin Heq]]; apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq; subst; contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_name_not_in names : ~ In (fresh_name names) names.
Proof.
  assert (forall x, In x names -> x <= fold_right Nat.max 0 names) as Hbound.
  { induction names as [|a names IH]; cbn; [tauto|].
    intros x [->|Hin]; [apply Nat.le_max_l|]. eapply Nat.le_trans; [apply IH; exact Hin|apply Nat.le_max_r]. }
  intro Hin; specialize (Hbound _ Hin); unfold fresh_name in Hbound; lia.
Qed.

(** Derived temporal notation, using the strict suffix semantics. [Next]
    selects the immediate nonempty tail because [Falsity] rules out any
    intermediate suffix. [Eventually] also allows the current trace. *)
Definition Next a := Suffix Falsity a.
Definition Eventually a := Disj a (Suffix Truth a).
Definition Always a := Neg (Eventually (Neg a)).

(** Labels are trees describing state lists. [Join] is plain concatenation:
    [Join (StateLabel u) (StateLabel u)] records two copies of the state.
    [StateLabel] and [TraceLabel] use separate environments, so the same
    numeric name may safely occur in both sorts. *)
Inductive label : Type :=
| Empty
| StateLabel (u : L.world_term)
| TraceLabel (trace_variable : nat)
| Join (a b : label).

Fixpoint label_eq_dec (a b : label) : {a = b} + {a <> b}.
Proof. decide equality; try apply L.world_term_eq_dec; apply Nat.eq_dec. Defined.

Fixpoint label_wfb (l : label) : bool :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => L.world_term_wfb u
  | Join a b => label_wfb a && label_wfb b
  | _ => true
  end.

(** A join is nonempty when either component is nonempty. Empty components
    are valid units; only an empty complete assertion label is forbidden.
    Trace variables are nonempty because semantic worlds carry that proof. *)
Fixpoint label_nonemptyb (l : label) : bool :=
  match l with
  | Empty => false
  | StateLabel _ | TraceLabel _ => true
  | Join a b => label_nonemptyb a || label_nonemptyb b
  end.

(** World substitution enters only world terms; trace substitution replaces
    only whole trace variables. Neither operation changes formula payloads.
    Relations and contexts are handled later by mapping these operations
    over every label in a judgment. *)
Fixpoint subst_world_label (x : nat) (replacement : L.world_term) (l : label) : label :=
  match l with
  | StateLabel u => StateLabel (L.subst_world x replacement u)
  | Join a b => Join (subst_world_label x replacement a) (subst_world_label x replacement b)
  | _ => l
  end.

Fixpoint subst_trace_label (x : nat) (replacement l : label) : label :=
  match l with
  | TraceLabel y => if Nat.eqb x y then replacement else l
  | Join a b => Join (subst_trace_label x replacement a) (subst_trace_label x replacement b)
  | _ => l
  end.

(** Explicit label algebra, with a caller-selected path: [false] descends
    left, [true] descends right. At the selected node, [left = true] groups
    to the left. An inapplicable path/rotation leaves the relevant syntax
    unchanged. These operations perform no normalization search. *)
Fixpoint rotate_label (path : list bool) (left : bool) (l : label) : label :=
  match path with
  | [] => if left then
      match l with Join a (Join b c) => Join (Join a b) c | _ => l end
    else match l with Join (Join a b) c => Join a (Join b c) | _ => l end
  | direction :: path => match l with
    | Join a b => if direction then Join a (rotate_label path left b)
        else Join (rotate_label path left a) b
    | _ => l end
  end.

(** Use the same paths to insert or remove an explicit [Empty] component.
    Semantics.v proves that both label-algebra operations preserve evaluation. *)
Fixpoint unit_label (path : list bool) (on_left insert : bool) (l : label) : label :=
  match path with
  | [] => if insert then if on_left then Join Empty l else Join l Empty
      else if on_left then match l with Join Empty a => a | _ => l end
      else match l with Join a Empty => a | _ => l end
  | direction :: path => match l with
    | Join a b => if direction then Join a (unit_label path on_left insert b)
        else Join (unit_label path on_left insert a) b
    | _ => l end
  end.

(** These are the only formula shapes allowed to carry cyclic trace tags.
    This policy concerns proof progress, separately from formula truth. *)
Definition traceableb (a : formula) : bool :=
  match a with Box _ _ | Suffix _ _ | DualSuffix _ _ => true | _ => false end.

(** Tags are proof metadata: Semantics.v ignores them when interpreting
    truth, while Progress.v uses them to find the occurrence whose rank is
    followed. Distinct copies of the same labelled formula remain distinct
    occurrences and need distinct tags when both are tagged. *)
Record occurrence : Type := Occ {
  occurrence_label : label;
  occurrence_formula : formula;
  occurrence_tag : option nat
}.

(** Relational assumptions are explicit and untagged. The ordinary Jdg
    abbreviation denotes exactly the relation-free legacy fragment. *)
Inductive relation_atom : Type :=
| ActionRelation (action : L.action_symbol) (payload : L.action_argument) (source target : label)
| CustomRelation (symbol : L.relation_symbol) (arguments : list label).
Definition relation_labels r := match r with
  | ActionRelation _ _ source target => [source;target]
  | CustomRelation _ arguments => arguments end.
Definition map_relation (f : label -> label) r := match r with
  | ActionRelation a p s t => ActionRelation a p (f s) (f t)
  | CustomRelation symbol arguments => CustomRelation symbol (map f arguments) end.
Definition relation_wfb r :=
  (match r with ActionRelation a p _ _ => L.action_wfb a p
   | CustomRelation symbol arguments => L.custom_relation_wfb symbol (length arguments) end) &&
  forallb (fun l => label_wfb l && label_nonemptyb l) (relation_labels r).
Definition relation_eq_dec : forall a b : relation_atom, {a=b}+{a<>b}.
Proof.
  decide equality; try apply L.action_eq_dec; try apply L.action_argument_eq_dec;
    try apply label_eq_dec; try apply L.relation_eq_dec.
  apply list_eq_dec; apply label_eq_dec.
Defined.
(** Read [Rdg R Gamma Delta] as [R ; Gamma => Delta]: relational assumptions,
    formula assumptions, and formula alternatives to establish. Lists retain
    their order and multiplicity, which matters to positional rule requests
    and exact graph-label comparisons. *)
Record judgment : Type := Rdg {
  relations : list relation_atom;
  antecedent : list occurrence;
  succedent : list occurrence
}.
Definition Jdg := Rdg [].
Definition map_label_occurrence (f : label -> label) o :=
  Occ (f o.(occurrence_label)) o.(occurrence_formula) o.(occurrence_tag).
(** Map relations as well as assertion labels. Leaving relation labels out
    would make a purported whole-judgment substitution semantically wrong. *)
Definition map_labels (f : label -> label) j :=
  Rdg (map (map_relation f) j.(relations))
    (map (map_label_occurrence f) j.(antecedent)) (map (map_label_occurrence f) j.(succedent)).
Definition rename_occurrence_tag (f : nat -> nat) o :=
  Occ o.(occurrence_label) o.(occurrence_formula) (option_map f o.(occurrence_tag)).
Definition rename_tags (f : nat -> nat) j :=
  Rdg j.(relations) (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) j.(antecedent)) (map (rename_occurrence_tag f) j.(succedent)).
Definition occurrence_eq_dec : forall a b : occurrence, {a=b}+{a<>b}.
Proof. decide equality; [decide equality; apply Nat.eq_dec | apply formula_eq_dec | apply label_eq_dec]. Defined.
Definition judgment_eq_dec : forall a b : judgment, {a=b}+{a<>b}.
Proof. decide equality; apply list_eq_dec; [apply occurrence_eq_dec|apply occurrence_eq_dec|apply relation_eq_dec]. Defined.
Definition judgment_eqb a b := if judgment_eq_dec a b then true else false.
Lemma judgment_eqb_spec a b : judgment_eqb a b = true <-> a=b.
Proof. unfold judgment_eqb; destruct (judgment_eq_dec a b); intuition discriminate. Qed.
(** A backlink compares all logical syntax after erasing tags only. It still
    compares relation contexts, label trees and formula order exactly. Tag
    routing across that backlink needs its own proved rule in Rules.v. *)
Definition erase_tag o := Occ o.(occurrence_label) o.(occurrence_formula) None.
Definition erase_tags j := Rdg j.(relations) (map erase_tag j.(antecedent)) (map erase_tag j.(succedent)).
Definition backlink_eqb a b := judgment_eqb (erase_tags a) (erase_tags b).
(** [right] selects the succedent policy: a tag on the left is rejected,
    and a tag on the right requires a traceable formula. [None] is allowed
    on either side, even for a formula that could otherwise be traced. *)
Definition occurrence_wfb (right : bool) o :=
  label_wfb o.(occurrence_label) && label_nonemptyb o.(occurrence_label) &&
  formula_wfb o.(occurrence_formula) &&
  match o.(occurrence_tag) with
  | None => true
  | Some _ => right && traceableb o.(occurrence_formula)
  end.

Definition judgment_tags j :=
  flat_map (fun o => match o.(occurrence_tag) with None => [] | Some n => [n] end)
    j.(succedent).

Fixpoint unique_tagsb (ts : list nat) :=
  match ts with
  | [] => true
  | t :: ts => negb (existsb (Nat.eqb t) ts) && unique_tagsb ts
  end.

(** Uniqueness makes lookup by tag unambiguous. The generic cyclic framework
    checks edge endpoints, but these object-language invariants belong here. *)
Definition judgment_wfb j :=
  forallb relation_wfb j.(relations) &&
  forallb (occurrence_wfb false) j.(antecedent) &&
  forallb (occurrence_wfb true) j.(succedent) && unique_tagsb (judgment_tags j).

Lemma unique_tagsb_spec ts : unique_tagsb ts = true <-> NoDup ts.
Proof.
  induction ts as [|t ts IH]; cbn.
  - split; constructor.
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, negb_true_iff, IH.
    assert (existsb (Nat.eqb t) ts = false <-> ~ In t ts) as H.
    { rewrite <- not_true_iff_false, existsb_exists.
      split.
      - intros H Hin. apply H. exists t; split; [exact Hin | apply Nat.eqb_refl].
      - intros H [x [Hin Heq]]. apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq. subst; contradiction. }
    rewrite H. split; [intros [Hn Hd]; constructor; assumption | intro Hd; inversion Hd; auto].
Qed.

(** This inductive predicate is the proof-facing version of [pureb]. Its
    constructors support induction over pure formulas; [pureb_spec] bridges
    it to the executable test. The historical constructor names [PureAll]
    and [PureEx] refer to generic extension slots here. *)
Inductive pure_formula : formula -> Prop :=
| PureTruth : pure_formula Truth
| PureFalsity : pure_formula Falsity
| PurePred p ts : pure_formula (Atom p ts)
| PureEqual t u : pure_formula (BinaryAtom t u)
| PureNeg a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (Neg a)
| PureConj a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Conj a b)
| PureDisj a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Disj a b)
| PureImpl a b : pure_formula a -> pure_formula b -> pure_formula (Impl a b)
| PureAll x a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (Extension x a)
| PureEx x a : pure_formula a -> pure_formula (Coextension x a).

Lemma pureb_spec a : pureb a = true <-> pure_formula a.
Proof.
  split.
  - induction a; cbn [pureb]; intro H; try discriminate;
      try solve [constructor]; try solve [constructor; apply IHa; exact H].
    all: apply andb_true_iff in H as [Ha Hb]; constructor;
      [apply IHa1; exact Ha | apply IHa2; exact Hb].
  - intro H; induction H; cbn [pureb];
      rewrite ?IHpure_formula, ?IHpure_formula1, ?IHpure_formula2; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Freshness covers every world term in assertion labels and relational
    arguments. Formula and action payloads have their own language-specific
    sorts; this check is specifically for the world-label namespace. *)
Fixpoint label_world_names l := match l with
  | Empty | TraceLabel _ => [] | StateLabel u => L.world_support u
  | Join a b => label_world_names a ++ label_world_names b end.
Definition judgment_world_names j :=
  flat_map (fun r => flat_map label_world_names (relation_labels r)) j.(relations) ++
  flat_map (fun o => label_world_names o.(occurrence_label)) (j.(antecedent) ++ j.(succedent)).
Definition world_freshb x j := negb (existsb (Nat.eqb x) (judgment_world_names j)).
Lemma world_freshb_spec x j : world_freshb x j = true <-> ~ In x (judgment_world_names j).
Proof. unfold world_freshb; rewrite negb_true_iff; apply occursb_false. Qed.

(** Propositional specifications for the reflected boundary. Payload
    validity belongs to the language; recursive structure belongs here.
    Each [_spec] theorem turns a successful Boolean check into a [Prop]
    usable in proofs, and conversely. Thus generation can compute checks
    while soundness proofs reason with conjunctions, [Forall] and [NoDup]. *)
Fixpoint formula_wf a : Prop := match a with
  | Truth | Falsity => True
  | Atom p args => L.atom_wfb p args = true
  | BinaryAtom a b => L.binary_atom_wfb a b = true
  | Neg a | First a => formula_wf a
  | Conj a b | Disj a b | Impl a b | Suffix a b | DualSuffix a b => formula_wf a /\ formula_wf b
  | Extension x a => L.extension_wfb x (pureb a) = true /\ formula_wf a
  | Coextension x a => L.coextension_wfb x (pureb a) = true /\ formula_wf a
  | Box p a | Diamond p a => program_wf p /\ formula_wf a end
with program_wf p : Prop := match p with
  | Atomic action payload => L.action_wfb action payload = true
  | Test a => formula_wf a
  | Seq a b | Choice a b => program_wf a /\ program_wf b
  | Star a => program_wf a end.
Lemma formula_program_wfb_spec :
  (forall a, formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a) /\
  (forall p, program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p).
Proof.
  apply formula_program_mutind; intros; cbn [formula_wfb program_wfb formula_wf program_wf];
    rewrite ?andb_true_iff; intuition.
Qed.
Lemma formula_wfb_spec a : formula_wfb a = true <-> formula_wf a.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.
Lemma program_wfb_spec p : program_wfb p = true <-> program_wf p.
Proof. apply formula_program_wfb_spec. Qed.
Fixpoint label_wf l : Prop := match l with
  | StateLabel u => L.world_term_wfb u = true
  | Join a b => label_wf a /\ label_wf b | _ => True end.
Lemma label_wfb_spec l : label_wfb l = true <-> label_wf l.
Proof. induction l; cbn [label_wfb label_wf]; rewrite ?andb_true_iff; intuition. Qed.
Lemma checked_labels_spec labels :
  forallb (fun l => label_wfb l && label_nonemptyb l) labels = true <->
  Forall (fun l => label_wf l /\ label_nonemptyb l = true) labels.
Proof.
  induction labels as [|l labels IH]; cbn.
  - split; intro H; [constructor|reflexivity].
  - rewrite !andb_true_iff, label_wfb_spec, IH.
    split; [intros [[Hl Hne] Hrest]; constructor; auto|intro H; inversion H; tauto].
Qed.
Definition relation_wf r :=
  (match r with ActionRelation a p _ _ => L.action_wfb a p
    | CustomRelation symbol args => L.custom_relation_wfb symbol (length args) end) = true /\
  Forall (fun l => label_wf l /\ label_nonemptyb l = true) (relation_labels r).
Lemma relation_wfb_spec r : relation_wfb r = true <-> relation_wf r.
Proof. unfold relation_wfb, relation_wf; rewrite andb_true_iff, checked_labels_spec; reflexivity. Qed.
Definition occurrence_wf right o :=
  label_wf o.(occurrence_label) /\ label_nonemptyb o.(occurrence_label) = true /\
  formula_wf o.(occurrence_formula) /\ match o.(occurrence_tag) with
  | None => True | Some _ => right=true /\ traceableb o.(occurrence_formula)=true end.
Lemma occurrence_wfb_spec right o : occurrence_wfb right o = true <-> occurrence_wf right o.
Proof.
  unfold occurrence_wfb, occurrence_wf; destruct (occurrence_tag o);
    rewrite !andb_true_iff, label_wfb_spec, formula_wfb_spec; intuition.
Qed.
Definition judgment_wf j :=
  Forall relation_wf j.(relations) /\ Forall (occurrence_wf false) j.(antecedent) /\
  Forall (occurrence_wf true) j.(succedent) /\ NoDup (judgment_tags j).
Lemma judgment_wfb_spec j : judgment_wfb j = true <-> judgment_wf j.
Proof.
  unfold judgment_wfb, judgment_wf; rewrite !andb_true_iff, unique_tagsb_spec, !forallb_forall, !Forall_forall.
  setoid_rewrite relation_wfb_spec; setoid_rewrite occurrence_wfb_spec; tauto.
Qed.

End MakeSyntax.

(** Consumers receive this exact syntax module instead of applying the
    inductive functor again. *)
Module Type SYNTAX (L : LANGUAGE).
  Include MakeSyntax L.
End SYNTAX.
TraceSafety.v:
(** * Compositional safety for finite traces

    These generic list lemmas support CounterLoop.v and NestedProgram.v.
    They reproduce the semantic overlap/power shapes without depending on a
    particular signature or kernel, so the lemmas apply to both model
    instances by definitional conversion. They prove every visited state
    safe, rather than only the final state or first observation. *)
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.
Import ListNotations.

(** Generic finite-trace invariant lemmas, independent of the LPL signature. *)
(** These definitions mirror [overlap_list], [compose] and [finite_power]
    in Semantics.v. Equal definition bodies let the safety proofs apply by
    conversion, without translating executions between representations. *)
Definition trace_join {A} (a b c : list A) :=
  exists prefix s tail, a = prefix ++ [s] /\ b = s :: tail /\ c = prefix ++ s :: tail.
Definition trace_compose {A} (R T : list A -> Prop) tr :=
  exists a b, R a /\ T b /\ trace_join a b tr.
Section Powers.
Context {A : Type}.
(** Iteration counts executions of [R]; the zero case is still the two-state
    stutter. Consequently safety must also cover that repeated initial state. *)
Fixpoint trace_power (R : list A -> Prop) n tr :=
  match n with 0 => exists s, tr = [s;s]
  | S n => trace_compose R (trace_power R n) tr end.
End Powers.
(** Safety assumes the invariant at the initial state and guarantees it on
    the entire execution list, including stuttering and intermediate states. *)
Definition trace_safe {A} (Inv : A -> Prop) (R : list A -> Prop) :=
  forall s tail, R (s :: tail) -> Inv s -> Forall Inv (s :: tail).

Lemma join_head {A} (a b c : list A) : trace_join a b c ->
  exists s tail tail', a = s :: tail /\ c = s :: tail'.
Proof. intros [[|x prefix] [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]]; cbn; eauto. Qed.
(** Combining two all-state invariants is valid even though their shared
    endpoint occurs only once in the overlapped result. No new state is
    introduced by joining the lists. *)
Lemma join_Forall {A} (Inv : A -> Prop) a b c : trace_join a b c ->
  Forall Inv a -> Forall Inv b -> Forall Inv c.
Proof.
  intros [prefix [s [tail [-> [-> ->]]]]] Ha Hb.
  rewrite Forall_app in Ha |- *; tauto.
Qed.
(** First use safety of [R]; its final shared state supplies the initial
    invariant needed by [T]. [join_Forall] then combines both all-state facts
    on the overlapped result. This is why endpoint overlap matters. *)
Lemma compose_safe {A} (Inv : A -> Prop) R T : trace_safe Inv R -> trace_safe Inv T ->
  trace_safe Inv (trace_compose R T).
Proof.
  intros HR HT s tail [a [b [Ha [Hb Ho]]]] Hs.
  destruct (join_head a b (s::tail) Ho) as [head [arest [crest [Hfirst Heq]]]].
  injection Heq as Hhead Htail; subst head. subst a.
  pose proof (HR s arest Ha Hs) as HsafeA.
  destruct Ho as [prefix [middle [btail [Haend [Hbstart Hresult]]]]].
  assert (Inv middle) as Hmiddle.
  { rewrite Forall_forall in HsafeA; apply HsafeA; rewrite Haend; apply in_app_iff; cbn; auto. }
  rewrite Hbstart in Hb. pose proof (HT middle btail Hb Hmiddle) as HsafeB.
  eapply join_Forall; [exists prefix,middle,btail; eauto|exact HsafeA|].
  now rewrite Hbstart.
Qed.
Lemma choice_safe {A} (Inv : A -> Prop) R T : trace_safe Inv R -> trace_safe Inv T ->
  trace_safe Inv (fun tr => R tr \/ T tr).
Proof. intros HR HT s tail [H|H] Hs; [eapply HR|eapply HT]; eauto. Qed.
(** Induct on an arbitrary finite iteration count. Zero repeats the initial
    state twice; the successor case is just compositional safety. No claim
    about reaching an exit condition or about infinite executions is needed. *)
Lemma power_safe {A} (Inv : A -> Prop) R : trace_safe Inv R -> forall n, trace_safe Inv (trace_power R n).
Proof.
  intros HR n; induction n.
  - intros s tail [start Heq] Hs; injection Heq as Hstart Htail; subst; repeat constructor; exact Hs.
  - apply compose_safe; assumption.
Qed.

From CyclistRocq.LPL Require Import Signature Syntax Semantics.
Module MakeSafety (L : LANGUAGE) (Syn : SYNTAX L) (Sem : SEMANTICS L Syn).
Export Syn Sem.
Section Model.
Context (M : Sem.model).
Variable Inv : state M -> Prop.
Hypothesis action_preserves : forall action payload s t,
  interpret_action M action payload s t -> Inv s -> Inv t.
(** Structural induction lifts one hypothesis about every atomic action to
    every program. Tests merely repeat a state, sequence and choice use the
    generic closure lemmas, and star uses induction on its finite count.
    The theorem is conditional on [action_preserves] for this chosen [Inv]. *)
Theorem program_safe p : trace_safe Inv (program_holds M p).
Proof.
  induction p.
  - intros s tail Hrun Hs; cbn [program_holds] in Hrun; apply atomic_trace_law in Hrun.
    destruct Hrun as [start [next [Heq Hstep]]]; injection Heq as Hstart Htail; subst.
    constructor; [exact Hs|]. constructor; [eapply action_preserves; eauto|constructor].
  - intros s tail [start [Heq _]] Hs; injection Heq as Hstart Htail; subst; repeat constructor; exact Hs.
  - apply compose_safe; assumption.
  - apply choice_safe; assumption.
  - intros s tail [n Hrun] Hs; apply (power_safe Inv (program_holds M p) IHp n s tail Hrun Hs).
Qed.
End Model.

(** The bridge needs a proved first-state property; arbitrary extensions are
    not assumed to have it. FOPL pure bodies and PPL atoms can supply it.
    Under this hypothesis, checking [a] on the current trace and every proper
    suffix is equivalent to checking [a] on each visited state's singleton.
    This theorem interprets [Always]; [program_safe] above establishes the
    separate invariant-preservation fact for executions. *)
Theorem always_head_forall M a :
  (forall s tail, formula_holds M a (s::tail) <-> formula_holds M a [s]) ->
  forall tr, tr<>[] ->
  (formula_holds M (Always a) tr <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds M a [s]) tr).
Proof.
  intros Hhead tr; induction tr as [|s tail IH]; intro Hne; [contradiction|].
  (* A singleton has no proper suffix. With a nonempty tail, [suffix_step]
     separates the current head observation from the remaining suffix
     obligation, allowing the induction hypothesis to establish [Forall]. *)
  destruct tail as [|t tail].
  - unfold Always, Eventually; rewrite !nonempty_neg by discriminate.
    change (~ (~ formula_holds M a [s] \/ formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) [s]) <-> Forall (fun s => formula_holds M a [s]) [s]).
    rewrite Forall_cons_iff; pose proof (suffix_singleton M Truth (Neg a) s) as Hsuffix.
    split; [intro H; split; [tauto|constructor]|intros [H _]; tauto].
  - specialize (IH ltac:(discriminate)).
    unfold Always, Eventually in *; rewrite nonempty_neg in * by discriminate.
    change (~ (formula_holds M (Neg a) (s::t::tail) \/ formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) (s::t::tail)) <->
      Forall (fun s => formula_holds M a [s]) (s::t::tail)).
    rewrite nonempty_neg, suffix_step by discriminate; rewrite nonempty_neg by discriminate.
    change (formula_holds M Truth (t::tail)) with True.
    rewrite (Hhead s (t::tail)).
    change (~ (formula_holds M (Neg a) (t::tail) \/ formula_holds M (Suffix Truth (Neg a)) (t::tail)) <->
      Forall (fun s => formula_holds M a [s]) (t::tail)) in IH.
    rewrite nonempty_neg in IH by discriminate; rewrite (Hhead t tail) in *.
    rewrite Forall_cons_iff; tauto.
Qed.
End MakeSafety.
